name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: The Blood Run in Eskilstuna takes place on September 7, 2026, and is organized by Eskilstuna Athletics. The race offers men's and women's classes for 5 km and 10 km, as well as the Little Blood Run and the Special Race, with courses described as fast and flat. The event is held in the City Park and combines a recreational run with the purpose of raising awareness about blood donation, including a blood donor gift and picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and registration can be done individually or in teams.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
5 km and 10 km courses are measured
Start and event area in the City Park
additional: Registration is done individually or in teams (up to 5 people per team); team members can participate in different distances within the same team. For larger registrations, an Excel template is available for download from the registration page, and the organizer can assist with customer side/rabatt code for companies with more than 20 participants. A blood donor gift is handed out at the Unilabs blood donation center tent at the event area. Storage/collection of bags is offered (drop-off/pick-up times are 17:00 - 20:00). Course routes: 5 km and 10 km. The Little Blood Run is 800 meters. The event area includes a bag drop and picnic basket; participation can be individual or in teams (up to 5 persons per team).

name: Bėgimas Kaune
description: Annual pink ribbon charity run dedicated to breast cancer prevention in Kaunas. It is a short, amateur, and fun running route, a joyful and positive sports celebration decorated with pink costumes, paints, balloons, and ribbons. During PINK RUN, both men and women can express support and love for their closest women: mother, daughter, sister, wife, or best friend.

images.alt_text: Rožinis bėgimas Kaune: didelis žmonių būrys rožiniais marškinėliais, scena ir renginio atmosfera.
Bėgimo Kaune startas, dalyviai bėga.
Rožinis kaspinas ant džinsinio audinio, simbolizuojantis kovą su krūties vėžiu.
Moteris su rožiniu megztiniu ir krepšiu su abstrakčiu piešiniu, skirtu krūties vėžio prevencijai.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 is a five-stage sports event encompassing cross-country running, MTB mountain biking, and rogaining competitions. The event promotes active leisure in nature and popularizes sports among participants of all ages. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, and the main organizer is VšĮ Sportas miške. Participants compete in different age groups and event types, with a common start for all groups during the event. The time limit for the competitions is 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining.
course_highlights: The competitions are held at Šilo primary school stadium
The start for all groups is simultaneous and uniform across all stages
The event includes running, MTB mountain biking, and rogaining disciplines
additional: Number and time tracking devices are issued from 16:30 to 17:30 at the competition site. The start time for the cycling discipline is 18:00 (the night stage at 19:15). The running discipline starts at 18:05 (night stage at 19:20). The hikers' start is at 18:10 (night stage at 19:25). Rogaining maps are distributed at 17:45, with the start at 18:00. The time limit to complete the competitions is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining). The event includes multiple sports disciplines, registration is on-site, participants of all ages are welcome, and there are several stages and different disciplines.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual recreational race in Skärblacka that offers a folk festival for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town with start and finish at the Folkets Hus, and there is also a 4 km walk class as well as a Little Children's Race of 900 meters. The race is open to all levels and features a generous prize table, lotteries, and goodie bags for participants. Organizers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome you to the starting line on September 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka with start and finish at Folkets Hus
The course runs on asphalt, bike paths, gravel, and partly on trails
Walk class 4 km (shortened) and Little Children's Race 900 m near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Bib numbers can be picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday, September 8 from 11:00 to 18:00; remaining bibs will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late registration can be done in connection with the bib number distribution. All participants receive a goodie bag; prize table, sprint prizes, and lotteries will be held (including tire prizes, course record bonuses). The walk class was introduced in 2024; bib numbers are picked up at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via RaceID; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment only by Swish or cash; chip records the time on the bib; medical services, food, and drinks are available on site.

name: Blodomloppet (Växjö)
price_range: 350 kr till 400 kr för vuxna, 50 kr för Lilla Blodomloppet
description: Blood Race in Växjö is a fun run that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km running, as well as a 5 km walking class, all starting and finishing in the beautiful Linné Park. The courses are flat and fast with lots of crowd support, making it a perfect race for both competitive runners and recreational participants who want to enjoy an energetic atmosphere. There is also a Little Blood Race for children, which runs in a loop in the park. Registration can be done individually or in teams, and late registration is available on-site on the same day.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Linné Park, Växjö
Flat and fast 5 km course, officially measured
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (up to 5 participants per team). Team members can participate in different distances. Late registration is possible on-site in Linné Park on race day. There is a special dog class (ICA Pälskling). Changing rooms and toilets are available at the event area. Bibs and T-shirts are distributed on-site. There are water stations along the course and medical services on-site. The race concludes with a large picnic for participants. The event promotes blood donation and health, with registration available until the day of the event and on-site in Linné Park.

name: Rava järve jooks, Liikumissari 8.Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 9.etapp
description: The Rava Lake Run is part of the Movement Series 8, the Järvamaa Lakes Run series, and takes place at Rava Lake in Järvamaa. Participants of various age groups, from toddlers to seniors, take part in the race. A distinctive feature of the race is completing one lap around the lake, with awards given to the fastest men and women. It is a traditional and community-involving race that offers a sporting challenge and an opportunity to enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Completing one lap around the lake
Suitable for different age groups from toddlers to seniors
Takes place at Rava Lake, offering beautiful nature
additional: The Järvamaa Lakes Run records are kept in several age categories: toddlers (born in 2020 and later), 2016-2019, 2013-2015, 2010-2012, 1992-2009, 1972-1991, born in 1971 and earlier. The race awards the fastest men and women who complete one lap around the lake in the shortest time. Participation is open to various age groups and the course is suitable for both runners and walkers. During the season, there are also raffle prizes, and at the end of the year, awards are given to the best participants.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day race (September 11-13, 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km up to 100 miles. The races take place on technical singletracks, coastal paths, and faster sections, suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners depending on the chosen distance. The event focuses on the trail experience with local food offerings, lectures, and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. Organizers provide GPS tracking, GPX files, and support at water stations for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: Trail with forest paths and coastal cliffs along Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 meters of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Surface: about 85% trail, 10% gravel, 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available for download; live GPS tracking and intermediate/final results are offered. The event is cupless – bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, window decal, and a handcrafted wooden finisher's medal/belt buckle depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists are provided (including 1 liter of fluids, mobile phone, navigation tools, first aid kit, map, GPS tracker, emergency blanket, rain jacket, headlamp) for 100 km and 100 miles. Early cut-offs and water station locations are published; the organizer plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (fee approx. 100 SEK, paid via Swish on-site). Night Trail and 2 km children’s race are included; start/finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park; bus transfers and GPX tracks are included in the information for different distances.

name: Rosvallaspelen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early-Bird pris fram tills 31 mars 2026: 200 kronor

description: Rosvallaloppet is a recreational race organized with start and finish at Rosvalla Arena in Nyköping. The race offers distances of five and ten kilometers that run on trails at Brandholmen, with start and lap inside the arena. It is a day filled with activity, socializing, and exercise, with medals for all participants and prize giving for the top finishers in the women's and men's categories. During the race, there are water stations with sports drinks and a simple kiosk on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the arena.
course_highlights: Start and finish inside Rosvalla Arena
5 km and 10 km on trails at Brandholmen
The 10 km race consists of two laps on the same course
additional: Number bibs are to be collected on race day no later than 60 minutes before start. Late registration is possible from April 30 to May 7 via the website and on race day with Swish payment. Timing is done with a transponder loaned out at the bib distribution and must be returned after the race. Lost transponders will be charged at 800 SEK. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women's and men's categories, as well as raffle prizes from sponsors. Sports drinks are available at the start/finish and on the 10 km lap. A simple kiosk is available on site. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the arena. The race requires pre-registration via anmalmig.nu; the event also includes family activities and is open to all levels.

name: Molėtai Bėga
description: Molėtų sports center together with the Lithuanian Amateur Running Association invites you to the traditional, fourth edition of the run "Molėtai runs 2024", which will take place on October 20, 2024. The race distances include 3 km (Girls/Boys, born in 2006 and younger), 9 km (Women/Men, aged 19-44 and 45 and older), and a 400 m track with no age restrictions. This event brings together running enthusiasts and provides an opportunity to participate in various age groups.

images.alt_text: Bėgikė interviu po varžybų.
Bėgimo apdovanojimų ceremonija: vyras su taure, ant kurios bėgikų siluetai.
Bėgimo varžybos mieste, matomos pro langą.
Molėtų astronomijos observatorija, Lietuva.
Bėgikas bėga su Lietuvos vėliava.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running race held in the city center of Tallinn at Freedom Square. The start will be given on September 12, 2026, at 14:00. The race is suitable for both runners and walkers, offering options with and without timing. Participants are guaranteed a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the autumn beauty of the city.
course_highlights: 10 km long route in the center of Tallinn
Option to participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% discount for seniors from 60 years old and for youth under 20 years old. 10% discount for groups of at least 10 people registering at the same time. The event offers discounts for seniors, youth, and groups and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, which takes place from September 11 to 13, 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running competition aimed at young people, taking place in the city center of Tallinn at Freedom Square. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the opportunity to participate in a fun and sporting event. The run starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and supporting an active lifestyle among youth. Registration is simple, and early participants can benefit from discounted prices.
course_highlights: Takes place in the city center of Tallinn at Freedom Square
Evening start at 18:30
Suitable and safe running environment for young people
additional: Registering early allows for lower participation fees. There are also special discounts for youth and seniors within the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are guaranteed a safe running environment and organization. The race takes place in Tallinn's Old Town and Freedom Square, giving participants the chance to be part of the youth athletes community, and there are awards for the best competitors.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Children's Paala Lake Run is a traditional children's race held on the shores of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The race features different distances according to children's age, ranging from 300 meters to two laps around the lake. The race is organized by the health sports club JOOSU and offers children the opportunity to engage in active sports and enjoy nature. The race starts on September 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM, and participants will receive prizes and souvenirs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Paala Lake shore
Run around Paala Lake, one lap 1200 m
Distances from 300 m up to 2 laps (2400 m)
additional: Registration begins at 10:00 AM on the same day. Distances are divided by age groups: toddler run 300 m (5 years and younger), main run 1 lap around the lake (boys and girls aged 6 - 10, girls aged 11 - 12), and main run 2 laps around the lake (boys aged 11 - 12). Many prizes and souvenirs. The race is organized by the health sports club JOOSU. Registration takes place on-site; the event focuses on health and movement and is aimed at children and youth.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause – mental health of children and youth. The event will take place on September 12, 2026, across Poland, encouraging participants to run together and act for the community. Every lap, kilometer, and minute on the route matters, emphasizing the idea of community and help. This anniversary edition invites runners to actively participate and support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations in Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno, and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option with an app
Relays and runs for children and adults for charitable purposes
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining sports activity with a charitable goal for the mental health of children and youth. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where not only the result matters but primarily collective action and social support. The event supports children's and youth's mental health, includes relay races and fundraising for therapies, and features participation in many Polish cities as well as virtual participation.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race at Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organized by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses are varied with asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails, starting and finishing at Edbergavallen, and offer distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes both recreational and competitive runners and teams.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails along Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
10 km includes hilly terrain trail (Humpa illuminated trail) and is more challenging
additional: Registration is done via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank transfer (discount codes available online). Bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; late registration on site from 10:00 (Swish or cash). Distance info: 700 m (children, no timing), 1.3 km (children, with timing), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel), and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded upon completing the 10th or 20th race (adult categories). Team registration (4 - 6 participants) includes a picnic basket for 5 people; team registration may close on September 7 if baskets are sold out. A kiosk is available at the race area. Award ceremony around 12:00 for the 1.3 km and around 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km, and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; additional commemorative medal available at the 10th or 20th race for adults; team registration for 4 - 6 participants; bib pickup at Edbergavallen; ICA picnic basket after finish; kiosks at the race area; prize distribution according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna City Trail is a welcoming trail run offered at 5, 10, and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast asphalt sections with winding trails through beech and pine forests, offering magnificent views over Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed for both the experience and performance, suitable for both recreational runners and more experienced athletes. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, ending with a downhill run from Grännaberget on winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trail through beech forest, gravel roads, and challenging hills with magnificent views
additional: Joint start from the square through Gränna to the harbor where timing begins; timing on all distances; unique medal for all participants; arena and finish area in the center of Gränna with proximity to cafes, eateries, and accommodations; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances of 5, 10, and 21 km. The courses may be altered depending on conditions and permits.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26 km trail run in the Paradiset Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race offers technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks over marshes, and through open pine forests - a demanding but scenic trail event. The distance is part of the Outnorth Trailtour and the race emphasizes community, personal challenge, and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organizer is Trailrunning Sweden AB and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience the wilderness south of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with ascents and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks over marshes and small ponds, as well as open pine forest sections
26 km through Paradiset Nature Reserve - part of the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: Date of the race is set for September 12, 2026. The event highlights after-party/finish line atmosphere and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organizer is listed as Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as challenging with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks, and marshes. The courses are marked with ribbons and start groups are organized by distance; start times and aid stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; there will be a hydration station and afterparty at Oasen.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes the Nybro Backyard 12h as part of their annual competition program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format welcoming runners seeking an ultra challenge in a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes movement, community, and joy in nature and also offers rental and personal training in Nybro. For questions, contact details for Topp & Dröm are available on their website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Organized in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
Organizer's focus: movement, community, and joy in nature
additional: Organizer: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organization number: 969796-6407. Contact email: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish for payment is 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rental (roller and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race offers a 6,706 m lap, starts every full hour, and changing rooms/showers are available nearby; parking at the stadium and camping/parking space via Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp and bibs are collected from 06:30 to 07:45 on race day.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly race and recreational run in Saltsjö-Duvnäs that winds through a beautiful and hilly villa community. The event is organized by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and features races for children and adults with start and finish at Ringparken. Everyone can participate, whether you are a recreational runner or more competitive, and the event emphasizes community and enjoyment. Registration opens June 1, 2026, and the race takes place on September 12, 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep climbs (including Fogdevägen, Vargungevägen)
5 km and 10 km have the same route; 10 km is run as two laps
Shorter race (1.7 km) and kids' race with start/finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens June 1, 2026. The final regular pre-registration usually closes around September 11; registrations after that are accepted until race day with a higher fee. Bibs can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (no later than one hour before start). The timing chip is attached to the bib; the 10 km races use two bibs (front and back). Registration is binding. Registration opens June 1, 2026; distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km as two laps); children's race at 11:00 and adult race around 12:30; bibs can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; pre-registration until September 11; the race is seeking volunteers.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott; Ideon Science Park; Medicon Village
description: The Innovation Relay Race is a team relay race held in the Brunnshög and Ideon areas in northeastern Lund. The start, finish, and exchange zone are located in Nobelparken, and the course winds northward towards ESS and through Kunskapsparken before returning to Nobelparken. A team consists of participants in women's, men's, or mixed categories, and each runner runs approximately 5 km. The event is organized in collaboration between IFK Lund Athletics, Ideon Science Park, and Medicon Village and is suitable for both corporate and student teams as well as families in connection with the Nobelloppet and Brunnshögskalaset.
course_highlights: The course passes through Nobelparken, Kunskapsparken, and towards ESS/Max IV
Relatively flat course with about 10 meters of elevation change
Surface is varied with gravel and asphalt; view from the hill over northwestern Lund
additional: Teams consist of 2 - 4 people (companies specify 2 - 4, some texts mention 4); each runner runs about 5 km. The first leg starts together at 14:00; subsequent exchange times depend on the team's pace (no maximum time). There is an opportunity to change clothes, store outerwear, and enjoy food and drinks in Nobelparken; medals or sausages after finishing. Recommended transportation: tram line 1 to Brunnshögstorget. 4-person team; start, finish, and exchange zone in Nobelparken (Brunnshög); the course goes towards ESS and Kunskapsparken; late registration on September 1; student discount; Mecenat card mentioned at bib pickup; collaboration between IFK Lund Athletics, Ideon Science Park, and Medicon Village.

name: Närkespelen
description: Närkespelen in Hallsberg is a traditional athletics competition organized by Åsbro GoIF. The event is held annually and brings together athletes for a day of various disciplines and competition elements. The event is well-organized with a clear schedule and has a long history with result lists from many years back. It is a welcome opportunity for both active participants and spectators to experience athletics in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Includes several athletics disciplines
Organized by local sports club Åsbro GOIF
District championships in pole vault for youth and adults
additional: The event takes place in Hallsberg and is part of the regional athletics calendar. It is an occasion for both competitive athletes and recreational participants to engage in a friendly and inspiring environment.

name: HIK-Kampen
description: HIK-Kampen is an athletics competition organized by the Hovslätts IK Athletics Section in Jönköping. The event gathers athletes of various ages and levels to compete in a welcoming and engaging environment. The event is part of the club's tradition to promote athletics and community in the region. Participants can follow the club's website for updates and information.
course_highlights: Different distances for various age groups
Held in Jönköping
Includes sprints and longer runs
additional: Results from previous years include categories such as P15 80m, women 800m, and P13 600m, demonstrating a wide range of participants.

name: Vilniaus maratonas
description: The Rimi Vilnius Marathon, taking place on September 8, 2024, will start for the 22nd time in Vilnius, at Cathedral Square. It is the largest run in Lithuania, attracting professional runners and enthusiasts from across the country and abroad. Participants can choose from various distances: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a 200 m children's run.
course_highlights: 22nd edition of the Rimi Vilnius Marathon
Start at Cathedral Square in Vilnius
Multiple race distances: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and 200 m children's run
Largest running event in Lithuania
Attracts both professionals and amateurs from Lithuania and abroad

images.alt_text: Bėgikai prie starto linijos „Rimi Vilniaus maratonas“.
Bėgikų minia „Rimi Vilniaus maratono“ starte.
Vilniaus maratono bėgimas, finišo linija, bėgikai.
Rimi Vilniaus maratonas logo, 2024 rugsėjo 8 d.

name: Swedbank Vilniaus maratonas 2026
description: Swedbank Vilnius Marathon is the largest running event in Lithuania, taking place in the Old Town of Vilnius. The event offers various distances from children's runs to a full marathon, allowing each participant to find a suitable challenge. The marathon routes wind through the streets, parks, and Neris River embankment of Vilnius Old Town, providing unforgettable views and emotions. It is an international event attracting runners from different countries around the world and a great opportunity to experience the joy of sport and community.
course_highlights: The route winds through Vilnius Old Town, Vingis Park, and the Neris River embankment
Marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and children's running distances
Picturesque city streets and parks with an international participant community
additional: Participant number is attached to the shirt on the chest and must be clearly visible. Participants of the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, walking, and children's runs will receive commemorative medals. Biotoilets will be available at the event gathering points. Minors must have parental or guardian consent to pick up their numbers. Corporate registration closes on September 1. The event offers various distances, children's runs, and walking events; registration information and free shirts for early registrants.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for those who enjoy movement, music, and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual, and coffee breaks. It is a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections, and experience summer energy in one morning event. Registration is required, and participants are encouraged to bring sports shoes, swim shorts, and a towel.
course_highlights: 5 km social run with DJ music
Mobility training
Ice bath ritual Vytauto Ice Bath
additional: The event takes place several times during the summer, including on 2026-09-13. Participants are encouraged to bring sports shoes, swim shorts, and a towel. RUN & RAVE is a community event combining movement, music, and good energy, with DJ music and an ice bath after the run. The event location is Palanga, and the date is September 13, 2026. The event includes social runs, city surroundings, registration is mandatory in advance, and it aims to promote community spirit and an active lifestyle.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten Kilometer Run is a street race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two loops of 5 km each, totaling a distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and integrate the local running community. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this event.
course_highlights: The route consists of two loops of 5 km each
Street race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and surrounding streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and the surrounding streets. The route includes two loops of 5 km. Registrations are conducted through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer provides contact and support through the Złotów Social Activity Center. The 10 km street race offers online registration, is supported by local companies, features an attractive route, and prizes.

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity for competitive racing, training, and eliminations across various rounds scheduled for the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts, offering also the possibility to rent cars and receive individual training sessions with instructors. It is an excellent opportunity to experience racing thrills and improve skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional infrastructure
Opportunity to participate in various rounds and eliminations of the 2026 season
Options for training and individual instructor-led coaching
additional: Car rental options available for personal use or as a gift. The starter package includes participation for a team member, the possibility of co-driving (age >17), full catering, individual timing measurement, and training options with an instructor. Payments for participation must include the appropriate title format to confirm attendance. Multiple rounds including training, eliminations, and night races; focus on sporty driving and excitement on the track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Hope Run and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers Championships is a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska, supporting the activities of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social goal, engaging the local community and the legal environment. It is a well-established event that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including runs for children and Nordic walking
additional: The run is charitable in nature, supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registrations open on March 1, 2026. No details about the route, start times, or fees are available on the website. The event is planned for September 13, 2026, and includes different forms of running and activities, with participation supporting the activities of the Piotr Hospice.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a street running event scheduled for September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km route runs through the city's representative streets, including the area around Jasna Góra, which gives the race a special prestige. The race has official certification, attracting competitors focused on fast pace and personal bests. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in a picturesque urban setting.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the center of Częstochowa
Course passes near Jasna Góra
Official certification of the route conducive to fast running
additional: Registration takes place at the Sports Hall of IV Liceum, payment in cash. The event also includes training sessions and information from sponsors.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The XII Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Biegacz Club Chyży. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and is part of the Grand Prix of the Nowotomyski County in running. The race is scheduled to start at 9:00 AM, and the race office is open from 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM. The race attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared route.
course_highlights: Fast 10 km route
Part of the Grand Prix of the Nowotomyski County
Start at 9:00 AM, race office open from 7:00 AM
additional: Race office open from 7:00 AM to 8:30 AM. Winners' ceremony at 10:45 AM. The race is co-financed by the Gmina Nowy Tomyśl and the Nowotomyski County. The event also includes 5 km runs, with registration opening on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

location: Hel - Jastarnia - Rozewie, Półwysep Helski, Pomorskie, Poland

description: The North Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on September 13, 2026, on the Hel Peninsula, combining the tradition of the North Marathon and Marathon Relays under one banner. The race route runs through picturesque locations of Hel, Jastarnia, and Rozewie, along the Puck Bay, with views of the sea and four lighthouses, which give the race a distinctive character. The event offers a variety of distances for runners of all levels, from marathons and relays, through half marathons, 10 km, and 5 km, to a children's run - Little Lighthouse Runner. It is not only a sport event but also a journey through beautiful coastal corners and contact with nature.
course_highlights: The route runs along Puck Bay with a view of the sea
There are four lighthouses on the route: in Hel, Jastarnia, and two in Rozewie
The route leads through the most beautiful corners of the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The race route is available in .GPX, .KML, and .TCX formats for download. Registration is open from January 1, 2026, to August 24, 2026, until 3:00 PM. Co-organizers and partners include local sports and cultural centers and a holiday resort. Honorary patronage by the Marshal of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The Little Lighthouse Runner is dedicated to children and youth up to 14 years old. The route is available for download in .GPX, .KML, .TCX formats; marine and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The XV Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running that guarantees a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half marathon route runs through scenic areas along fields, forests, and apple orchards, giving the race a unique character. The event attracts runners of all ages, offering also children's and youth races. Organizers take care of participants by providing attractive start packages and sponsor support.
course_highlights: The route runs along fields, forests, and apple orchards
Scenic areas provide a unique race atmosphere
Family event with races for children and youth
additional: Start packages include eco-friendly bags, reflective bands, and thermal mugs with the sponsor Fakro logo. The start packages also contain Kamis spices. The limit for children's and youth races is 150 participants. The race office is located at ul. Szarych Szeregów 8 in Tarczyn. Urban area, online registration, family event, local sponsors and partners.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
location: Jedlnia-Letnisko, Kozienice County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Radomski Marathon of Sobriety is an annual running event organized by the Association "Biegiem Radom!". The race takes place on scenic routes through the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a marathon, half-marathon, and other accompanying runs. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, as well as integrating the local running community. This event with an established tradition attracts both amateurs and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes run through Kozienice Forest
Picturesque forest trails and natural surroundings
Available distances: marathon and half-marathon
additional: Participants can personalize medals for a symbolic fee of 10 PLN. The organizer encourages participation in the marathon, half-marathon, and other accompanying runs. The "Biegiem Radom!" association also conducts integration and promotional activities for running in the region. The event includes various distances, including marathon and half-marathon, with training plans and support for participants. Registration opens from September 14, 2025.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Society, which will take place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km, which run around the reservoir with multiple laps and finish on the reservoir grounds. The race promotes physical activity, integration, and a friendly sporting atmosphere, as well as supports the promotion of the city of Żyrardów and the Mazowsze region. The event is open to adults, and on the 10 km distance, active wheelchair users can also participate.
course_highlights: Route around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance, 2 laps for the 5 km distance
Start and finish located at the Żyrardów Reservoir, ul. Ziołowa 17
additional: Online registration is available until September 10, 2026. After this date, registration is only possible at the event office until 9:00 AM on the day of the race. Each participant receives a start number with a chip at the event office. For the 10 km race, active wheelchair users can participate. The event base, start, finish, and parking are located at the Żyrardów Reservoir, ul. Ziołowa 17. Distances: 10 km and 5 km, online registration, a time limit of 100 minutes for the main race, wheelchair start options, and a swimming area available during the weekend of the event.

name: Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years of hiatus, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö – a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event includes four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman, and the classic main race Mälarömilen (10 km). Start and finish are at Träkvista sports field, and the event emphasizes community, joy of movement, and fast courses for those who want to compete. There is also an option to register entire teams or companies through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Asphalted walkways and park trails
Signage at each kilometer mark
Start and finish at Träkvista sports field; looping on the walkway north of the sports field
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is possible on race day with an increased fee. The number of starting places is limited, and registration is valid only after payment is completed. Timing and bibs are used in all categories (exceptions: Mälarö Knattelopp without timing; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys 9 - 11 years timing without placement). The event area is located at Träkvista sports field with medical services, a water station just after the start/loop, as well as toilets, showers, and changing rooms in the KOM building. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301 - 311 (stop Träkvista Idrottsplats). A total cap of 1,000 runners, and all surplus funds go back to Mälarö SOK's sports activities. The race offers corporate and team registration and support for teams.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively and popular relay race in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is a team event for teams of four people, where each runner runs a distance of approximately 3 km. The starting shot is at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an award ceremony with a raffle after the finish. The event welcomes everything from elite teams to recreational groups and encourages colorful and imaginative elements along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team event: 4 people per team, each segment approximately 3 km
Prize ceremony around 18:15 and raffle on race numbers
additional: Number bibs are distributed at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday, September 11 from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday, September 12 from 11:00 to 13:30 (then at the start and finish area). Food sales are available on site and a Post-Run package is offered for the entire team (price 140 SEK). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (hydration stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and raffles. Teams pick up bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually between 11:00 and 13:30 on the days prior) and there is a Post-Run package for the team (e.g., 140 SEK according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety guidelines according to authorities and promotes sustainability with thematic elements.

name: Greičio Ratai
description: VšĮ Nesustabdomas bėgimas (Volvere Run running club) together with the Sports Events Association will host races on September 19, 2025, at Vingio Park Stadium, including 60 m, 1000 m, and a 5×1000 m relay race. This is a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to test their strength across various distances and enjoy the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: 60 m race
1000 m race
5×1000 m relay race

Estafetinis bėgimas. Bėgikai su estafetės lazdomis prie starto/finišo linijos.
Greičio Ratai 2022 afišas. Bėgikas su estafetės lazda.
Bėgikų grupė su vėliavomis, rodanti sporto renginį.

name: Bėgimas "Ateik ir Įveik!"
description: Run "Come and Conquer" is an unforgettable event filled with challenges and surprises, where the most resilient participants are invited to run through the adventure course winding through Ažuolynas Park with hills and slopes! From a real test of endurance to active entertainment – with various distances and obstacle sections, everyone will find something suitable – whether you are an adrenaline junkie or an active leisure enthusiast. This year, the run attracted a record number of participants and was organized at the KTU Student Campus and Ažuolynas Park.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo "Ateik ir Įveik" renginio nuotrauka. Bėgikai starto linijoje.
Sportininkas su Lietuvos vėliava ant kliūčių ruožo.
Bėgikų startas, pasiruošę lenktynėms.
Bėgiko nuotrauka su medaliu ir marškinėliais su užrašu "Ateik ir Įveik!"

name: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas
location: Zelvė, Elektrėnų savivaldybė, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The Lithuanian Blind and Visually Impaired Athletics Road Race Championship is a specialized running event designed for blind and visually impaired athletes. The competition takes place in Zelvė, Elektrėnai Municipality, and is organized by the Lithuanian Blind Sports Federation (LASF). The federation has been actively supporting blind and visually impaired sports in Lithuania since 1990, aiming to create equal opportunities to participate in various sports competitions and events. The championship is an important tradition that encourages physical activity and community among athletes.
course_highlights: The competition takes place on a road in Zelvė, Elektrėnai Municipality
Designed for blind and visually impaired athletes
Organized by the Lithuanian Blind Sports Federation
additional: The event promotes inclusion and the development of sports among athletes with visual impairments, and will be held on September 19, 2026, in Zelvė.

name: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!", skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui
description: The 'Come and Conquer!' run is a traditional event organized by Kaunas University of Technology, dedicated to the memory of Prof. K. Baršauskas. The event invites participants to test their strength on various running and walking routes, including a new 5 km run with dogs. It is a great opportunity to spend active time, promote a healthy lifestyle, and participate in a community sports event. The competition takes place at the KTU stadium and Ąžuolynas park, with participants awarded commemorative medals and prizes according to age groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish of the race at KTU stadium (Radvilėnų pl. 19, Kaunas)
Routes: 10 km run, 5 km run, 5 km run with dogs, 5 km walk, 200 m children's obstacle run
During the event, part of the registration fee is donated to an animal shelter
additional: Event program: bib collection from 10:30 to 11:50, 10 km run starts at 12:00, 5 km run, run with dogs, and walk start at 12:10, 200 m children's run starts at 13:40, awards at 13:55. Registration is free for members of KTU sports teams. The registration fee is transferred to the Lithuanian Running Enthusiasts Association account. Participant number transfer is prohibited. The team from the most represented KTU faculty/administrative unit, the youngest, and the oldest participant are awarded. Routes include running and walking; age groups: children up to 12 years old, adults. Online registration is open until September 18. The start fee is paid to the Lithuanian Running Enthusiasts Association.

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
location: Heino Lipu staadion, Jõhvi, Jõhvi vald, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: Jõhvi Community Run is a traditional running event held for the 39th time at the Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated and now runs through city streets, a park, and the shops of the Park Center. The race offers an exciting and diverse running experience for both 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and a good sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Updated course runs through city streets, park, and shopping center
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at Heino Lipp Stadium
additional: The run takes place on September 19, 2026, at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. The course has been updated to include city streets, a park, and a shopping center. The main distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is community-oriented and traditional, offering a sporting challenge for runners of different levels. The race is held at Heino Lipp Stadium and is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series, with participant numbers reaching 600-700, and runners can choose between different distances. Participation fees start from 10 euros, and registration is primarily before the event. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes the joy of participation and community bonding.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Autumn Run 2026 is a running, walking, and strolling event held in Ida-Viru County, inviting all movement enthusiasts to participate. The event is part of the activities of the Movement Enthusiasm Competence Center, aimed at promoting a healthy and active lifestyle. The Autumn Run offers an opportunity to enjoy movement and support mental and physical health. Participants can choose a suitable form of movement and experience the joy of moving together.
course_highlights: Takes place around Astri Center in Ida-Viru County
Suitable for running, walking, and strolling
An event supporting participants' activity levels and promoting health
additional: The event includes running, walking, and strolling and will take place on September 19, 2026. Registration is open, and the event is aimed at all age and skill levels.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
location: Saarepeedi Rahvamaja, Saarepeedi, Põhja-Sakala vald, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Mountain Run is a traditional race held at the Saarepeedi Community Center. The race offers participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful scenery and mountainous trails. It is suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners who want to test their endurance and skill. The event organizers invite all running enthusiasts to participate and enjoy a sporty day.
course_highlights: Mountainous terrain around Saarepeedi
Beautiful natural views
Diverse and varied route
additional: The event is part of the Seeriajooks series and likely includes different distance options and results, providing athletes with the opportunity to enjoy sport and nature.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Evening Half Marathon Łódź is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a center of culture and science. The 21.097 km route takes runners through the most recognizable places in the city, combining industrial history with modernity. This race is not only about the result but also about the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant
Route passes through the most recognizable places in Łódź
Evening street race in the city center
additional: The participant limit is 5000 people. The start package includes a souvenir drawstring bag and a medal for everyone who completes the race. There is an option to purchase an official technical T-shirt by SMMASH. The participant limit is 5000, with discounts for PKO Bank Polski customers when paying online. Registrations began a week before the event. The route covers key points of Łódź.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km in the picturesque Gontyńca massif. Participants cover as much distance as possible, benefiting from well-equipped refreshment stations after each loop. The route offers changing landscapes at different times of the day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as figurative beehives shaped like ancient gods. This is a special experience for runners seeking challenges and unforgettable sensations.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of about 10 km
Refreshment station after each loop for participants
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the route
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The route runs on loops of about 10 km. A refreshment station is available after each loop. Participants can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The route traverses the Gontyńca massif with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain, and forest paths, participant limit of 150 in each race, preparations from 8 to 20 weeks.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race that will take place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located at the parking lot near Opera Leśna, and the route runs through scenic areas around this location. The race is part of a series of four events held at different dates and locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the opportunity to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Route of 5 km around Opera Leśna in Sopot
Start and finish at the parking lot near Opera Leśna
Race takes place in a picturesque park and green areas
additional: Limit of 250 participants. Only runners with start numbers and organizational staff are allowed on the route. Participants line up at the start in a designated zone. The finish line is located at the same place as the start. The event includes several editions, with the main race on September 19, 2026; discounts available for Sopot residents with the Sopot Card; routes include beach and park areas; participants receive medals and drinks.

description: Uppsala Running Club welcomes elite runners, recreational runners, and children of all ages to the King Bear Race - Uppsala's cross-country race with the family at the center. The race is organized at OK Linné's club house and offers several distances (10 km, 6 km, trail run, and children's race). The event now has fixed times, bib number distribution with electronic chips, and prize giving, with the 20th anniversary of the race in 2026.
course_highlights: Mostly gravel roads and forest trails, with sections of asphalt
Three distances: approximately 10 km, just over 6 km, and trail run about 5 km; courses have kilometer markers
Water stations: two at 10 km, one at 6 km; water also available at the finish
additional: Bib numbers with electronic chips can be collected at Löplabbet, Dragarbrunns Torg 6 on Friday, September 19 from 12:00 to 18:30 or on race day from 09:00 until one hour before each start (30 minutes before children's races). Those who pick up on Friday receive a 20% discount on regular prices in Löplabbet's store (excluding electronics). Parking is available for a fee; the organizer recommends public transport (bus line 7) or cycling. There are changing rooms and showers with limited space, a kiosk on site, prize giving around 13:30, and a prize draw. Start groups: 10 km has start group 1 (under 50 minutes) and group 2; 6 km starts in a combined group. Members who have contributed at least one work shift can register free of charge via kb.loppet@gmail.com. Water stations, bib number pickup at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 6), Swish payment, start times: 11:00 (10 km), 12:00 (6 km), 12:15 (trail); prize giving around 13:30; medals for all finishers; parking for a fee; public transport or cycling recommended; no timing in children's races.

name: Kistaloppet
description: Kistaloppet is a family-friendly city-based running event organized by Löparakademin with races for all ages: Kistaloppet 5 km, Lilla Kistaloppet/Fun Run 1.6 km, and Kistaloppet MINI for the youngest participants. The courses offer a varied running experience through the high-rise buildings of the Million Programme, the green areas of Järvafältet, and Kista's IT cluster, with start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg near Kista Galleria. The event emphasizes accessibility and community (including the #RUN4ZERO initiative) and is designed for both recreational runners and those who want to compete on the controlled 5 km course. The event is usually complemented by music, entertainment, and a festival atmosphere along the route.
course_highlights: Controlled 5 km course through Kista: high-rise buildings, Järvafältet green areas, and the IT cluster
Start and finish centrally at Färögatan near Jan Stenbecks torg, adjacent to Kista Galleria
Music stations/DJs and entertainment along the route for a festival atmosphere
additional: Registration is free and includes a medal; registration is open until September 17 (subject to availability). Bib distribution at the competition center in Kista Galleria (opposite McDonald's): Friday, September 19, 12:00 - 18:00 and Saturday, September 20, 09:15 - 13:00 (bib must be picked up at least 30 minutes before start). Water stations are available at the finish line; medical personnel are on site. Only the adult class (Kistaloppet 5K) has official timing; other races, including Fun Run, are non-timed. Volunteers are expected to be available approximately 09:00 - 15:30. Races for the whole family: 5K, LILLA Kistaloppet, Kistaloppet MINI, and Fun Run; registration is free; Lilla Kistaloppet is approximately 1.6 km and MINI 500 m; medals are awarded to all finishers of Lilla Kistaloppet; start times and bib pickup at Kista Galleria.

name: Coop Eskilstunarunt
description: A flat course without hills, offering a chance for good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

Coop Eskilstunarunt startportal med löpare i parken.
Barn och vuxna startar Coop Eskilstunarunt i stadsparken.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOKs klubbstuga Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås offered at several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km), and 10 miles. The start, turnaround, and finish are at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers, and a sauna. The course consists of a varied loop of 10 miles (16.1 km) with technical trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails, and sections of asphalt. The race is organized by Västerås Running Club and offers rewards such as a medal for completing the race and a belt buckle for 100 miles under 24 hours.
course_highlights: One lap = 10 miles (16.1 km); the race is run in repeated laps
Very varied terrain: technical trails, jogging tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails, and some asphalt
City-close course with start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen
additional: Distances: 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra (48 km), 20 miles, and 10 miles. Start/turnaround/finish at Västerås SOK's clubhouse Orientalen with changing rooms, showers, and a sauna. 100-mile runners who complete the course within 24 hours receive BRR's belt buckle; others who finish receive a medal. Participants can opt out of the medal, in which case the organizer will donate 20 SEK to Doctors Without Borders. The distances include 100 miles, 50 miles, Intro Ultra 48 km, 20 miles, and 10 miles; the course is permanently marked with red posts; start and finish at Orientalen; 24-hour time limit for 100 miles; sauna and showers in the clubhouse.

name: Šiaulių Bėgimas
description: Amazingly unique and representative Šiauliai Run 2024 will take place on September 22 at 12:00 PM. The main goal of the project is to promote physical activity and sports by fostering active and quality leisure, nurturing community spirit, and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The run will take place along the central city streets through famous locations in Šiauliai related to the city's history, suitable for people of all ages, amateurs, and professionals. The program includes a children's run of 700 meters, a run commemorating the Battle of Saulės in 1236, and 5 km and 10 km runs.

name: Bėgimas „Molėtai bėga-2026“
organizer: Molėtų sporto centras, Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija
description: Molėtų sports center together with the Lithuanian Running Enthusiasts Association invites everyone to the traditional run "Molėtai runs 2026," which will take place in Molėtai. The event offers various distances suitable for participants of different ages and fitness levels, including 3 km and 400 m runs for children and age groups for adults. The start is at Molėtai Stadium, and participants receive numbers and timing devices. It is a great opportunity to spend active time and join the community sports festival.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Molėtai Stadium (Ąžuolų g. 10, Molėtai)
Participant age groups from children to older adults
Different distances: 400 m, 3 km, runs for age groups
additional: Number and timing device distribution takes place from 10:00 to 11:00 at Molėtai Sports Arena. Registration is canceled if the start fee is not paid by 2025-10-03 17:00. Location: Molėtai Stadium, registration: pre-registration and on the race day, event type: community and sports event.

name: Rakvere 43. Rahvajooks
description: Rakvere 43rd People's Run is a traditional mass sports event inviting all running enthusiasts to participate. The race takes place at Rakvere City Stadium and offers a variety of distances for both children and adults. The courses are carefully selected to provide an enjoyable running experience and support a healthy lifestyle. The event is open to everyone who is sufficiently trained to complete the chosen distance.
course_highlights: 13.6 km running course
Nordic walking is not allowed on the course
Separate public walking distance for walkers
additional: Distribution of start materials and on-site registration will take place on September 26 from 14:30 to 19:30 and on race day September 27 from 12:00 to 13:30 at Paide Machine Hall Sports Hall. Re-registration for changing distance or participant is possible until 23.09.2026. Participants are divided into age groups and the competition is conducted according to the rules of the Estonian Athletics Association. The event also focuses on traffic management and parking options around Rakvere City Stadium, ensuring a convenient and safe experience for participants.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th "King of the Park" Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Mosina. The competition takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the city park, offering participants an attractive route and sporting competition. The run attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and integration of the local community. The organizers provide professional service and a rich start package.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city park area in Mosina
Picturesque surroundings with natural greenery
Well-marked and prepared running route
additional: The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Center in Mosina. Phone contact: +48 61 813 29 03. Detailed information and registration will be available soon. The event is part of the sports and recreation events calendar of the Mosina municipality. The event also includes races for children and youth, and participants can expect medals and accompanying attractions. The runs are part of the Mosina Grand Prix cycle.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechitów Half Marathon is the oldest Polish half marathon, continuously organized since 1978. The race course of 21.0975 km runs from the Small Skansen in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish line at St. Adalbert's Square in Gniezno, referencing the historical journey of Otto III. The race attracts thousands of participants each year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. Organizers ensure professional service, timing measurement, and route security, and participants receive a starter pack with a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: Start from the Small Skansen in Ostrów Lednicki, finish at St. Adalbert's Square in Gniezno
Course length of 21.0975 km with PZLA certification, fully asphalted
5 nutrition points along the route, including water and isotonic drinks
additional: The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Timing is measured using chips in the start numbers. The organizer provides bus transportation to the start in Ostrów Lednicki. The start package includes a set of safety pins for attaching the number, a medal at the finish, and a recovery meal. Registration and packet pickup are at the II LO sports hall in Gniezno, September 19 from 15:00 to 20:00 and September 20 from 7:00 to 9:00. The participant limit is 2000, age restriction is 18 years and older. Transportation is available by bus or personal vehicle.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oak Avenue Half Marathon is a race covering a half marathon distance (21.097 km), scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Wieruszów Sports and Tourism Center. The race is open and friendly to runners, with the course running along the scenic Red Oak Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing is recorded electronically. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and attractive start conditions.
course_highlights: Half marathon course of 21.097 km
Scenic Red Oak Avenue
Electronic timing
additional: Race office open on 20.09.2026 from 08:00 to 11:30. Organizers: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Wieruszów Sports and Tourism Center, Green Service Social Cooperative. Partners: Kępno County, Wieruszów County. Main sponsor: HK Meblowa Group. Participants must accept the regulations and consent to personal data processing. A map of the route and authorization for collecting the start package are available. Participant limit: 434. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Registration details and regulations are available on the official website.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The Farmer's Run II is a street race over a distance of 10 km, which will take place in Police. The event is a perfect opportunity to test your form on a scenic route, and participants can benefit from training plans tailored to various levels of advancement. Organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions, allowing for optimal preparation for the start. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and opportunities for development.
course_highlights: Street route of 10 km
Scenic areas of Police in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship
Tailored training plans from 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Available training plans matched to the runner's level, expert support, the possibility to use a platform for managing the race profile and marketing cooperation. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as integration of the local community. Participants can expect support and attractions along the route.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
location: Cewice, Gmina Cewice, Powiat lęborski, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The VII Postilion Run is a 10 km race scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants can prepare for the start using dedicated training plans tailored to various skill levels. The event is an excellent opportunity for runners to test their form on a scenic route and enjoy sports competition in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Street route in Cewice
Picturesque surroundings of Pomerania
additional: Training plans available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level with instructions and expert support. Date: 2026-09-20; Location: Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship; Distance: 10 km

name: XV Półmaraton Augustowski
location: Amfiteatr Miejski, Augustów, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 15th Augustów Half Marathon will take place on September 20, 2026, in Augustów, starting at 1:00 PM at the Municipal Amphitheater. Participants will cover the half marathon distance, which is 21.0975 km, running along a route that is half the length of a full marathon. The event is organized by the Augustów Swimming Society and is an important running event in the region.
course_highlights: Distance of 21.0975 km - classic half marathon
Start and finish at the Municipal Amphitheater in Augustów
The route runs through scenic areas of Augustów
additional: The event also includes other races and activities, and registration details and the start list are available on the official website.

name: Hökensås Trail
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race scheduled for September 20, 2026, in the area around First Camp Hökensås outside Tidaholm. The race offers three distances: 19 km, 11.5 km, and 5.5 km, with start and finish at First Camp Hökensås between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizer CKU6 (Cykelklubben U6) offers the race as part of Motionsloppet, in collaboration with Grebbestad Multisport according to the information. The terrain combines forest roads and trails with roots and stones, providing natural challenges in the Hökensås area.

Start och mål vid First Camp Hökensås i Tidaholm
Starttider mellan 10:00 och 14:00

name: Coop Linköping Runt
price_range: Gratis för LGIF-medlemmar; övriga deltagare pris ej angivet
description: COOP Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping with start and finish at Trädgårdsföreningen. The race is organized by Linköpings GIF (LGIF) in collaboration with COOP Linköping, and registration is done via cooplinkopingrunt.se. For LGIF members, the race is free with the campaign code LGIF2024; other participants pay the price listed on the website. The event also seeks volunteers and offers a clear city tour experience in central Linköping.

City run focusing on Linköping's city center
LGIF2024 campaign makes the race free for LGIF members
