Registration is via cooplinkopingrunt.se; the campaign code LGIF2024 makes the race free for LGIF members; volunteers are sought.

name: Enhörna Challenge
location: Södertälje IP, Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Enhörna Challenge is a 5000-meter track race organized by Enhörna IF at Södertälje IP. The competition is open to both men and women and is divided into heats based on runners' ability. The first heat starts at 18:30, with the faster heats following later in the evening. It is a well-organized event with check-ins up to 45 minutes before each heat. Welcome to participate in this challenging and exciting running festival!
course_highlights: 5000 meters on track
Heat division based on runners' ability
Organized at Södertälje IP
additional: Check-in occurs up to 45 minutes before each heat. There are several heats with start times around 18:30, 19:15, and 19:45 depending on the number of participants and runners' levels. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from the region, including elite performances such as Johanna Anvell who has run under 37 minutes in the 10,000 meters. It is an opportunity for runners to challenge themselves and participate in a well-organized competition.

name: Brommaspelen
description: The Bromma Games is an athletics competition organized by Bromma IF that promotes athletics and sports development in the Bromma area. The competition welcomes children, youth, and adults and offers a wide range of events and classes. The event is an important part of the club's activities and contributes to both elite and recreational development in athletics. Officials are encouraged to register to help with the execution of the competition.
course_highlights: Wide range of athletics events including sprints, jumps, and throws
Held at Stockholm Stadium, an iconic athletics venue
Open to participants from age 9 and up, with opportunities to compete in different age groups
additional: Officials are encouraged to register to help with the competition. The office is located at Stora Mossen IP with entrance from Västerled, but visits require an appointment. Registration for the competition is via Sportadmin and includes various events for different age groups. The event is part of Bromma IF's broad activities in athletics and offers opportunities for both competitors and officials.

name: 20. ETAPP
description: The 20th stage is part of the running series organized by Stamina Sports Club, taking place at Järve Health Trail in Tallinn. This stage offers participants the opportunity to enjoy a city-adjacent health trail, suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners. The event is traditional and well-organized, providing a pleasant sports experience and a sense of community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and healthy outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Järve Health Trail in Tallinn
City-adjacent and well-maintained health trail
Suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners
additional: The competitions include disc golf, motocross, and running; various activities are available for participants and spectators, and results and information about the competitions are accessible on the website.

name: Greičio ratai 2026
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Speed Wheels 2026 is a running race held at Vilnius Vingis Park Stadium on September 25, 2026. The event includes 60-meter races for children, 1000-meter races with special categories for people with disabilities using tricycles, and 5×1000-meter relay races for mixed, men's, and women's teams. The goal of the race is to promote running as a healthy lifestyle, popularize athletics, and identify the most capable teams. Participants must adhere to the rules, and the event is open to everyone interested; registration is conducted in advance.
course_highlights: Vingis Park Stadium in Vilnius
60 m races for children
1000 m races with tricycles for people with disabilities and 5×1000 m relay
additional: Men's and women's tricycle races are free of charge. A relay team consists of 5 runners; one runner cannot run multiple stages. Participants are required to wear a number on the front of their shirts. During the race, the use of vehicles and personal escorts is prohibited. Animals are not allowed on the track during the event. Musical performances, laser shows, and other entertainment will take place, encouraging an active lifestyle.

name: #BeActive bėgimas, skirtas Europos sporto savaitei
description: The European Sports Week #BeActive event in Vilkaviškis is an important community tradition inviting people of all ages and fitness levels to actively participate. The event program includes relays, active games, football, wrestling, chess competitions, line dances, exercise, Nordic walking, and a city walk. The evening program is crowned with a joint dance and an energetic "Dance party" with Zumba rhythms, uniting participants and emphasizing the importance of movement in the community.
course_highlights: Relays and active games for children
Football, wrestling, and chess competitions
Joint #BeActive walk through Vilkaviškis streets
additional: Participants can join various activities from relays to chess, as well as a joint dance and "Dance party". The event is designed for all age groups and fitness levels, highlighting community spirit and the importance of movement. The Vilkaviškis event is a major participation in the European Sports Week #BeActive, engaging the local community and various sports activities.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: The Tartu City Marathon children's runs are open races for all children, where the main goal is the joy of participation. There are recommended guidelines regarding distances and age groups, but every child is welcome and equal on the track. Starting numbers are issued one hour before the start, and the race is not organized based on rankings. The event takes place at Tartu Town Hall Square and offers the opportunity to participate both pre-registered and on-site.
course_highlights: Children's runs take place at Tartu Town Hall Square
Participation is open to all children regardless of age and previous experience
Starting numbers are the same for all children (number 1) and the start organization is simple
additional: Pre-registered participants will receive a unique QR code to obtain their starting number. Distribution of starting numbers begins one hour before the start at the Tartu Market Hall. All children start with the starting number 1. There is an option to download and color a personalized diploma. Participants' names will be published on the website after the event. A raffle for prizes will be held among all pre-registrants. Several partners offer discounts to participants. Medals and diplomas are awarded to all participants. Registration is available both online and on-site. The participation fee is 4 euros.

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 kr till och med 6/9 2026 (Gruppanmälan öppen tom 6/9)

description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race, held on the last weekend of September on Lidingö. The weekend offers events for all levels - from toddler races of 1.7 km to the classic 30 km race - and attracts over 30,000 runners to its scenic, hilly courses. The event is both a competitive challenge and a running festival with a Sports Fair where you can pick up your bib and meet exhibitors. The natural surroundings and soft trails are the hallmark of the race.
course_highlights: Hilly, soft trails through forests and open areas: alternating between flat meadows, gravel roads, sloping paths, and steep inclines
TCS Lidingöloppet 30 km: approximately 522 meters of elevation gain
TCS Lidingöloppet 15 km: approximately 250 meters of elevation gain; start at Koltorp and finish at Grönsta Gärde
additional: All finishers receive the TCS Lidingöloppet bronze medal with a unique Carl Milles motif each year; a silver medal is available if you meet the silver time and started in start group 2 or lower. A diploma is provided as a PDF in the results email (a paper diploma can be ordered for 50 SEK including shipping). Enervit offers fueling service along the course (product stations for a fee). Minimum age: 30 km = 17 years, 15 km = 15 years (several other age limits apply for different races). The Sports Fair is used for bib distribution and exhibitors. Lidingöloppet is a non-profit organization run by a club (contact: Vasavägen 82, 181 41 Lidingö; phone 08-7652615; email info@lidingoloppet.se). Early Bird discount (20%) is already deducted from prices marked with *. Plan your experience: bib, partners, and exhibitors are on site. Environmentally friendly travel options include free buses from Ropsten to Lidingövallen, running buses from several locations in central Sweden, bike parking, and carpooling. Limited access and few parking options during the race. Seeding race before the weekend: Vårmilen can be purchased as a seeding race (price 100 - 200 SEK).

name: Nidos pusės maratonas
description: The 24th International Nida Half Marathon will take place on September 28, 2024, in Nida. It is organized by VšĮ Kuršių Legendos in cooperation with Neringa Municipality and other institutions. Participants will be able to compete in various distances: Nida Half Marathon – 21.098 km; 5 km YIT run; 2 km, 0.5 km, and 0.21 km children's runs. Registration will be only at the bib number distribution, and the start line will be near the "Sakutis" café.

images.alt_text: Bėgikai kerta finišo liniją Nidos pusės maratone.
Bėgimo varžybos Nidoje. Daug bėgikų bėga gatve.
Bėgikas su numeriu bėga keliu, galimai pusmaratonio varžybose Nidoje.
Bėgimo varžybų taurės, skirtos nugalėtojams.

name: Swampman Backyard Ultra
description: Swampman Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon race where participants must consecutively run a distance of 6,706 meters (4.167 miles) in less than one hour. After each lap, the remaining time can be used for rest and food. Every hour, you will stand at the starting line and run another lap until only one runner remains. The Lithuanian record is 22 laps, and the world record is 108 laps.

images.alt_text: Bėgikai kerta finišo liniją.
Bėgikas bėga smėliu, pilkas dangus.
Backyard Ultra lenktynių logotipas ir trasa.
Žemėlapis su bėgimo trasa.

name: XXVI Nidos pusės maratono bėgimas. Lietuvos pusės maratono bėgimo čempionatas.
description: The Nida Half Marathon International Running Event is a traditional and annual event held in the Curonian Spit, Nida. The event includes a half marathon distance, a 5 km YIT run, and shorter distances for children and youth. It is a great opportunity for both professional runners and amateurs to enjoy running in a unique natural environment and to participate in the Lithuanian Half Marathon Championship. The event promotes physical activity and sports popularization in Lithuania, with participants facing professionally prepared routes and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21.098 km half marathon distance in the natural environment of the Curonian Spit
5 km YIT run route around the city
Short children’s and youth runs with starts at Nida Harbour and the city center
additional: Starts take place at different locations: the half marathon at the Sakutis café (Naglių g. 14A), the 5 km YIT run at the Catholic church (Taikos g. 17), children’s and youth runs at Nida Harbour and near Neringa Municipality. Participants' numbers are issued on the event day from 8:00 AM. Registration on the event day is not available. The running routes are certified according to World Athletics and AIMS requirements. Awards will be presented at 4:00 PM at Nidos KTIC ‘Agila’. The event will be held on September 26, 2026, offering various distance options, including children’s runs.

name: VERTICAL VILNIUS 2026
location: Liepkalnio šlaitai, Vilnius, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
organizer: TA Trail Akademija VŽ Vaidas Žlabys
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania's most vertical trail running race held in Vilnius. Participants overcome the slopes of Liepkalnis, and the race offers an opportunity to earn ITRA rating points. An ecological 'Trash Vertical' challenge is also organized, encouraging participants to care for the environment. Registration for the event is free, so we invite everyone to actively join and test their strength on this unique course.
course_highlights: Overcoming the slopes of Liepkalnis
Trail running courses in Vilnius
Opportunity to earn ITRA rating points
additional: Registration is free. Participants can take part in the ecological 'Trash Vertical' challenge. trail, ecological challenge, ITRA points, distances: 200 m, 600 m, 1000 m, event takes place on the slopes of Liepkalnis in Vilnius.

name: 26-as Tarptautinis Nidos Pusės Maratono Bėgimas
location: Nidos kultūros centras, Nida, Klaipėda County, Lithuania
description: The 26th International Nida Half Marathon will take place on September 26, 2026, in Nida. The event offers various distances: a half marathon, a 5 km YIT run, a 2 km youth run, and short children's runs (500 m and 210 m). The race courses are certified according to World Athletics and AIMS standards, with starts taking place at different locations in Nida. This is a traditional event promoting sports and popularizing running and athletics in Lithuania.
course_highlights: 21.098 km half marathon course certified according to World Athletics and AIMS standards
5 km YIT run course through the streets of Nida
Short children's runs (210 m and 500 m) at Nida Harbour and near Neringa Municipality
additional: Children's runs start at 10:00 AM at Nida Harbour and near Neringa Municipality. Number pick-up is on the event day from 8:00 AM until the start times. Awards are scheduled for 4:00 PM at Nidos KTIC „Agila“. The event features participants of various age groups, with starts at Nida Harbour and the Culture Center. Registration is conducted online.

name: Vertical Vilnius
description: Vertical Vilnius is Lithuania's most vertical off-road running race held on the slopes of Liepkalnis in Vilnius. Participants overcome steep mountain slopes to earn ITRA rating points and take part in the ecological "Trash Vertical" challenge. The race promotes physical activity and environmental conservation, inviting runners to test their strength on a unique course.
course_highlights: Steep ascents of Liepkalnis slopes
Trail running course
Opportunity to earn ITRA rating points
additional: Free registration. The race features the ecological "Trash Vertical" challenge. trail, vertical ascent, ecological challenge, free registration

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering fun and experiences for the whole family. The beautiful seaside area provides an ideal backdrop for both sporting activities and a pleasant day outdoors. The race day begins with a children's run and offers various distance options suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. In addition to sports, there will be a free concert and a diverse program, creating a great atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Beautiful seaside Noblessner area
Views of Noblessner and Põhja-Tallinn
Various distances for children and adults
additional: The race day begins with a children's run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptun 10 km distance at 15:10. The event center is open from 11:00 to 17:10. At 13:40, there will be a free concert by artist INGER at Noblessner's central square. Outdoor seaside terrain, family-friendly, includes running and a concert, autumn event.

name: 44. Viking Window Paide-Türi rahvajooks
description: Viking Window Paide-Türi Community Run is a traditional mass participation event that brings together running enthusiasts from Järvamaa and beyond. The course features diverse terrain, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event is suitable for all age groups and includes, in addition to the main race, children's runs and other active activities. Completing the course between Paide and Türi is an annual major event that unites the community and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Paide and Türi route
Diverse terrain and beautiful views
Suitable for all age groups
additional: During the Community Run weekend, in addition to the main race, there are children's runs and the Paide Heart Walk. Bus schedules between Paide and Türi and traffic arrangements have been organized for the event. Maps of the race center and live results are available online. On race days, there are also children's runs and fun runs suitable for the whole family and the community.

name: 24. Jooks ümber Võhma
location: Võhma Kooli staadion, Võhma, Lääne-Virumaa, Estonia
description: The 24th Võhma Run is a traditional 5 km race held on the streets and health trail of Võhma town. The course is mostly on hard surface and marked with arrows on asphalt, with a cyclist leading the runners. The race is open to everyone born in 2020 or earlier and is suitable for runners and walkers, including Nordic walkers, who start from the last row. Electronic timing is provided for participants, and each finisher receives a medal. The event takes place at the Võhma School stadium, which also serves as the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5 km course on Võhma town streets and health trail
Predominantly hard surface, marked with arrows on asphalt
Cyclist leading the runners, course open to traffic
additional: Registration is available online until September 24 at timesport.ee and on race day in front of Võhma School from 10:00 to 11:40. Electronic timing is via a chip attached to the ankle, which must be returned at the finish. An unreturned or lost chip incurs a fee of 70 €. Participants will receive medals, and there will be a prize draw. Runners are responsible for their health. Children are allowed on the course under parental supervision. Registration can be done online or on-site, and participants will receive prizes and medals. The course includes city streets and asphalt, providing a pleasant and motivating running experience. The event will take place on September 26, 2026.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: The Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, with a course length of 21.0975 km. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is mass participation, divided into start zones based on declared results, and also offers the possibility to participate in 4-person relay teams. Organizers provide professional timing, medical security, refreshment stations, and water along the route. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as popularizes Gdańsk domestically and internationally.
course_highlights: Half marathon course of 21.0975 km in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Division into start zones based on declared results
additional: Start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time zones according to the declared result (red, blue, green, yellow). Relays start from the blue zone. The race kit includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timing measurement, medical security, water at refreshment points, a finish line buffet, and a medal. The full race kit is guaranteed for payments made by August 30, 2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer's consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including the half marathon and 5 km, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration is online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or traditional bank transfer. There are also races for children and youth available.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Night Five is a unique 5-kilometer race scheduled for September 26, 2026, in Gdańsk, taking place the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are located on the illuminated surface of the Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk stadium, where participants will enjoy a spectacular show with laser displays, music, and light effects. The race route runs through the city, enhanced with fan zones featuring music and fire shows, creating a distinctive night atmosphere. This is a new edition of the well-known race accompanying the half marathon, moved to Saturday evening to provide runners and spectators with an exceptional experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the illuminated surface of Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk stadium
Route through the city with fire shows and fan zones with music and a DJ
Spectacular lighting with laser shows and energetic music
additional: The race takes place the day before the half marathon, start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk stadium, nighttime atmosphere with music, laser and fire shows, fan zones with DJ. Evening run with laser and pyrotechnic displays, start at 20:00, illuminated route, event accompanying Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon, participant limit not specified, attractions and visual effects at the highest level.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeg Odyssey ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, combining passion, strength, and a seaside atmosphere. Participants can take part in races of 5 km, half marathon, marathon, and 10 km. The routes are certified by PZLA, and participants can expect generous start packages, a finisher zone with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It is a perfect opportunity to feel the seaside energy and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.
course_highlights: Routes certified by PZLA
Flat course along the pedestrian and bike path with asphalt and cobblestone surfaces
Seaside climate and views
additional: Start and finish at the Seaside Hotel at ul. Wschodnia 20 in Kołobrzeg. Race office open on 16.05.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 17.05.2026 from 8:00 to 10:50. Sanitary facilities include deposit, changing rooms, showers, toilets. Professional timing and referees. Finisher zone with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drink, and water. Award ceremony at Atrium Seaside Park Hotel. Quiz with additional prizes for participants present at the ceremony. Routes certified by PZLA, finisher zone, meals, prizes, gala, accommodation discounts, timing, rich start packages.

name: Björknässpelen
description: Björknässpelen is an athletics competition organized by Hellas Athletics Club in Nacka. The event includes multiple age groups from children to seniors and offers a fun and relaxed competitive environment. It is part of Hellas Athletics' broad event schedule and is held at Björknäs IP. It is a welcoming competition that promotes joy in athletics and community.
course_highlights: Youth and senior categories
Diverse athletics disciplines
Held in scenic Nacka and Björknäs IP
additional: The competition includes several age groups from children born in 2014 to seniors. Björknässpelen is held at Björknäs IP in Nacka. No specific start times or price information are provided on the available pages. Includes youth and senior classes, opportunities for medals and personal best performances, and registration via SportAdmin.

name: Frontyard Sölvesborg
description: A Frontyard usually takes place on a lap course where time and distance can vary depending on the organizer's decision. Our course is 2.6 km long, with participants having 26 minutes for the first lap, and the same distance for the second lap with 25 minutes, the third lap with 24 minutes, the fourth lap with 23 minutes, and so on. An exciting race and challenge where it is about conserving both energy and speed until it really counts. The race is decided when two participants start at the same time and the one who crosses the finish line first wins. How many laps will there be? How many laps will you do?

images.alt_text: Tremedalj med texten Sölvesborgs Frontyard 2024 och romerska siffror.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 41. Jooks ümber Porkuni järve
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional series of running and walking events that offers a variety of distances for different age groups and skill levels. The stages of the series take place in the beautiful locations of Lääne-Virumaa, providing runners with both competitive excitement and sporting enjoyment. Throughout the series, popular events include both main runs and youth and children's races, motivating movement and a healthy lifestyle. The series stages have secured a firm place in runners' calendars and hearts.
course_highlights: Diverse distances from children's races to main runs
Courses run through the beautiful natural locations of Lääne-Virumaa
Throughout the series, running directions and traditional stages vary
additional: The series includes separate runs for children and youth, where participation is not an official competitive distance but offers a valuable running experience. The stages of the series are held in different locations within Lääne-Virumaa, such as near Kadrina Paisjärv, the Simuna-Laekvere run, and the Kunda city run. The number of participants has been large, for example, over 200 athletes at the Kunda event. The series also features health walks and a variety of age categories. The event includes different competition distances such as the main race, mini-run, toddler run, children's run, and youth run, and also offers the opportunity to participate in walking competitions.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Metsajooks 2026
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Forest Run is a trail run taking place on September 27, 2026, offering participants the chance to run through a pristine nature reserve along beautiful trails. The race distances are 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a youth run for those up to 17 years old, plus free children's runs. The courses run entirely within a protected natural area, providing breathtaking views and fresh nature. The race center is conveniently located near Tallinn, and the whole family can enjoy additional activities, childcare, a sauna, and hot tubs. All finishers receive a medal and gifts, winners are awarded prizes, and the best of the season and teams are recognized.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a beautiful protected natural area
Trail running in pristine nature, with alternating ascents and descents
Courses suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: Race center opens at 10:00, children's runs start at 10:40, group warm-up at 11:45. After the run, free soup and smoothies are available, and the sauna and hot tubs are open. Sportland pop-up shop at the race center. Prizes for winners, recognition for the best of the season and teams. Option to rent a private Igloo sauna by the lake. Childcare and activities for the little ones. Finish line closes at 15:30. Trail running, forest trails, family and children's runs, registration and info HERE, modern course experience and family events.

name: 48. Maraton Warszawski
description: The 48th Warsaw Marathon is a unique running event held in the heart of Warsaw, attracting thousands of runners. The route passes through the most beautiful and historic sites of the capital, offering unforgettable views and atmosphere. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and T-shirt, and spectators can enjoy numerous attractions and cheering zones. It is a celebration of running that combines sport, culture, and community.
course_highlights: Start from the Palace of Culture and Science in the center of Warsaw
The route goes through Krakowskie Przedmieście, Nowy Świat, Poniatowski Bridge with a view of the Vistula River, and PGE National Stadium
Car traffic is closed, ensuring safe and comfortable running conditions
additional: The start number must be placed on the front of the outfit and cannot be covered or modified. The start and finish are located in the city center, near the metro station. On race day, deposits, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The event features numerous attractions, cheering zones, and programs in the Marathon Fan Zone and EXPO Sport&Fitness. Participants can join the charity route #BiegamDobrze with a free start number. During the same weekend, there are also 10 km races (Warszawska Dycha) and a Mini Marathon for children and youth. Registrations can be made through the official website. The event also includes a half marathon and a 5 km run. The organization provides attractions and support for participants.

name: 13. Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk Nocna Piątka
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Akademicki Związek Sportowy COSA Oddział w Gdańsku
description: Garmin Half Marathon Gdańsk is an annual running celebration held in the heart of the Tricity area, which will take place in 2026 on September 26-27. The program includes a new event - Night Five, an evening 5 km run with light illuminations, fireworks, and cheering spectators. The main part of the event is the 13th edition of the half marathon on a distance of 21.0975 km, which traditionally starts and finishes at Polsat Plus Arena in Gdańsk. The route is fast and conducive to personal bests, and the atmosphere is exceptional thanks to supporter encouragement and beautiful cityscapes.
course_highlights: Half marathon route of 21.0975 km, fast and PB-friendly
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - the most beautiful stadium in Poland
Night Five - evening 5 km run with light illuminations and fireworks
additional: Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon start is divided into start zones based on declared results (red, blue, green, yellow). Relays start from the blue zone. The Night Five starts in the evening of September 26, 2026, after 8:00 PM with light illuminations and fireworks. Race packets are issued at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 26-27, 2026. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 1:30 PM on the half marathon day. The event also includes children's races on various distances, warm-ups, award ceremonies, and pre-registration from October 7. Participants can expect attractive cash prizes and record bonuses.

name: Kresowe Trail #11
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate, non-commercial trail runs organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The series mainly takes place in the Podlasie region and surrounding areas, offering two distances: Szpurt (approximately 6-8 km) and Wertep (approximately 17-21 km). The events are characterized by a limited number of participants, ensuring safety and respect for nature and local communities. The events are friendly for both beginners and experienced runners, and also include Nordic Walking competitions. The 2026 season will conclude with a final run in Michałów on September 27.
course_highlights: Two distances: Szpurt (6-8 km) and Wertep (17-21 km)
Trail routes through picturesque areas of Podlasie and surroundings
Well-marked routes with refreshment stations on the longer distance
additional: Starts at 9:00 AM (except Mielnik, where the start is at 11:00 AM). Participant limit for each event. New start numbers are required for the 2026 season. The race pack includes, among other things, a warm recovery meal, electronic timing, medical support, refreshment stations at the start, finish, and along the route, and a commemorative medal (for registrations at least 10 days before the event). Registration on the day of the race is possible until 8:40 AM, but the race pack may be incomplete. Transfer of the registration fee to another date is possible without additional charges before the online registration closes. The run is part of a trail event series, with training preparations and online registration available. The event promotes outdoor activity and sports competition in the beautiful natural surroundings of Podlasie.

description: The 8th Green Trail Run of the Mazovian Lowland is a 5 km race scheduled for September 27, 2026, in Czerwonka Włościańska. The start and finish are located at the Primary School in Czerwonka. The event is organized by local sports clubs and institutions, and the course runs through the scenic terrain of the Mazovian Lowland. The event is open to adults and youth over 15 years old with parental consent.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Start and finish at the Primary School in Czerwonka Włościańska
Scenic terrain of the Mazovian Lowland
additional: The race office is located at the school sports field in Czerwonka. Registration of participants takes place from 08:30 to 10:00. After the race, there will be a winners' ceremony, summary, and closing of the event. The participant limit is 200 people. Timing is measured using a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips, and results are immediately displayed at the finish line and sent via SMS to participants. Terrain: 5 km course, registration from 8:30 to 10:00, limit of 200 participants, age from 15 years with parental consent, online payments or at the office.

description: The 28th Autumn Małkińskie Runs is an annual running event organized in Małkini Górna, attracting runners and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The competition takes place on cross-country routes, offering participants the opportunity to compete in a beautiful autumn scenery. The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking marches, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle within the local community.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the picturesque terrain of Małkini Górna
Autumn scenery conducive to running and Nordic walking
Event as part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and NW marches
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix in cross-country running and Nordic walking marches organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center in Małkini Górna. Registrations are conducted through the portal dostartu.pl. The organizer provides support and information at gokis@malkiniagorna.pl. Registration for the runs is available via the dostartu.pl platform. The race includes various distances, including options for children and youth.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)
description: The Pink Ribbon Run is part of the TCS Lidingöloppet weekend on Lidingö and offers 4 km or 10 km runs for Cancerfonden. The start times follow the Greensta and Koltorp schedules, and the courses are soft and scenic. From 2025, a new category for ages 9 - 15 in the 4 km race (FP-9-15) will be introduced. 100 SEK of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden, and the Pink Ribbon Run@Home option is available as a home event. The Pink Ribbon Run is included in the Lidingöloppet weekend and is part of the Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km on soft courses in Lidingö's scenic terrain
100 SEK of the entry fee goes directly to Cancerfonden
New category FP-9-15 in 4 km from 2025 for younger runners
additional: The minimum age for Lilla Lidingöloppet is 7 - 15 years. Start times are announced with the Greensta and Koltorp start groups, and rules for warm-up and start pens are followed carefully. 100 SEK of the entry fee goes to Cancerfonden, and the Pink Ribbon Run is part of the Lidingöloppet weekend, Tjejklassikern, and Kortklassikern.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is an autumn running festival in Nacka welcoming runners of all ages and levels. The main race is a 10 km recreational run along beautiful lake shores in Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energy Run and the Little Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old. The race offers a scenic and fast course with a lively atmosphere and lots of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organized by Järla IF Orientering and is a big community event for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course runs along lake shores in Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface consists of approximately 60% asphalt, 30% gravel, and 10% wooden bridge
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter with beautiful nature and crowd support
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at the partner XLL Sickla Köpkvarter days before the race and on race day. The race site opens at 08:00 and offers services and food trucks. Warm-up occurs on-site before the start. Registration on race day is possible for an increased fee if the race is not fully booked. All finishers receive a medal. The start pen for the 10 km opens at 12:30. The maximum time for the 10 km is approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes; after that, a rope is drawn at Kyrkviken for safety reasons. Terrain: scenic course along lake shores, registration via partner XLL Sickla Köpkvarter, family-friendly event, includes children's race.

name: Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in the center of Tartu, taking place on October 2nd at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, running through city streets and offering an opportunity to enjoy the autumn city atmosphere with friends. The run is not a competition; participants can choose between timed and untimed options. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: Approximately 4 km long route in the center of Tartu
Route runs through city streets and park paths
One refreshment point with timing for the timed distance
additional: Start number must be attached to the chest and visible throughout the race. The timing chip is attached to the back of the start number and is single-use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish line closes at 21:45. The participation fee includes a marked route, start number, timing (if a chip is used), finish line services, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until October 2nd at 17:00 and on-site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts are available.

name: TCS Lidingörullet & TCS Lidingöruset, TCS Lidingöfemman
location: Lidingö, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world's largest cross-country race and a beloved running challenge held on Lidingö since 1965. The race offers distances from 1.7 km for the youngest to the classic 30 km endurance test, all on scenic and hilly trails. Over 30,000 runners and a large audience gather during race weekend for a world-class running festival that also serves as a celebration of joy of movement and public health. TCS Lidingöloppet is part of En Svensk Klassiker and welcomes all runners regardless of level.
course_highlights: Hilly and soft terrain trails with both flat meadows and steep climbs
Scenic courses around Lidingö with varied surfaces such as gravel roads and trails
Unique medals with Carl Milles motifs for all finishers
additional: Bronze medal with a unique Carl Milles motif for all who complete the race. Possibility of a silver medal for fast times. PDF diploma included, paper diploma can be ordered. Energy services and relay packages offered via Enervit. Bib numbers and honors for diligent participants. Volunteer support and sports fair during race weekend. Free bus to Lidingövallen for participants in TCS Lidingöfemman. Several races during the weekend, including children and youth races, with options to participate in teams and receive medals and diplomas. The event takes place at the end of September 2026 and includes live broadcasts and audience support along the course.

The marathon is a great opportunity not only for runners but also for all sports enthusiasts who want to spend active time in nature.

The race distances and routes remain unchanged: 8 kilometers start at 20:00 from the Giruliai TV Tower, and 3 kilometers start around 20:20 from the Summer Stage. The first 700 finishers will be awarded with uniquely designed medals, and the fastest runners will receive prizes from teamsport.lt.

The event offers 7 distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, family run of 1 km, and a 400 m children's run. It is a great opportunity for both experienced runners and families with children to spend active time and test their strength on various routes.
course_highlights: The most modern hippodrome in the Baltic countries
7 different distances from 400 m children's run to marathon
Event takes place at Utena hippodrome, Užpalių g. 103

Registration opens on April 1, 2026, the event includes various distances and children's runs, participants are expected from different locations.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of the most recognizable running events in Poland, attracting thousands of participants to the heart of the capital every year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer route through the most characteristic places of Warsaw. The FUNRUN formula emphasizes the joy of movement, without pressure or competition, encouraging running, walking, or jogging at your own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheerleaders, and motivating partner points, and each participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT shirt and a medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the most atmospheric and characteristic places of Warsaw
Music zones and cheerleaders along the entire route
Hydration zone at the halfway point and comprehensive medical support
additional: The start package includes a Nike Dri-FIT shirt with a commemorative print, a start number with a chip for timing, gifts from partners, and a commemorative medal. Package pickup is available at Legia Sports Bar at Legia Warsaw Stadium from September 29 to October 3, 2026, with a recommendation for early collection. Drivers using catering services receive 2 hours of free parking. The route is certified by PZLA and is friendly for beginner runners. The event attracts over 6,000 participants, and the route has been changed to the right bank of the Vistula River, with significant involvement from ING employees and a charity collection.

name: Ekerumsloppet
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, a fall cross-country race around Ekerum and Rällaskogen on Öland, organized by Högby IF athletics. The race offers 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for youth, starting at 11:00 and 10:00 respectively, with start and finish at Ekerum Resort. Registration must be completed by September 26, 2026; late registration is available at the bib pickup from 09:00 on race day. The course runs on forest trails around Ekerum and Rällaskogen.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
Two distances: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for youth
additional: Cross-country race in forest terrain around Ekerum and Rällaskogen; Start and finish at Ekerum Resort; Registration deadline September 26, 2026; Late registration at bib pickup from 09:00 on race day

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a running event in Tidaholm, Sweden, organized by Motionsloppet. Official information and results are published on motionsloppet.se. The event is promoted via Motionsloppet's Facebook page and advertised as Tidaholm Marathon by the municipality's event page, indicating that it is a recurring race in the area.
additional: Results are available at motionsloppet.se; the event has been communicated via the municipality's Facebook event page (Tidaholm Marathon).

name: John Bauer Trail Run
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.4 km
price_range: 18 km: 400–700 kr; 10 km: 320–600 kr; 5 km upplevelseloppet: 160–300 kr; 5 km Stortrollens lopp: 120 kr; 2 km Knattetrollens lopp: 120–250 kr; 400 m: ej angivet
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a challenging and hilly cross-country race held from IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget. The race is offered in several distances (18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and several children/youth classes) and takes place partly on trails and partly on unpaved terrain with significant elevation changes and technical sections. A special feature is Strutsabacken, where run times are measured and the Bergatrollet award is given for the fastest ascent. The event is family-friendly with catering and activities at the start/finish, as well as changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Challenging, hilly terrain with both trail and unpaved sections
Strutsabacken (slalom slope) with separate ascent time and the Bergatrollet award
View over Vättern and technical downhill through Ulvadalen
additional: Registration can be done on race day between 9:00 and 11:00. Bibs with timing chips are to be collected at the IKHP cabin no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly during the race; the chip does not need to be returned. There are water stations placed along the course (kilometer markers per distance), changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin, secure valuables storage at bib distribution, and catering at the start/finish. The organizer offers participants a "troll menu" after finishing (show bib). After the race, hamburgers are served; water stations are available along the course; changing rooms and showers; insurance Startklar available (175 SEK/year); maximum 500 participants; bibs must be collected by 11:00 at IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a new-old course layout and starts and finishes in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organized by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances suitable for a wide range of participants - both 5 km and 10 km are available. The event is promoted as one of Sweden's most beautiful recreational races and welcomes recreational runners and runners of all levels to participate on October 3rd.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadsparken in central Motala
New-old course layout through central parts of Motala
Shorter recreational distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for casual runners
additional: Organizer: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as "Sweden's most beautiful recreational race". The website encourages to mark October 3rd in the calendar and notes price levels until September 28th (next increase). Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth), and 400 m (kids' race). Bibs can be collected at Team Sportia on October 2nd and 3rd. The award ceremony takes place in Stadsparken around 2:30 PM.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The bypass premiere is a one-time event where you can run or walk on the new E4, both above ground and through tunnel tubes, before the road opens to traffic. The race will be held on October 3, 2026, with start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are race categories (approximately 12 km), recreational categories (choose approximately 4, 7, or 12 km), and walking categories (Herr Gårman, approximately 4 km). The event is highlighted as a unique "once in a lifetime" experience to be among the first to traverse the new road.
course_highlights: The course goes both above ground and through tunnel tubes on the new E4
Start and finish at the new traffic junction Akalla (Vandagatan)
Recreational class has exits after approximately 4, 7, or 12 km so you can choose your distance during the race
additional: Registration opens February 5 at 12:00. The maximum race time is 1 hour 30 minutes; the competitive category starts around 09:00, the recreational categories have start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and Herr Gårman (walk) between 18:00 and 19:30. Customer service: Gustavslundsvägen 18, 167 51 Bromma, phone +46 8 545 66 440, opening hours Tuesday - Thursday 09:00 - 15:00 (lunch 12:00 - 13:00). Payment for individuals via card, Klarna invoice, or Swish; corporate invoices are only offered for groups of 20+ via special contact. Registration is binding and personal. Registration opens February 5 at 12:00; the first stage Hjulsta - Häggvik is planned to open at the end of 2026; the entire Stockholm Bypass will be completed in 2030; start places are sold through Marathongruppen; the race offers bib number, timing, finish line service, and medal; approximately 10,000 start places were sold in the first hour.

name: Taifspelen
location: Bredstorps IP, Tranås, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Taifspelen is an athletics competition organized by Tranås AIF FIF at Bredstorps IP, also known as Siw Dahlgren Arena. The event is held on the last Sunday of September and is open to participants from 7 years old up to adults. It is often the last chance of the season to set a personal record, and the event attracts many participants, making it a popular and well-attended competition in the region.
course_highlights: The competition is held at Bredstorps IP, also called Siw Dahlgren Arena
Open to everyone from 7 years old to adults
Last chance of the season to set a personal record
additional: The timetable is published on easyrecord.se and is also available for download. The goal is to minimize conflicts between competitions, but some overlaps may occur. Veterans participate but there are limitations in veteran classes. The arena honors volunteer leaders through the unofficial name Siw Dahlgren Arena. The competition takes place at Bredstorps IP, focusing on creating an inclusive and inspiring competitive environment for all participants. It is an opportunity to challenge oneself and participate in a friendly athletics weekend.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
description: PINK RUN with Antėja is an annual pink ribbon charity run dedicated to fighting breast cancer and its prevention. Join our event in the heart of Kaunas – Laisvės Avenue – and run for those you love. Support the fight against breast cancer by participating in various distance runs suitable for both professionals and amateurs. Pink Run with Antėja is not just a run; it is a message that we love them.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
location: Kauno muzikinio teatro parkas, Kaunas, Lithuania
description: Pink Run with Antėja is an annual pink ribbon charity run in Kaunas, dedicated to fighting breast cancer and disease prevention. The event takes place in the Kaunas Music Theatre Park and Laisvės Avenue, offering routes of various lengths for both professionals and amateurs. It is a joyful and positive sports celebration where participants run for their loved ones, dressed in pink costumes, face paint, and balloons. The funds raised are allocated to support women suffering from oncological diseases. The event invites everyone to join and support this important mission.
course_highlights: 600 m children's run in the city park
5 km and 10 km routes on Kaunas Laisvės Avenue
Joyful atmosphere with pink costumes, face paint, and balloons
additional: Number pickup takes place on Friday and Saturday from 11:00 to 19:00 and on the event day from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start. The location for number pickup is I. Kanto g. 25, near the 'KAVALIERIUS' café. On the event day, there are several start times scheduled: 5 km starts at 11:00 and 12:00, 10 km starts at 13:00 and 14:30. After the runs, awards are given and the most original costume is selected. Registration is at I. Kanto g. 25, Kaunas; queues for bib distribution may form on the event day; the event program includes warm-ups, awards, and costume contests.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Poznań Marathon named after Maciej Frankiewicz is a jubilee, 25th edition of the royal distance of 42.195 km, which will take place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. The race has been attracting thousands of runners and spectators for a quarter of a century, offering a new, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań. Organizers ensure professional medical security, timing measurement, and a rich start package. This is a unique sports celebration with strong support from Poznań fans and a rich tradition.
course_highlights: New, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań
Royal marathon distance of 42.195 km
Jubilee, 25th edition with rich tradition and support from local fans
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, sponsor materials, professional timing, medical security, nutrition points with isotonic drinks, water, chocolate, fruits, and sugar. The organizer provides free accommodation for 600 people in POSiR sports halls on October 3-4, 2026; participants must bring their own mats and sleeping bags. Numerous parking lots are available near MTP with various prices. Participants of the OK Poznań program receive a 25% discount, and seniors 60+ get a 50% reduction. An official marathon t-shirt can be ordered until September 1, 2026, for 70 PLN. Registration is open until October 1, 2026, with discounts for seniors and program participants, official gadgets and sportswear available, as well as accompanying events like Poznań Run Expo and Kids Marathon.

description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual race covering a half marathon distance (21.1 km) around the picturesque Ukiel Lake in Olsztyn. The course is mixed, including asphalt, cobblestone, hardened gravel paths, and forest trails, making it attractive and varied for runners. The event is accompanied by 5 km races and children's races, creating a sports atmosphere for the whole family. Organizers provide at least two refreshment zones along the route and professional race office support. It is an excellent opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Course length of 21.1 km around Ukiel Lake
Mixed surface: asphalt, cobblestone, gravel, forest trails
At least 2 refreshment zones along the route
additional: Start packages can be collected on 13.09.2025 from 14:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:45 at the race office at CRS UKIEL. Collection of packages is only in person. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours, and for the 5 km race 45 minutes. Registration on race day is not possible. The course is not certified by PZLA. The event includes various distances, including the half marathon, 5 km, relays, and the Family Mile. Participants can expect start packages, medals, finisher photos, insurance, and on-site attractions.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
description: FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to Vånga Mountain Xtreme on October 4, 2026. Choose between 8, 16, or 40 km trail running with 300, 600, or 1500 meters of elevation gain; the course features the steep Vångabacke, winding trails through wilderness, and views by lakes and quarries. The race is promoted as both beautiful and very challenging, leaving a lasting impression. For the youngest participants, there is VMX Kids with free registration on-site.
course_highlights: Steep classic Vångabacke as a short but powerful climb
Winding trails through wilderness, past small lakes and deep quarries
Total elevation gains: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1500 m (40 km)
additional: Online registration via the website is open until Wednesday, September 30, 2026, at 23:59. Late registration can be made at the venue subject to availability until about an hour before the start; payment on-site is via Swish. Registration is binding and refund of the entry fee is only possible with valid insurance (e.g., Startklar). The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Organizer: FK Göingarna. VMX Kids: free registration on-site. Maximum number of participants: 800; online registration until 2026-09-30 at 23:59; start times: VMX Kids starts at 12:15; maximum times: 3 hours (16 km) and 7 hours (40 km); Startklar insurance recommended; VMX Kids free registration on-site; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Run series, offering a variety of running opportunities for different age groups. The course runs around the Rava artificial lake, featuring diverse terrain of sand, soil, and gravel. The race awards the best runners and is suitable for both amateurs and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.
course_highlights: Run course around Rava artificial lake
Varied terrain: sand, soil, and gravel
Multiple lake views along the route
additional: In the Järvamaa Lakes Run series, runners are classified in different age groups. The course has separate start corridors and is suitable for both toddlers and adults. The race awards the best men and women who complete one lap around the lake in the fastest time. The event is part of the Järvamaa Lakes Run series, which includes several stages and promotes community and health sports development.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 is a five-stage sports event aimed at promoting running, cycling, and orienteering in nature. The competition takes place in Ukmergė, with participants competing in cross-country running, MTB mountain biking, and rogaining disciplines. The event encourages active leisure among people of all ages and youth interest in sports. The start of the race is at the Šilo primary school stadium, and the time limit is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining).
course_highlights: The competition takes place in nature in Ukmergė
The course includes cross-country running, MTB mountain biking, and rogaining
Time limit is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining)
additional: Number and time tracking device issuance is from 16:30 to 17:30 at the race start location. Rogaining maps are distributed to participants at 17:45, with the start at 18:00. The race start is synchronized for all groups and is the same across all stages. The event is open to all residents and guests of Ukmergė who fill out a participant form and undergo health checks. Participants can expect competitions in various age groups, registration and health verification, as well as results and route descriptions.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: Ukmergės Factory Cross Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event that includes cross-country running, MTB cross, and rogaining competitions. The event takes place in Kopūstėlių Forest in Ukmergė and aims to promote active leisure in nature and popularize sports among participants of all ages. The race starts simultaneously for all groups in the evening, and participants compete according to age groups and discipline types. The main organizer is VšĮ Sportas miške, and the event is supported by several Ukmergė companies.
course_highlights: The competitions take place in Kopūstėlių Forest in Ukmergė
Five stages covering running, MTB cross, and rogaining disciplines
The race starts in the evening, with a time limit of 120 minutes (except Mini Rogaining)
additional: Number and timing devices are issued from 16:30 to 17:30 at the race start location. Rogaining maps are distributed to participants at 17:45, with the start at 18:00. The race time limit is 120 minutes (except Mini Rogaining). The start is simultaneous for all groups and consistent across all stages. Participants register with a health check and consent form; race categories are divided by age and activity level.

name: Vilniaus Kroso Pirmenybė
description: The open Vilnius district cross-country championships took place on November 14 in Nemenčinė, at the biathlon shooting range, organized by the Vilnius district municipality's Department of Culture, Sports, and Tourism together with the Vilnius district sports school. Athletes from various Lithuanian districts participated in the event, and the youngest participants competed in the 150 m "Olympic Hope" run. After the finish, children were awarded medals, and the best were presented with cups. The competitions were held in different age groups, where participants had to cover distances from 150 m to 5000 m.

description: The international running race "Amber Sea Maiden 2024" will take place in Klaipėda on October 12, 2024. Participants can choose the 8 km distance, which starts at 13:10 from the Giruliai TV tower. The route is marked along a bike path, and at the Summer Concert Stage, runners will turn onto Liepaja.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė
description: The Amber Sea Mile 2025 will take place in the beautiful Smiltynė, where the start and finish will be at the Sports Wellness Base. Participants under 20 years old and LLAF members can start for free if registered by October 8th at 11:00 PM. Those registering on October 9th until 3:00 PM will pay a starting fee of 5 euros. The race includes 3 sea miles (5.55 km – one lap) for women and youth, and 6 sea miles (11.11 km – two laps) for men and youth.

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Kaišiadorys Marathon 2026 is the first marathon organized in Kaišiadorys, scheduled for October 10, 2026. This event marks a new tradition, bringing together runners from Lithuania and abroad. The marathon will take place in an active and sporty city known for its sports events and active lifestyle. The event is organized by BK "Kaišiadorys bėga", Kaišiadorys District Municipality, Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Center, and VšĮ "Maratomanija".
course_highlights: Marathon distance: 42.195 km, half marathon 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5 km, 2 km, 400 m
Start and finish at Teofilio Matulionio Square, Kaišiadorys
10.6 km loop with GPX file link for route planning
additional: Participant number issuance begins at 8:00 AM. The start times are 10:00 AM for the marathon, half marathon, and 10.6 km distances. The 400 m children’s run starts at 1:30 PM. Time limits are: 6 hours for the marathon, 3 hours for the half marathon, 2 hours for 10.6 km, 1 hour for 5 km. A 6-hour limit is set for Nordic walking distances. Awards will be given after the finish of each distance. The event location is Kaišiadorys, Teofilio Matulionio Square; registration and regulations are described in the event rules.

description: The Amber Sea Mile is an international running event held in the beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers various distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for all participants, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports Wellness Base, and participants are served soldier's porridge and tea. The race tradition commemorates the winners' names on a memorial stone, raised from the seabed.
course_highlights: The route takes place in the stunning Smiltynė with start and finish at the Sports Wellness Base
Distances: 0.5, 1, 3, and 6 nautical miles races according to age and gender groups
Memorial stone with winners' names, raised from the seabed
additional: Participant numbers are issued on October 10 from 10:15 AM at the Secretariat. The event opening is at 12:30 PM on October 10. Soldier's porridge and tea are served to all participants. Registration is open until October 8 at 3:00 PM; on October 9 and on the race day, registration will not be available. Age groups and distances are adjusted according to year of birth and gender. Ferry schedule for participants: www.keltas.lt. Event date - October 10, 2026, start at the Smiltynė nature corner. Participant registration is online, and the routes include 1, 3, and 6 nautical miles distances.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
location: SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaas Kubijal, Võru, Estonia
description: The 42nd Munamäe - Võru trail run-walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance takes place on terrain and asphalt roads, providing a diverse route in the Võru region. The series also includes shorter distances and children's runs suitable for participants of all ages. The event is held at the SA Võru Sports Center's ski base in Kubija, known for its beautiful nature and good trail conditions.
course_highlights: The main distance runs on terrain and asphalt roads in the Võru region
Diverse distances: approximately 5.9 km, mini-distance 1.16 km, and children's runs
The route is partly trail and partly paved
additional: The competition center opens at 11:00 at the Kubija Ski Base. Buses depart from Kubija to various start points, such as Haanja and Kasaritsa. In addition to running, the series includes walking and children's runs. The route is partly on asphalt and gravel roads and also includes softer terrain on the grounds of the Haanja Recreation and Sports Center. Smaller distances for children and beginners are also held as part of the event, with registration and maps available on the organizer's website. The event promotes healthy lifestyles and active community participation.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Skrylle naturreservat, Södra Sandby, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-oriented race organized by Björnstorps IF with start/finish at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organizers are focusing on a new, more trail-based loop course where you can choose to run one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is promoted as a close-to-nature and challenging experience on the best trails in the area, with information updated continuously during the spring. An early bird spot is offered, and there is also a children's race of 600 meters.
course_highlights: Loop course starting from Skryllegården
More trail - the course utilizes the area's best trails
Time limit for 25 km: passing 12.5 km no later than 12:15 (based on a start at 10:30)
additional: Registration can be done online up to 60 minutes before the start, and on-site registration is also available. On race day, name or class changes can be made for a fee of 100 SEK (class change 12.5->56 km 200 SEK). On-site payments can only be made via Swish. The 600 m children's race is free, medals are awarded, and pre-registration is not possible; bib numbers for the children's race are collected during check-in on race morning. Parking at Skryllegården may be crowded - the organizer encourages carpooling or cycling. New course with trail elements; first start at 12.5 km at 11:00 and 25 km at 10:30. The 25 km race has a time limit for the second lap at 12:15. Registration online until 60 minutes before the start; on-site or class changes allowed for a fee. On race day, registration can also be done on-site and paid via Swish. Bib distribution at Löplabbet in Lund before the race and at Skryllegården on race day. There is baggage check, and the 600 m children's race is free.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is organized by Ryssbergets IK and offers several races on the same competition day: 10.0 km, 5.0 km, children's race 2.0 km, as well as a Walk - Stroll - Run option. Registration is done via the club's registration page and maps for 10.0 km and 5.0 km are published on the website. The club encourages participants to review the age/class division and volunteer information in advance. The organizer continuously communicates practical information via their website and contact email.
course_highlights: Courses for 10.0 km and 5.0 km (maps are available on the website)
Children's race 2.0 km and Walk - Stroll - Run as alternatives
Age/class division according to age/class (see division on the website)
additional: Maps for 10.0 km and 5.0 km are published on the website. There is a volunteer registration - the organizer requests volunteers and volunteer participation affects the handling of entry fees (see volunteer registration). Contact details and mailing address: Ryssbergets IK, Kyrkvägen 1, 29535 Bromölla; tel. 0705876711; email info@ryssbergetsik.se. Results will be published after the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race aiming to raise awareness of how important physical activity is for mental health. The race is organized by the association Mental Health Run and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to participate regardless of background or fitness level - the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maritime Museum on Djurgården
Easy 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
Course on Djurgården with lake views and city environment
additional: There is a virtual version of the race (scheduled for October 10 - 18, 2026) and the event offers medals as an optional add-on during registration as well as the possibility to donate. Optional medals and donations are shipped within a month after the virtual race has ended. Information about bib numbers and pickup is published on the news pages (in previous years, bibs could be collected at Filmstaden Sergel). Medals as an optional add-on and the opportunity to donate to psychiatric research; medals are sent out within a month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app during the period October 10 - 18 with a special code, and results are displayed at the finish area. Timing is done with Racetimer; baggage drop, accessible toilets, and refreshments are available; Nordic walking and dogs are allowed to start further back.

name: Ultunamilen
description: The Ultuna Mile is a recreational race in Uppsala offering distances of 5 km and 10 km. According to the results list published for the race on October 10, 2026, the categories for men in the mentioned distances are visible. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration managed via SportAdmin. The date for the mentioned edition is October 10, 2026, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Results published (men's categories) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows October 10, 2026, as the date and the distances of 5 km and 10 km. Note that external pages (such as Stockholm-updates) require login for full information.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården – a fun and challenging cross-country race where the fighting spirit often matters more than a perfect running stride. The course offers forest trails, muddy passages, wet sections, and technical elements; choose between 5 or 10 km as an adult. For children, there is Kalvruset (approximately 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approximately 700 m). The event is organized by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården with forest trails, muddy passages, and wet sections
Choice between 5 km and 10 km for adults; Kalvruset approximately 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approximately 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers in tents are available a few minutes walk from the finish line, as well as simple rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are clothing disposal stations for items that may not be taken home. Kalvruset has a medical first aid team on site, and all children receive a medal with the year. The organizer is Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; profits go back to sports. Group registration for companies; company tents and gathering areas; profits go back to sports.

name: Tjurruset (Haningen)
location: Rudans friluftsområde, Haninge, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun cross-country race held in wild forest with natural obstacles in Rudan outdoor area in Haninge. The race offers distances of 5 and 10 kilometers where participants will experience muddy passages, trail paths, and challenging terrain. Tjurruset is known for its fighting spirit and is open to both veterans and beginners who do not fear dirt and muddy clothes. After the race, there are opportunities for showers and rinsing, and the event is organized by Marathongruppen with profits going back to sports.
course_highlights: Wild forest and natural obstacles
Muddy passages and challenging terrain
Trail paths in Rudan outdoor area, Haninge
additional: The bib number is sent home upon registration before September 2, otherwise it can be collected on site from 08:30. The bib number is personal and must be worn with a chip for timing. After the race, there are warm showers in tents and simpler rinsing facilities. There are clothing disposal stations for items that cannot be taken home. Public transport by commuter train to Handen station is recommended. Name changes for start places are possible for a fee until September 24. The race also includes a children's race and often co-organizations with other cross-country races, as well as information about registration, parking, and start times.

description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a challenging race held at the classic Yxbacken outside Norrköping. The race consists of five laps, each including a tough ascent of 100 meters in elevation over 350 meters, followed by a downhill in the family slope. Participants can choose to run with or without timing, and pole use is allowed; however, pole users are not counted in the timed class. After the race, participants are offered food and drinks as well as free leg massages, and everyone receives a medal as proof of their achievement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg's home slope, Yxbacken
5 laps with 100 meters of elevation gain over 350 meters per lap
Downhill in the family slope between each ascent
additional: Number bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday, October 3rd between 14:00 and 18:00. Late registration is possible via the website until October 1st and on-site with Swish payment. Liquids are available at the start and finish areas. Manheims Säteri provides food and drinks after the race, Fenix Brewery offers non-alcoholic beer, and Finspångs Brunnsborrning supplies sports drinks. Free leg massages are offered before and after the race. Professional timing with chip on the bib. Toilets and staffed baggage drop-off are available at the competition area. The event takes place in October and includes challenging terrain with steep hills and multiple laps, making it a popular and demanding race for adventurous runners.

name: Vilnius 700 Ultra
description: The Vilnius 700 Ultra running race will take place on October 12, 2024, in Vingis Park. The event partners are the Craftsmen's Club "Dvaro Meistrai". Participant numbers will be issued starting at 8:00 AM on the day of the race. All distances will start at 9:00 AM, and the time limit for the 70 km and relay 70 km runs is 8 hours. The winners and prize-winners will be awarded at 5:00 PM.
