name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional series of running and walking events that offers diverse running opportunities for different age groups and levels. The stages of the series take place in the Lääne-Virumaa region, providing runners with beautiful landscapes and a pleasant sporting experience. The Võsu Autumn Run is the 7th stage of the series, held in the Võsu Laine area, and is part of a long-standing running series. The goal of the series is to motivate people to stay active, enjoy running, and engage in health sports.
course_highlights: Diverse terrain in the Lääne-Virumaa region
Part of a long-standing running series
Courses suitable for different age groups and levels
additional: The series features various distances and age categories, including youth runs and children's runs. The stages of the series are held in different locations within Lääne-Virumaa, with the direction and terrain of the runs varying from year to year. Participants are advised to register in a timely manner, but detailed registration and pricing information is not provided. Other runs and activities are organized as part of the Võsu Autumn Run, with online registration available, and participants have the opportunity to receive awards categorized by age group.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: Viljandi City Run is a traditional endurance race held annually on the second Sunday of October in Viljandi. The race course runs around Lake Viljandi and is one of the oldest sports competitions in Estonia, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several community sports events are organized, including children's races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long and offers a sporting and lively experience for both amateurs and professional athletes.
course_highlights: Run around Lake Viljandi
Course length 10.4 km
One of Estonia's oldest endurance race traditions
additional: Children's races for age groups 5 - 6, 7 - 8, 9 - 10, and 11 - 12 years old, free of charge and without timing. The community run 5 km starts at 11:00. Awards ceremony at 14:00. Registration and distribution of start materials at Freedom Square from 9:00 to 11:30. The race course closes at 14:30. The event day begins with registration at Freedom Square at 9:00, and competitions run until 14:30. Participants receive medals, and the event also includes children's activities and a fun run for amateurs.

name: Piwna Mila

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za Piwną Milę wynosi 50 zł

description: Piwna Mila is a unique race with an adjustable distance from 1700 to 2000 meters, and is the most important event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking a beer, and approximately every 500 meters there are refreshment points with beer. This sporting celebration combines runners, spectators, and entire families, offering a unique atmosphere and a special medal for completing the race.
course_highlights: Flexible distance 1700 - 2000 m
Refreshment points with beer every 500 m
Race start by drinking a beer
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip for timing and 4 craft beers along the route. The bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and cannot be covered or modified. A T-shirt can be ordered during the registration fee payment in the Runner's Panel. The race office is open on 14.08.2026 (17:00 - 19:00), 15.08.2026 (7:00 - 11:00), and 16.08.2026 (11:00 - 11:45). The flexible distance is 1700-2000 meters, beer on the route, online registration from January 1, 2026, to August 12, 2026, with the option to order a T-shirt during the registration fee payment.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: Friendship Run is one of the events within the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Skrzeszewo, offering participants the opportunity to spend active time and discover the charms of Kaszuby. The running series attracts runners of various ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the integration of the local community.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic areas of Kaszuby
The race takes place in a natural, friendly environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: The event will take place on October 11, 2026, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. Participants can expect a medal, prizes, raffles, and refreshments.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, October 11, 2026 - a fast and well-organized 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby in northwest Stockholm. The course is flat, precisely measured to 10,000 meters, and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. On the same day, the Little Hässelbyloppet for children and youth is also held. All information about the course, start, registration, and practical details for runners can be found on the website.
course_highlights: Flat and fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta, and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: Race center is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100), the start takes place on a field 400 meters from the sports ground, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometer away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 years (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5-13 can participate in Little Hässelbyloppet. The maximum allowed time is 2 hours. The course has been measured by an approved course measurer and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; the event is broadcast live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approximately 37:30 - 60 minutes). Live streaming of the event is offered according to information from the organizer.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of darkness. Dog trail is a special class where you can share the evening with your dog on 5 km or 10 km, and the courses are designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark - the courses are reflective marked and headlamps are mandatory. All proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Reflective marked courses
Free start time 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for dog handlers: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km can start until 19:00). The courses are reflectively marked and headlamps are mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run together with their dog (5 and 10 km). Free start time between 18:00 - 19:30 (10 km until 19:00); courses with reflectors; headlamp required.

name: Trail Kuršių Nerija
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratonas, 30 km, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Trail Kursiu Nerija (#TKN) is an unforgettable running adventure with incredible views and lots of sand! This run takes place in the Curonian Spit and offers various distances – from 1 km to 104 km, so everyone can find a suitable challenge.
course_highlights: Various distances from 1 km to 104 km
Runs in the Curonian Spit
Scenic views and sandy terrain

images.alt_text: Bėgikas bėga per Trail Kuršių Nerija lenktynes.
Bėgikai miško takeliu.
Bėgikai miško takeliu, Kuršių Nerijos kraštovaizdis.
Bėgikas bėga taku per mišką ir smėlį. Aplink medžiai ir pilki debesys.

name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: Running race "Grazikai - Kelmė" in memory of V. Rimkus took place on October 28, 2023, in Kelmė, commemorating the 50th anniversary of this traditional event. This year, more than 200 runners from all over Lithuania and guests from Ukraine participated, with Vitalij Kuznetsov being the fastest over the 8 km distance. Among women, the fastest was Aurika Balsytė, originally from Kelmė district. There was also a 1.8 km race, where Lukas Mikavičius performed the best, and a 200 m race for children.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo startas su S-Sportas logotipu, dalyviai bėga pro starto liniją.
Bėgikų grupė su medaliais po lenktynių.
Bėgikų grupė su medaliais ir trofėjais.
Bėgikų grupė su Ukrainos vėliava prieš arba po bėgimo.

name: Pagarbos bėgimas IN MEMORIAM
location: Vingio parko estrada, M. K. Čiurlionio gatvė, Vilnius
description: On October 19th at 10:00 AM, for the 10th time at Vingis Park in Vilnius, a memorial/support run "In Memoriam" will take place to honor those who sacrificed their lives for our freedom. The event brings together the community to remember and honor these heroes, and participants in the 10 km distance will compete for awards in the open Lithuanian Army Championship. There will also be opportunities to run, walk, or roll 1 km and 4 km non-competitively, where winners and prize recipients will not be selected.

images.alt_text: Karių grupė bėga parke.
Lietuvos kariuomenės kariai su vėliavomis renginyje "In Memoriam", skirtame kariams atminti.
„IN MEMORIAM“ bėgimo reklama su data ir organizacijų logotipais.
"IN MEMORIAM" bėgimo reklama su bėgančio žmogaus siluetu ir informacija apie renginį.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: The Backyard Ultra World Championship is a unique off-road running event where runners must complete a 6.7 km loop every hour until only the last one remains. The competition takes place on mountainous and off-road trails that require endurance and willpower. The event is a challenge for both physical and psychological endurance, and there is always only one winner. Trail Kalvė organizes this event with special attention to trail quality and participant experience, inviting runners to test themselves and surpass their limits.
course_highlights: Off-road trails with mountainous terrain
A 6.7 km loop every hour
The race continues until only the last runner remains
additional: The race takes place during the cold season, usually on Sundays. Participants receive a Trail Kalvė running band upon first registration of the season. Medals are awarded only for special achievements, not at every stage. About 15 athletes participate in the event, with trail distances ranging from 5 km to 60 km, free training sessions, medals and souvenirs are given, aiming to break 100 miles in 24 hours records. The event has been organized since 2022.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
price_range: bilieto kaina – Jūsų pasirinkta paramos suma
description: The 'In Memoriam' Run of Gratitude and Support in Vilnius is a prominent event dedicated to honoring Lithuanian Armed Forces soldiers who passed away this year and supporting their families. The event takes place in Vingis Park and includes 1 km and 4 km distances without competition, as well as a 10 km open Lithuanian Armed Forces running championship. The run originated as a heartfelt initiative to remember a young officer and has become an important annual civic and patriotic tradition. Organized by the Birutė Officers' Families Women's Union in cooperation with the Ministry of National Defence and the Lithuanian Armed Forces.
course_highlights: Vingis Park routes in Vilnius
1 km and 4 km distances without competition
10 km open Lithuanian Armed Forces running championship
additional: The event patron is the Commander of the Lithuanian Armed Forces, Gen. Raimundas Vaikšnoras. Participants can choose to run, walk, or roll the 1 km and 4 km distances without competition; winners and prize recipients are not awarded in these categories. The event also includes a 10 km run with competitive elements. Support for the families of fallen soldiers is collected via Paysera, bank account, and PayPal platform. The event is dedicated to the memory of soldiers, with proceeds allocated to their families; it takes place in the fall.

name: Trail Kursiu Nerija #TKN
description: Trail Kuršių Nerija #TKN is a wonderful run through the natural trails of the Curonian Spit in Lithuania, offering various distance options from a 1 km kids' route to an extreme 104 km. The event captivates participants with its breathtaking views, sandy paths, and the opportunity to run or walk at your own pace. It is a great chance to experience the beauty of nature and spend active time with family or friends. The event is friendly for all running levels and age groups.
course_highlights: Natural trails with plenty of sand
Various distances from 1 km for children to 104 km for extreme runners
Unmatched views of the Curonian Spit
additional: The 10 km route has a 76 m elevation gain, with a maximum of 400 participants. The 1 km kids' route is limited to 200 participants and includes running with an animator in a heated tent. Participants in the 10 km route must carry an ID and a charged mobile phone or a watch with the route's GPX. After the finish, participants can enjoy showers, massage, porridge, tea, as well as a national park ticket and outdoor games for children. The event center features a heated tent and a luggage storage area. The TKN AFTER PARTY runs until 01:30, with the last ferry to Klaipėda at 02:20. The event offers various distances, including kids' races and ultramarathons, with aid stations, GPX tracking, medals, and post-race activities. Registration closes in mid-September.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 8 km distancijai taikomas 5,- Eur startinis mokestis

description: The Graužikai-Kelmė Run is a traditional race in the Kelmė district dedicated to the memory of Vaidotas Rimkus. The event takes place in October and aims to promote running and athletics in Lithuania, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase activity among local residents. The event attracts runners of all ages, with several distances to choose from, including an 8 km main race. Participants are awarded cups, medals, and commemorative prizes.
course_highlights: 8 km distance starts from Graužikai
1.8 km run for girls and boys near the Kelmė Regional Museum
200 m children’s run near the museum
additional: The race begins at 12:30 PM with different distances and times. Arrive by 11:30 AM at the Kelmė Regional Museum, departure to the start at 12:15 PM. The 200 m children’s run is conducted without registration. Participants must present a medical certificate regarding their health condition. Winners and prize-winners of various age groups are awarded, and all who complete the distance receive a commemorative medal. The event will be held at the Kelmė Regional Museum, with registration available until October 16. Participant age groups and prizes are specified.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The race promotes the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, and participants can enjoy excellent refreshment stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent refreshment stations along the route
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, and a Junior Trail run up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions of Pomerania and is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. Supported by Coconaut, with routes of varying difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino, and stunning views of Kashubia.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, based at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The races promote the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, with well-prepared aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the route
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. There are 5 main distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, as well as a Junior run up to 1 km. The organizer is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic Walking. It is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. The event features multiple distances, routes through beautiful Kashubian areas, support from #ActiveVillage, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka that invites runners of all ages and levels. The races go through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills on lovely running trails and roads, offering short courses for children as well as longer options for recreational runners. For the youngest participants, there is a relatively flat course, and the event is arranged as a pleasant day with music, refreshments, and award ceremonies. It is emphasized as a local and friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Hellas area past lakes and over hills
Beautiful running trails and sections on roads - mixed terrain
Three-stage format: 400 m (MICA race), 1,400 m, and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; bus from Slussen is indicated as a transportation option. There is ample parking and bicycle parking at the start area. Award ceremonies are held continuously and the catering will be open. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km, and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and space to park bikes at the start; catering opens.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race runs eight laps around Växjösjön on what the organizers call "Sweden's fastest course." The course is very flat (elevation change approx. 3 m) and mostly paved with about 300 meters of fine gravel; each lap is measured in August 2024. There is also a relay race and a children's race, and the course is marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Växjösjön
Very flat course, elevation change approx. 3 m
Mostly asphalt with ~300 m fine gravel; marked with lead cyclists and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed, which means runners share the paths with pedestrians and cyclists; motor traffic occurs at three points along the course. Each lap is measured (August 2024). There is an option to participate in a relay as a team, and the event also includes a children's race for 2026. The relay consists of four runners each running two laps; the course is open to pedestrians and cyclists and shares space with them as well as motor traffic at three locations.

name: Åhus TrailRun
location: Strandridaregården, Friseboda, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race in the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organized by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km, and 2.5 km, as well as a children's race of about 350 meters with a medal and no timing. The courses are gently hilly and consist of a mix of trails, sand dunes, terrain, and beach running along the coast - participants are guaranteed a running experience beyond the ordinary. The race suits both competitive runners and recreational athletes and also features team competitions and a maximum of 1000 participants.
course_highlights: Gently hilly terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, challenging hills, and beach running along the sea
17 km: approximately 60% trail, 25% terrain, 15% beach - elevation gain approx. 310 meters
Arena at Strandridaregården, only about 100 meters from the sea
additional: Participant limit: max 1000 participants. Start times: 12:30 for 2.5 km and 6 km; 12:40 for 11 km and 17 km; children's race individually from 13:00 to 15:00. Bib distribution from 10:45 (pick up no later than one hour before your start). Cut-off time: the finish line closes 2 hours and 50 minutes after the 17 km start (at 15:30) - the last 6 km lap must be started no later than 60 minutes before the finish line closes. Arena: Strandridaregården in Friseboda; parking is limited and only allowed according to officials' instructions (carpooling tips via the race's Facebook group). Valuables storage available for a fee (20 SEK, cash or Swish). Children's race with medal and free registration; online registration closes the Wednesday before the race; late registration can be done at the start/finish area; bib must be collected by 10:45; parking is limited near the arena; water stations at all stations; electronic timing and live online results.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is an urban and nature marathon that runs through historic Uppsala with start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The race combines city pulse in central Uppsala with scenic views along Ekoln, Fyrisån, and the mounds in Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, and relay for four-person teams, and also serves as the district championship (DM) in marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and targets both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and central shopping streets
The route goes along the shores of Ekoln and Fyrisån and out to the mounds in Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half hard-packed gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib number pickup from October 1 to 16 at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4 - 6) and on race day October 17 from 07:30 (lasts 45 minutes before the start). Registration is accepted via RaceID and Epassi can be used as payment. Maximum participants: Marathon 1500, Half Marathon 2500, Marathon relay 150 teams. Anyone registering by September 15, 2026, will have their name on the bib. Age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon (born 2009 or earlier). Award ceremony at the finish area at 13:00. Food and non-alcoholic drinks are available at the finish area; relay teams receive a finisher’s shirt and medal. Recommended to use public transport or bike (bus stops Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus, buses 2 and 7); parking is available within walking distance. DM medals in Marathon and Half Marathon; medal ceremony the Tuesday after the race; age limit 17 years for marathon/half marathon; Epassi payment, transfer via RaceID, start times, transportation and parking, baggage drop, changing/shower, insurance, and prizes; registration opens until October 12, 2026, with the possibility of closing earlier if maximum capacity is reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a pleasant race in central Jönköping suitable for both elite runners and enthusiastic amateurs. The races, starting at Lillsjöplan, take place on a completely flat and measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seedings. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are offered, and the organizers emphasize a good atmosphere with pacemakers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Group registration offers a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and there are options for group registration for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap, 10 km = 2 laps
The course is measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and seedings are based on it
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. 5K run in one lap, 10K in two laps. Pacemakers with flags for 40, 45, and 50 minutes on the 10K. Register up to 5 runners at the same time via the regular registration; for more runners, group registration is available. Group registration (three people) offers a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. No start certificates are sent out. The course and profile are presented on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: October 17, 2026, start at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K in one lap, 10K in two laps; refreshment stations with UMARA sports drinks and water; baggage drop-off at start/finish; proximity to parking garages; start list and pacer information; limited baggage drop-off and on-site start certificate pickup.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC Race is an annual cross-country race organized by Linköpings OK at Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km trail in varied terrain, including forest paths and marshes, and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive categories. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, as well as a recreational class of 5 km, with the 10 km races run twice. The event is known for its challenging and muddy terrain, with start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with forest paths and marshes
Distance options for both recreational and competitive runners
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Sports Center
additional: Muddy and challenging terrain, registration via website with payment by card or Swish on site, parking at Vidingsjön and LOK-gården.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail runs focusing on the experience of how light and darkness meet. You can choose 5 km, 10 km, or 30 km with start and finish at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km, you navigate with a downloadable GPS route and map, and the race has energy stations along the way. Welcome to register - all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Night trail run in the glow of headlamps with course marked with reflectors
30 km run with GPS route and map, featuring two energy stations
The final part of the 30 km follows the same reflector-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: For 5 km and 10 km, there is free start time within specified windows (18:00 - 19:30 for 5 km; 18:00 - 19:00 for 10 km). For the 30 km, you receive a GPS route and map in advance, the race has two energy stations and a maximum time of 4 hours 30 minutes; the last part follows the reflector course. Start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna, the organizer requests participants to finish by 20:30, and registration is open until one hour before each start. The 30 km starts at 16:00 on October 17, 2026. For 5 km, free start is between 18:00 - 19:30, and for 10 km between 18:00 - 19:00; the course follows the reflector course to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense uphill race in Hammarbybacken scheduled for October 17, 2026. The race is just over 3 - 3.5 km long with steep inclines and over 200 meters of elevation gain, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners looking to challenge themselves. The finish line is at the top of the hill with a beautiful view of the city. The children's races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 - 3.5 km with over 200 meters of elevation
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbyhöjden; finish at the top with a view of the city
Intensive uphill focus (finish line services, water stations along the course)
additional: Start bibs are sent via email (usually about 2 weeks before the race or sooner if registering late). Number bib distribution takes place at the event area Hammarby Fabriksväg (details in the information text) and opens from 09:30 according to participant information. The bib contains a chip and should be worn unfolded at 45 - 90°; attach with safety pins (bring about 4) and write name/phone number and medical info on the back. The race includes timing, a medal, and water stations; in the children's races, water is available at the finish and medals are awarded. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free uphill training sessions in Hammarbybacken are available before the race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 meters, and the format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour up to a total of 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under one hour to start the next; the one who completes the most laps (and is fastest on the last lap) wins in the women's and men's categories. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to challenge their endurance on a technical but easy-to-run trail in the scenic Garnudden. A smaller MiniBackyard is offered for children/beginners with on-site registration and their own start time in the afternoon.
course_highlights: A lap length of 6.706 km with start/finish at Bubblan in Toredal
Surface approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the promenade around Garnudden
Several longer inclines and a concluding downhill run as well as a flat asphalt stretch towards the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens March 1, 2026. Rönninge 6h (June 6, 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, registration on site. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se no later than October 1 with an administrative fee of 45 SEK. The race features hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, etc.; the final start at 20:00. Laps are registered with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Coffee and snacks are served at 20:00 after the last lap. The race: 6706 meters per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, last start at 20:00; surface approximately 80% asphalt/gravel; women's and men's categories. Mini Backyard is organized by KIF Toredal with a fee of 50 SEK on site.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
location: Stadion Miejski w Pucku, Puck, Puck County, Poland
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known Pomeranian running event, returning in 2026 in a new edition under the banner of STONE TRI & RUN. The race takes place on a refreshed route in an autumn setting, making it an ideal end to the running season. The event features races over the half marathon distance and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic walking march, all with individual start times. It is a perfect opportunity to actively spend time in the beautiful Kashubian landscapes and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Triathlon Series.
course_highlights: Refreshed half marathon route through picturesque Kashubian landscapes
Autumn climate conducive to runners
Final event in the Puck Triathlon Series
additional: The event includes three competitions: a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking march, all with individual starts. Organizers ensure professional route preparation, excellent marking, and security. The event is part of the STONE TRI & RUN cycle, which promotes an active lifestyle and a family-friendly sporting atmosphere in Kashubia. The route is asphalt, with start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Puck, the finale of the Puck Triathlon Series. Registrations open from December 12, 2025, to October 12, 2026.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is an easy-to-run and fast half marathon in a scenic environment with start and finish at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along Värtan’s shoreline, a scenic loop around Rönningesjön, and a finish back at the sea with a view towards Bogesundslandet. The race is measured and organized by Täby IS Athletics, and suits runners who want to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. In previous years, the race has been very popular with limited spots, so the organizer encourages early registration.
course_highlights: First approximately 5 km along Värtan’s shoreline with sea views
Scenic loop around Rönningesjön passing Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlötens outdoor recreation area
Approximately 125 meters of elevation; about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Castle. Little Täby Marathon for children aged 5 - 11 years (1.2 km) with start times at 10:00 (born 2017 - 2020) and 10:15 (born 2014 - 2016). Sports drinks from partner Umara are served at water stations. The maximum time for the half marathon is 2 hours and 45 minutes. Bib number distribution: Stadium in Täby Centrum from Wednesday before the race and pickup at the start area from 09:00 to 10:45 on race day. The course has approximately 125 meters of elevation and consists of about 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel; water stations along the course with Umara; previous capacity approximately 1500 participants.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen - perhaps the fastest controlled measured 10K run this autumn at Geneta Sports Field in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on bicycle and pedestrian paths and is fully asphalted, making the race very fast and suitable for those aiming for a personal best. Water stations are available at 5 km and at the finish line. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Children's Cancer Foundation for each registered runner; prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and there will also be a raffle of approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Controlled measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% asphalt on bicycle and pedestrian paths - very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish line
additional: Changing rooms are available on site but the organizer recommends that participants come dressed. Late registration on the day of the race is possible if the race is not fully booked. The organizer forgoes medals and instead donates an amount to the Children's Cancer Foundation per registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both women's and men's categories, and approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants. Names and images from the race day may be published on the club's website and social media. Contact information: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Last registration date is October 15; late registration on site if spots are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medal will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be raffled among all participants; contact details are provided in the event page text.

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF in Södertälje. The race starts and ends at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area and offers several categories for children, youth, and adults. It is a well-established event with a long tradition, where participants can enjoy a varied and scenic course. The event is open to everyone and follows the competition rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail running
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports ground)
Multiple distances and categories for children, youth, and adults
additional: Late registration on site is possible up to 60 minutes before each start with an additional fee of 100 SEK for adult categories and 50 SEK for youth categories. Start times for youth categories are 11:00, 11:10, and 11:35, and for adult categories at 12:30. By registering, participants agree to the publication of their name and any photos on the website and social media. Road and trail running, different distances for children, youth, and adults, registration by April 4, late registration on site up to 60 minutes before the start.

name: Krosas Juodšilių ruduo
description: On October 25, 2025, the Sports Events Association together with the Juodšiliai Eldership of Vilnius District Municipality will organize the sports festival "Juodšiliai Autumn." The race course includes the Mokyklos Street forest trail and the Šilo Street forest trails, with a length of 4.5 km per lap. Bib number distribution and new participant registration will take place from 10:00 to 11:30 AM, and the races will start at 12:00 PM with a 600 m run, followed by 4.5 km, 9 km, and 18 km distances at 12:15 PM.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo startas "Juodšilių ruduo" varžybose.
Bėgimo startas su vaikais po Juodšilių rudens arkos.
Juodšilių ruduo logo su bėgikais, dviratininku ir rudens lapais.
Botanikos sodo bėgimo trasa.

name: Krosas „Juodšilių ruduo“
description: Juodšiliai Cross Country is a sports festival in Vilnius district, taking place on October 24 in Juodšiliai. The event is organized by the association "Sports Events" together with the Juodšiliai eldership of Vilnius district municipality. This cross country race encourages the local community to engage in sports and promotes athletics and running in Lithuania. The competition is open to all interested participants and focuses on a healthy lifestyle and the participation of athletes from various age groups.
course_highlights: The course runs in Juodšiliai town, Mokyklos g. 9
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross country distances
Participants must wear numbers on the front of their shirts
additional: Number distribution and registration are from 10:00 to 11:30. It is prohibited to transfer the number to another participant, use personal accompaniment, or walk animals on the course. Participants must follow the course and officials' instructions. Complaints must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the race with a 30 EUR fee. Changing to a shorter distance incurs a 6 EUR fee, changing to a longer distance involves an additional start fee. Event location: Juodšiliai, Vilnius district; distances: 600 m, 4 km, 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; the number of participants is open, with special conditions and fees.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Sports festival "Juodšiliai Autumn" is a sports event in Vilnius district, taking place on October 24, 2026, in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to actively participate in sports, promotes track and field athletics and running, and advocates for a healthy lifestyle. The competition is open to all interested participants, with race distances of 600 meters, 4 km, and 12 km. Participants register and receive their numbers on-site from 10:00 to 11:30 AM. The races are voluntary and at participants' own risk regarding their health.
course_highlights: Course within Juodšiliai municipality, Vilnius district
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross-country races
During the event, it is forbidden to walk animals and use personal escorts
additional: Number distribution and registration are from 10:00 to 11:30 AM. Participants must have an ID to collect their number. It is prohibited to transfer the number to another person, use personal escorts, walk animals on the course, or deviate from the course without a referee’s permission. Complaints must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the end of the race, with a fee of 30 EUR. The fee for changing a race category is 6 EUR; upgrading to a longer race requires paying the difference. Running events: 600 m, 4 km, 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participant encouragement and commemorative medals; participant restrictions and rules.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held in Norrköping's own ski slope. The race is described as challenging - in 2024, five tough laps were completed in the hill - and it caters both to competitive runners and families through a separate children's race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children's activities, and subsequent prize and photo ceremonies.
course_highlights: Run in Norrköping's ski slope (Yxbacken)
Consisted of five challenging laps in 2024
Children's race "Lilla Yxbackenloppet" introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race was held on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. The 2024 children's race had approximately 50 participating children who received medals at the finish line; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Photographer Magnus Media took pictures published on the race's Facebook page. About 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children's race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Stockholm: ALL OUT
description: All Out Dubstep is a long-standing and influential club night in Stockholm that has shaped the city's club music scene for nearly two decades. With a unique mix of subbass, mutated garage, hip hop, electro, and techno, the residents create an atmosphere that spans from Kingston to London. The event also celebrates birthdays with a broad lineup of DJs and artists playing everything from dancehall to Afro and Samba. It is a party for everyone who loves club music and the vibrant energy of the dance floor.
course_highlights: Deep subbass and mutated garage as a foundation
Mix of hip hop, electro, and techno with influences from Kingston and London
Wide musical styles from dancehall to Afro and Samba
additional: Free entry between 15:00 and 18:00, then admission from 200 SEK. The event runs from 15:00 to 03:00 and is held at Capital Sound System in Kvarteret / Hus 7, Styckmästargatan 10, Stockholm. Music, club, dubstep, techno, hip hop, Afro, Samba, dancehall, preparty

name: LBT 16 - Bėgimas Lietuvoje
description: LBT 16 - Run Around Lithuania will take place on October 26, 2025, at 11:00 AM at the Lithuanian Ethnographic Museum in Rumšiškės. Registration and number distribution will begin at 09:00 AM.
course_highlights: Event Date: October 26, 2025
Start Time: 11:00 AM
Location: Lithuanian Ethnographic Museum, Rumšiškės
Registration and number pickup start at 09:00 AM

images.alt_text: Bėgikas bėga mieste.
Rumšiškių Bėgimas Aplink Lietuvą vaizdas su malūnu ir peizažu.
Bėgikų grupė lauke, pasiruošę bėgimui.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The 'Around Lithuania' running event is a traditional race held in Rumšiškės, on the territory of the Lithuanian Ethnographic Museum. The event offers various distances from a children's 300 m run to a half marathon of 21.098 km, which is the main stage and included in the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend active time in nature and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances from 300 m children's run to 21.098 km half marathon
Starts according to age group handicap rules
Location - Lithuanian Ethnographic Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and bib distribution, 10:45 event opening, starts from 11:00 to 13:00 for different distances, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age group handicap system allows weaker participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with the possibility to register online. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Beach Run is the concluding race of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club season and triple event series, held at the Pärnu Beach Stadium. Participants can choose between 5 and 10 kilometer distances, which can be completed by running or walking with poles. The course runs through the beautiful Pärnu seaside area, offering participants natural scenery as well as characteristic architectural monuments of the city, including a seaside promenade with a view of the sea. The event is suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners and provides an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: 5 and 10 km distances run or walk with poles
Course runs through Pärnu seaside area with beautiful natural views and architectural monuments
Seaside promenade with a view of the sea
additional: Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers can be completed by running or walking with poles. The race is part of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club triple event series. Children's runs and virtual race distances are also scheduled. The event includes virtual runs and children's races and takes place at the Pärnu Beach Stadium, offering an opportunity to enjoy sports and nature together.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Night Deception is a unique night marathon and half-marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nocturnal setting. The race course consists of a loop approximately 7 kilometers long, which participants complete multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has an official PZLA certification, ensuring the verification of the course length and the possibility of setting world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners eager to improve their personal bests in the unforgettable conditions of a night run.
course_highlights: The course consists of a loop about 7 km long, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirming the course length
Views of the stadium along the route and the hilly terrain of Koszalin
additional: The registration office for children and youth opens around 7:00 PM, with a limited number of 20 spots. The registration office for adults is located at the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at Racławicka Street, about 300 meters from the stadium, and is open until 30 minutes before the start. A photo ID is required to collect the race number. The race route runs through the streets of Koszalin with views of the aviation museum exhibits. Medals and gadgets are updated annually and are an important part of the event. The event offers various distances, including marathon and half-marathon, with live reports, photo galleries, and videos, as well as online and in-person registration options. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the opportunity to compete in different thematic categories.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual race covering the half marathon distance, held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants have the opportunity to run through charming parts of the city, with the finish line at ERGO Arena, providing a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive starting packages. It is an excellent opportunity to experience sports emotions in the Pearl of the Baltic and to receive a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route runs through the center of Sopot and seaside promenades
Finish line located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and the characteristic Sopot pier
additional: The start package includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half marathon route is certified and runs through the center of Sopot and seaside promenades. The finish line is at ERGO Arena, ensuring comfortable conditions for competitors after the race. Start packages are available from February 10, 2026, with a participant limit of 3,500 people, discounts for Sopot Card holders, and the event is part of the Pomorze Half Marathons Crown cycle 2026-2030.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Valley Run along the Lower Vistula Valley is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two routes: a marathon of 42.195 km with PZLA certification and a half marathon of 21.097 km without certification. The courses lead through picturesque areas of the Vistula Valley, with varied surfaces including asphalt and gravel, and the race takes place with limited vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00 AM, and the half marathon begins in Małe Walichnawy at 11:00 AM, with the finish line located in Tczew.
course_highlights: Marathon with PZLA certification of 42.195 km through Tczew and surrounding towns
Half marathon of 21.097 km with a mixed asphalt and gravel route
Course marked every 1 km with horizontal signs and yellow boards
additional: The participant limit is 400 paid runners. The start line closes 15 minutes after the race begins. The marathon route is PZLA certified, the half marathon is not certified. The finish line is at the Building and Clothing Schools Complex in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes feature varied surfaces, limited participant registration to 400, online registration available, the event includes both half marathon and marathon.

name: XVI Półmaraton Szakala Dookoła Lasu Łagi... (Łódź)
description: Autumn Szakal Festival is a two-day running event in Łagiewnicki Forest in Łódź, combining various trail distances. The XVI Szakal Half Marathon features a classic, demanding route with scenic ponds and steep ascents, ideal for runners seeking a challenge and contact with nature. The program also includes Ultra Szakal, Cross Szakal, and races for children, making the festival attractive to a wide range of participants. Organizers ensure a good atmosphere and safety, and the course allows for competition or a leisurely enjoyment of the autumn forest.
course_highlights: The half marathon course runs through scenic ponds and steep ascents of Łagiewnicki Forest
Ultra Szakal is approximately 52 km long, featuring a historic water mill and the Snail Hill
Cross Szakal is a demanding but accessible 7.8 km trail distance
additional: Start groups are divided by gender and half marathon results: women start at 12:00, men in two groups at 12:15 and 12:25. Participants with a record below 1:28:00 can start in group M I if packages are available. Race packages are issued at the Race Office according to the start number. The event includes various distances and locations for pick-up of race kits, requiring proof of identity. The race takes place in a forest setting, making it a unique experience for nature lovers and trail runners.

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne's largest cross-country races, organized by Heleneholms IF in the autumnal Bokskogen in Torup. The race starts from Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course consists of forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants who want to experience the autumn nature. All practical information and the invitation are available on the race's information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn landscape and trails - traditionally the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is done via AnmälMigNu (see registration page). The invitation, classes, registration fees, course description, PM, start list, and practical information are available in the left tabs on the race page. Contact for the race: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF's office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, phone 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two course lengths (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; bankarta available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is a recurring running event that will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026 and is scheduled for Sunday, October 25, 2026. The event page indicates that the race has offered several distances (according to previous registration forms: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km) and that the organizer publishes invitations, race rules, start lists, maps, and results on the website. The website describes the course's beautiful scenery and a challenging 14 km profile. More information and details about the course and profile are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Beautiful course layout (linked on the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Multiple distances - 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km, and 14 km (according to previous registration forms)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website contains links to maps and course profiles as well as previous years' race rules, invitations, start lists, and preliminary results. Previous registration forms (2020) showed options for distance and preferred race day (October 23, 24, or 25). Content includes invitation, race rules, start lists, course map, results, and course profile; 14 km course. The race is traditionally held during the last weekend of October and will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
location: Huskvarna, Jönköping Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a challenging and quite hilly cross-country race held in Huskvarna, near Lake Vättern. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, including 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, as well as children and youth classes. The courses go partly on trails and partly on unpaved terrain, with demanding hills such as Strutsabacken where the Bergatrollet title is awarded to the fastest runner uphill. The event is family-friendly with changing rooms, showers, catering, and security personnel along the course.
course_highlights: Challenging and quite hilly cross-country race with partly trail and unpaved terrain
Strutsabacken (slalom hill) as a challenging hill with the Bergatrollet race
Water stations with water, sports drinks, and bananas on longer distances
additional: Number bibs with chips are collected on race day no later than 11:15 and must be worn visibly on the front of the shirt. Timing is done with a chip and provides both total time and uphill time at Strutsabacken. Water stations are available at various distances with water, sports drinks, and bananas. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available in the IKHP cabin. Valuables can be left and picked up at the bib distribution. Security personnel and Red Cross medical staff are present. Children and youth classes start at 10:45, adult classes at 11:30, and the 400m toddler run has free start times between 10:00 and 12:00. Trail race with hilly terrain, on-site registration, medals for all participants, prizes for top finishers and Bergatrollet, safety measures including medical support.

name: Höstmilen
description: The Autumn Mile is a cross-country race in the Kolmård Forest outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on November 1, 2026. The course runs on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic and challenging terrain for both competitors and recreational runners. The organizer is OK Kolmården, and there are three main course options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, as well as courses for children and youth.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running in the scenic and hilly terrain of Kolmård Forest
additional: Registration closes on October 29 at 23:00 online; thereafter, registration is possible on October 31 from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start location on November 1. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus departs from Jurslaskolan to Sörsjön. A race information packet with practical details will be published approximately one week before the race. The competition classes have only two prize categories (Men and Women) for the adult races. A complete list of registered participants is published on the 'Registered' page. The distances and race formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km, and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team race, corporate race, and school race. The race info and registration can be found at hostmilen.nu.

name: Panevėžio maratonas
description: The Panevėžys Marathon 2024 will take place in Panevėžys, Lithuania, and registration will open on September 13, 2024. The event is open to all interested participants who register and have their health checked. Participants can choose from various distances: 400 m walk, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, with different age requirements.

Bėgikas kerta finišo liniją Panevėžio maratone, džiaugdamasis pergale.
Bėgikas Panevėžio maratone, gauna vandens.

name: XVII-asis bėgimas „Varnutės ruduo“
description: Varnutės run is a traditional running event in Jonavа, offering routes for participants of all ages. The event features three distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a great opportunity to spend active time and enjoy running in the community.
course_highlights: Route in Jonavа
Distances: 2.5 km, 10 km, and 300 m for children
Suitable for participants of all ages
additional: The event date is November 7, 2026, and it is a popular annual running event in Jonavа.

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail run through the scenic trails and forests of Vooremäe in Tartumaa. The race highlights challenges such as 1000 meters of elevation gain in a single run, offering participants the opportunity to test their abilities and enjoy the positive energy from the forest trail. The race center is located at the new service building, which provides convenient shower and changing facilities. There is a staffed refreshment point on the course, and timing is done with a contactless SPORTIdent system. Distances range from a 14 km hike to over a 42 km marathon, where marathon runners complete exactly three 14.1 km loops.
course_highlights: 14.1 km loop that follows the direction of Vooremäe's main circuit
Over 1000 meters of total elevation gain in the marathon distance
Staffed refreshment point on the course, which is crossed multiple times
additional: Start number can be found before the race on the Seiklushunt website's start protocol. Timing is done with a contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system, with the chip attached to the wrist. The race center offers shower and changing facilities after the race. There is one staffed refreshment point on the course offering water, Coca-Cola, and light snacks. On-site registration is not available. Re-registration and changes are only via email. Trail run, mountainous terrain, registration through Stebby, aid stations, finisher medals, awards.

name: Höstrusket
description: The Autumn Run is a trail and road race in Northern Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on November 7, 2026. Choose between 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km), or marathon (42.195 km) with start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners and offers motivating pacers, well-stocked water stations, and a festive conclusion to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organized by Marathongruppen in collaboration with local athletics clubs, and the proceeds go back to sports.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Northern Djurgården (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station)
Measured courses mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total +439 m
Rich water stations and lap services as well as clear kilometer signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (about 800 m from Ropstens T‑station). Bib number distribution, pacer tents, food/coffee sales, drop-off of outerwear and toilets at the event area. Opportunity to change clothes and shower in a facility a few hundred meters away for a fee. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers offered for several finish times (list per distance). Max and cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (repetition at the last lap at 13:40). Age limits: 15 years for 10 km (13 years with guardian), 17 years for half marathon and marathon. Certain aids and vehicles (staves, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles, racing wheelchair) are not allowed; special conditions apply for escorts/wheelchairs. Proceeds go back to sports. Registration is open.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
location: Österbymo, Ydre kommun, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: The Jätten Bule Race is a traditional cross-country race organized by IFK Österbymo on the first weekend of November. The race celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2019 and attracts runners of all ages to the Ydre forests. The distances vary from KnatteBule for the youngest, 2.4 km for children aged 4-12, as well as 5 km and 10 km in running or walking through challenging terrain. The event is a folk festival in autumn attire and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in hilly and challenging forest terrain
Distances from children's race to 10 km for adults
The race takes place in the Ydre forests around Bulevallen and Bulespåret
additional: Distances include KnatteBule for the youngest, 2.4 km for children aged 4-12, as well as 5 km and 10 km in running or walking. Bulevallen is the gathering place and IFK Österbymo, together with Ydre Municipality, is responsible for the electric light trail Bulespåret, a 2.4 km hilly course used in connection with the event. The race includes various distances, from children's races to adult races, and is held in a scenic environment in Ydre. Weather conditions in 2026 may affect the terrain, but the race is open to all runners and outdoor enthusiasts.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Routes highlighting the aesthetic qualities of the location
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Greater Poland
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Participants can pick up their race kit with an authorization form. Cross-country event held in Lasek Marceliński, November 8, 2026. Medals in the form of puzzles. Forest routes.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Running Club "Rzeszów Biega" in partnership with the Rzeszów City Hall and PKO Bank Polski. The main race on a 10 km distance starts and finishes at the Rzeszów Market Square, taking place on November 11th at 11:11 AM. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region, offering age classifications and special categories, including categories for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, number, and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The participant limit is 3000 people, and participation requires confirmation of fitness to run through a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance with start and finish at Rzeszów Market Square
Separate age classifications and special categories (e.g., doctors, lawyers)
Participant limit of 3000 people, race kit includes a T-shirt, number, and chip
additional: Gilding on the medal is available for an additional fee of 30 PLN. On race day, the number of race kits is limited, and the registration fee is non-refundable. Participants must be over 16 years old (minors with guardian consent). Race kits include a T-shirt, race number, and chip. The route is marked every 1 km, and the event features warm-up sessions and refreshment points along the course. Wearing the organizer's mandatory T-shirt is required.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event organized on the occasion of National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital city, with start and finish lines located on Aleja Jana Pawła II. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering also a Nordic walking category and a commemorative mile race over 1918 meters. The main race starts in waves, ensuring comfort and safety for participants. Organizers provide a rich program and efficient service, including the collection of race numbers at convenient times before the race.
course_highlights: Certified route by PZLA measuring 10 km through Warsaw streets
Start and finish on Aleja Jana Pawła II, at ul. Miła
Wave start of the main race divided into zones based on expected times
additional: The main race starts at 11:11 with a wave division into time zones. The Independence Mile begins at 10:00. Participants in active wheelchair, handbike, and tandem categories start at 11:08. Race numbers can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7 to 10; on race day, the race office is closed (except for packet pickup for participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00). Participants are asked to line up at the start in white or red shirts, forming a white-red flag. The route is well-known and loved, with about 20,000 participants taking part. The event includes various categories such as the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, it was the most numerous running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości - Kocham Polskę! is cross-country race organized in picturesque locations in Poznań, especially at Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of activities by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, emphasizing the aesthetics of the routes and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension, taking place on November 11, combining sport with honoring Poland's independence. We invite runners to participate in various distances in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
Patriotic race organized on November 11
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races. The race takes place on green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Trilogy. Participant limit is 750, with scenic routes and cross-country races.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and short children's races up to 400 meters. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and the number of spots is limited, with online registration open until November 6th.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km race routes run through the Ukiel CRS area and nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
The event combines athletic competition with patriotic celebration
Nordic walking marches and children's races up to 400 meters are also available
additional: Start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center. The event takes place on November 11th, with online registration open until November 6th. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and children's races up to 400 meters. Due to the race, traffic disruptions are expected on the route. Road traffic restrictions will be in place on the course, with the start at 9:00 AM, registration until November 6th, and the event held at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center as well as on Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event organized in Gdynia, as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026. The main race on a 10 km distance attracts runners of various ages, and there are also children's and youth races. The event has a sports-recreational character, and participants can expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Polish independence. During the event, photos and video materials are taken for promotional purposes by the organizers.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance
Children's and youth races
Part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026
additional: During the event, photos and video materials will be taken for promotional purposes of events organized by GCS and the Gdynia City Municipality. Registration is open until October 28, 2026. Results, photo galleries, and partner information are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The Polish Legion Run II is a race commemorating the anniversary of Poland regaining independence, held on two distances: 5 km and 10 km. Starts take place in scenic seaside locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office the day before and on the race day. The race route is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the course before the start.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
10 km start from the Haller monument at Morska Street in Władysławowo
5 km start from the bust of Marshal Piłsudski at Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on November 10, 2025, from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo and on November 11, 2025, from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The race route is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration is open from September 22 to November 5, 2025; the event takes place on moderately elevated routes, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: Bastardai bėga iš Lenkijos
description: We invite you to start 2025 actively!!! We will run in Karoliniškės Reserve in several groups at a comfortable pace for everyone. Time: 12:00 PM. Distance: 6-7 km. We look forward to seeing everyone.
course_highlights: Running event in Karoliniškės Reserve
Multiple groups at comfortable paces
Start time: 12:00 PM
Distance: 6-7 km
Open to all

images.alt_text: Ežeras, žalias augalas ir medžiai. Puikus gamtos vaizdas.
Kraštovaizdis su kalnais, mišku ir laukais, tinkamas bėgimui.
Bėgikas su lazdomis bėga kalnų taku, Lenkijos gamtoje.
Bėgikas su lazdomis bėga kalnuotu taku.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in the Gränsö nature reserve outside Västervik that offers technical and scenic trails, sea-facing rocky areas, and some of Sweden's finest oak groves around Gränsö Castle. You can choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let children participate in the Gränsö Kids Trail (up to 12 years old). The race is open for both timed and untimed Fun Run and encourages a wonderful nature experience - feel free to combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle. Welcome to experience Västervik's archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Sea-facing rocky areas and Skanvik cliffs along the course
Trails through sparse pine forests and valuable oak groves; technically varied sections
15 km has a bonus loop at Ekholmen; 8 km and 15 km courses join at the energy station Kroken
additional: Event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km at 11:00, 15 km at 11:15. First finish is expected around 11:35 and the finish line closes at 13:45. The courses are marked with hanging red/white ribbons and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Terrain: mostly trail/hiking trail with sections of rocks, terrain, and short road segments. Energy stations: 8 km has one station, 15 km has two. All children receive a medal and energy after finishing. Registration is online and possible until one hour before start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before start; energy and water stations along the course; timed or untimed Fun Run; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finish around 11:35; finish line closes at 13:45; spa options at Gränsö Castle.

name: Bėgimas Lietuvos karių dienai
description: The Lithuanian Soldiers Day Run will take place in Tauragė on November 17th, Saturday. The event will start at 11:00 with a 600-meter run for children and parents, followed by a 1.8 km race at 11:20 for runners who will complete three laps of the 600 m course. At 12:00, participants in the 6 km and 12 km distances will start. Registration is open until November 16th at www.begimotaure.lt, and winners in each age group will be awarded medals and prizes.

images.alt_text: Lietuvos kariai bėga snieguotu keliu su vėliavomis.
Lietuvos karių bėgimas.
Bėgimo renginio plakatas su kariu, nurodantis datą, vietą ir atstumus.
Bėgikai bėga lauke per Lietuvos karių dienai skirtą renginį.

name: Grand Prix Powiatu Kościerskiego
description: The Grand Prix of Kościan County is a series of five 5 km races organized by all municipalities of Kościan County under the patronage of the Starosta of Kościan. The aim is to promote physical activity, healthy competition, and integration of local residents. Participants must be residents of the county and at least 16 years old in 2025. Each race is paid separately, and the overall classification is based on the total points earned in each race.
course_highlights: Series of 5 races of 5 km each
Organized by all municipalities of Kościan County
Separate classification for women and men, without age category divisions
additional: Participation in the Grand Prix is free; only the entry fee for individual races, determined locally, is payable. The race dates are spread from June to December 2025 in various towns within the county. The point classification sums results from each race, with prizes for the top 6 women and top 6 men, as well as additional special prizes from the organizers of each race. The series includes five 5 km races held from June to December, with classification and prizes for the best. The main 10 km race is scheduled for November 15, 2026, in Kościerzyna, with typical autumn weather, possible rain.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: Eurovaistinės Christmas Run stands out not only for its festive atmosphere but also for its exceptional participants, who dress up in Christmas (and other) costumes specifically for the running celebration. This year, the event schedule has shifted so that participants can run after sunset, when the magical Christmas spirit will unfold across the city streets! We invite you to prepare not only Christmas costumes but also luminous accents that will turn the runners into a truly glowing Christmas magic!

name: VC TRAIL 2026-11-21 FINALINIS ETAPAS
description: Vilnius Challenge is a unique multisport event held since 2009, offering participants the opportunity to test their physical and psychological limits across various courses. The event includes running, cycling, orienteering, and special physical challenges, allowing for adventure experiences in the city of Vilnius and natural surroundings. Participants can choose the course level according to their preparedness - from amateurs to extreme courses with various obstacles. Vilnius Challenge promotes a healthy lifestyle, team relationships, and community spirit, bringing together sports enthusiasts and active lifestyle lovers.
course_highlights: The course includes running, cycling, orienteering, and physical challenges
Ability to choose course level: amateur, challenge, and extreme
The extreme course features climbing, crawling, swimming, and rope descents
additional: The competition center is the main venue where registration, start, and finish take place. Participants are informed about the program and important information via email in stages. Start times and participant flow management may be organized in waves for safety reasons. The competition schedule and courses may be adjusted due to objective reasons. The trail running event has multiple course levels, registration is required, and the event date is November 21, 2026.

name: Bėgimas Atgal į Praeitį
location: Vilnius, Laisvalaikio erdvė prie Baltojo tilto
description: Running Back to the Past is a unique event where history becomes the present. All medals, cups, and prizes awarded from last year's races are given a second life and new meaning, symbolizing the connection within the running community. The essence of the event is not the novelty of trophies, but the joy of running and the opportunity to rediscover the meaning of sport. Every participant who completes the full marathon distance will receive a Sunrise Marathon neckerchief.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo varžybų startas. Bėgikai po starto linija. Arka su asociacijos pavadinimu ir logotipu.
Bėgimo "Atgal į praeitį" pavadinimas.

name: XIII Makowska Piętnastka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – opłata online lub przelew na konto do dnia 27.11.2025 r.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 40 zł – opłata online lub przelew na konto do dnia 27.11.2025 r.

description: The 13th Makowska Piętnastka is an annual race organized in Maków Mazowiecki, scheduled for November 22, 2026. The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with start and finish lines located at the municipal stadium. The race is organized by the Athletic Sports Club Maków Mazowiecki in collaboration with local authorities. It attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering competitive sport and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Maków Mazowiecki
Two distance options: 15 km and 5 km
City route suitable for adult and youth runners
additional: Timing is measured using a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are immediately displayed on a screen at the finish line and sent via SMS to participants.
