The event is recorded with a Full HD camera, and an electronic clock at the finish line tracks the time. Organizers provide original bib numbers on synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans from 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; it is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and is promoted as a fall highlight for trail runners. The race is offered in several distances, making it accessible for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. The website features preliminary competition information and course maps, as well as information about test runs before the event. Organizer pages and registration links are collected on the race's homepage.
course_highlights: Running in Bockebodaskogen - forest terrain near Kristianstad
Multiple distances: approximately 25 km (25 - 26.4 km), 12 km (12 - 12.9 km), and 5 km (5.3 - 5.7 km) depending on measurement method
Course lengths vary depending on different measurement methods
additional: Registration: individual registration and group registration are mentioned on the page. The website mentions insurance and has a link to registration for previous editions (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). Test runs have also taken place before the race, and it has been communicated that late registration has been possible via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad, and information about this year's edition can be found in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF's page as well as on RaceID.

name: Temple x Nike Winterized Challenge
description: Nike Winterized Challenge with Temple Social – your motivation injection for the cold season. Don't stop running when days get shorter and the weather turns cold. Join Nike and Temple Social runners community – run for 4 weeks, twice a week. Every step counts – earn points, and Nike will reward you with discounts and gifts. Four of you will have the chance to win the new VOMERO GORE-TEX!

name: Saulėtekio maratonas
description: Sunrise Marathon 2025 will take place on December 14, 2025, in Vilnius, at the VGTU sports complex, Saulėtekio al. 28. The event will offer several distances: 600m "children's run", 4.2 km, 12.6 km, half marathon (21.1 km), and marathon (42.2 km). Participants can compete in various age groups, and winners will be awarded with cups and prizes. The slogan of the Sunrise Marathon: YOUR ONLY LIMIT IS YOU!!!

images.alt_text: Saulėtekio maratono reklama su bėgančiu žmogumi saulėlydyje.
Bėgikai startuoja Vilniaus maratone.
Bėgikai bėga gatve. Viršuje oranžinis arkos vartai. Gausybė žmonių bėga.
Vilniaus maratonas 2023. Bėgikai gatvėje, renginio vieta.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultras Trail Race is a pleasant, local trail race organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and mainly consists of beautiful gravel roads and nice forest trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming character for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Gathering takes place at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40) and the start is at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mainly beautiful gravel roads and nice forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Gathering for information at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/organizer partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course layout for 2025 and fully booked 100 starting places one week before the race; new walking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes bus from Linköping to Åtvidaberg (stopping at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space, carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon race in the middle of Stockholm, running up, over, and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon - a micro ultra which, according to the organizer, can also be called Sweden's probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly with lap and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organized by Stockholm Multisport Club.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start/lap/finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope)
Start at the bottom of the slope (to the left of the lift when facing the top) and up over the "Trysil" section at the bridge
Technical sections: down along the machine road, around the chimney, through Indian Park, inside the allotment gardens, and along the bike path
additional: Organizer: Stockholm Multisport Club. Registration takes place at lap and finish (wind shelter in the children's slope). Nearest subway: Hammarbyhöjden. Starting situation: start at the bottom of the slope to the left of the lift. Registration is done via RaceID according to the registration page. Registration and finish at the wind shelter in the children's slope; bags can be left at the foot of the slope; rain cover provided; toilets behind the parking lot; the right of public access applies; results published after the race (top 10 fastest).

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race organized in Lublin, taking place on November 29, 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, promoting physical activity and social integration. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of various skill levels to test their form and enjoy the sporting atmosphere of the city.
course_highlights: 5 km distance in an urban environment
Training support from 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events, includes various distances and age categories, and also features the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: Trail Start: Nemokama Bėgimo Treniruotė
location: Vingio parko lauko treniruoklių sporto aikštelė
description: Trail START. Free running training session with Monika Mile will take place on December 2nd (Tuesday) at 18:30 at the outdoor fitness area of Vingis Park. The training will last about 1 hour, covering approximately 5 km at a light pace, aimed at beginners who want to learn to run confidently in the forest. Focus will be on technique, sensation, and safety in the forest. Participants must have running shoes with tread, weather-appropriate clothing, a headlamp, and a good mood.

name: Advento bėgimo iššūkis 2026
description: The Advent Running Challenge 2026 is a virtual event taking place from December 1 to 24. Participants receive a new task each day, which includes running, physical, precision, and creative tasks. This challenge encourages not only speed but also perseverance, creativity, and engagement throughout all 24 days. Participants compete for the Advent Champion title and receive a participant package as well as the chance to win a prize fund.
course_highlights: 24 days with 24 different tasks
Physical, precision, and creative tasks
Virtual running challenge with points collection and competition
additional: Participant package for each participant. Prize fund - €175 (may increase depending on the number of participants). 24-day challenge with tasks, prizes, and registration via Google form.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is a unique trail running event taking place on December 5, 2026, in the picturesque Trójmiejski Landscape Park. The route combines a seaside climate with varied mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging ascents, valleys, gorges, and ravines. It is an excellent opportunity to end the season in an atmosphere of sporting competition and contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The route runs through Trójmiejski Landscape Park with proximity to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, gorges, and ravines
Challenging elevation changes and natural ascents characteristic of trail running
additional: Start packages are issued on December 4-5, 2026, at the race office. Starts are staggered: a 6 km night run at 19:00 on December 4, and on December 5, races on distances of 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30), 12 km (13:30), as well as Garmin Junior runs for children. The time limit for completing the distances ranges from 2 to 15 hours depending on the course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The athlete card is available 5 days before the race after logging in at startlist.pl. Distances range from 12 km to 86 km, with time limits, qualification points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and youth.

name: EUROVAISTINĖS Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: EUROVAISTINĖS Christmas Run 2024 – the most beautiful winter run, welcoming Christmas and spending time with the most memorable emotions and enchanting running energy! The event will take place on December 7, 2024, in Vilnius. The event is characterized by a festive atmosphere and participants dressed in Christmas costumes with glowing accents. This year, participants will be able to run after sunset, when the streets of the capital will reveal a sparkling and magical Christmas spirit.

images.alt_text: Kalėdinis bėgimas su kostiumais, Vilniuje.
Senelis Kalėda su maišu prie eglutės.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2024. Šventinis bėgimas Vilniuje.
Eurovaistinės Kalėdinis bėgimas 2023 metų logotipas su kalėdiniais elementais.

name: Edgaro atminimui Bėgimas
description: On October 18th, we invite everyone to the 11th annual Respect and Support Run "In Memoriam," dedicated to honoring the memory of soldiers who passed away this year. All funds raised during the run will be allocated to support the families of fallen Lithuanian soldiers. Two championship distances are dedicated to the memory of Lithuanian sports legends – Felicija Karoblienė Cup (2000 m for girls) and Jono Pipynė Cup (5000 m for boys).

name: Kauno SK Nemunas 1000 m
description: Kaunas SK "Nemunas" 1000 m Running Cup will take place on December 14, 2024, in Kaunas. On Saturday, 127 runners competed in the 1000 m distance, with the first places going to Youth – Simas Gedeikis (Kaunas) with a time of 2:38.62 and Viltė Bubinaitė (Vilnius) with 3:04.08. The event also included juniors, cadets, and children, who achieved excellent results.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas lenktynėse su numeriu 49, SK Nemunas apranga.
1000 m bėgimo varžybų nugalėtojai ant pakylos.
Jauni bėgikai su medaliais ir dovanomis ant podiumo.
Dvi mergaitės po bėgimo su medaliais.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard Ultra running race designed to help runners complete the 100-mile distance more easily. If you haven't received a DNF (Did Not Finish) in your life yet, this is your chance to earn it honorably. There will be only one winner, so prepare for a challenge in Alytus.
course_highlights: Designed to help runners complete 100 miles
Opportunity to earn a DNF honorably
Single winner race
Location: Alytus

name: Santa Fun Run Šiauliai
description: The "Santa Fun Run" is a beautiful tradition of Šiauliai residents and city visitors, where nearly 500 participants dressed as Santa Claus run through the streets of Šiauliai. The noble goal of this run is that all collected funds are donated to charity. There are no age restrictions for participants, and everyone can easily complete the symbolic 1.3 km distance. Upon reaching the finish line, participants will be greeted by one of Lithuania's most famous performers, Jovani, who will welcome the Santa runners.

name: Varėnos Kalėdinis pusmaratonis
description: On December 20, 2025, Varėna Sports Center will organize the Christmas Running Event "Varėna Christmas Half Marathon." The event is free of charge, but organizers invite participants, if possible, to contribute to improve the event quality. Your support helps us create a festive, smooth, and memorable running event for all participants.

name: Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: The annual Eurovaistinė Christmas Run will take place on the first winter Saturday, celebrating its 50th edition. This running festival invites thousands of participants. The run is distinguished not only by a festive atmosphere but also by unique participants dressed in Christmas costumes. This year, the event schedule has been adjusted so that participants can run after sunset, when the Christmas spirit will shine brightly on Vilnius streets!

images.alt_text: Žmonės kalėdiniuose kostiumuose bėgimo renginyje. Šventinė nuotaika.
Kalėdinis bėgimas su Santa Claus kostiumais.
Kalėdinis bėgimas Vilniuje. Bėgikai su Kalėdų Senelio kostiumais bėga gatve.
Kalėdų Senelis su maišu ir eglute.
Kalėdinės dekoracijos ir vaikai su kostiumais, atspindintys šventinę nuotaiką.

name: Kalėdinis bėgimas
description: Christmas Run is the most beautiful winter run in the evening, welcoming Christmas and spending time with the most memorable emotions and enchanting running energy! This year, we will run on December 7 in Vilnius, where participants can enjoy the festive atmosphere and run after dark, when the streets of the city reveal their true sparkling Christmas spirit. We invite you to prepare not only Christmas costumes but also luminous accents that will turn our group of runners into a real Christmas shining magic!

name: Kauno „Kalėdinis bėgimas - 2026“
description: Kaunas Christmas Run is a traditional running event held in Kaunas in December. The event is designed for runners of all age groups to promote a healthy lifestyle and the popularity of running. The race takes place in Panemunė Forest, with routes paved and suitable for both amateurs and professionals. After the run, participants are served kūčiukai (traditional Lithuanian Christmas cookies) and tea, and there is also an opportunity to use the swimming pool services.
course_highlights: Route in Panemunė Forest, Kaunas
Paved surface, possible snow and ice depending on weather conditions
Options to run 1.7 km, 5 km (one lap), or 10 km (two laps)
additional: Number distribution for participants on race day from 10:00 to 11:40 AM. The start fee is paid to the Kaunas Running Enthusiasts Club account. After the run, participants are served kūčiukai and tea. From 14:30 to 15:30, there is an option to swim in Žalgiris Pool (Karaliaus Mindaugo pr. 50, Kaunas). Registration is only possible in the participant's name; transfer of numbers is prohibited. Registration is open until October 31, with personalized numbers for participants. The event date is 2026-12-19.

name: 2026 Audi Vana-aasta jooksupäev
location: Rocca al Mare kool, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: The Audi New Year's Run is a traditional winter running event held on December 19, 2026, in Tallinn in front of Rocca al Mare School. The competition center and start-finish are conveniently located near the school, and the event features three distances: marathon, relay marathon, and 8.4 km run. The courses mainly follow bike paths, are well-marked and safe, offering a sporting way to end the year. Medical assistance, timing, medals, and hot tea at aid stations and the finish line are provided for participants.
course_highlights: 8.4 km run follows bike paths, marked and with directional signs
Marathon consists of 5 laps, each 8.44 km long asphalt bike path
Relay marathon consists of 5 stages, each stage is a lap of 8.44 km
additional: There are participant limits for the marathon and relay marathon, with 100 marathon runners and 150 relay teams respectively. The race is limited to 150 runners. Bib numbers are issued on the race day at Rocca al Mare School. Medical aid is available at the start-finish area. Awards are given after the run or marathon accordingly. Running on the road surface is prohibited and may lead to disqualification. The course is in an urban area; registration and participation fees are detailed. The event takes place annually and is part of the Estonian running calendar.

name: Panevėžio Kalėdinis Bėgimas
description: The annual Eurovaistinės Christmas Run will take place on the first winter Saturday, celebrating its 50th anniversary this year. This running event will invite thousands of participants, distinguished by a festive atmosphere and unique attendees dressed in Christmas costumes. The event schedule has been adjusted so that participants can run at dusk, when the streets of Panevėžys will reveal a magical Christmas spirit. This year, we invite not only to prepare Christmas costumes but also luminous accents that will turn the runners into a glowing Christmas magic.
course_highlights: Celebrates 50 years
Takes place on the first winter Saturday
Participants dressed in Christmas costumes
Run at dusk through Panevėžys streets
Includes luminous accents for a glowing effect

name: Bėgimas į Naujus
description: Running into the New Year is an annual race held on the last day of the year. This event brings together runners and enthusiasts who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year actively. Participants can choose from different distances, allowing everyone to find a suitable challenge. The race route offers beautiful city sights and a unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Participants can choose from different distances
Race route features beautiful city sights
Unique atmosphere created by participants and spectators

images.alt_text: Didelis fejerverkas virš miesto, švenčiant Naujuosius metus.
Bėgikai starte, renginys lauke.
Kalėdų eglutė su šventinėmis lemputėmis ir dekoracijomis, puikiai tinkanti Naujųjų metų šventei.
Bėgimas į Naujus 2026 su fejerverkais.

name: Pažadų Bėgimas
description: The PROMISE RUN continues the tradition started in 2018. On January 1, 2026, in the morning, while the fireworks sounds still echo in your ears, you will confirm to yourself during the run that New Year's resolutions will definitely come true. No competition, registrations, medals, or prizes – only you and your New Year's "PROMISES". Run 10 km and write down your goals so that on January 1, 2027, you can check if they have come true. The start will take place on January 1, 2026, at 14:00 at the Kaunas Santaka Stadium.

images.alt_text: Bėgimas per miestą Naujųjų metų proga, daug bėgikų.
Kauno santakos stadionas.
Naktinis Kauno santakos stadiono vaizdas.
Bėgimo lenktynės, bėgikai.

name: Naujametinis ruonių maratonas
description: 2026-01-01 Pasvaliečiai kviečia visus klubo narius ir draugus į 1-ąjį Naujametinį RUONIŲ MARATONĄ, kuris vyks Pasvalyje. Šis maratonas yra dalis tradicinių jau 18-tų Pasvalio rajone organizuojamų ledinių maudynių. Po maratono vyks klubo narių susirinkimas, kurio metu bus apdovanoti aktyviausi klubo nariai.

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Run in Kalmar is a local running classic organized by Högby IF Athletics and will be held on December 31, 2026. Basic information about the race can be found on the club's website. For officials and volunteers, the club's login system is used for registration.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km and 10 km around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
Medal and a specially designed hat for all registered participants
Walk class 5 km without timing and various class divisions
additional: Kalmar Sylvesterlopp is described as a running classic. Registration as an official/volunteer is done via the website's registration form (WordPress) and requires login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for different classes include P/F 5 - 13, 0.4 - 2.0 km, M/F 5 and 10 km, as well as Walk class 5 km without timing; late registration and payment options include card, Swish, or bank transfer.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: The Sylvester Run in Olofström is a traditional concluding race organized by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 meters), which has been run in two laps on the current course since 2018, and there is also a shorter route of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured finish, changing, catering, and award ceremony in the Sports Hall, providing a pleasant setting for runners and spectators. The history and club connections make the race a folk festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon 10,549 m (run as two laps on the current course since 2018)
Shorter route approximately 5.3 km remains as an alternative
Finish, changing, catering, and award ceremony in the Sports Hall
additional: Registration is done via EasyRecord (specified in the invitation). PM and course maps are available as PDF files on the organizer's pages (invitation, PM, course). Start list is published separately on the organizer's website. The event has historically included changing, catering, and award ceremony in the Sports Hall. History and course profile, including start and finish points around the Sports Hall and Nya torget.

name: XIV Jonavos Naujametinis bėgimas
location: Žemaitės ir P. Vaičiūno gatvių sankryža, Jonava, Lithuania
description: The 14th traditional Jonava New Year's Run will take place in 2027 on January 1st. The start will be at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets. The traditional 20 km running route stretches through Čičinai and Kurmagala villages, with the finish line on Kauno street near the treatment facilities. The event features a hilly course and winter conditions, and after the run, participants are invited to enjoy tea, snacks, and receive commemorative medals.
course_highlights: 20 km traditional running route
Start at the intersection of Žemaitės and P. Vaičiūno streets
Route passes through Čičinai and Kurmagala villages, finish on Kauno street
additional: After the run, participants are awarded cups and prizes, receive commemorative medals, and can enjoy tea and snacks. The route is hilly, and in winter it can be slippery and windy. The course passes through Čičinai and Kurmagala villages, the weather is often wintry, and the event is popular among local runners for the New Year.

name: Resolution Run
description: Resolution Run 2026 is a fast and flat 5K run taking place on New Year's Day, January 1, 2026, at 10:15 AM in Galway city center. The route passes through the city center, starting from Claddagh, crossing Wolfe Tone Bridge, along Merchants Road and Docks, returning via Grattan Road and Promenade, finishing quickly at South Park, near Nimmos Pier. This route goes past most of the city's most famous landmarks. The race is AAI certified.

name: Resolution Run 2026
description: Resolution Run 2027 invites you to start the new year energetically and actively. It is a great opportunity to fulfill New Year's resolutions by running together with a crowd of enthusiastic runners. The event guarantees a good mood, smiles, and a fun start to the year in Kaunas.
course_highlights: Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Warm-up for all distance participants
Running through the streets of Kaunas
additional: Participant kits distribution and awards are scheduled in the event program. There will be an official opening and warm-up for all distance participants during the event. The event takes place in Kaunas, organized by VšĮ Kauno maratono klubas. Distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km; the event will be held in Kaunas; the organizer offers a festive start and community spirit.

name: LBT Kėdainiai
location: Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1.)
description: Kėdainių sporto centras organizes the LBT 1 – New Year Run "KĖDAINIAI 2025", which will take place on January 5th at 12:00 PM at the central stadium of Kėdainiai (J. Basanavičiaus g. 1). The race distances include a 400 m children’s run, as well as 4 km and 8.5 km routes.
course_highlights: Event date and time: January 5th at 12:00 PM
Location: Kėdainiai central stadium, J. Basanavičiaus g. 1
Race distances: 400 m children’s run, 4 km, and 8.5 km routes

images.alt_text: Naujametinis bėgimas "Kėdainiai 2025" plakatas su informacija apie datą, vietą ir distancijas.
Bėgimo lenktynės Kėdainiuose, startas. Sportininkai bėga stadione.
Kėdainių miesto centrinis stadionas, kur vyks bėgimo varžybos.
LBT I Kėdainiai apdovanojimai.

name: Gyvybės ir Mirties bėgimas
description: In Vilnius, the 31st annual run in honor of the victims of the January 13 events, called "The Road of Life and Death," took place on Saturday, with about 6,000 participants. The "Road of Life and Death" run has been held every year since 1992, except in 2021 due to COVID-19 pandemic restrictions. The record number of participants was reached three years ago, when more than 8,000 runners took part in the event.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo dalyviai prie TV bokšto su medaliais ir vėliava.
Bėgimo renginio nuotrauka. Dalyviai ir kariškiai pagerbia žuvusiuosius už laisvę.
Bėgimo „Gyvybės ir Mirties keliu“ logotipas su bėgikais, TV bokštu ir simboliais.
XXVI Pagarbos bėgimas „Gyvybės ir Mirties keliu“ logotipas.

name: Aplink Želvos ežerą
description: The 'Run Around Lake Želva' will take place on January 11, 2025, in Suginčiai (Molėtai district), dedicated to the memory of Lithuania's Freedom Fighters Day. The event is organized to promote running in Lithuania, enhance athletic excellence, and advocate for a healthy and active lifestyle. It is recommended to arrive around 10:00 AM, with the race starting at 11:00 AM.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski 2027
description: The Winter Holy Cross Mountains Marathon is a unique tourist event held in the picturesque Holy Cross Mountains, around Chęciny and Ciekoty. Participants can choose between two routes: the Royal Battle and the Knight's Charge, which lead through natural terrain in challenging winter conditions. This challenge attracts hundreds of runners and hiking enthusiasts from all over Poland each year, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. Organizers ensure the safety and comfort of participants by providing refreshment and control points along the route.
course_highlights: Two routes to choose from: the Royal Battle and the Knight's Charge
Routes pass through natural terrain of the Holy Cross Mountains in winter conditions
Refreshment and control points along the route and the option to download a GPX file
additional: Start packages can be collected in person at designated dates and locations, including the Regional Tourist Information Center in Kielce and the European Geological Education Center in Korzecko. The Royal Battle starts at 7:00 AM, and the Knight's Charge at 9:00 AM. Participants must have mandatory equipment and prepare for winter conditions. The start package is issued only to individuals with a signed Athlete Card and an ID document. The event does not conduct official time measurement, focusing on tourism and outdoor activity, with tourist attractions and a community atmosphere. Registrations are available through the B4SPORTONLINE platform.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Winter Świętokrzyski Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event combines running, walking, and Nordic walking, offering participants the opportunity to explore the beautiful and picturesque terrains of this region. Organizers have been promoting outdoor activity and mountain tourism for years, creating and renewing tourist trails. This event is for enthusiasts of long-distance challenges and nature contact.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Picturesque landscapes and natural tourist trails
Routes adapted for running, walking, and Nordic walking
additional: Organizers also focus on renewing and promoting tourist trails in the region. The event is part of a broader outdoor activity offer in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants have access to refreshment and control points, the possibility to download a GPX file with the routes, and the event is aimed at runners and hikers in challenging winter conditions.

name: Trail Kalvė
description: Trail Kalvė is a Backyard ultra type run designed to make it easier for runners to complete a 100-mile distance. If you haven't experienced a DNF (Did Not Finish) in your life yet, this is your chance to earn it honorably. There will be only one winner.
course_highlights: Backyard ultra style race
Designed for 100-mile completion
Opportunity to experience a DNF
Single winner will be crowned

name: XXV bėgimas Laisvės gynėjų dienai paminėti
description: The 25th Run in commemoration of the Day of the Defenders of Freedom in Klaipėda is a traditional running event dedicated to honoring those who died and fought for Lithuania's freedom. The event brings together the city community and visitors, taking place on January 18 in Klaipėda. Participants can choose from two distances - an 8 km main route and a 3 km short route, designed for schoolchildren, seniors, and anyone for whom the long route is too challenging. The start is in the evening, and the routes pass through beautiful city locations, including a bicycle path and the Summer Stage.
course_highlights: The 8 km route runs along the bicycle path through Klaipėda Summer Stage, Liepų and H. Manto streets
Finish line at Klaipėda City Municipality (Liepų g. 11)
The 3 km route starts near Klaipėda Summer Stage, intended for schoolchildren and seniors
additional: Numbers with an outdoor RFID chip. It is recommended to pick up numbers in advance to avoid queues on the event day. Number pickup for 8 km runners is at the bus from the Town Hall, for 3 km runners - near the Summer Stage. Buses depart to the start locations at 19:00. Individual warm-up from 19:45 to 19:55. Route closing at 21:20. Medals are awarded to the first 900 finishers. The event is organized with buses and community participation, starting in Klaipėda at the Giruliai Radio and TV Tower.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 3/5
description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of cross-country runs held in the picturesque Pietrasze Forest in Białystok. The race course is fully natural and highly varied, including forest trails, ascents, descents, and different surfaces such as forest litter, grass, sand, and mud. The run requires versatility and good condition from participants, with volunteers and cycling guides present along the route. After the race, there is an integration event with music, donuts, and tea, emphasizing the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: The course is 100% on natural, varied forest terrain
Numerous ascents and descents with a total elevation gain of over 140 meters
Course marked with white-blue tape and presence of guiding cyclists and volunteers
additional: Race packets are distributed from 8:30 to 9:30 at Primary School No. 32 named after Major Henryk Dobrzański 'Hubal', ul. Pietrasze 29. Before the start, a warm-up with a trainer accompanied by music takes place at 9:40-9:50. After the race, a music event and social gathering with donuts and tea continue until 12:00. The start is from start zones with referee verification of bib numbers at 9:55. The series includes many runs on different dates, with the possibility of online registration. Participants can expect a sporting atmosphere and beautiful surroundings.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a new winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race offers three distances on snowy trails in Northern Djurgården with start and finish at Stora Skuggan. All participants who finish will receive a unique winter medal and can enjoy a warming afterrun with hot drinks and snacks. The race suits both competitive runners and those who want to enjoy nature at a slower pace.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Northern Djurgården
Hydration stations at 6 km and 12 km distances at 4 km
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan with good transportation options
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, Northern Djurgården. Subway and bus from the city to the start. Hydration stations at 6 km and 12 km distances at 4 km. Warming afterrun with hot drinks and snacks after finishing. Unique medal for all finishers. Terrain, winter conditions, registration via EQ Timing, no cancellations, option to purchase refund protection.

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
description: Winter Run Stockholm is a winter race that takes place on a unique 5 km course with start and running inside Skansen as well as a loop around Djurgården. The course is partly paved and partly gravel, with a clear elevation gain up to Bollnästorget and some smaller hills on Djurgården. The race encourages participants to compete in luminous and imaginative outfits, creating a festive and colorful atmosphere. The event is organized by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus proceeds go back into sports.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% asphalt and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km running inside Skansen
Significant elevation gain up to Bollnästorget
additional: The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and measured by an approved course measurer. In icy conditions, shoes suitable for winter conditions are recommended. Any surplus from the race goes back into sports. The event includes opportunities for children and families, with a festive winter atmosphere and entertainment along the course.

name: VI Utenos sporto arenos maratonas
description: Utena Arena Marathon is a unique indoor marathon held in Utena city. Participants run 182.5 laps of 231.3 meters each, providing an exceptional opportunity to experience a marathon in a controlled environment. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs seeking to test their endurance and speed. It is a traditional event held annually that promotes sportsmanship and community spirit.
course_highlights: Indoor venue - running takes place inside the arena
182.5 laps of 231.3 meters each
Controlled environment unaffected by weather conditions
additional: Registration takes place only on the day of the event at the start location; pre-registration is not available. The event will be held in Utena, Lithuania; the date of the event is February 7, 2027; the event description emphasizes community spirit and various running activities.

name: 15-asis bėgimas „Žiema Jonavoje“
description: The 15th Winter Run in Jonava invites runners to participate in the traditional winter event around Jonava. The event takes place on bike paths around the Jonava ponds, offering an opportunity to enjoy winter nature and active leisure. It is a great chance for both experienced and beginner runners to test their endurance and enjoy a community atmosphere. The event is held in February when winter is still fully present in nature.
course_highlights: Running around the Jonava ponds
The route runs along bike paths
Winter nature and clean air environment
additional: The event attracts participants from various cities in Lithuania, and participation is open to all age groups. In 2024, the number of participants was 88, and the scenic routes are suitable for runners of different levels.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail run that takes place along the tracks of the Snapphanar in the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km with many elevation changes and varied terrain, including deciduous forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter version of the race provides an extra tough challenge with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners to a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget with one of Sweden's largest deciduous forests
Moss-covered winding coniferous forest trails
Steep climbs and delightful descents
additional: Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Training Center receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Insurance Startklar can be purchased for reimbursement in case of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail running in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for certain distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolan sports hall, no mugs at energy stations.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E4. Prienai

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alavinė jaunimo kategorijos 3,15 € + 0,08 € bilieto paslaugos mokestis

description: Trail Hill S4E4 Prienai is a winter off-road running race held at Giraitiškės Recreation Area in Prienai. This stage traditionally took place in autumn, but this season participants are invited to test the course in winter. The race offers various distances suitable for runners of different ages and experience levels, from children to adults. The event is part of the Trail Hill Cup, which includes courses of varying difficulty with different elevation gains.
course_highlights: Course lengths from 5 km to 23 km with varying elevation gain
Winter season provides a unique opportunity to run on snow-covered forest trails
Start at Giraitiškės Recreation Area, Prienai
additional: The race does not award medals, but first-time registrants for the season receive a Trail Hill running band. Since the event takes place in winter, the trails are snow-covered and require special preparation. Registration is only available for team participants; individual categories are recommended to use simple tickets. Participants are encouraged to register in teams; the event is held at Giraitiškės Recreation Area, with the course in winter conditions.

name: 5. Pietrasze Cross Country 4/5

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Upłynął termin. 2026.02.23 - 2026.03.08 Nordic walking - 7 830 m 30.00 PLN

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Upłynął termin. 2026.03.09 - 2026.03.14 Nordic walking - 7 830 m 35.00 PLN

description: Pietrasze Cross Country is a series of five cross-country runs and Nordic walking marches held in Białystok. Each run covers a distance of approximately 7.8 km and attracts runners who enjoy outdoor activity in scenic terrain. The participant limit is restricted to 135 people, ensuring a intimate atmosphere and comfortable competition. The event is organized by Podlaskie Biking Center Pędziwiatr and takes place on various dates from November to March.
course_highlights: Distance of runs and marches: 7.83 km
Cross-country route in Białystok
Participant limit: 135 people
additional: Participant limit is 135 people. Registration is open from February 23 to March 14, 2026. The entry fee is 30 PLN for the first date, 35 PLN for the second and on-site. The cross-country route is 7.83 km long. The event is organized by Podlaskie Biking Center Pędziwiatr. Cross country and Nordic walking, participant limit up to 135, registration from February 23 to March 14, 2026.

name: Bėgimas varžybos „Bėgame už Laisvę“ 2026
description: The running race "Running for Freedom" is a special running event in Mažeikiai, dedicated to commemorating February 16th - the Day of Restoration of Lithuania's Independence. The event promotes an active lifestyle, community, and celebration of freedom. Participants are invited to join this traditional celebration and run together for freedom.
course_highlights: 10 km run on the road
Event takes place in Mažeikiai
Dedicated to February 16th commemoration
additional: It is recommended for all runners to gather at the start line at 11:35 AM. The event features participants of various age groups, registration is held at M. Račkauskas Gymnasium, and participants are awarded medals.

name: Respublikinis bėgimas „Pabaiskas - Ukmergė“, skirtas Lietuvos Valstybės atkūrimo dienai
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The national run "Pabaiskas - Ukmergė" is held in Ukmergė to celebrate Lithuania's Independence Day. It is a traditional race attended by running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania, aimed at promoting patriotism, active leisure, and running sport. The competition includes an 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas and a 3 km distance for students at the Ukmergė hippodrome. After the finish, participants are awarded medals, and the event concludes with an award ceremony for the winners and tea refreshments.
course_highlights: 11.6 km distance starting in Pabaiskas
3 km distance for students at Ukmergė hippodrome
Finish at Ukmergė Sports Center stadium
additional: Number distribution takes place at the Ukmergė Sports Center stadium gym from 9:30 to 11:00. Buses depart to Pabaiskas at 11:15. After the finish, all participants receive commemorative medals and are awarded the youngest and oldest participants. Race winners are awarded cups and medals. All participants are responsible for their health condition, either themselves or their accompanying persons. During the event, concerts, exhibitions, and other cultural activities are held in Ukmergė, with approximately 120 runners participating.

name: Klajoklio maratonas #25: Kūjagalviai
price_range: dalyvių startinis mokestis negrąžinamas, registracijos perleidimas 5€
description: The Klajoklis Marathon is a traditional running event in Lithuania, taking place in various locations since 2020. This event brings together running enthusiasts for unique marathons where participants can experience different natural and urban environments. Each year, the marathon is held in different parts of Lithuania, and the 25th marathon in 2027 will be held in Kūjagalviai. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs seeking to test their endurance and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: The marathon takes place in various locations across Lithuania, providing a unique experience each year
The Kūjagalviai marathon route features natural beauty and challenges for runners
The event attracts both professional and amateur runners from all over Lithuania
additional: running event Kūjagalviai, awards, post-race entertainment

name: XXXVII tradicinis bėgimas „Obeliskas A. Kulviečiui – Jonava“
location: Jonava, Jonava District Municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The traditional run "Obelisk A. Kulviečiui - Jonava" is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup held in Jonava. This event invites running enthusiasts and professionals to participate in various distances, promoting a healthy lifestyle and sporting spirit. The run is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup, which includes several stages across the country. The event is organized by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė to popularize running and encourage continuous participation in competitions.
course_highlights: More than 1100 participants from Lithuania and abroad
Traditional distances: 2 km and 15 km
March 11 commemorative events and concerts
additional: Registrations are managed by and the participant fee is collected by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The paid start fee is non-refundable unless the event is canceled. Participants can change the distance or transfer their registration to another participant no later than the closing of early registration, with a fee of 10 euros. The first stage of the run begins at 08:00. The event is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, offering awards and a photo gallery. All age groups are welcome to participate.

name: Bėgimas „Pamario taurė“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lietuva

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registracija NEMOKAMA, atidaroma 2026 m. vasario 10 d., sustabdoma 2026 m. kovo 8 d., 22.00 val.

description: The 'Pamario Trophy' run is a traditional event in Šilutė, aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and popularizing running. The event is organized by the Šilutė District Municipality together with local sports organizations. Participants are invited to run various distances, including a 400 m children's track located in the city center near the municipality. The event features a friendly atmosphere and seeks to bring together both local residents and visitors.
course_highlights: Start near Šilutė District Municipality
Children's track - 400 m in the city center
Participants run with electronic timing measurement
additional: Number distribution takes place on the day of the race near the Šilutė Cultural Center and on March 10 at the Šilutė Leisure and Sports House reception. Children’s race participants can run accompanied by one parent or guardian. Each participant must attach a number with an electronic timing microchip to the front of their shirt. The event takes place in Šilutė, often associated with Lithuania's Independence Day, with about 500 participants, offering various distances and prizes.

name: 2026 metų Kovo 11-osios bėgimas, skirtas Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės atkūrimo dienai paminėti
location: Gargždų kultūros centras, Gargždai, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai iki IV grupės, 4-5 eurai vėlesnėms grupėms

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: I-III grupės dalyviai ir pensininkai - nemokamai

description: The 2026 March 11 Run is dedicated to celebrating Lithuania's Independence Restoration Day and aims to encourage the public to engage in sports as well as to identify the most capable runners across various age groups. The event takes place near the Gargždai Culture Center, and participants can choose different distances based on age and physical fitness. The run is open to all interested, with participants starting in groups from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM. It is a traditional event that not only promotes physical activity but also unites the community in celebration of an important date.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Gargždai Culture Center
Different distances from 1.3 km to 14.3 km according to age groups
The route consists of laps, run according to age group
additional: Participant number pickup takes place on the race day from 8:45 AM to 9:30 AM. Participants start in two groups: I-III groups at 10:00 AM, IV-V groups at 10:30 AM. Registration is only available online until March 10 at 8:00 PM. During the run, it is prohibited to accompany participants with bicycles or other means; directional signs will be on the route. The routes vary, registration is online, awards will be given, and traffic will be regulated during the event.

name: Nuotykių lenktynės „Aplink Rėkyvos ežerą“
description: Adventure race "Around Lake Rėkyva" is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup held in Šiauliai near Lake Rėkyva. It is approximately 14.5 km long run designed for both amateur and professional runners to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place in spring and is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup series, which includes various runs across Lithuania. Participants are invited to test their strength and enjoy the natural scenery around the lake.
course_highlights: Approximately 14.5 km long distance around Lake Rėkyva
Held in Šiauliai, surrounded by nature
This is a stage of the Lithuanian Running Cup, suitable for both amateurs and professionals
additional: The paid start fee is non-refundable unless the event is canceled. Participants can change the distance or transfer their registration to another participant before the pre-registration deadline, paying a 10 euro change fee. Registration and start fee administration are handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, with a planned date of 2027-03-21; the route is not marked, participants choose their own route, with orientation and tactics being important.

name: Riešės krosas
location: Riešės hipodrome, Vilniaus r., Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Riešės Cross is a traditional cross-country running event held at the Riešės Hippodrome in Vilnius district. The competition aims to popularize cross-country running and athletics, promote a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity. The track surface is 100% natural, consisting of the hippodrome loop, outdoor trails, forest paths, and grassy terrain, making the run varied and hilly. Participants are divided into age groups, and upon finishing, everyone receives commemorative souvenirs, with prizes for the winners of each age group.
course_highlights: 100% natural surface: hippodrome loop, outdoor trails, forest paths, grassy terrain
Hilly course with possible mud or snow depending on weather conditions
Different lap counts based on age groups and distances
additional: Number distribution takes place on the day of the event from 09:30 to 10:50 near the start-finish zone. The event schedule may change depending on the number of participants, with updates communicated when collecting bibs. Participants are responsible for their own health, and minors are the responsibility of parents or guardians. All finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, and winners and prize-winners in each age group are awarded medals, monetary, and material prizes. The event will be held on 2027-03-27 at the Riešės Hippodrome, Vilnius district, and aims to promote an active lifestyle and community spirit.

name: ULTRA 55 !!!
location: Bėgimo namai Kūjagalviai, Kauno rajonas, Lithuania
description: ULTRA 55!!! is a birthday ultra run dedicated to celebrating the 55th birthday of long-time running enthusiast Vidas Totilas. The event takes place at the Running House in Kūjagalviai, Kaunas district, and aims to promote long-distance running in Lithuania and expand the community of long-distance runners. The course consists of forest and outdoor trails with sandy sections, and the start and finish are at the same point. Everyone can participate regardless of age, gender, or nationality, and participation is free of charge.
course_highlights: Forest and outdoor trails
Sandy sections on the course
Start and finish at the Running House in Kūjagalviai
additional: Registration is available online and on the race day from 9:30 to 10:55 AM. Participation is free. All finishers receive commemorative medals, awards in absolute and age group categories. After the finish, participants can enjoy hot soup, snacks, drinks, as well as entertainment - sauna and hot tub. The event is part of the Running House race series, held annually and attracting experienced ultramarathon runners.

name: Ursvik Ultra
location: Ursvik, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
price_range: 550 kr för de olika distanserna, efteranmälan 650 kr
description: Ursvik Ultra is a traditional ultramarathon that always takes place on the third Saturday in March. The race offers three distances: 75 km, 45 km, and 15 km, all on a hilly and varied trail with a mix of illuminated tracks and paths. Participants will experience challenging terrain with gravel surfaces that can vary from dry to muddy or snow-covered depending on weather conditions. During the race, food and drinks are available at the lap point, and changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Brotorpshallen. Ursvik Ultra is a perfect start to the ultrarunning season for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 15 km hilly trail with 320 meters of elevation gain
Mix of illuminated tracks, larger and smaller paths
Varying surfaces from dry and hard to muddy and snow-covered
additional: Start takes place at Ursvik trail center. Race packets can be collected from 2 hours before the start. The exchange area is located at the water and food station. Changing rooms and showers are available at Brotorpshallen. Late registration can be done on-site on race day for a fee of 650 SEK. The rope is pulled at 23:30; after that, no one can continue on the course but they can finish on the current lap. The nearest subway station is Hallonbergen, about a 1 km walk to the sports field. Bus 504 stops right outside Motionsgården. The race includes changing, showers, food and drinks, as well as mandatory equipment such as a headlamp and change of clothes. The race takes place on the third Saturday in March, with a transition area at the lap point and free parking for participants.

name: Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. This event offers a unique opportunity to run on a takeoff and landing strip, which is an unusual and interesting running location. The event is aimed at school students, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports activities. Participants can enjoy a special atmosphere and test their strength on this unique course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a takeoff and landing strip
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course on an airport territory
additional: The event is intended for school students, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is ongoing, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking may be available for students. The event is organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027, the race distance is 3 km, and the location is Šiauliai, Lithuanian Air Force Base. Registration details are not provided.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10 km race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race takes place on a beautifully located course in Norra Djurgården with start and finish near the T-bane station Universitetet. Here, runners can test their form, seed themselves for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, and enjoy a well-organized competition with experienced pacemakers. The course is measured and offers a mix of asphalt, gravel, and ground plates with a total elevation gain of 117 meters.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with start and finish near Universitetet T-bana
Total elevation gain of 117 meters
Surface: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), ground plates (5.3%), and wooden bridge (0.2%)
additional: Maximum time 2 hours from start. Seeding basis for adidas Stockholm Marathon. Prize money for the top three women and men in the first start group. Age limit 15 years. Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles, handcycles, and racing wheelchairs are not allowed. Wheelchair participants can participate with a companion and free-wheel, starting in the last start group. The race runs on a mix of asphalt, gravel, and ground plates, with a preliminary start around 11:00 and a maximum time of two hours. Registration is open until March 28, 2026, and payment can be made via Swish or credit card.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Final is the final stage of the traditional Lithuanian trail running cup season, held in the Bražuolė area. The event offers various distances suitable for participants of different ages and experience levels, from youth to adults. The routes feature wooded surroundings with varying lengths and difficulty levels, allowing participants to experience the beauty and challenges of nature. Participants start at the Bražuolė campsite, and the event is friendly and open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Wooded routes in the Bražuolė area
Different distances from 4.8 km to 24.8 km
Routes with various elevation gains and natural scenery
additional: Start at Bražuolė campsite. The routes include elevation gains ranging from up to 150 m to over 500 m, depending on the distance. The event features categories for youth and adults. The event merchandise is inspired by forest animals, and part of the proceeds are donated to support care organizations. Different distances are offered at the event, registration is conducted online, and the location is Bražuolė campsite, Pugainiai.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
location: Romeleåsens höjder, Genarp, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race held on the heights of Romeleåsen with three distances: 10 km, 20 km, and 30 km, with elevation gains of 150, 340, and 620 meters respectively. The race is open to all runners, from amateurs to elites, and the 30 km distance is also a Swedish Championship event and part of the Skånes TrailCup. Start and finish are at Ekevallen, Genarps sports ground, and along the course there are water and energy stations. The registration fee includes food and drinks after the finish, and showers and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen
Three distances: 10 km (150 m elevation), 20 km (340 m), 30 km (620 m)
Water and energy stations along the course
additional: Bib numbers are collected on race day one hour before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available. After the race, a hamburger, beer, and other drinks prepared on site are included. The 30 km distance awards 1 UMTB point and is a Swedish Championship event. The 20 km and 30 km races run clockwise with a challenging serpentine climb on the north side of the ridge. The race is part of the Skånes TrailCup and offers food and drinks after the race, with water and energy stations along the course as well as facilities for changing and showering.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Växjöloppet is a running festival taking place in Växjö, starting at Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The races include distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with the longer distances offering a scenic course passing through Bokhultet Nature Reserve and ending with a shared stretch around Växjösjön. The finish line is at Lagunvallen, near the goal in Strandbjörket. For younger runners, there is also Lilla Växjöloppet with several shorter distances without timing. Växjöloppet is a day filled with joy of movement and community for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course through Bokhultet Nature Reserve with deciduous trees
Shared final stretch around Växjösjön with finish at Lagunvallen
additional: Water stations are available at 10 km (4 stations) and 21.1 km (8 stations). Lilla Växjöloppet offers shorter distances without timing for younger runners with bib, medal, and fruit or T-shirt and diploma depending on the distance. Registration can be made with a wellness allowance.

name: Västerås Marathon
description: Västerås Marathon is an energetic and community-oriented running event offering a flat and fast course in Västerås. The race starts in Vasaparken and features a counterclockwise route with some challenging sections, including a steep hill 400 meters from the start. Participants can enjoy water and sports drink stations as well as well-organized bib distribution and baggage drop-off. The event is characterized by running joy and a strong atmosphere, including the national anthem performed from a gondola lift at the start.
course_highlights: The course runs counterclockwise with a steep hill 400 meters from the start
Flat and fast course with some tricky sections, including a tunnel
Strategically placed toilets and hydration stations with water and sports drinks from Umara
additional: Start times: Marathon 9:00, Half Marathon 10:00, 10 km 13:00. Bib distribution and baggage drop-off open at 07:00 in the City Hall restaurant. The central station is 300 meters from the start and finish with good transportation connections. No showers or changing facilities are available. Pacers are used for speed reference with self-seeding in the start area. Medals are awarded to participants. Merchandise can be ordered on demand with shipping included. The race includes water and sports drinks, as well as the opportunity to purchase merchandise. The course passes several local landmarks and is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running race in Sölvesborg organized by Ryssbergets IK. The race offers several distances with varying lengths and difficulty levels, making it accessible for both beginners and experienced runners. The competition is part of the Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic and challenging course in beautiful terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organized and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, lines, and ribbons at each kilometer
Water and sports drinks are available at water stations at the turnaround and finish
The terrain is varied with forest sections and hilly parts
additional: Number bibs are to be collected no later than 30 minutes before the start at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla. All participants must wear their bib on the front of their chest. The award ceremony takes place around 12:30. Medical services are available at the start/finish. Refreshments with coffee and grilled sausages are offered. Volunteers are stationed at crossings to guide the way. Multiple race distances, start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club's website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories with distances of half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km. The start takes place simultaneously at 13:00 from three different locations along national road 34 between Linköping and Motala, with the finish at the sports field Bergvallen in Borensberg. The race is organized by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, and Vreta SoMK, welcoming runners of various ages and levels. Buses transport participants from the finish line back to the start locations before the race. Late registration is possible at the start locations with an additional fee.
course_highlights: Shared start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge, and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the sports field Bergvallen in Borensberg
Bus transport from finish to start locations before the race
additional: Number bibs are collected at each start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30 with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are handed out free of charge to participants up to 16 years old; others can purchase a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish line. The distance is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web and Swish/bank transfer. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants annually.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional running race "Senvagė-2026" is part of the Lithuanian Running Cup stage, taking place in Panevėžys, at Senvagė and the Culture and Recreation Park. This event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports activity, a healthy lifestyle, and the appreciation of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuanian regions. The race is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has been uniting runners and amateurs across the country since 2009. The event is held in spring, providing participants with the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Senvagė and the Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage with runners from different cities
Encourages discovering the natural and architectural beauty of Lithuanian regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The paid start fee is non-refundable unless the event is canceled. Participants can change the distance or transfer their registration to others no later than the closing of pre-registration, with the difference in price between the more expensive and cheaper distances not refunded. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will be held at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

description: Easter Run is a classic road and trail race organized by Enhörna IF with start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area. The race has a long tradition and offers several categories for both youth and adults. It is a welcoming competition where participants can enjoy varied terrain and a wonderful running experience in scenic surroundings. Registration is done in advance with the possibility of late registration on site for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Combination of road and trail
Start and finish at Enhörna Outdoor Recreation Area (sports field)
Several youth categories with shorter distances
additional: Late registration on site is possible up to 60 minutes before each start with an extra fee (100 SEK for adult categories, 50 SEK for youth categories). The Swedish Athletics Federation's competition rules apply. Participation is at your own risk. Names and possible photos may be published on the club's website and social media. The race includes several distances for children, youth, and adults, with registration until the day before the race and the possibility of late registration on site. Results and start lists are published on the club's website and social media.

location: Hallaryds skola, Hallaryd, Kronoberg County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual running race held on Easter Monday at Hallaryds School. The race is suitable for all ages with distances from 1.2 km for the youngest to 21 km as the main class. The courses mostly run on gravel roads and asphalt stretches through beautiful environments with winding stone walls, meadows, and forests in the borderland between Skåne and Småland. There are also shorter routes of 3.2 km, 6 km, and 9.8 km suitable for both running and walking. The event offers timing, water stations, prizes for the top finishers in each class, and a plaque for all who complete.
course_highlights: 21 km course passes an old stone arch bridge from 1870 with four arches
The course runs through the borderland between Skåne and Småland with varied surfaces of asphalt and gravel roads
Several water stations and challenging ascents, including a hill with 25 meters of elevation over approximately 500 meters
additional: Number bibs are collected at the school no later than 30 minutes before the start. Changing rooms and showers are available in HIF's clubhouse for women and the school gymnasium for men. Timing is done with a barcode on the bib. Sports drinks and water are served at the water stations. Late registration can be made on the day of the race for an increased fee (50 SEK for adults, no increased fee for youth and walking classes). Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class, and everyone who finishes receives a plaque. The race also includes shorter children’s and walking routes, starting and ending at Hallaryds School. Participants can register via email or bank transfer. The event offers water stations and prize distribution after the race.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: The Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course runs two clockwise laps around the scenic Rocksjön and offers a wonderful running experience. The results from Varvetmilen are used for seeding in Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organized by Göteborgsvarvet in collaboration with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour in Sweden.
course_highlights: Two laps around Rocksjön clockwise
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Seeding for Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Number bib distribution and baggage storage take place on site in Knektaparken on race day. Simultaneously with Varvetmilen, the Minivarvet is held, a 210-meter race for children aged 0-6 years with medals for all participants. Registration for Minivarvet is on-site via Swish (80 SEK). The race starts in Knektaparken, runs two laps around Rocksjön, with number bib distribution the day before and on race day. Showers, changing rooms, luggage storage, and a simple café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition since 1989 and is an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to participate.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place May 3-5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's bib number. The event area opens at 17:30 with sponsor booths and activities. There is an option to leave outerwear and shower at the arena. Water stations and toilets are available at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 years for 2.5 km (in adult company from 7 years) and 13 years for 5 km (in adult company from 11 years). Registration is binding and can be done until race day, no later than 1 hour before start. The event offers optional timing, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish bag, and a bib. The race is both fitness- and team-friendly and held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: 1600 kr långa banan, 1000 kr korta banan; efteranmälan 1900 kr och 1200 kr
description: Öland's Parish Relay is a classic long-distance relay race held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on a spring-blooming Öland. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race is available in two variants: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs suitable for all levels. Organizers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service with officials, a commentator, and individual timing.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs between 2.7 km and 8.5 km, total 67.5 km
Short course: 6 legs between 2.7 km and 5.4 km, total 23.5 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Number bib pickup takes place on May 8th from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day May 9th from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall 200 meters north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio hosts a group warm-up before the start. Officials are present on the course, at exchanges, as well as at the start and finish. Individual segment times, intermediate times, and team finish times are provided. The commentator follows the lead race from start to finish. Running on Öland, two course lengths, team categories, medals, grill plates, GPX files, changing/shower facilities, food/accommodation are offered.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race with six legs that starts and ends in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The race is flat and easy to run, with varying surfaces of gravel and asphalt, making it suitable for both recreational runners and more experienced athletes. The focus is on community and running joy, and all teams start together at the same time. During the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also organized, with medals and diplomas for all participants.
course_highlights: Flat and easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Number bibs are collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing rooms are available in Sparbankshallen. Timing is done with a data chip, and both total finish time and split times for each runner are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken with a group warm-up at 10:20. After crossing the finish line, all children receive a medal, diploma, drink, and fruit. The race includes a mini-class for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to measure total and individual times.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event offering a delightful six-kilometer course through Mjölby with start and finish in the City Park. The course runs along the Black River and features both challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments, with almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children's race, Bostadsbolaget Little City Run. All participants crossing the finish line receive a medal as proof of their effort. The race is organized by Norrköping Running Club in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cycling Club.
course_highlights: 6 km course with start and finish in City Park, Mjölby
Runs along the Black River for most of the route, 99% asphalt
Includes challenging uphill sections and smooth downhill segments
additional: Number bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 with a 25% discount coupon. Warm-up led by Fitness4You before the start. All finishers receive a medal. The children's race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45 for ages up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is possible until May 8 with an additional fee of 50 SEK. Massage services are available at the start and finish areas. The race takes place in City Park, with options for corporate tents, registration via the website, bib pickup at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship opportunities.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm offering both half marathon and 10 km distances. The race takes place on flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for those aiming for a personal best. The event is a festival with start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, welcoming runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in the scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a festival with flat courses suitable for personal bests. There is also a kids' race for children. Start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus traffic and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, kids' race for children up to 13 years old.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a delightful spring race that takes place along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic natural experience and a wonderful atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that invites participation in exercise and community in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Running along Lake Hulingen
Fantastic natural environment
The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race is held at Knektavallen, Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. It is a family-friendly event focused on exercise and health. No specific information about price or registration fee is available on the website. The event includes a 10 km course and children's races, and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Registration details are available on the website.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a cross-country race that welcomes all participants, from children and recreational runners to experienced runners and mountain bike cyclists. The race takes place in beautiful terrain along the pine-covered gravel ridge between Alberga and Kungsör, with trails and gravel roads offering moderate elevation changes and technical sections. The event is characterized by an open and welcoming atmosphere, created together by officials, spectators, and participants, and is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club. Many return year after year while new participants try for the first time.
course_highlights: Cross-country running and cycling along pine-covered gravel ridge
Trails and gravel roads with moderate elevation changes
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday the week before the race. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is organized voluntarily by Kungsörs Sports Club with a strong sense of community among participants, officials, and spectators.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainių sporto centras invites everyone to participate in a run dedicated to celebrating World Health Day. The event is community-oriented and active, aimed at promoting healthy lifestyles, physical activity, and strengthening the community's physical and mental health. It is a great opportunity for families, children, youth, and older adults to gather and spend time actively in Kėdainiai. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Program, designed to organize mass physical activity events.
course_highlights: Physical activity activities
Health testing
Community engagement
additional: The event is intended for all age groups - families, children, youth, and older residents. Organized by the Lithuanian Sports Society "Žalgiris" and Kėdainiai Sports Center. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Program, encouraging mass physical activity. It includes various physical activities, testing, sports competitions, and lectures, taking place in Kėdainiai, with the main venue being the central city stadium.

tiers.label: tier_2
