description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km around the beautiful Växjösjön. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes participants regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and focuses on promoting women's health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Controlled 5 km course around Växjösjön
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish line for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. The bib must be worn visibly throughout the race. There is an option to opt out of timing. The event area has water stations, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. Teams consist of 5 people and a picnic is granted to teams after crossing the finish line. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. The event also includes opportunities for HPV vaccination for women born between 1994 and 1999, which is offered free on-site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt's Marathon in Hultsfred is a personal and welcoming marathon and half marathon race held in celebration of Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday and his 300th marathon. The course is a 5-lap park road around Lake Hulingen, consisting of approximately 20% asphalt and is officially measured and sanctioned. The race offers two water stations with water, sports drinks, cola, and energy supplements. After the race, participants are invited to a gathering with food and socializing near the start and finish at Knektavallen.
course_highlights: 5-lap course around Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred
20% of the course is asphalt, the rest is park road
Two water stations with sports drinks, cola, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the entrance of Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. For runners expecting to take over 5 hours, the start time is 09:00. After the race, a gathering with food and socializing is offered around 14:30, approximately 1 km from the start. The race is part of a festive event to honor Kurt Gustavsson and is a unique opportunity for runners to participate in a private, but officially sanctioned competition.

name: Hässleholmsloppet
location: Hovdala slott, Hässleholm, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km, and 5.4 km, with the 21 km included in Spring i Skånes Trailcup 2026. The courses feature soft, winding trails through varied forest environments with water crossings, where the longest route has extra elevation gain and the shorter distances offer an easier technical course with equally beautiful natural scenery. The race welcomes both recreational runners and youth, with a recommendation that younger participants run in adult company on the longest distance.
course_highlights: Soft, winding trails in varied forest environments
Views of water crossings along the course
The 21 km route starts with parts of the 10 km course and has extra elevation gain
additional: Start times: 5.4 km at 11:40, 10 km at 11:50, 21 km at 12:00. Maximum 400 participants. Bibs are collected on site no later than 30 minutes before the start and must be worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing. Water stations with water and sports drinks are available on all courses. No showers or changing facilities, toilets available. Name changes can be made via the website for a fee of 100 SEK. Trail running, registration via the website, maximum 400 participants, water stations, no showers or changing facilities.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an exciting endurance run event held indoors at Tallinn's Ülemiste Center. Participants can choose between a 1-, 2-, or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-meter loop. The event is not a competition but a joy of movement and self-challenge, where you can run, walk, or brisk walk. There is a service point on the course offering water, juice, and solid foods, and at the finish line, participants receive a medal and a gift bag. The event is limited in participant numbers and offers a unique indoor track experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Center, a 552 m loop
Indoors, tiled floor, many glass surfaces, requires caution
Service point with water, juice, Coca-Cola, and solid foods (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate, orange)
additional: Distribution of start materials takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of Ülemiste Center's parking garage. Storage of belongings at the event center costs €2. Medals and gift bags are given after the finish at the event center. Participants are asked to stay briefly in the finish area for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (escalator from Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. Virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. It is possible to place your water bottle with a name tag on the course. The event is non-competitive, emphasizing cooperation and safety. No on-site registration; event is sold out; participants receive gift bags; courses are experiential and not for record-breaking.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly fitness event in Stockholm featuring races for all ages, including Mini-race for the youngest children, the Little Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class up to grade 6, a 5 km timed race for participants aged 13 and older, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The race is organized by Löparakademin, a non-profit organization working with youth in immigrant neighborhoods for personal development through running. Throughout the day, there will be music and entertainment with DJs along the course, and all participants will receive a medal at the finish line. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive and encouraging running experience that promotes movement and equal health.
course_highlights: 5 km timed race for ages 13 and up
Little Skärholmsloppet approximately 1.6 km for children in preschool to grade 6
Mini-race of 500 meters for children 0-6 years, with the opportunity to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplan. Start times: Mini-race at 10:30, Little Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different start groups by age, Fun Run 1.6 km starting at 12:25, 5 km race starting at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and energy at the finish. Registration is free and can be done until May 14 at 17:00, with late registration possible at bib distribution and on race day if spots are available. Music and DJs along the course for extra motivation. The race takes place at Puckelbollplan in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants will receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC 200 miles is a challenging ultramarathon held in Tyresö, with start and turnaround at Alby Friluftsgård. The course is a 11.5 km loop offering hilly terrain, technical trails, and beautiful views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten. The race is part of the Tyresö Extreme Challenge, which offers several distances including Backyard Ultra, MiniUltra 46 km, 50 miles, and 100 miles. It is a race that combines tough challenges with a wonderful community and positive energy among runners and volunteers.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop with start and finish at Alby Friluftsgård
Hilly gravel roads and technical trails with roots and stones
Spectacular views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve, and Tyresö-Flaten
additional: Start and turnaround are at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö. The course is marked with orange reflective ribbons spaced 20-70 meters apart. Runners pass a tent with a buffet and volunteers at the turnaround, but are advised not to stay too long. The race takes place all weekend with multiple distances, and the start time for 200 miles is at 10:00 on race day. The event is held in mid-April and may require endurance in difficult weather conditions, including icy or cold conditions early in the season.

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: The international run "Tropem Wilczym 2026" will take place in Vilnius, Vingis Park, and is dedicated to honoring anti-fascist, anti-communist, and anti-Soviet underground fighters. The event promotes running and athletics in Lithuania, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and aims to bring together runners of all ages. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is organized with great attention to safety and professionalism. It is a great opportunity for both professionals and amateurs to participate in a meaningful sports event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Vingis Park near the stage
Distances: symbolic run of 1963 meters, 5.2 km, 10.5 km, and half marathon
Route closure and traffic restrictions to ensure safety
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 13:30, after which times will not be recorded. The number of participants is limited to 1200. It is possible to change the distance for a fee of 2 EUR. Participants must have an ID to receive their bib number. The event combines sport and history, offering several distances including the symbolic 1963-meter route, and emphasizes community importance. Participants are divided into age groups, and the use of vehicles or personal escorts is prohibited.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organized by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops, and through scenic Småland nature. Participants will experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running on technical and hilly trails. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a picturesque environment with good atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Winding trails through Småland forest
Technical sections with elevation and rocks
Passage through forest tunnel and muddy holes
additional: Changes to the distance are possible until April 10 via email. Cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run) with lap at 11:45. Bib number must be clearly visible. Recommended equipment is trail running shoes and mobile phone. In case of interruption, contact volunteers or the phone number from the bib distribution. Transportation is arranged from water stations if needed.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
location: Stensö/First Camp Stensö, Kalmar, Kalmar Municipality, Sweden
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon run on a 6,706-meter loop starting at 10:00 AM. The race follows the original format where each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the next start occurs at each full hour. The winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. The distance of 6,706 meters is chosen because 24 laps equal 100 miles, a dream goal for many ultrarunners, but everyone is welcome regardless of ambition level.
course_highlights: 6,706-meter loop
Start every full hour, race continues until one runner remains
24 laps equal 100 miles (161 km)
additional: The race is a Backyard Ultra in the original format. Runners who do not complete a lap within one hour must end the competition. The winner is the one who completes one more lap than the others. All levels are welcome. Registration as a volunteer requires login.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
location: Strandvägen to Sollentunavallen, Sollentuna, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km race that challenges you to run your best mile in Sollentuna. The course runs through the town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with a water station at 5 km. The final part of the course is beautifully situated along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade before finishing at Sollentunavallen. The results from Varvetmilen are seedings for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, giving you the opportunity to secure a better starting group.
course_highlights: The course runs through Sollentuna town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen
Water station at 5 km
The final part of the course runs along the water on Nils Göranssons promenade
additional: Start and finish area at Sollentunavallen and Strandvägen near the water. Bib number distribution and baggage drop-off take place on site on race day. The mini race for children 0-6 years old is held simultaneously with a 210-meter race, registration on site (80 SEK via Swish). The race is an important seed race for Göteborgsvarvet and offers facilities such as bib number pickup and baggage drop-off.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amidst pristine nature in the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The race headquarters is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Center. The courses are diverse, offering a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run, and youth races. Additionally, free children's runs are organized, along with activities and childcare for the whole family. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna, hot tubs, and the opportunity to participate in an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through protected nature area
Diverse distances: 16 km, 6 km, and youth run
Race headquarters conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Participants have free bus transportation from Aegviidu train station to the race center and back. The race center offers childcare, baggage storage, a Stebby wellness area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop for running gear. For children, there are nature-themed activities organized by Aegviidu RMK, a low ropes course, a mini pancake cafe, and horse and pony rides (cash only). After the run, a hot sauna and hot tubs are available. During the Spring Run, a raffle will be held for a stylish Trek city bike at the awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off for at least 5 participants registered, 20% off for at least 10 participants. 50% discount for seniors (60+) and youth (up to 17) with pre-registration, minimum final price 15 €. The event takes place on April 25, 2027, offering the chance to participate in various distances and enjoy outdoor activity and family time.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Spring Ruset in Stockholm is a recreational race for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km in Norra Djurgården. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. It is possible to register individually or in teams, with team registrants receiving a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen near Stockholm University
The race takes place on gravel and forest trails in a scenic environment
additional: Number bibs are sent by mail upon registration before April 17, otherwise they can be picked up on site. Teams of five people receive a picnic after finishing. Changing rooms and showers are available at cost. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike, or public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden's largest sports tour for girls and focuses on community and health.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 350 kr till 2000 kr, gratis för de första 250 i Lilla Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: NYHET – Spring gratis! Sparbanken Skåne bjuder på startavgiften för de 250 första anmälda

description: Blood Run Kristianstad is a recreational race offering a scenic course through the Water Realm, with varying surfaces of grass, gravel, and asphalt. The race features distances of 5 km and 10 km that extend westward from Tivoli Park, crossing the Helge River and further into the beautiful natural area. For younger participants, there is Little Blood Run with shorter courses inside Tivoli Park, adapted for children aged 0-12 years. Blood Run is a social and healthy activity that also highlights the importance of blood donation and concludes with a communal picnic.
course_highlights: Scenic course through the Water Realm
Varying surfaces: grass, gravel, and asphalt
Little Blood Run for children 0-12 years inside Tivoli Park
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (up to 5 participants per team). Team members can participate in different distances. The last day to register a team is May 12. Late registration can be done on-site at Tivoli Park from 4:00 PM on the race day. Course lengths for Little Blood Run are 100 m (ages 1-3), 550 m (ages 4-7), and 1100 m (ages 8-12). The surface for the 5 km and 10 km varies between grass, gravel, and asphalt. There are changing facilities and toilets at the event area. Blood Run concludes with a communal picnic. The event includes a blood donor gift, activities on-site, the opportunity to participate in teams (up to 5 people), and various distances to suit all participants. The race is part of Sweden's largest blood donation and fitness campaign.

name: Blodomloppet
location: Västra Marks IP, Karlskrona, Blekinge, Sweden
organizer: Blodcentralerna i Blekinge och KA 2 IF

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 1750 kr tom 29 april

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 2000 kr tom 13 maj

description: Blood Race in Karlskrona is a fitness event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose to walk, jog, or run over distances of 5 km or 10 km, and also participate in the children's race over 800 meters or in a special walking class over 5 km. The race is open to both individual participants and teams, and concludes with a communal picnic for all participants. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, with designated routes for walkers to enable a joint finish. Blood Race is one of Sweden's largest health initiatives and attracts many participants each year.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses of 5 km and 10 km for running
Separate route for walkers over 5 km
Children's race over 800 meters
additional: The race offers individual and team registrations (up to 5 people per team). Team participants can compete in different distances. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members (40 SEK per person). Large registrations can be managed via an Excel template and customer portal in the registration system. Walkers are released first on their own route to facilitate a joint picnic after the race. There are changing facilities, toilets, water stations, medical services, and options for free transportation to and from the event. The race is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association. Participants can run on-site or participate remotely between May 17 and September 7, 2027. The starter kit includes a shirt, medal, and bib number. The event offers discounts for blood donors and ICA members.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race with start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping where teams of four participants each run an exciting four-kilometer stretch. The race offers a great team spirit with men's, women's, and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course is close to the competition center with motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish. It is an evening filled with exercise, community, and joy, where children and youth can participate for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchange, and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on an exciting course near the competition center
Motivational music along the route and audience support at exchanges and the finish
additional: Helhetshälsan offers leg massages both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes are awarded to the first team in each class, and nice prizes are raffled among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides energy-rich products after the finish. The race is held in Folkparken, with the possibility of late registration on site, and participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-rich products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a recreational run for women offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km through central Västerås with start and finish at Lögastrand. The race is characterized by joy of movement and community and welcomes everyone regardless of training background or level of ambition. Registration can be done individually or as a team, where teams registered receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. The event is part of a long tradition since 1989 and aims to promote women's health and create an inclusive environment for exercise and socializing.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5 people
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at Intersport in the Livli shopping center Erikslund in the days before the race. There is supervised baggage drop-off, water stations, and toilets at the event area. Picnic pickup is done with the team leader's number bib. The recommended age is 13 years for the 5 km and 11 years for the 2.5 km, younger with adult supervision. It is possible to opt out of timing during registration. Training sessions are organized in several locations before the race. Participants receive a number bib, finish bag, and medal; teams of 5 people; open to runners, joggers, and walkers; registration via the web; the event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland
description: The Blood Race in Linköping is one of Sweden's largest sporting events focused on raising awareness of the vital need for blood donation. The race offers the opportunity to walk, jog, or run 5 or 10 kilometers and is open to both individual participants and teams. During the event, the blood bus will be on site for those who wish to become blood donors, and the race has a strong local connection with ambassadors and collaborations. It is a social and healthy activity that concludes with a communal picnic and contributes to youth activities through the proceeds.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in Linköping
Opportunity to register as a blood donor on site via the blood bus
The race is organized for the twenty-second time with a local ambassador
additional: Youth teams (five team members born in 2009 or later) participate at half the registration fee if registered by April 30. Teams can be expanded to five participants at no cost until April 30. Participants registering by May 14 will receive free public transport within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day via SMS ticket. Late registration is possible at the bib distribution days before the race. Payment can be made via Swish, card, or e-invoice for companies. The race includes various distances for adults and children, with options to walk or run, as well as blood donation on site. The event is a large community celebration with music and social gathering.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging trail race of 5 km with 300 meters of elevation gain in beautiful and technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course offers nice trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The start is at the old football field, and the race includes steep climbs, singletrack, and scenic views over Ågelsjön. Welcome to participate in this somewhat classic race that provides a real challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 meters of elevation in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep climbs
Beautiful view over Ågelsjön and passage by Eremiten's Jakob's Cave
additional: The start is at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each class as well as raffle prizes. A ballpark is located 200 meters from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are offered as add-ons. The course's technical sections include "Koklämman" with a rope for assistance uphill, and the race passes a cozy barbecue area under a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk, course description includes climbs and trail sections.

name: Vilnius trail run 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 100 km, 73 km, 70 km, Maratonas, Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, Pusmaratonas, 15 km, 15 km, 5 km, 1.8 km
description: Vilnius Trail Run 2027 invites runners to experience a unique variety of routes in Vilnius's nature and city environment. The event offers courses ranging from beginner-friendly 15+ km to the challenging 108 km trail around Vilnius. Participants will enjoy diverse terrain, including forest trails, mountain paths, and scenic viewpoints that provide unforgettable Lithuanian landscape views. It is a great opportunity to test your endurance and explore the city's nature and culture through running.
course_highlights: Unique routes in Vilnius from 15+ km to 108 km
Varied terrain: forest trails, mountain paths
Scenic viewpoints with Lithuanian landscape views
additional: The event takes place at Kalnų Park Stadium, T. Kosciuškos g. 5, Vilnius. The number of participants exceeds 1000. Organizer: VšĮ, address: Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, phone: +370 610 24484. The event offers routes that include forest trails, mountain paths, and scenic viewpoints; participants can choose from various distances and age groups, including ultramarathon and children's runs.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
location: Baltoji Vokė, Rūdiškių seniūnija, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The traditional international run Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė is an annual spring sports festival held in Baltoji Vokė. It is a traditional run that brings together running enthusiasts from Lithuania and abroad. The event is characterized by a long history and a friendly atmosphere, encouraging an active lifestyle and community spirit.
course_highlights: Traditional route Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
Part of the spring sports festival
Held annually since at least 2018
additional: The event takes place during the spring sports festival. Registration is managed by the Lithuanian Running Cup. The start time in previous years was usually at 11:00 AM. Several hundred athletes participate, with awards and sponsor support, and security measures are in place.

name: Skrylleloppet
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Björnstorps IF invites you to the 54th Skrylle Race on April 25, 2026. The races are offered in 3, 5, and 10 km, with a new recreational class for men and women at 3 km. The courses run on Skryllegården's exercise trails through varied forest terrain and have gravel surfaces. Here is practical information about registration, bib numbers, parking, and race day.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km on Skryllegården's loop courses
Varied forest terrain with recreational trails
Surface: gravel
additional: Online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; Early bird until February 22, regular until April 19, and late registration until April 25. On race day, registration is possible on-site with the option to change name or category for a fee of 100 SEK; only Swish payments are accepted on-site. Bib numbers are sent via email during race week and can also be collected at Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race from 10 am to 6 pm (20% discount at pickup). Results for the 10 km can be used for seeding in the TCS Lidingöloppet. Participants cycling to the event can register this at bib pickup for a chance to win prizes. Online registration is open until the start; Early Bird prices until February 22, regular until April 19, and late registration until race start. On race day, registration is available on-site with Swish payment. Bib numbers are sent via email or can be picked up at Löplabbet in Lund. There is baggage check.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly recreational race in Kalmar organized by Högby IF on April 25, 2026. The race offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge), as well as youth categories from 600 meters to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs through the Skälby environment with gravel and park paths, as well as a short asphalt section, and fluids are available at the turnaround and finish. Medals are awarded to all finishers, and registration is conducted according to the schedule provided by the organizer.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 and 2 laps over the bridge)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and forest paths with a short asphalt section
additional: Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish. Bib numbers are collected at Skälby lodge; start times are according to the schedule, and late registration is possible as per the organizer. The routes for 4 km and 8 km are standard (1 and 2 laps over the bridge). Presence on site is required for certain volunteer registrations according to RF standards. Bib numbers can be picked up at Skälby lodge on Friday, April 24, from 15:00 to 17:00, and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at bib pickup no later than 1 hour before the start. Fluids are available at the turnaround on the long course and at the finish; medals are awarded to all who complete the race.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon of 21.1 km held in Stockholm on April 25, 2026. The race starts at 11:00 AM and has a maximum time of three hours, with start and finish areas at Biskopsudden. The course runs around Southern Djurgården and passes through scenic natural areas near central Stockholm. The event is organized by Marathongruppen and is seen as a good preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon, while also welcoming all who want to experience springtime in a beautiful city environment. Registration is available at different price levels (495-745 SEK), and bib and start information are shared in advance; water stations and medical personnel are available along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs around Southern Djurgården with start and finish at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring environment and scenic views near central Stockholm
Mixed surface with asphalt, gravel, and cobblestones along the course
additional: The race is a preparation for the adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance as well as start information. Water stations and medical personnel are available along the course. The maximum time is 3 hours and the age limit is 17 years. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is March 31. The course is a single lap of 21.1 km around Southern Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/cobblestones) and sports drinks from Enervit are offered along the course.

description: Lidingöloppet Spring Mile is a spring race of 5 and 10 kilometers with start and finish at Lidingövallen. The course is called one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile routes and runs through winding forest roads, meadows, and along the archipelago coast, mostly on soft trails and sometimes hilly. The race serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet and is suitable for those wanting to check their fitness or secure a better starting group. Before and after the race, coffee and light food are available for purchase at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails; hilly (10 km 127 m elevation, 5 km 52 m elevation)
Water station at 5 km and at the finish; course marked with red/white ribbons and km flags
additional: Number bib distribution from 09:30 on race day until 30 minutes before start. Late registration is available at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and no later than 60 minutes before start. Name and class changes can be made via Mina sidor for a fee (details and fees are on the website) or on-site for a higher fee. Free baggage drop-off is available; baggage storage costs 20 SEK (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (fee 40 SEK via Swish 1234575775); the organizer recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + bus 204/211/212). Changing rooms, showers, and sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; last 350 m on the running track. Distances are 5 km and 10 km; Kids' Spring Run for younger participants; water station at 5 km and water supplies at the finish; seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: VXO Ultrafest
location: Trummens södra strand, Växjö, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning and walking festival held in Växjö at the southern shore of Trummen on April 25-26, 2026. The event includes the Swedish Championships in 24-hour running and 100 km ultramarathon, as well as the Swedish Championship in walking with distances of a marathon for men and a half marathon for women. The race courses are flat and mainly consist of asphalt with some gravel sections, providing good conditions for fast and enjoyable races. Växjö Running Club welcomes both previous participants and new runners and walkers to this annual festive weekend.
course_highlights: Flat lap course for VXO24h approx. 820 meters, mostly asphalt with some gravel sections
The race course for VXO100k and Swedish walking championships (42 km and 21 km) runs around Lake Trummen, approx. 3.2 km per lap
The competition area is located on open grassy areas at the southern shore of Trummen with space for tents and lap counting
additional: Pre Race Dinner Friday 24/4. Lap counting takes place at the competition arena, which has space for organizers' and participants' tents. The event includes ultramarathon, walking competitions, and is held on a flat course with asphalt and gravel, providing good conditions for records and performances.

name: Vårmilen
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott / Lidingöloppet Marknads AB
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge offering one of Stockholm's most beautiful mile courses. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on winding forest paths, meadows, and along the archipelago coast. The course is mostly soft and hilly, making the race a gentle and scenic start to the running season. The race also serves as a qualifying event for TCS Lidingöloppet, providing an opportunity for a better starting group in the autumn's classic cross-country race. During the race, there are water stations with water and sports drinks, as well as entertainment along the course.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and meadows
Running along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails with elevation
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Water and sports drink stations at 5 km and at the finish. Group warm-up before start. Bag drop-off available free of charge, valuables drop-off costs 20 SEK. Changing rooms with showers and sauna available. The course is marked with white ribbons and spray paint, with officials at difficult sections. It is recommended to travel by public transport or bicycle due to limited parking. Category and name changes can be made for a fee before and on race day. Cross-country course, hilly, start and finish at Lidingövallen, accessible by public transport and car, limited parking.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: Kaunas Akropolis Marathon is an annual international running event in Kaunas attracting thousands of participants. The event is open to everyone regardless of age or physical fitness and aims to promote social and physical activity as well as healthy lifestyle traditions in Lithuania. The marathon and half marathon courses are certified by the International Association of Athletics Federations (WA) and the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS). It is a sports celebration for both professionals and amateurs, taking place in a safe environment that meets high standards.
course_highlights: Marathon and half marathon courses are certified by WA and AIMS
Course measured according to international standards
Event certified with a 5-star quality mark
additional: The event is certified with a 5-star quality mark, ensuring the highest level of safety and services. The marathon courses meet international standards. The event is designed for both professionals and amateurs, taking place in Kaunas city. Organized by VšĮ "Kauno maratono klubas". During the event, remote running options, group registrations, and various distances are offered, with certified courses.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon Run "PRALENK ŽIRGĄ" is a high-quality half marathon event dedicated to the Jurginės festival. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European sports city, promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The run takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, increasing the offering of mass sports events and involving the local community in sports activities.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The route is marked and adapted for runners
Encourages a healthy lifestyle and promotes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the smooth conduct of the event.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on April 26, 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known as a fast, spectator-friendly course where many have set personal bests - the course is organized by Bålsta IK and has grown every year since its start in 2019. The competition offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (possible one lap) and 10 km (two laps) with the finish inside the Gröna Dalens athletics track. The organizer emphasizes speed, joy, and a friendly event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (resulting in 5 km or 10 km total)
Approximately 99% asphalt; finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many have achieved personal records and several course records are documented
additional: Number bib distribution takes place inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration can be done digitally subject to availability until 1 hour before each start on race day. Start and finish are located at Gröna Dalens sports field (Badhusvägen); commuter train (line 43) to Bålsta station is about 850 meters walk from the venue. There are several parking options within 100 - 900 meters; Badhusvägen will be closed during the race day. There is clothing drop-off (instructions to attach the lower part of the bib to the bag), limited changing/shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Sports drinks (Umara) and water are available at the turn-around for the 5 km race. A team competition for the 5 km (Sparbanksloppet) is introduced; the course is described as fast and PB-friendly.

name: Landsjön runt
price_range: 12,5 km: 250-350 kr; 5,5 km: 150-250 kr; Vista FUN RUN: gratis eller 100 kr efter sista anmälningsdatum

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Herr/Dam 13-99 år 12,5 km 250 kr 350 kr efter 19/4

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Herr/Dam 7-99 år 5,5 km 150 kr 250 kr efter 19/4

price_tiers.distance: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race in a scenic environment by Landsjön in Kaxholmen outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages - 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults/youths as well as several children's classes including Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake with start and finish at Vistavallen, and musicians and water stations along the course contribute to the atmosphere. The event encourages both individual registration and team competitions for four participants.
course_highlights: Road race in a scenic environment around Landsjön, start/finish at Vistavallen
Distances 12.5 km and 5.5 km along the lake; the course is run clockwise so the climbs come early
Music along the course and water stations for participants
additional: Parking at Vistavallen is available (recommendation to use public transport or park at Hunnerydsbadet); team competitions consist of four people all running the same distance and total time is recorded, teams receive a bag from Rudenstams Gårdsbutik; in case of a course record on 12.5 km, 5,000 SEK is awarded to the runner's club; payment is made via Swish to 123 429 98 22 and no automatic confirmation is sent - you are registered if you receive a six-digit number and have paid; IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20 (the website also mentions April 19); registration closes on April 25 at 17:00 but registration on race day can be done at least one hour before if space permits. Registration closes April 25 at 17:00. Payment is via Swish. IK Vista members participate free if registering by April 20; specify IK Vista as club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is possible with combined finish/result.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics' running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels with both shorter recreational runs and technical trail options. The event offers a kids' class, recreational runs of 3 and 5 km, as well as trail runs of 7 and 17 km, welcoming both casual runners and more experienced trail runners. The course mostly runs on smaller forest paths and features sections of technical terrain with stones, roots, and steep inclines, as well as several scenic parts. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several categories, and all finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: Mostly runs on smaller forest paths, partly very technical with stones, roots, and steep inclines
Several scenic sections along the course
17 km follows Gömmaren's black/white trails "SKATAN"
additional: Date and location: April 26 at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Kids' class 700 m at 11:00; Trail 17 km at 11:10; Recreational 3 and 5 km at 12:00; Trail 7 km at 12:00. Prizes: Trophy for the first woman and man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km, and Trail 7 km and 17 km; medals for all finishers. Large prize table from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva where bib numbers serve as raffle tickets; award ceremony around 13:00; practical prizes and medals for the kids' class immediately after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Registration by April 19, 2026; team discount for at least 5 participants; bibs are picked up on race day; results available at kvantumloppet.se

name: Orion Trail
location: Ådalen, Jämjö, Karlskrona kommun, Blekinge län, Sverige
description: Orion Trail takes place in Ådalen in Jämjö outside Karlskrona in Blekinge. The race follows nature-rich trails along the river and passes a waterfall as well as a sea of wood anemones, and can be completed as running or walking. The organizer OK Orion welcomes participants to a scenic terrain experience on April 26, 2026. The event focuses on an easy to moderately challenging course in a beautiful environment near Karlskrona.
course_highlights: Trails along Ådalen and the river with varied terrain
Waterfall along the course
Wood anemones in springtime natural environment
additional: Booking is done via the MittLopp link. Trail running on trails in Ådalen; Facebook event: https://fb.me/e/1TyHBrexxh

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
location: Graalstugan, Strömsnäsbruk, Ljungby kommun, Kronobergs län, Sverige
description: SK Graal invites you to the Strömsnäs Trailrun, a trail race held on April 26, 2026, starting and finishing at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. The courses mainly run on trails and forest roads, with sections of unpaved terrain in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd. The event is open to both competitors and recreational runners, with electronic chip timing, and all finishers receive a medal. The race director and club will provide ongoing information via SK Graal's website.
course_highlights: Mainly runs on trails and forest roads
Sections through the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd, with some unpaved parts
Road crossings occur - traffic regulations apply
additional: Start and finish at Graalstugan. Pre-registration via the website by April 23 (payment can be made to bank transfer 879-0545, marked with name and birth year); late registration is only accepted on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before each start, payment via Swish or cash. Late registration fee varies on the website (+50 SEK or +60 SEK beyond the regular fee). Electronic timing with chip in the bib number (to be returned at the finish). Prizes for 1st to 3rd in each class, raffle prizes, and medals for all finishers; award ceremony around 12:30. Limited changing and shower facilities; cafeteria available at the finish. Clubs registering more than 3 participants can send a registration list to info@skgraal.se and will be invoiced afterward. Race director: Jonas Almarsson (contact details on the website). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; start times generally between 11:00 and 14:00, start lists and results published on the website; late registration accepted on race day no later than 30 minutes before start; limited changing/shower facilities and cafeteria at the finish; participation at own risk.

name: STHLM Trail Run
course_highlights: Beautiful forest trail through Northern Djurgården with natural terrain challenges
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Easily accessible by public transport (reachable from Ropsten; close to Stureplan by bike)
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 11:00, age limit 13 years, 11 years with guardian) and 10 km (start 12:00, age limit 15 years, 13 years with guardian). Event area: Fisksjöäng, Northern Djurgården. Medal, finish line service, bib with timing, and refreshments along the course. Registration is personal and can be done digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: Swish, Visa/MasterCard, Klarna invoice. Start times: 5 km at 11:00 (age limit 13 years, 11 years with guardian) and 10 km at 12:00 (age limit 15 years, 13 years with guardian). Included: medal, finish line service, bib with timing, and refreshments along the course; registration is possible until 1 hour before the first start.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://sthlmtrailrun.se/): 2026-04-26 — "Den 26 april 2026 kan du ta dig an terrängen på Norra Djurgården" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard Ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė is a unique endurance race in Alytus, near Dailidės Lake. This event invites runners to test their limits by running a Backyard Ultra format course, which makes it easier to complete a 100-mile distance. There will be only one winner of the race, and the challenge is significant – it seems easy only up to a certain point. It is a great opportunity to experience the true spirit of endurance running and to earn a respectable DNF status.
course_highlights: Trail running around Dailidės Lake
Endurance format Backyard Ultra designed for completing 100 miles
Race location in Alytus, on the slopes of Vidzgiris
additional: Race regulations are available in PDF format. The event takes place in Alytus, near Dailidės Lake. The number of participants exceeds 120. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, where the winner is the last remaining runner. The event location is in Alytus, near Dailidės Lake, with a course length of about 6.7 km featuring wooded and paved sections, with the possibility to bring your own tent, parking for cars and campers outside the start zone, food and drinks during the event.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional run "Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai" invites participants to actively spend time on May 7th in the stunning landscape of Anykščiai. The running routes are designed to suit participants of all ages and fitness levels, from children's recreational runs to 11 km endurance races. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, and the fastest in the 11 km distance will be awarded cash prizes.
course_highlights: Scenic route through the landscape of Anykščiai, along the forest of Anykščiai celebrated by Antanas Baranauskas
Different distances: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angel Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts are organized by age groups: 10:30 AM - children's recreational run "Puntukėlis"; 11:30 AM - 3 km distance; 11:50 AM - opening of the event; 12:00 PM - 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is only open until April 28th at 12:00 PM; same-day registration will not be available. Participants who reach the finish line will receive commemorative medals. The fastest in the 11 km distance will be awarded cash prizes. Pre-registration is recommended, with options to recharge after the race at the pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and activities for various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda Eco-Marathon is a traditional running event held along the Giruliai forest trails in Klaipėda. The event is open to both amateurs and professionals, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. The course length varies from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for eco-marathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda City Runners Club "Marathon" and supported by the Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Eco-marathon course - 10 laps of 4.2 km through Giruliai forest trails
Schoolchildren's course - 2 km (1 km forward, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai forest, at the beginning of the bike path near the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. Participants' start fees are paid on-site when collecting their bibs. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals, and all participants receive certificates. Participants must present an ID to collect their bib. Participants agree that the event organizers may use photos and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. Distances are 4.2 km and 42.2 km; schoolchildren's distance is 2 km. The start is in Giruliai forest. Online registration is open until April 30.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on May 1, 2026 - a running festival for the whole family with distances from children's races up to half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Little Växjöloppet for younger participants. Start and finish are at Strandbjörket with start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen; the course features both forest paths through the scenic Bokhultet and asphalt stretches around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run as two laps on essentially the same course, providing both variation and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing Bokhultet (mainly deciduous forest) and transitioning to forest trail after the first kilometer
The last approximately 3.5 km are asphalt around Växjösjön with a finish on Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and several children's distances in Little Växjöloppet (no individual timing for children's races). The 21.1 km is completed as two laps (the first lap just over 11 km, the second 10 km). Hydration stations: at 10 km there are four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km, and 6.5 km); at 21.1 km there are opportunities for fluids eight times (e.g., 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5, 16.5 km). Little Växjöloppet: participants in some children's races receive bib numbers, medals, and fruit; The Newspaper Run offers a T-shirt and diploma. It is possible to use a wellness allowance for registration (registration via mittlopp.se and receipt can be used against the employer's wellness benefit). Team competitions are available; start lists and participant information can be found on the official website. The distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km, and Little Växjöloppet; hydration stations along the course (4 on 10 km; up to 8 on 21.1 km); Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; finish closes at 14:30.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: Vilnius Spring Marathon invites runners of all levels to test their strength in the spring rhythm at Vingis Park in Vilnius. The event offers various distances from 600 meters for children to the classic marathon of 42.195 km, as well as a half marathon and shorter runs. It is a great opportunity to start the running season surrounded by nature, moving through the city and parks, enjoying the spring revival. The event is organized with great attention to the experience of all participants and encourages an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vingis Park stage
Running through Vilnius city parks and streets
Distances from 600 m for children to 42.195 km for the marathon
additional: The event takes place on 2026-05-02, starting at 10:00 AM at the Vingis Park stage. Distances: 42.195 km, 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 600 m for children. Regulations are published at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registration is available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. The event offers various distances, including children and youth runs, as well as the option to participate with insurance. Registration is conducted through myrace.lt.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Landscape Marathon is a traditional running event held at the Tartu County Sports Center, offering participants the opportunity to enjoy trail running in beautiful nature. The event is part of the Estonian movement recreation promotion program and is suitable for runners of different levels who want to improve their physical fitness and mental well-being. The marathon emphasizes the importance of movement for maintaining health and well-being and invites all active people to participate. The organizer is the Movement Recreation Competence Center, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running in the beautiful forests of Tartu County Sports Center
Diverse and varied route suitable for runners of different levels
Opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartu County Sports Center and offers participants registration options and start numbers at Tartu, Turu 10, and in the Aura Center parking lot.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race held in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen in Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with proceeds for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken with mixed terrain and a new start every full hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next. The event offers an energy station, medal, goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved walk/cycle paths
A steep uphill at Örnberget and illuminated trail along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens August 1. Name changes can be made until April 17, 2026, for a fee of 150 SEK (done via info@runraisers.com with new participant details). Bib distribution takes place on Thursday, April 30. Race format: mass start every full hour; those who do not complete the loop within 1 hour are out. The registration fee includes an energy station, race photos, medal, and goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event supporting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the registration fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; includes aid station, medal, race photos, goodie bag, and prizes for winners.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund organized by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course mostly run on narrow trails in the beautiful Småland landscape - through dark, fairy-tale forests, along lakes, and over long cliffs with fast downhill sections. There are categories for men and women at 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children's race of about 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register until race day; the children's race is free and awards a medal at finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails in Småland landscape
Through dark, fairy-tale forests and along lakes
Long cliffs and fast downhill sections
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. Registration is via email to sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com and payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration can be done on-site on race day. The children's race is about 1 km, all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish; a parent can accompany the child. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window Saturday 10:00 - 16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 estimated number of participants approximately 45; 2024 women's course record at 26 km is 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children's race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a light and fast lap course in central Trosa where each lap is 6.706 km and the race continues as long as participants can complete a lap within one hour. The start is on May 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM and the concept follows the Backyard format: those who complete a lap within an hour can start again until only one participant remains. The race is open to the public and family-friendly with Mini-TUB for children (start at 12:15 PM) and awards for the top three in men's and women's categories. The organizer offers sports drinks, fruit, sandwiches at the lap change, and has ongoing raffles during the race.
course_highlights: Lap of 6.706 km (large course)
Mostly follows the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 meters elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (MiniTUB follows the large course 700 m before deviation)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on Facebook page Trosa Ultra Backyard; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition where the top three results count for each club (the club with the top three gets 20% discount next year); tent spaces outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy support during the race (candy, sports drinks, fruit) and Selfie-Corner after the race; free silicone mug from Umara for all main race participants.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: The Druskininkai Race Marathon is an international running event held in Druskininkai near Lake Vijūnėlė. The event promotes running as a healthy lifestyle and aims to popularize athletics in Lithuania and increase the activity of Druskininkai residents. Participants of all ages can take part, but only those aged 18 and over can start in the marathon and half-marathon categories. Participants compete in various distances from 500 meters to a marathon, and all are awarded special event medals.
course_highlights: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half-marathon and marathon distances
Starts from 10:00 AM, time limits of 5 hours for marathon and half-marathon distances
The race takes place near Lake Vijūnėlė in Druskininkai
additional: Starts are organized in waves: 10:00 - 500 m (timing not recorded), 10:17 - 5 km (time limit 43 min), 11:00 - 10.5 km, half-marathon and marathon (time limit 5 hours). Participants compete only for themselves. Only individuals aged 18 and over can participate in the marathon and half-marathon categories. All participants receive special event medals, and winners in the 1st to 3rd places are awarded winners' cups. Distances: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half-marathon, marathon; online registration; awards for top finishers.

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run is a unique run held simultaneously worldwide, including Vingio Park in Vilnius. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the "Catch Car." This event is dedicated to supporting spinal cord injury research, with 100% of participant fees allocated to scientific studies. Join thousands of runners around the world and run for those who cannot.
course_highlights: Run takes place in Vingio Park, Vilnius
Start simultaneously with runners worldwide
Unique "Catch Car" format that ends the run
additional: Start time is 11:00 UTC. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the "Catch Car." 100% of participant fees are allocated to spinal cord injury research. The event occurs simultaneously worldwide, including Vilnius. The event is held in Vingio Park, with participants choosing to run or walk, and there is no traditional finish line; funds are raised for spinal injury research.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: The A. Vietrinas Cup running race is held in memory of Lithuania's marathon pioneer Alfonso Vietrinas. The event takes place in Kaunas Ąžuolynas Park, with the start and finish near the S. Darius and S. Girėnas monument. Participants can choose between 2.5 km or 10 km distances, and the course is certified and consists of a 2.5 km loop. The event promotes running in Lithuania and invites all interested to participate with a doctor's permission.
course_highlights: Course runs through Ąžuolynas Park
One lap length - 2.5 km, certified course
Start and finish near the S. Darius and S. Girėnas monument

The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.

No showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents but are not the organizer's responsibility. There is a tent camp and aid stations at the event, but there are restrictions on aid along the course.

description: Pasvalys Marathon is a traditional running event held in Pasvalys city, aimed at promoting running among youth and adults and encouraging a healthy lifestyle. The event takes place at the Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park stadium, where participants compete in marathon, half-marathon, and children's running distances. The course lengths and laps are adapted for different distances, with water and refreshment stations set up every 5 km along the route. Participants are awarded prizes and commemorative medals, and the event is part of the Pasvalys city festival "Vys par to ãlo."
course_highlights: 10 km course, 4 laps for the marathon, 2 laps for the half-marathon
Water and refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at Pasvalys Culture and Recreation Park stadium
additional: Numbers are issued from 8:00 AM at Pasvalys stadium. The children's 400 m run starts at 11:00 AM. Participants must have a doctor's permission or a registration with a doctor's visa, or assume responsibility for their health during the race. Participants who reach the finish line within the control time receive commemorative medals. The event offers various distances, with medals, diplomas, prizes, and refreshments awaiting participants.

name: 55-asis bėgimas – pusė maratono „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“
description: The 55th 'Around Elektrėnai Lakes' run is a traditional half marathon held in Elektrėnai municipality, taking place in the beautiful surroundings of Elektrėnai city. The event brings together sports enthusiasts and active leisure lovers, offering an opportunity to run around the large Elektrėnai reservoir. It is a great chance to explore the nature and history of the Elektrėnai region while enjoying sport and community spirit. The event takes place in June, traditionally starting in the morning and continuing until the afternoon.
course_highlights: Running around Elektrėnai Lakes - a large reservoir formed by damming the Strėva River
Scenic route through Elektrėnai city and natural surroundings
A traditional event held since 1971
additional: The event takes place on June 21 from 08:30 to 16:00. Registration is available through the official website with account creation. Elektrėnai municipality offers many accommodation and dining options near the event location. The event date is June 27, 2027, with start and finish in Elektrėnai. Participants are encouraged to register in advance. The event runs all day, from 08:30 to 16:00.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“
description: The running race "For the Future of Children" is an event aimed at encouraging society to become guardians of older children and to change negative attitudes towards foster children. The race takes place in Kaunas Ąžuolynas, with the start and finish near the central buildings of the Lithuanian Sports University. The event aims to draw attention to children over 10 years old awaiting foster families and to promote the services provided by the foster care center. Participants can choose from several distances, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal.
course_highlights: 5 km distance - 2 laps of 2.5 km each
Start and finish near the central buildings of the Lithuanian Sports University
The race takes place in Kaunas Ąžuolynas, near the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: The race features three distances: 500 m (for those born in 2014 and later, start at 18:30), 1 km (start at 18:45), and 5 km (start at 19:05). Participants must wear a number on the front of their shirts. Winners and runners-up in various age groups will be awarded, and every finisher receives a commemorative medal. Participants and supporters are prohibited from using transport and personal escorts during the event. Registration is conducted online. The event is designed for children and youth to promote an active lifestyle and social engagement.

name: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas
location: Sudeikių ežeras, Sudeikiai, Utenos rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: VšĮ Utenos verslo ir turizmo agentūra
description: The 6th Alaušas Marathon is a traditional running event held in the town of Sudeikiai, Utena district, on the eve of the Midsummer Night. The marathon offers sports enthusiasts a chance to experience a unique atmosphere and test their endurance in a beautiful natural setting near Lake Sudeikiai. The event begins in the evening on June 23 at 19:30 and invites participants and spectators to an active and fun sports evening.
course_highlights: Takes place in the town of Sudeikiai near Lake Sudeikiai
Event starts on the eve of Midsummer Night, June 23 at 19:30
Marathon is held in Utena district, surrounded by nature
additional: Registration is conducted through the official website with the option to log in via Facebook. The event takes place on the eve of Midsummer Night, so the start is scheduled for the evening. The event location is marked with a Google Maps link in Sudeikiai. The event includes not only running but also other active activities, registration is done online, and it is an important part of the local sports festival.

description: Night Running Festival "Kaišiadorys 2026/10" is dedicated to celebrating the Day of the State (the coronation of King Mindaugas of Lithuania). The event will take place at Kaišiadorys Teofiliaus Matulionio Square and will include various age groups and distances, providing runners with the opportunity to compete and enjoy running through city streets and educational trails. Organizers invite all running enthusiasts to participate and promote a healthy lifestyle. During the race, filming and photography will be conducted, and participants agree that the material may be used for marketing purposes.
course_highlights: Race location - Kaišiadorys Teofiliaus Matulionio Square, city streets, Girelės educational trail, Gandriuko trail
Different distances from 436 m to 8 km, suitable for various age groups
Night run with the option to purchase special running shirts
additional: Number pickup at the race site from 17:00 to 20:45 depending on the distance. Participation fee is waived for students and staff of Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Center. Special running shirts (light or dark) can be purchased for 15 EUR. Safety requirements must be followed during the race. The race location is Kaišiadorys Teofiliaus Matulionio Square and surrounding areas. Registration on race day, sale of shirts, various distances.

name: V-asis maratonas „Vilniaus tiltai“
location: Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: The Vilniaus Tiltai Marathon is a traditional running event held in the Vilnius leisure zone near the White Bridge. Participants can compete in various distances from a 500 m kids' run to a full marathon of 42.195 km. The routes wind along the Neris riverbanks and across Vilnius bridges, offering a unique city view for runners. The event is aimed at both amateurs and professionals, promoting running culture in Lithuania and showcasing Vilnius.
course_highlights: The route winds along the Neris riverbanks and across Vilnius bridges
The marathon distance consists of 4 laps of 10.6 km each
Opportunities to compete in various distances from 500 m to 42.195 km
additional: Number pick-up begins at 6:45 AM. Warm-up for marathon, half marathon, and 10.6 km participants starts at 7:50 AM. Awards are given for men's and women's marathon distances, as well as for the largest and most resilient team nominations. Time limits: marathon 7 hours, half marathon 3 hours, 10.6 km 2 hours, 5.3 km 1 hour, Nordic walking distances 6 hours. The event location is the Vilnius Leisure Zone near the White Bridge; registration and health check are mandatory. The event encourages community spirit and an active lifestyle.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 3 etapas
description: Jonavos Running Cup is an open running competition held in the Jonavos district, aimed at promoting sports and physical activity. The event takes place in five stages at different locations, where runners compete against each other and earn points for the overall ranking. Each stage has its own course and start time, and participation is free of charge. The tournament is organized by the Jonavos Sports Center in collaboration with the Lithuanian Running Enthusiasts Association and other partners.
course_highlights: Five stages at different locations in the Jonavos district
Courses ranging from 6 km to 8.4 km in length
Start in the evening at 19:30, bib collection before the race
additional: Bib collection takes place on the day of the event from 18:30 to 19:20 at the start location. Registration for each stage is done separately online. Participation in the race is free. The race courses may intersect with road traffic, so participants must adhere to traffic rules. A series of 5 stages, online registration, open to all participants from Lithuania and abroad, with starts usually at 19:30.

name: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis 2026
description: The Trakai Night Half Marathon is a unique running event held around Trakai Castle. The race starts on Karaimų Street and finishes on Birutės Street near the church. The event attracts running enthusiasts who enjoy the unforgettable atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Trakai. Registration is available online until July 17, and participants' numbers can be collected the day before the race.
course_highlights: Start at Karaimų St. 13
Finish at Birutės St. 4 near the church
Around Trakai Castle and night atmosphere
additional: Participants' numbers and electronic timing chips can be collected on July 18 from 5 PM at Birutės St. 4 in Trakai. The evening night run features a route with hills, illuminated Trakai Castle, peninsula, museums, church, Lukos Lake, starting near the peninsula castle. Distances: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 500 m children’s run. Preparation and nutrition are recommended.

name: XXXV-asis tradicinis estafetinis bėgimas „Medininkai - Vilnius“
description: The 35th traditional relay race "Medininkai - Vilnius" is the oldest traditional relay race in Lithuania, dedicated to honoring those who died at the Medininkai border post near the memorial. The event takes place in July, starting near the Medininkai memorial. The relay consists of 7 stages of 5 km each on an asphalt road, with participants running in teams. It is a unique opportunity to take part in a historic and meaningful sporting event that connects Medininkai and Vilnius.
course_highlights: 7 × 5 km relay on asphalt road
Start at Medininkai memorial
Route dedicated to honoring those who died at the border post
additional: The event is organized by the Police Department under the Ministry of the Interior, the Customs Department, and LBMA. The results will be published on the official organizer's website. The event takes place on an asphalt road, so appropriate running shoes are recommended. The event aims to honor the victims of Medininkai, was held in Vilnius, involved law enforcement officers, covered a distance of 34 km, with 7 stages, a symbolic baton with soil, medals, and refreshments at the finish line.

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: The Coastal Bash is a unique barefoot run on the seaside sand held in Smiltynė, Klaipėda. The event takes place during the Sea Festival and offers participants unforgettable experiences running between the sea and dunes. The race promotes running culture in Lithuania and encourages a healthy lifestyle. Participants can choose from several distances and enjoy the stunning seaside nature and gentle breeze.
course_highlights: Barefoot run on seaside sand
Start at the beach near the southern pier, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distances of 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km with a 2-hour time limit
additional: A 2-hour time limit applies to all distances. Participants must have an ID and a bib attached, as well as an electronic timing chip on their shirts. Race participants run at their own risk and assume all related liabilities. The barefoot run on seaside sand includes various distances (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), online registration, regulations and rules, awards, and commemorative medals.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Jurbarkas 2026“, skirtos Nemuno metams paminėti
description: Running race "Jurbarkas 2026", dedicated to the Nemuno Year, will take place on August 8, 2026, in Jurbarkas, Nemuno Street. The event invites children, youth, and adults to participate, with three distances offered: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km. The event starts at 11:00 AM, and all finishers will receive commemorative gifts, while the top athletes will be awarded cups. It is a great opportunity to actively celebrate the Nemuno Year and run together in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: Choice of three distances: 400 m, 3 km, and 12 km
The race takes place on Nemuno Street, Jurbarkas
12 km distance consists of 4 laps
additional: Number distribution for participants begins at 10:00 AM. Age groups according to distances: 400 m - B12/M12 (born in 2014 or later), 3 km - B14/M14, B18/M18 (older participants without competition), 12 km - men and women in separate age groups. All finishers receive commemorative gifts, with the best awarded cups. Race distances: 400 m, 3 km, 12 km; age groups; pre-registration required; registration on the day of the event will not be possible.

name: Šilutės naktinis bėgimas „ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026“
location: Šilutė, Šilutės rajonas, Klaipėdos apskritis, Lithuania
description: The Šilutė Night Run "ŠILUTĖ RUN 2026" is a night running event designed for all active lifestyle enthusiasts - from families and beginners to experienced runners. The event takes place in Šilutė, featuring an illuminated night route, music, atmosphere, and various entertainment. Participants can choose between a 1 km family, children, and pet run or 5 km and 10 km distances. During the event, finish medals, prizes for the fastest, and delicious food await the participants.
course_highlights: Illuminated night route
Location: Kiškio dauba, Šilutė
Distances: 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: Event program: 18:00 number pickup, 19:30 official opening, 20:00 1 km family, children, and pet run, 21:30 5 km and 10 km runs. Participants will enjoy music, prizes for the fastest, various entertainment, and tasty food. Registration is open until August 7, 2026. The event includes various distances and entertainment, with medals and prizes for participants.

name: Druskininkų naktinis bėgimas 2026
