description: The Druskininkai Night Run is a unique summer night run in Druskininkai, inviting participants to experience the rhythm of running under the stars. The event features a vibrant atmosphere, music, light effects, and a scenic route around Druskonis. Participants can choose from several distances, including running, relay, and rollerblading, making it a great entertainment for families and friends. The run symbolizes friendship between Lithuania and Poland and is part of sports projects promoting community cooperation.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Druskonis (1.2 km loop)
Night run with music, light, and smoke effects
Opportunity to participate in running and rollerblading events
additional: Start numbers and packets are issued at the event village from 20:00 to 21:40. Warm-up with a Zumba instructor. 21:25 - 1.2 km rollerblading (no time recording). 21:40 - 1200 m run (no time recording). 22:00 - 4 km and 12 km rollerblading. 22:30 - start of 4 km, 8 km, 16 km, and 2×4 km relay races. The event is part of the 'Run with a Friend in Druskininkai' project, funded by the state budget. The event is financed by the Interreg Lithuania-Poland program. Participant number issuance is on August 8. The start is in Druskininkai, with several hundred participants. It is an international project.

name: VI Ilgų nuotolių bėgiko Piotro Silkino jubiliejinis 85-mečio bėgimas
location: Kretingos Vasaros estrada, Maironio g. 15, Kretinga, Lithuania
description: Piotr Silkin's anniversary long-distance runner race is a traditional race held at the Kretinga Summer Stage. The competition is based on laps, where marathon participants complete one 2.2 km lap and twelve 3.3 km laps. The event is dedicated to honor the long-time runner Piotr Silkin and attracts running enthusiasts from various locations. Participants can enjoy both competitive sport and a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Marathon course consists of 1 lap - 2.2 km and 12 laps of 3.3 km
The race takes place at the Kretinga Summer Stage
Lap format allows spectators to watch the race and support the participants
additional: Various distances and age groups will be held during the event, results will be announced, registration is available online.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 4 etapas
description: Jonavos Running Cup is a traditional running competition held in the Jonavos district, aimed at promoting sports and physical activity. The event is open to all runners, who can compete in different stages and age groups. Participants earn points at each stage for the overall standings, and the routes are set in various locations across the Jonavos district, providing an interesting and diverse running experience. Registration is conducted online, and bib numbers are collected on the race day at the start location.
course_highlights: Stages take place in various locations across the Jonavos district: Šilai - Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai - Bartoniai, Jonava
Start time for each stage is at 19:30
Bib number collection on race day from 18:30 to 19:20 at the start location
additional: Participants register separately for each stage. Participation in the event is free of charge. The race routes may intersect with road traffic, so participants must adhere to traffic rules. Registration deadlines vary for each stage, and bib numbers are collected on the race day at the start location. Registration is conducted online. The races take place in various locations across the Jonavos district, with divisions into age groups.

name: VIII-asis Žolinių maratonas
description: The VIII Herb Festival Marathon is a traditional running event held in Vingis Park, Vilnius, dedicated to celebrating the Herb Festival in a healthy, joyful, and meaningful way. The event is open to both professional athletes and beginners, offering various distances from children's runs to a full marathon. Each participant is awarded a metal figurine symbolizing a herb plant, and the course length is a 5.275 km loop, which runners complete according to their chosen distance. The event promotes community spirit and an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course is certified by the Lithuanian Athletics Federation (LAF) and measured by Alfonso Kazlauskas
Loop length - 5.275 km, 8 laps for the marathon
Start is in front of the Vingis Park stage
additional: Participants can choose from 6 distances: marathon (42.2 km), 31.6 km, half marathon (21.1 km), 10.6 km, 5.3 km (one lap), and a 600 m children's run. Each participant is awarded a metal figurine, the design of which changes annually, symbolizing different herb plants. The event celebrates traditions and community spirit, offering various distances and symbolic awards featuring herb plants.

name: XXXV-as tradicinis tarptautinis estafetinis bėgimas „Baltijos Kelias“
description: The 35th traditional international relay race "Baltic Way" will take place from August 21 to 24, 2027. The race symbolically recreates the Baltic Way of 1989, when millions of Lithuanians, Latvians, and Estonians linked hands to seek freedom and independence. The approximately 650-kilometer route runs from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn, with runners passing the baton in relay style, covering different segments of varying lengths. It is not only a sporting event but also a living history lesson and a celebration of community, bringing together participants and supporters from the three Baltic countries.
course_highlights: Approximately 650 km route from Vilnius through Riga to Tallinn
Relay race across three Baltic states
Symbolic reenactment of the historic Baltic Way live chain
additional: The race lasts four days, during which runners cover up to 200 kilometers daily. The event opening takes place at Vilnius Cathedral Square. Participants pass the baton in relay style, and the race is accompanied by meetings with city and community residents. The event is part of the national physical activity program. It spans four days, with opportunities to welcome and support runners along the way, and is dedicated to commemorating the unity of the Baltic nations.

name: Vilniaus bėgimo klubų taurė
location: Vingio parkas, Vilnius, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius Running Clubs Cup is a running event held in Vilnius at the Vingis Park athletics stadium. The event is dedicated to running clubs, sports clubs, families, children, youth, adults, seniors, and people with disabilities from Vilnius and other Lithuanian cities. The main race is a team relay 5×1000 m, involving five participants, along with individual 1000 m runs and a 60 m children’s race. The event promotes physical activity, community spirit, and a healthy lifestyle in Vilnius.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the Vingis Park athletics stadium
Main event - team relay 5×1000 m
Also includes 1000 m individual runs and 60 m children’s race
additional: Race program: 12:00 children’s 60 m race, 13:00 women’s 1000 m race and women’s tricycle race, 13:15 men’s 1000 m race and men’s tricycle race. Relay events for women, mixed, and men are canceled. Organizers reserve the right to adjust start times. The event includes various running competitions, including races for children, adults, and people with disabilities, taking place on August 28, 2027.

name: Naktinis bėgimas 2026
description: Night Run 2026 invites you to feel the rhythm of the night and immerse yourself in the end-of-summer buzz in Kaunas. This is a unique opportunity to relax from everyday life and end the summer with an energetic run accompanied by music, a sea of lights, and the company of inspired runners. The event takes place at the Town Hall Square and Santalka Park, offering stunning views and an unforgettable night adventure. Participants compete in 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances, and the event is suitable for both amateurs and professionals.
course_highlights: Route through Town Hall Square and Santalka Park
Night run with music and a sea of lights
Competitions in 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances
additional: Participants must attach a bib with a timing microchip to the front of their shirts. Registration data and distance changes are possible until 2026-08-23 for a fee of 5 €. Race times may not be recorded if the route is not completed within the set time limit. The use of transport on the route is strictly prohibited. The event will be held in Kaunas, featuring a night run with lights, music, and a lively atmosphere. Registration and more detailed information are available on the official website.

description: The North Lithuania Half Marathon will take place in the Pakruojis district in northern Lithuania in 2026. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active by offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The start and finish will be in Pakruojis town park, and participants will enjoy not only sports but also the opportunity to explore the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of all ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis town park
Exploring northern Lithuania during the run

name: TEMPLE Kauno pusmaratonis `26
organizer: TK Temple Kauno pusmaratonis TS Temple social club
description: The TEMPLE Kaunas Half Marathon '26 is the hottest summer running celebration in Kaunas, taking place on August 29. The event offers four distances: half marathon (21.089 km), 10 km, 5 km, and a 400 m children's run. It is not only a competition but also an experience filled with excitement, adrenaline, and community spirit, inviting both those aiming for personal records and those wanting to enjoy the festive atmosphere of running. This event colors the city with participants' smiles and invites everyone to become part of the history.
course_highlights: Choice of four distances: 21.089 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 400 m children's run
Summer running celebration in Kaunas city
Atmosphere full of excitement, adrenaline, and community spirit

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytaus half marathon 2026 invites all running enthusiasts to a special summer finish in Alytus. The event starts and ends at Alytus Town Hall Square, and the course takes you through the most beautiful parts of the city - lush parks, cozy streets, and the banks of the Nemunas River. Participants will experience camaraderie, movement, and emotions, and at the finish line, they will be greeted with a festive atmosphere and support. This is a great opportunity to get to know Alytus and take away unforgettable emotions, whether aiming for the best result or simply spending a meaningful day.
course_highlights: Course takes you through lush parks
Cozy city streets
Inspiring Nemunas River banks
additional: various race distances, registration required, medals for all participants, awards for top finishers

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė 5 etapas
description: On the evening of August 21, the Jonavos Sports Center invited running enthusiasts and fans to the fourth stage of the Jonavos Running Cup. This time, participants had to test a prepared 7 km scenic route in Panoteriai village, which was special this August due to the 115th anniversary of Panoteriai School and the 30th anniversary of the consecration of the Holy Cross Discovery Church. Although runners were accompanied by heavy rain, it did not hinder the festive running mood – awards were presented at the very Panoteriai Church.

description: The Arco Vara 55th Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km race taking place on May 30, 2026, on the shores of Lake Harku. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. The course features water stations and is marked and secured by a route management team. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome, starting in the last group. The race center is located at the start-finish area, where bib numbers are issued and awards are presented.
course_highlights: 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Water stations at 3 km and at the finish
Route management and marked course
additional: Race bibs will be issued on race day from 9:30 to 11:30 at Lake Harku. Timing is via a chip attached to the back of the bib. Participants will receive a medal, sports drink, and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance throughout the course. Awards ceremony is scheduled around 13:00, where the top 6 men and women and age group winners will be recognized. The race features two distances and children's runs, with registration starting at 9:30 and the start at 12:00. Participants can enjoy nature and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
location: Koeru KK staadion, Koeru, Järva County, Estonia
description: Koeru Athletics Competition is a traditional athletics event held at the Koeru KK stadium. Men and women participate in two age groups and compete in several disciplines, including 100 meters, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, and 1000 meters. The winner is determined by the total points from the top three disciplines. The competition is open to everyone and offers the opportunity to participate in all events, where young athletes use implements appropriate for their age group.
course_highlights: Event disciplines: 100 meters, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, 1000 meters
Four attempts in long jump and throws
The competition takes place at Koeru KK stadium
additional: In the men's and women's categories, the triathlon winner is awarded a trophy, and the 2nd to 6th place receive medals. Winners of individual disciplines are awarded medals. Young athletes use implements suitable for their age group. The event will be held on May 30, 2026, at Koeru sports track, where participants can accumulate points across multiple disciplines, and winners will be awarded trophies and medals.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together movement enthusiasts of all ages. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children's runs, youth runs, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 and 5-kilometer runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The aim of the event is to offer the joy of movement, a good feeling, and an active day outdoors, emphasizing quality time spent with family and friends.
course_highlights: Multiple distances: 100 m children's run, 1 km youth run, 500 m walk for people with special needs, 3 km and 5 km runs
Health walk over a 3 km distance
Starts and activities next to Maxima XX shopping center on the main stage
additional: Participation is free. Registration is open until May 29 at 19:00 online or at Maardu City Stadium from May 14 to 29 between 13:00 and 17:00. On the day of the Spring Run, on-site registration is only available for the 500 m walk for people with special needs. All finishers receive a medal. The day concludes with a lottery among participants. On race day, registration and awards will take place at the finish line. The event includes various running and walking distances and is aimed at the whole family.

name: jooks ümber Harku järve

price_tiers.distance: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve 6,5 km

description: The Arco Vara 55th Run Around Lake Harku takes place on May 30, 2026, at the shores of Lake Harku in Tallinn. It is a 6.5 km run that is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is the second event in this series. In addition to runners, Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome, starting in the last group. The course features water stations, and the race center offers, in addition to the run, a children's athletics workshop and pop-up shops. Participants will receive a medal, chip timing, sports drink and water on the course, and awards.
course_highlights: 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Water stations at 3 km and at the finish
Course signage and marked route
additional: Race numbers will be issued on the day of the event from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM at the shores of Lake Harku. Timing is chip-based, attached to the back of the bib. Participants are guaranteed a medal, sports drink, and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance and awards at 1:00 PM. Nordic walkers start after the runners in the last starting group. The event day includes children's races, awards, raffles, and additional activities such as a ski jump and sports equipment sales. Registration is open until May 20, 2026.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Lääne County running event is a lively and peaceful family gathering taking place on May 31 at the Haapsalu railway station. The group run is approximately 3+ kilometers long at a relaxed pace (~7:30 min/km), inviting all sports enthusiasts from Lääne County to participate. The event is the final part of a campaign that connects various runs held throughout May across the county. Both returning participants and newcomers are welcome to enjoy movement together and strengthen community spirit.
course_highlights: Start at Haapsalu railway station
Relaxed pace about 7:30 min/km
Distance approximately 3+ km
additional: The group run is part of a broader movement campaign taking place in different parts of Lääne County during May. The event is intended for all sports enthusiasts to enjoy movement together and strengthen community spirit. The pace is relaxed, suitable for a family event. Both youth and adults participate, emphasizing healthy lifestyles and community involvement. Specific registration and participation conditions have not been publicly published.

name: Meie oma maijooks 2026
description: Our own Maijooks 2026 is a traditional running race held on June 1 at the Kolga-Jaani school stadium and sports grounds. The event features various distances and age categories suitable for runners of all ages, Nordic walkers, and fitness enthusiasts. The aim of the event is to promote a healthy lifestyle, provide opportunities for competition, and value family-centered communal activities in the Kolga-Jaani area. Participants can enjoy a pleasant evening run on the bike path and stadium, and receive recognition for the best runners and regional representatives.
course_highlights: Children's runs around the stadium track for those up to 7 years old
1.5 km youth run on the bike path
4.5 km main run from and around Kolga-Jaani stadium
additional: The race includes children's runs for those up to 7 years old without timing, a 1.5 km youth run, and a 4.5 km main run. Nordic walkers can participate in the main run. Participation fee and bib distribution take place at the registration desk on race day. Awards are given to the top three in the youth and main runs, as well as to the best regional participants with special prizes. The races are held at the stadium and sports grounds; registration is required; free for children born in 2010 or later.

name: Virtuaaljooks suvi 2026
description: Virtual Run Summer 2026 is a flexible remote running race that allows participants to complete the chosen distance at a convenient time in their hometown. The race includes various distance options, including 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21 km), and also offers the opportunity to participate in a children's run. Participants can save and upload their results to the GoAndRun.eu portal, ensuring result reliability and comparison with other participants worldwide. Virtual running provides an environmentally friendly and convenient way to participate in sports without having to go to a physical location.
course_highlights: Virtual running race that can be completed in your hometown
Distance options of 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km half marathon
Results can be saved and uploaded from sports watches and app files
additional: Participants can upload results from common sports watch and app files (.fit, .gpx, .tcx, .pwx) or enter results manually. The race supports 'fair play' rules and allows results to be published anonymously or privately. Virtual running makes participation in sports events accessible to everyone, even in the face of unexpected obstacles. Registration and participation are conducted online, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts and supports Estonian veterans philanthropically.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs are a traditional running series event that started in 2016 and will take place in 2026 over three stages. The runs are held on Kambja health trails, offering participants the opportunity to enjoy forest paths and some asphalt segments. The goal of the series is to promote healthy lifestyles and motivate people to engage in health running. Each stage features a 10 km race, as well as a health run and a power run, which use a formula based on body weight and elevation gain to determine the winner. All runners who participate in all three stages receive a series shirt, and the main winners are awarded a Merida Big Nine 20 bicycle.
course_highlights: Runs take place on Kambja health trails, mainly forest paths
10 km competitive run consists of one or two 5 km laps
Power run uses a formula based on body weight and elevation gain to determine the winner
additional: Start is open on the event day from 18:00 to 20:00, the 10 km race starts at 18:00 at each stage, and the finish line closes at 21:00. Timing is electronic. Registration is free and available online at regama.ee/kambja or on-site at the event center. The top three finishers in the race are awarded medals or trophies. Three stages, registration online or on-site, part of the Tartu County running and walking series.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: Lääne-Virumaa Youth Athletics Championship is an athletics competition for young people and adults held in Rakvere. The competition includes various athletics disciplines such as running, jumping, and throwing, and is intended for different age groups from U-14 to adults. The aim of the event is to honor the memory of Eerik Konist and to popularize athletics among youth. All age groups are awarded medals, and the best performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the Heino Lipp Stadium in Rakvere and starts at 11:00 AM, with registration opening at 10:00 AM.
course_highlights: Diverse athletics disciplines: running, jumping, throwing
Age groups from U-14 to adults
Events held at Heino Lipp Stadium in Rakvere
additional: Registration begins at 10:00 AM and technical check-in must be submitted half an hour before the start of the competition. All disciplines include 4 attempts in jumps, throws, and shot put. The top three in each age group are awarded, with special prizes for the best boy and girl performances. The event starts with registration at 10:00 AM and competitions begin at 11:00 AM. Participants can enjoy sports and friendly competition, with medals and special prizes awarded to the best performers.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia's oldest and most prestigious tempo series, offering the opportunity to challenge yourself in cycling, running, or roller skating. The series stages take place in various locations around Tallinn and its surroundings, providing time-trial speed competitions. The Tallinn stage is held at Freedom Square, where the course is short and technical, well-suited for sprint enthusiasts. Finishers of the series receive a prize program called Kullapada, which rewards consistent participation in all stages.
course_highlights: Time-trial cycling on a speed track around Tallinn
Short 1.3 km sprints in the heart of Tallinn at Freedom Square
Roller skating on good surface roads on city streets
additional: The stage features a hot group, which is invited by name for the last 10 minutes. Warm-up during the race is prohibited, but free warm-up suits are available at the race center. Participants must follow traffic laws, as most of the course is not closed to cars. Finishers of the series are eligible for the Kullapada prize program, which rewards everyone who completes all season stages. The event includes various terrains and offers registration options as well as multiple distance categories, including 1.3 km and up to 5 km courses.

name: Kohila pikamaajooksude sari 2026 IV etapp 400m
location: Kohila Spordikeskuse staadion, Kohila, Rapla County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stardimaks 8 eurot, kuni 19a ja pensionärid 5 eurot

description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series 2026, Stage IV, 400m, takes place at the Kohila Sports Center stadium and is open to all running enthusiasts. The series features different distances and age groups, where participants earn points based on their placement in each race. The starting fee is 8 euros, 5 euros for youth and pensioners, payable in cash on site. Pre-registration is recommended and closes at 4:30 PM on the day of the event; late registrants will be placed in the back heats. The winners of the series will be determined by age groups, and awards will be presented at the end of the series.
course_highlights: 400m long running track at the stadium
Races take place on the tarmac track of the Kohila Sports Center
The series includes various age groups and distances from 400m to 5000m
additional: Pre-registration ends at 4:30 PM on the day of the event; late registrants will be placed in the back heats. On-site registration closes at 6:30 PM. Races start with the faster heats. In each race, the top 10 receive points; the series standings are based on the best 6 races. Awards are given after the last race. To qualify for a prize, participants must take part in at least four stages. The starting fee is paid in cash on site; pre-registration is available on the website; the competitions are held at the Kohila stadium; there are age categories and a points system.

name: 5. ETAPP - Merimets
location: Pelguranna and Stroomi beach parking lots, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Stage 5 - Merimetsa is part of the 24th Health Run and Walk series, which takes place in the parking lots of Pelguranna and Stroomi beach. This 3.6 km long stage offers participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful nature and health trails in a seaside area. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers who want to spend active time and improve their health. The series stages take place in different parts of Tallinn, offering diverse landscapes and views.
course_highlights: 3.6 km long route in the Merimetsa area
Proximity to Pelguranna and Stroomi beach parking lots
Seaside and scenic landscape
additional: The event is part of a broader health journey that includes various running and walking events and is aimed at health-conscious participants across Estonia.

name: Kohila Pikamaajooksusari
description: The Kohila Long-Distance Running Series is a sports series in Kohila Parish consisting of several stages and aimed at local sports enthusiasts. The goal of the series is to promote sports and physical activity and to offer participants the opportunity to compete in various distances. At each stage, participants receive a beautiful commemorative medal, and overall points are tallied across the series in different competition categories. The series is organized by Kohila Sports Center, which supports a healthy lifestyle and active movement.
course_highlights: Multi-stage long-distance running series in Kohila Parish
Point scoring and commemorative medal for each stage finisher
Suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The series includes several stages at different distances, such as 800m, 2000m, 5000m. All participants receive a commemorative medal at each stage. It is recommended to undergo health tests before competitions. The events mainly take place in the evening, for example at 19:00. The series also features 800-meter runs, and participants can accumulate points throughout the season. The event is open to all age groups and offers a sports opportunity in a community-supportive environment.

name: Filter Temposari
description: Filter Temposari is Estonia's oldest and most prestigious tempo series, offering participants the chance to challenge themselves in cycling, running, or roller skating. The series consists of six events around Tallinn, featuring time-trial races where participants can accurately measure their form. A unique aspect of the series is the paired start at the Kiili stage and the prize program Kullapada, which recognizes consistent participation. The races are usually held on Wednesday evenings, with fast and short courses suitable for sprint enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Time-trial cycling, paired start allowed at the Kiili stage
Fast short sprints in running (3-6 km) and roller skating
Course on roads around Tallinn, partially open to traffic, safety is important
additional: The Hot Group: the last 10 minutes of the stage are reserved for the best cyclists. Warming up on the track during the race is prohibited; warm-up pants are available free of charge at the race center. Traffic is regulated on the race routes, but most of the course is not closed to cars; participants must follow traffic laws and stay on the right side of the roadway. The Kullapada prize program rewards consistent participation in all stages. Several stages and participant categories, prizes and medals, detailed schedule, and registration are available on the website. The event takes place on Wednesday evenings and includes various distance options.

name: KEVEK ja Tartu Kalev staadionijooksu sari
description: The KEVEK and Tartu Kalev Stadium Run series is an athletics stadium running series organized by Tartu Sports Club Kalev, offering participation opportunities at multiple stages at Tartu and Ülenurme stadiums. The aim of the series is to provide competition opportunities for children and youth and to promote athletics in the city and county of Tartu. The competitions take place during the summer months and are open to different age groups. Registration closes at 12:00 on the day of the competition, allowing flexible participation.
course_highlights: Competitions are held at Tartu Tamme and Ülenurme stadiums
The series includes several stages during the summer, including stages on June 6 and July 8
Suitable for children and youth to engage in athletics
additional: Stages 6 and 7 will be held at Ülenurme stadium due to track surface renovation. Registration closes at 12:00 on the competition day. Madsa Sports and Recreation Center is a supporter and offers sports facilities in Valgamaa, 11 km from Otepää. The competitions will take place on June 17, 2026, at Tartu Kalev Stadium, registration is open, and participants can obtain results and compete in various distances.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
location: Võru Staadion, Võru, Võru County, Estonia
description: The Võru Athletics Evening Series is a traditional athletics event series that combines stadium races, throws, and jumps competitions. Each evening consists of one throwing and one jumping discipline, as well as running distances, providing a diverse athletics experience. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and use the IAAF points table for ranking. The series includes five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants are required to register separately for each stage, and the bib number is valid throughout the season.
course_highlights: Various athletics disciplines held at Võru Stadium
Each evening includes throwing, jumping, and running competitions
The series uses the IAAF points table for ranking
additional: Registration opens on May 28. Separate registration is required for each stage. The bib number is valid throughout the season and is recommended to be left with the organizer at the end of each stage. Registration for throwing and jumping disciplines usually closes around 16:30-16:45, and for running events around 18:30-18:45. The competition schedule includes exact registration and start times. The last stage of the series is on August 3. Awards are given at the end of the season. Multiple stages include races, throws, and jumps, with registration according to each stage. The event is part of the Võru sports calendar and invites all sports enthusiasts to participate.

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa open Estonian Orienteering Sprint Championship is an orienteering competition held in the Valga region. The event is part of the RMK Estonian Orienteering Day events, which are community events without age restrictions. The courses are designed so that they can be completed by participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose a pace that suits them. Timing is used during the event, and it is possible to rent an SI-pulse to assist with orienteering. The event is intended for everyone who wants to enjoy moving in nature and orienteering in good company.
course_highlights: Orienteering sprint in the Valga region
Courses suitable for participants of different skill levels
Option to rent an SI-pulse and use a compass
additional: The competition is part of the RMK Estonian Orienteering Day events, which are community events without age restrictions. Participants are advised to come in sportswear and bring a compass and SI-pulse, which can be rented if needed. Timing is used, but competing is not mandatory, emphasizing enjoyment of moving in nature and choosing a suitable pace. Participants have the opportunity to take part in different distances and enjoy Estonian nature and sports. The competitions are open to various age groups and offer diverse sporting experiences.

name: Narva Linna Jooks
description: Narva City Run is the largest sports event in Ida-Virumaa, encouraging people to engage in physical activity and showcasing the region in the field of Estonian culture and sports. The beautiful route through the historic border town attracts participants from Narva, other parts of Virumaa, across Estonia, and abroad. The event takes place near the Joaoru beach house and recreation area and offers a diverse and engaging running experience.
course_highlights: Beautiful route in the border town of Narva
Organized as the largest sports event in Ida-Virumaa
Participants from local areas and abroad
additional: The event takes place on June 5, 2026, starting at 17:30 near the Joaoru beach house and recreation area at Linnuse tn 2, 20308 Narva. The participation fee is 25 euros and includes various distances and a children's run. The route passes through beautiful sites in Narva, and the event is part of the Ida-Virumaa sports events series.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
location: Jaanikese Moto- ja Vabaajakeskus, Jaanikese, Tartu County, Estonia
description: Jaanikese Running Race is the second stage of the running series held at Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center. The course features diverse terrain suitable for both amateurs and experienced runners. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful nature and is part of the active running and cycling trail at the center.
course_highlights: Diverse running track on the territory of Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center
Additional trail for hiking, cycling, and running
Beautiful natural views and varied terrain
additional: The running race is part of the running and cycling trail at Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center, which also includes a hiking trail and disc golf options. The center has a history room and a café open on training days. The event is organized by Valga Sports and is part of a larger sports event where participants can also enjoy activities such as motocross and disc golf.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: Narva City Run is the largest mass participation event in Ida-Virumaa, taking place on June 5th and 6th at Joaorg in Narva. The event spans two days, with a mile run around the Town Hall Square on Friday and main races, including 5 km and 21.1 km distances, on Saturday. This year's course is flatter, allowing for better times, and the race is also part of the Estonian national championships in road mile running. The Narva City Run attracts thousands of amateur and elite athletes, offering a great mass participation experience.
course_highlights: Flat course allows for better times
Mile run around Town Hall Square on Friday
Main races of 5 km and 21.1 km on Saturday
additional: The race center is located at Town Hall Square. The mile run takes place around Town Hall Square on Friday, with the start and finish at the square's edge. The Narva City Run is also part of the Estonian national championships in road mile running. The two-day program features a well-planned course with sights to see, with over 3000 participants. Participation fees were not specified.

name: Ida-Virumaa staadioniultra
location: Kohtla-Nõmme Kooli staadion, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Virumaa, Estonia
description: The 5th Kohtla-Nõmme Stadium Ultra, also known as the 6th Ida-Viru County Stadium Ultra, is an ultramarathon held at the Kohtla-Nõmme School stadium. The race starts on June 6th at 12:00 PM and lasts until noon on June 7th, offering participants the opportunity to test their endurance and running ability over an extended period. Organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud, the event invites all running enthusiasts to participate and enjoy a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Race takes place at the Kohtla-Nõmme School stadium
The competition lasts 24 hours, from noon on June 6th to noon on June 7th
A well-known ultrarunning event in the Ida-Viru region
additional: The race begins on June 6th at 12:00 PM and continues until noon on June 7th (24 hours). Organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud. The event is held at the Kohtla-Nõmme School stadium located at Kooli tn 6, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Viru County. The stadium features ultramarathon, 308-meter laps, 12-hour results, and is part of the Estonian championships.

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa border run is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village hall and is approximately 5.9 km long. Additionally, there are shorter mini distances and children's runs suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to provide a sporty and friendly competition experience in the beautiful nature of Võrumaa.
course_highlights: The main distance runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village hall
Mini distances and children's runs are suitable for beginners and children
The track is mostly asphalted, ideal for fast running
additional: The track is entirely on asphalt. Children's runs take place in the Central Park and around EWERS in Väimela. The race is part of the 12-stage Võrumaa running and walking series, which features different distances and walking options. Participation fees and registration information, transportation arrangements, and the route partly passes through areas inaccessible to the general public at other times.

name: Padise liigub
location: Lääne-Harju Kultuurikeskus Padise rahvamaja, Padise, Lääne-Harju, Estonia
description: Padise Run is part of the Lääne-Harju Movement Series, which takes place at the Lääne-Harju Cultural Center in Padise. The course runs through the beautiful landscape of Padise, offering excitement and visual delight for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family, with a main distance of 5 km and children's races. It is a great opportunity to enjoy physical activity in a historic and scenic environment.
course_highlights: The course runs through the beautiful landscape of Padise
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
In addition to the 5 km main distance, there are children's races
additional: The competition center opens at 10:00, number pickup and registration take place before the start. Children's races begin at 11:00, warm-up exercises at 11:45, the main race starts at 12:00. Awards ceremony at 12:50 and the finish line closes at 13:15. The route is scenic and suitable for all levels; registration is on the day of the event from 10:00; the event also includes children's races and the 5 km main distance.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The II Jaanikese Running Cross will take place on June 6, 2026, at the Jaanikese Moto and Leisure Center and is part of the Valgamaa Running and Walking Series named after Rein Leppik. The event features several distances, including children's runs, a 2.7 km run and walk, and a main run of 5.4 km. The courses run along the cross-country trail, and participants will have the opportunity to enjoy a sporting event across different age groups. The organizer is the Valgamaa Sports Union, which invites all running enthusiasts to participate and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Runs take place on the Jaanikese cross-country trail
Multiple distances from children's runs to the 5.4 km main run
The competition is held on a cross-country trail with varied terrain
additional: Pre-registration is available online at www.timesport.ee, with additional registration at the start area from 10:30 AM. Electronic timing is available for participants from the age groups born in 2019-2020. Awards will be given to all age groups, with prizes for the top three in the overall 5.4 km main run. Participation in children's runs is free. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, and is open to all running enthusiasts, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature and engage in health sports.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team-based experience run taking place in the beautiful nature of Saaremaa. The run starts at sunrise from Kuressaare and ends at sunset on Illiku Island in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. All collectives, groups of friends, and sports clubs are welcome to participate, forming a team and sharing the distance among themselves. The goal of the run is not to win, but to run comfortably and enjoyably with friends. Each participant receives a GPS bracelet that acts as a relay baton, and there are water stations and refreshments along the route.
course_highlights: 180 km long route from Kuressaare to Orissaare
15 stages where the GPS bracelet acts as a relay baton
Beautiful running paths and coastal scenery in Saaremaa
additional: The run starts on June 6 at 4:30 AM from Kuressaare Wow Center. Each team receives a GPS bracelet, which must be handed over to the next runner at freely chosen points. There are water stations, occasional hot soup, tea and bread, and the possibility to wash at the finish. The finish line is on Illiku Island, where a summer starting celebration takes place. Changing runners on the route is prohibited. Support vehicles must follow Estonian traffic rules. The route includes Saaremaa landscapes and coastlines; registration requires the use of a GPS device and running kit; the event takes place on June 6, 2026, starting from Kuressaare at 4:30 AM.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the 2026 West-Viru County running and walking series is the traditional Simuna-Laekvere run, which has secured a firm place in runners' calendars and hearts. The run is unique in that the direction of the race changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and invites all running enthusiasts to participate.
course_highlights: Traditional Simuna-Laekvere run
Race direction changes every year
Location at Simuna School
additional: The competition takes place at Simuna School and is part of several running events in West-Viru County, offering various distance options and age categories. Registration is conducted online, and all participants have the opportunity to receive awards.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
location: Peetri, Rae Parish, Harju County, Estonia
description: E-LUX Peetri Jooks is one of Estonia's most lively mass participation events, bringing together running enthusiasts of all ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, where timing and awards for the best are provided, but there is also a charity run, youth run, and children's runs. The event takes place in Peetri and also features a large expo and marketplace area with various vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Children's Fund of Tartu University Hospital and helps children with movement disabilities. All finishers receive an awesome summer medal.
course_highlights: 10 km main run with timing and awards
5 km charity run and walk with timing and awards
Children's runs of 300 m and 1 km, no timing
additional: Virtual run allows participants to choose the distance, time, and location themselves, and medals and gift pack products are sent to virtual runners via parcel locker. No timing or rankings are kept for children's runs; everyone is a winner. The event also features a large expo and marketplace area with crafts, farm products, sweets, sports equipment, and a children's zone. Volunteers are offered hot meals and snacks. The event includes an exhibition and community gathering, medals for finishers, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere Community Run is a traditional amateur running race held alternately between Simuna and Laekvere every other year. The course runs along paved roads, featuring undulating sections and some inclines, providing participants with a varied running experience. The race is friendly and well-organized, suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs, and offers a sauna and hot soup after the run. The number of participants is usually around 100, ensuring a pleasant and relaxed atmosphere. Awards are given in age categories, and the top ten finishers receive a running shirt.
course_highlights: Course along paved roads
Undulating profile and some larger inclines
Varied running experience in a low-traffic area

The event involves completing a marathon distance (42.195 km) by 6-person teams, with each athlete running a designated segment. The race route is asphalt and runs along a loop of 5.4 km, except for the first segment. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Additionally, there is Ekiden Junior for the youngest runners as part of the event.
course_highlights: Asphalt route around Malta regatta course
Distance divided into 6 segments: 9.795 km, 10.8 km, 4x 5.4 km
Start at Hotel HP Park Poznań, finish near the stands and transition zone
additional: The team time limit is 4 hours and 30 minutes. Dedicated transition zone. The race includes a charity program, where 42.91 PLN from each start fee is donated to a selected local public benefit organization. For children, Ekiden Junior is organized over a distance of 120 meters for age groups 2015 - 2024. The event ambassador is Dominika Stelmach, who also leads a special women's team with sporting requirements. The event features team competition, Ekiden Junior races for children, charitable support, attractions, and an exciting atmosphere of sporting rivalry.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Half Marathon along the Baltic Shore is a flat street race held in the picturesque seaside scenery of Kołobrzeg. The route runs along a granite-paved promenade, bike path, and asphalt surface, with five refreshment points along the way. The start and finish are located at the Seaside Park Hotel, and the race is part of the Kołobrzeg Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and community engagement among runners. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is measured electronically using disposable chips.
course_highlights: Flat route along the promenade, bike path, and asphalt
Route marked every kilometer with vertical signs
Five refreshment points along the course
additional: Race office open on 16.05.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 17.05.2026 from 8:00 to 10:50 near the start and finish. Electronic timing with disposable chips. Participants must wear a visible start number with a chip. Pedestrian and cyclist traffic may occur on the route; runners must obey traffic regulations. Categories include open women and men, as well as residents of Kołobrzeg County. The route runs along the promenade with pedestrian and cyclist traffic, a time limit of 3 hours, children's races planned, and options to participate in other distances (5 km, 10 km, marathon).

name: Kresowe Trail #5
location: Prostki, Ełk County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kresowe Trail #5 in Prostki is a running challenge offering two routes: the shorter Szpurt (approximately 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approximately 17 km). The courses lead through picturesque landscapes, featuring technical elements such as ascents, sand, and roots, as well as historic sites of Gmina Prostki, including the Border Post from 1545 and an old wooden Evangelical church from 1667. The start and finish are located at the forest stadium in Prostki, providing comfort for spectators. The competition is part of the year-round Kresowe Trail series with overall and team classifications, and the possibility to participate in the DUAL competition combining running and cycling.
course_highlights: Courses approximately 7 km (Szpurt) and 17 km (Wertep) with technical ascents, sand, and roots
Passing through scenic areas and historic monuments of Gmina Prostki, including the Border Post from 1545 and a wooden church from 1667
Start and finish at the forest stadium in Prostki near the city beach by the Ełk River and Toczyłowo Lake
additional: Participation in the overall classification after completing 6 runs, the FINISHER title for 11 runs, and the SUPER FINISHER for 12 runs. Team competition separately for the Szpurt and Wertep distances. Opportunity to compete in the DUAL event combining the Szpurt run and the cycling Half Marathon. The route mostly follows a permanent MTB trail marked since 2017, with varied sports and scenic sections. The event includes trail runs and other sports activities, with online registration available. Details about routes and registration will be provided on the organizer's website.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy is the second edition of an outdoor race taking place on May 17, 2026, in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic Walking walk. The route runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering contact with nature and active outdoor recreation. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and integrate the local community.
course_highlights: The race and walk routes run through fields and forests between Modrze and Drożdżyce
Available distances: 5 km run, 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic Walking
The route and format of the event remain the same as in 2025
additional: No information about registration fees. The event has a promotional and integrative character, takes place in open outdoor areas, with no specified participant or wave limits. The event occurs on natural terrain routes, and participants can expect friendly athletic competition. Starts are scheduled from 8:30 to 9:45, and registrations can be made through the official event website.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
location: Nadleśnictwo Herby i Kłobuck, okolice Blachowni, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Half Marathon... Do you feel like it? This is a cross-country race over a distance of 21 km, as well as an additional race of 32 km, taking place on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run or walk with Nordic walking poles. The event also features races for children and youth. This is the fifth edition of the competition, which combines sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts
Participation options in Nordic walking and races of 21 km and 32 km
Additional races for children and youth
additional: Start schedule: 8:00 am opening of the race office; 9:00 am start of Nordic walking and the 32 km race; 10:00 am start of the 21 km runners; 10:10 am start of races for children and youth; route closes at 1:00 pm. Cross-country terrain, online registration, accompanying races for children and youth, 32 km race, Nordic walking.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy - Run Toruń Plaza, which will take place on May 17, 2026, is a race on two distances: 5 km and 10 km. It is a great opportunity to test your form in the spring edition of the series and feel the unique atmosphere of Toruń running. The organizers ensure professional organization of the event on a nationwide scale, while maintaining a friendly and family atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.
course_highlights: Races on 5 km and 10 km distances
The atmosphere of Toruń running
Spring edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy
additional: The race is organized by the Association "Run To Run", which promotes a healthy lifestyle and sports. The event has a nationwide character but maintains a friendly and family atmosphere. Participants can expect a unique medal and the opportunity to take part in a satisfaction survey after the race. 5 km and 10 km races, spring edition, Toruń Legends Trilogy series.

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race organized in Sierakowice, part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubuś Puchatek Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering both the main 15 km race and numerous children's and youth races. The competition features electronic timing, rich event organization, and prizes for the best competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police security, as well as amenities such as deposit, showers, and a café.
course_highlights: Main race route of 15 km
Start and finish at the sports stadium in Sierakowice
Electronic timing and classification in 14 categories
additional: The race office is open from 10:00 at the Orlik near the Primary School, where race numbers and chips are issued. Free showers, deposit, café, and toilets are available. Children's and youth races start at 11:30, with a preschooler 100 m race at 12:40 (free of charge). A recreational walk-run of 1200 m begins at 13:05 for those not participating in the main races. Prize draws for children's and main race participants. Official parking is available at 7 Kubuś Puchatek Street. Medical and police security are provided. The event also includes preparatory training sessions, and online registration will start in December 2025. The race takes place at the sports stadium in Sierakowice, ul. Kubuś Puchatek 7.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Rector Stanisław Komornicza Run is a street race covering a distance of 10 km, taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of various skill levels, offering preparation opportunities through dedicated training plans. The race is street-based and held in the picturesque city of Tarnów, providing participants with an attractive route and sporting excitement.
course_highlights: Street route of 10 km
Picturesque areas of Tarnów
Suitable for runners of different skill levels
additional: Training plans available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level with instructions and expert support. No detailed information about registration fees, and registration has not been described in detail.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The XII Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kucharach Królewskich. The competition includes various distances suitable for different age groups, including races for preschoolers, school children, the main 10 km run, a 3 km accompanying run, and a 6 km Nordic Walking march. The start and finish are located at the forester's lodge, and participants can enjoy festive decorations and a prize draw after the event. The participant limit is 300 people, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main run of 10 km
Accompanying run of 3 km
Nordic Walking march of 6 km
additional: Participant limit is 300 people. Registration and chip distribution take place from 9:30 to 10:15. After the races, around 1:00 PM, a ceremonial closing with decorations and a prize draw will be held on the main stage. Registration opens on March 19, 2026. The event includes various age categories and levels of difficulty.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
location: Jabłonna, Legionowo County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-format race that originated in the USA. Participants start every hour and must complete a loop of 6.706 km. After finishing the loop, they have rest time until the next full hour, and the competition continues until only one participant remains who completes the last loop within the time limit. It is an endurance race where not only speed but also strategy and perseverance matter.
course_highlights: Loop of 6.706 km (4.167 miles)
Start every full hour
Unique format - race lasts until a single winner is determined
additional: No podium - only a throne for the winner. Adult event. The time limit to complete each loop is 1 hour. Regulations and map available for download on the website. The event features the Backyard Ultra format, with participant limits and online registration. The series also includes winter editions and special editions with prizes such as the Silver Ticket to the World Championships.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
location: Cytadela, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free timed runs organized in Poznań on distances of 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in the picturesque surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique nocturnal racing atmosphere. The event attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels, promoting physical activity and local community integration.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Citadel area in Poznań
Distances of 5 km and 10 km with timing measurement
Nighttime race atmosphere
additional: The races are free of charge, organized regularly, with timing measurement. The event is supported by Kiprun Poznań Runners. The event is free, takes place at night, attracts participants from different age groups and skill levels, promoting physical activity and community integration.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5 MILE Run is a race over a distance of 5 nautical miles (9260 meters), organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ships Squadron and the Navy Officers' Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Center. The route consists of two loops of 4630 meters each and runs along the quay, with the start and finish located in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship. The race is open to active professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian competitors after prior verification. The event is held in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and the sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Distance of 5 nautical miles (9260 m) - two loops of 4630 m
Start and finish in front of the ORP "Gen. K. Pułaski" ship
Seaside route in Gdynia, without PZLA certification
additional: Payments are processed via Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreigners can participate after prior arrangement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500 people, online registration, recovery meal, no PZLA certification.

location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - spring edition 2026 is a cross-country run organized in the picturesque Marszewo Botanical Forest Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value contact with nature and the aesthetic environment. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time outdoors amidst greenery and a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Marszewo Botanical Forest Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and aesthetic qualities
Spring run as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Organizers are a group of running enthusiasts emphasizing cross-country races and the aesthetics of the location. The event is part of a series of races held in various Polish cities during the spring season. It is aimed at runners of different skill levels, with the option to participate in the 5 km run. The race promotes outdoor activity and popularizes running within the local community.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in street running over a distance of 5 km, held in Żurawica. The event is under the Honorary Patronage of the Provincial Police Commander in Rzeszów. Over 400 participants take part in the competition, and the route runs through the roads of Żurawica. The organizer is the Provincial Board of the NSZZ Policemen of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: Street run over a distance of 5 km
The route runs through the roads of Żurawica
Event under the Honorary Patronage of the Provincial Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: Over 400 participants compete in the event. The organizer is the Provincial Board of the NSZZ Policemen of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The run takes place on May 23, 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Piotrkowska Street Run Rossmann Run is one of the most important running events in Poland, taking place in the city center of Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Established in 2003, the race attracts both amateurs and top athletes from the country. The course runs through the representative avenue of the city, and the event features a rich program of attractions, including a food zone and a free recovery meal. There is a Mini Run for children and people with disabilities on shorter distances.
course_highlights: The race course runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish at al. Scheiblerów, close to al. Poznańskich
Evening start at 19:00 with start zones divided according to declared times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Station. Deposits and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at Well Fitness club upon presentation of the start number. Participants have free travel on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal - soup. Each participant can use a one-hour access to the swimming and sauna zone at Aquapark Fala from May 20 to 25, 2026. It is forbidden for accompanying persons to move on the route by bicycles, scooters, and other vehicles. Traffic disruptions and public transport delays are expected during the race, which starts at 19:00, with disruptions from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
price_range: 180.00 PLN (standard), 90.00 PLN (zniżki dla mieszkańców powiatu Hajnowskiego i seniorów)

The half marathon route runs through charming areas of the Hajnówka Municipal Park, offering participants contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Hajnówka, which ensures the comfort and safety of runners. The race office is open the day before the race and on the race day, and participants can count on race packets and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: Route runs through Hajnówka Municipal Park
Picturesque areas of Białowieża and surroundings
Contact with nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on May 22 from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Amphitheater of the Hajnówka Municipal Park and on May 23 from 8:00 to 9:30. A valid ID is required to collect the race packet. It is not possible to run under another participant's name. No registrations on race day. Participants have access to a free coffee buffet. The route is asphalt, starting in Białowieża, finishing in Hajnówka, race office at the amphitheater, massages and showers available after the race.

description: The Lion Run is an annual half marathon held in Tarnów Podgórny, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for excellent organization, an attractive route, and enthusiastic spectator support. As part of the festival, there are also races for children and various accompanying events such as cheering contests and concerts. The Lion Run is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in a beautiful setting.

Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race route
Numerous nutrition points along the route

Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, Stadium track competitions. Large races for children during the festival. Registrations until May 10, start and recovery packages, cheerleading contest, previous edition's race sold out.

description: Poznaniak Run for Preschoolers is a family running event held on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Greater Poland National Park and at the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden

This unique event brings together runners of all skill levels, where teams of six members collectively cover the marathon distance in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes team spirit and cooperation, offering various relay change distances that facilitate participation for beginner runners. It is an excellent opportunity for sports competition and integration among friends, families, or colleagues.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Main Campus of the University of Physical Education in Białołęka
The route consists of two loops
Fast and friendly course for teams of six members

Volunteers support the organization and atmosphere of the race, and volunteer recruitment is open. The event promotes cooperation, integration, and team spirit, with various distances and categories for different age groups, including races for children and youth.

Night street races with start and finish at the Nowe Miasto Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km

Both races start and finish at the Nowe Miasto Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, start packages, festive atmosphere

The event offers a variety of distances for adults and children, promoting active spending time with family and friends. Nordic walking 5 km for adults
Children's races from 100 to 800 meters
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester's lodge near Nowy Tomyśl. Children's races start at 9:00 AM, main race and Nordic walking for adults at 11:00 AM. The main race is the Horse Ten, a 10 km course that runs through fields, dirt roads, and forest paths, offering participants contact with nature and sporting competition. The event aims to promote running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, as well as to integrate the local community. In addition to the main race, races for children are also organized, making the event attractive for entire families.

Team classification considering the gender of competitors
additional: Limit of 150 participants in the main race. Age categories from 16 years and above, divided into age groups and open classification. Each participant receives a commemorative medal, and winners receive cups and cash prizes in the open category. name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: The XV Wichrowskie Forest Run is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District Office, attracting enthusiasts of outdoor physical activity. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District Office, and participants have the opportunity to join a trail familiarization training session.
course_highlights: The race course runs through the Wichrowo Forest District
Scenic forest trails of 10 km
Categories for children, youth, individuals with disabilities, and Nordic walking
additional: A trail familiarization training session takes place on June 6 at 10:00 AM. The children's and youth races start from approximately 10:10 to 11:00 AM. The Nordic walking march starts at 9:00 AM from Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto, with a distance of about 10 km. The main 10 km race starts and finishes at the Wichrowo Forest District Office. The main distance is 10 km, with races for children and youth, Nordic walking, a pre-race training, online registration until May 21, 2026, and a time limit of 2 hours for Nordic walking.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon "Through Hell to Heaven" is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding course, which passes through areas called Hell and Heaven, emphasizing its character and challenge. Organizers provide professional support and assistance for participants.

Picturesque landscapes around Końskie
Challenging cross terrain
additional: The organizer's office is open on Mondays from 13:00 to 17:00, Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 11:00. Contact by phone: +48 514 030 401. The race starts at 9:00 AM, with an earlier start for participants planning to finish in over 6 hours. After the race, participants will receive medals, trophies, and refreshments.

Refreshment points every 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km, 6 km, and 7.5 km with water in paper cups
Youth and children's races at the athletics stadium - tartan track, distances from 50 to 600 meters

The youth and children's races start at 11:00 AM at the athletics stadium, with distances adjusted to participants' ages. Award ceremony will take place at the amphitheater at 5:30 PM. It is forbidden to move on the route on bicycles, roller skates, skateboards, and other devices without the organizer's permission. Distances are 10 km and 5 km, with a time limit of 1:30 for 10 km and 1:00 for 5 km, start packages can be picked up on the day of the event, route security, a limit of 500 participants, electronic registration from December 6, 2025, to May 15, 2026.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Queen Dąbrówka Princess Crown Run is a jubilee, fifteenth edition of the running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main race over a distance of 10 km runs through forest paths surrounded by greenery, providing pleasant conditions for running on a soft surface. Nordic walking enthusiasts can participate in a 7.5 km route, and younger participants can compete on shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1000 meters. The start and finish are located on the edge of the Palędzko-Zakrzewski forest near Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-oriented and integrative, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.
course_highlights: Main race 10 km through forest paths surrounded by greenery
Nordic walking over 7.5 km
Children's races from 200 to 1000 meters
additional: Children's races start at 10:15 AM, the main race at 12:00 PM, and the Nordic walking march at 12:02 PM. The race office and packet pickup are available in the days prior to the race at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall and on the race day on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Individual and team classifications, including classifications for people with disabilities and residents of the Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer estates. Teams must be mixed (women/men). Distances: 10 km, 7.5 km, children's races; start location on the edge of the Palędzko-Zakrzewski forest near Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka; date: May 31, 2026; registrations are already open.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a unique running event scheduled for May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half marathon course consists of two loops around the picturesque Swarzędzkie Lake, while the 10 km race offers a dynamic profile with forest accents and city streets. The event combines sport, education, and charity activities, with participants enjoying a rich gastro zone, partner expo, recovery meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including participants in active wheelchairs and seniors over 70 years old, who can start free of charge.
course_highlights: Half marathon course: two loops around Swarzędzkie Lake
10 km course: dynamic profile with forest accents and streets of Swarzędz
Event includes three races and offers a rich gastro zone and expo
additional: Participants aged 70+ have a free start package for the 10 km and half marathon. Limited edition commemorative T-shirts available for runners and families. Debut of active wheelchair athletes in the 10 km race. After the race, recovery meal, stretching, and massages at the finish line, as well as a charity auction. The area includes the surroundings of Swarzędzkie Lake, with discounts for families and veterans, and new accessibility amenities.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest run held in the picturesque Mazovian forests, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sports and recreational event combines competition with a love for nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Routes of varying difficulty are available for runners at different levels of advancement, as well as for families and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The atmosphere of the run is full of positive energy and respect for nature, as confirmed by participants of previous editions.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the heart of Mazovian forests of varying difficulty
Scenic forest trails around the Ostrołęka Forest District
Distances from a family-friendly 2 km to a challenging run of about 20 km
additional: Race office open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times for individual distances: 08:00 Forest Deer Marathon (42 km), 09:00 King of the Forest (about 20 km), 10:00 Winds Run (5 km) and Wolf Route (10 km), 10:05 Jackal Nordic Walking (5 km), 10:15 Green Adventure (family run/walk 2 km). The registration fee includes a start number, a returnable chip, a commemorative gadget, a medal, a recovery meal, and a sweet treat. For distances of 5 km, 10 km, 20 km, and Nordic Walking, an Open classification for Women and Men is conducted with trophies for the best. Participants have access to training plans and support, and the event includes various race categories, including marathon, 20 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a family run. Registration is open until May 25, 2026.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: The Mazovian Fifteen is a jubilee, 30th edition of the national street race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a perfect opportunity for a sporting celebration in a picturesque city. The race is street-based and attracts runners from all over Poland, offering an attractive route and professional organization.
course_highlights: Street route in Mińsk Mazowiecki
Jubilee, 30th edition of the race
Organizer: MOSiR Mińsk Mazowiecki
additional: street race, date May 31, 2026, Mińsk Mazowiecki, PZLA certification, registration closed

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The Mokotowski SGH Run is the largest charity run organized by students in Poland, combining sport with helping those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants — students, alumni, residents, and running enthusiasts. The race route runs through the streets of Mokotów with the finish line in the SGH Rector's Gardens, and every step has a real impact on the lives of those in need thanks to the support of the 'Akogo?' Foundation. It is not only a sporting event but also a community, solidarity, and the energy of student engagement.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km and 10 km through the streets of Mokotów
Finish line in the SGH Rector's Gardens
Run for children and entire families
additional: The event includes a meeting and attractions zone for partners, a joint warm-up before the start, and medal awards after the race. The run has a charitable character, with proceeds going to the 'Akogo?' Foundation supporting people in a coma. The event promotes community integration among students and residents of Warsaw, encouraging a healthy lifestyle and helping others.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual event that takes you on a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app, logging various physical activities that are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge offers the flexibility to choose your own pace and duration, as well as individual or team participation. Additionally, for every progress made in the challenge, organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.
course_highlights: 198 km (123 miles) route through Rio de Janeiro
8 virtual postcards to unlock during the challenge
Integration with popular fitness apps and smartwatches
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate each other. The challenge allows logging of any distance-based activities, including yoga or weightlifting. Participants can choose their own start date and challenge duration. Access to a mobile app on iOS and Android for tracking progress. Participants can complete the challenge at any time; medals and apparel are available, and participation supports ecological initiatives.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultra running festival taking place in Pabianice from May 29 to May 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish championships in their categories. The races attract long-distance runners, offering challenging routes and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the Sports Club "O Co Biega" from Pabianice.
course_highlights: Routes of UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h
UltraPark 100 km route
Event held in Pabianice
additional: The event includes various ultramarathon distances, with opening and closing ceremonies during the 48-hour race; registration details are not yet available
