description: The 5th Kolei Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.1 km long taking place on May 31, 2026, in Lemany near Szczytno. The route runs along a bike path on an old railway line and municipal roads, offering scenic views and well-equipped hydration and nutrition points. The event is organized by the District Sports, Tourism, and Recreation Center in Szczytno and the Local Tourism Organization of Szczytno County. In addition to the half marathon, there are children's races and a 5 km run, making the event attractive for various age groups and skill levels.

Hydration points at 5.5 km, 10.5 km, and 16 km
Nutrition point at 10.5 km of the route

Cash prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in the Open categories for women and men, as well as in additional categories such as uniformed services and county. The race promotes physical activity; participants receive medals and T-shirts. Online registration is available. The event takes place along the old railway line route.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sports, and a healthy lifestyle. The run is charitable, and all proceeds are donated to support those in need. The course runs along a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children's run, 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic Walking. Organizers provide electronic timing and a warm meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: Loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
5 km and 10 km courses with a time limit of 1 hour and 30 minutes
Children's run approximately 500 meters on the recreational square
additional: The participant limit is 200 people across all distances. Timing is provided by Sports Timing Poland using electronic chips worn on the leg. Chips must be returned after the run or a fee of 50 PLN applies for loss. Participants must check in at the race office, open from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizer provides a warm meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea for participants. The event is a municipal charity run scheduled for May 31, 2026, supporting local initiatives.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. A. Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, promoting running and integrating the running community of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz City Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, marked every 500 meters. The event lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and promotional in nature, and participants receive electronic lap and time measurement.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in A. Mickiewicz City Park in Sieradz
100% gravel surface
Lap markings every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00, participants can pause and resume at any time but must stay within the designated transition zone during breaks. Each participant receives a returnable start number with a chip for electronic lap and time measurement. The participant limit is 250 people. Minors (ages 16-17) can participate with parental consent and can run up to 10 km (5 laps). The race involves running on a 2-kilometer park loop, with electronic timing, commemorative medals, awards for the best, and starter packs.

The start and finish are located at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans to hold a raffle for tangible prizes for participants, and the race office is open a few hours before the start.

The event also includes training sessions, prize draws, and is part of local sports attractions.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
location: Stadion 'Arena Mistrzów', Gniewino, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolem Run is an annual 10 km race organized at the 'Arena Mistrzów' Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and youth, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a recreational walk-run. Participants can enjoy electronic timing, medals for all participants, and prizes for the best. For those wishing to participate virtually, there is an option for a virtual run from May 27 to June 4, 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with certification
Nordic Walking march over 5 km
Children's and youth races over shorter distances

The preschool run of 80 meters is free, and every participant receives a medal. The recreational walk-run over 1200 meters requires no registration and is free of charge. Participants are classified into 15 age categories. On-site registration for the 5 km and 10 km races is possible. A free bouncy castle is available for the youngest participants, and there is coffee and cake from KGW Perlino on site. Participants can choose from various distances and age categories, and the event also features attractions and decorations at the stadium.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer street race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of the European community. The race course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowego Maja 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging movement and local community integration.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer street course in Kielce
Race promoting physical activity and European spirit
Organized as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026 in Świętokrzyskie
additional: Street race in Kielce, 5 km, event as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026.

The event attracts runners who want to challenge themselves with a 5-kilometer course in a picturesque setting. The run is recreational and sports-oriented and is an excellent opportunity for active recreation and local community integration. Organizers ensure a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.
course_highlights: 5 km course on Wydminy Island
Night run in a scenic, natural environment
Organized as part of the local community of Gmina Wydminy
additional: The event takes place in the evening, starting at 19:00 and ending by 23:00. Registration opens on April 20, 2026. Participants can expect the atmosphere of night running in the beautiful scenery of Wydminy.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: Poznańska Piwna Mila is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who appreciate scenic routes and a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from Greater Poland, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race features a division into start groups with participant limits, allowing for comfortable participation and good organization. Particular emphasis is placed on the aesthetic qualities of the route and the integration of runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes of Poznań
Division into start groups with limits up to 60 people
Routes with aesthetic and sporting characteristics
additional: Starts are staggered every 20 minutes from 12:00 PM to 3:40 PM, including two HARD waves and the '0 %' group. The participant limit in each group is 60 people. The schedule of group starts with participant limits, event on a summer evening, promotes activity and fun.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpiowski Pśejåk Half Marathon is a run along the route of the SGO "Narew" combat shelters in Nowogrod. The half marathon course takes runners through historic areas with numerous combat shelters, giving the race a unique character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who appreciate both terrain challenges and the atmosphere of Kurpiowszczyzna. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and learn about local history.
course_highlights: The course runs along the route of the SGO "Narew" combat shelters
The race takes place in the scenic terrain of Kurpiowszczyzna
Half marathon of 21.097 km combining sport with history
additional: The event features races of various distances, including a half marathon and shorter distances, with participation options for different age groups. The run promotes local history and nature, and participants can look forward to attractive routes and an atmosphere conducive to sporting competition.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race organized in Wieluń, part of the Running League - a platform promoting physical activity and running competition in Poland. The event is open to runners on various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The Running League allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, motivating regular running and sports development. The race is open and inclusive, encouraging participation from both amateurs and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance (42 km)
Scenic route in Wieluń
Annual traditional running event
additional: The Running League is a year-round running platform that automatically registers race results for distances of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon, converts them into points, and enables competition in many rankings. Participants can create private leagues and access materials related to training, diet, and sports psychology. No details are provided about the route, registration, or other notes regarding the specific race.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Night Kopernik Half Marathon is a unique street race held in the magical scenery of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from distances of 10 km, 5 km, as well as Nordic Walking, and a special race for children called "Discoverers of Power". The event takes place at night, adding a unique atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city center, and organizers provide full logistical support and attractive start packages.
course_highlights: Night race through the streets of Toruń - the city of Copernicus
Start of the 10 km race from Galeria Copernicus, finish at the Municipal Stadium
Available distances: 10 km, 5 km, Nordic Walking, and children's races
additional: The race office operates on June 6, 2026, from 15:00 to 21:00 at Galeria Copernicus near the Decathlon store. Item deposit is provided at the start, with transport to the finish line. The 10 km start is from Galeria Copernicus, while the 5 km and Nordic Walking start from the Józef Piłsudski Bridge (Camping Tramp). The finish is at the Municipal Stadium. The time limit for 10 km is 1 hour and 20 minutes, for 5 km 50 minutes, and for Nordic Walking 60 minutes. The routes are certified by PZLA, fast, flat, start at 22:00, various distances, children's race, medals and prizes, guided walk option.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Kazimierz Biskupi, Gniezno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Run under the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in the picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Puszcza Bieniszewska. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of local nature, leading participants through the avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, amateurs, and families, offering races on various distances as well as Nordic Walking marches. The organizers are the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Kazimierz Biskupi Municipality, and the tradition of the race dates back to the early 21st century.
course_highlights: The route runs through a scenic avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of the Puszcza Bieniszewska, offering contact with nature
Available race distances are 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking march
additional: Verification and distribution of start numbers take place the day before the race (June 6, 2026) from 17:00 to 20:00 and on the race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The main race over 10 km starts at 13:00, the accompanying race over 5 km and the 5 km Nordic Walking march start at 13:10. The time limit to complete the race is 14:40. The award ceremony and event conclusion will be at 14:45. Participant limits are 250 for the main race, 150 for the accompanying race, and 100 for Nordic Walking. The event was reactivated for the first time in 2007, with online registration available. Participants can expect attractive prizes and certificates.

description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland's capital city, combining swimming in Lake Zegrzyńskie, a 90 km bike ride to downtown Warsaw, and a half marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the opportunity to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is full of sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, with the finish line located in Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a unique character to the competition.

90 km cycling route leading to downtown Warsaw
21.1 km run ending in Multimedia Fountain Park

Start and finish are located in Multimedia Fountain Park. Opportunity to qualify for IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship 2026 in Nice. Available services for athletes include bike rental, bike transfer, bike build & pack, finisher photo, medal engraving, camper park, licenses, and accommodations. The event also features IRONKIDS, Night Run, and other triathlon activities; sponsored by Enea; options for relays and services such as bike rentals and transfers.

description: The 10th Festival of Northern Poland Running and Physical Activity in Wdzydze is a jubilee edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the picturesque areas of Kashubia. The event takes place from June 5 to June 7, 2026, with its base located at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival unites the running community of Northern Poland, popularizes a healthy lifestyle, and promotes local culture and nature. The program includes races of various distances, Nordic walking marches, and cycling rallies.

Picturesque Kashubian landscapes and forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Promotion of the 'Kashubian Sea' and surrounding natural attractions

The program also includes Nordic walking marches and cycling rallies. The event is a jubilee, integrating the running community of Northern Poland. It features various forms of physical activity, including running, marches, and cycling, promoting a healthy lifestyle in the Kashubia region.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon named after Barbara Karaczyńska is an intimate running event held in Opalenie, organized by the DASZRADE Foundation in cooperation with the "Zapowiednik" Addiction Treatment Center. The marathon route is entirely asphalt, passing through picturesque fields and forests of Kociewie, certified by the Polish Athletic Association, and features numerous fairly steep ascents with a total elevation gain of 646 meters. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and all finishers receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt.
course_highlights: Asphalt route through fields and forests of Kociewie
Total elevation gain of 646 m with numerous steep ascents
Route marked every 1 km and nutrition points every 5 km, including flying checkpoints
additional: Nutrition points every 5 km and flying checkpoints along the route. Post-race recovery meal. Participants receive a commemorative medal, diploma, and T-shirt. The "Olka" 10 km route partially overlaps with the half marathon, is paved, and runs through the forest. The route is asphalt with an elevation gain of 646 m, nutrition points every 5 km, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and the 10 km "OLKA" route.

name: Coconaut Pomerania Summer Trail
description: Pomerania Summer Trail is a running challenge held on hilly trails of Pomerania, offering three distances: 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km. The event takes place in the picturesque area of Czymanowo, right by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko viewing tower, creating a unique trail running atmosphere. Organizer, Pomerania Sports Association, together with local sports centers, invites both debutants and experienced ultra runners to participate in this unforgettable event. It is an excellent opportunity to face challenging routes and enjoy the beauty of Kashubian nature.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Kashubia
Distances of 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km
Start and finish at Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko viewing tower
additional: Online registration usually closes 7 days before the event, but registration on the day of the race is possible if there are still spots available. The organizer provides a super village at the concert square in Czymanowo, near Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko viewing tower. The event offers various distances, the possibility to download GPX files, and requires specific equipment. The race takes place in a beautiful area with access to tourist attractions of Kashubia and Pomerania.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha

The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages, and on race day, there are also races for children and a family festival. The race is open to all and promotes active leisure in the picturesque surroundings of the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: The race route runs through the recreational areas of Bilcza Park
Urban race over a distance of 10 km
Picturesque surroundings of the Morawica municipality
additional: On race day, a family festival and races for children are also organized. The event includes children's races, a family festival, and recreational attractions in Bilcza Park. Registrations can be made online, and the event promotes active leisure and integration of the local community.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Night Bydgoszcz Canal Marathon is the oldest continuously organized night marathon in Poland, taking place since 2007. The race is held in a unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Plantations and along the historic hydrotechnical monuments, such as 18th-century locks on the Bydgoszcz Canal — the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across the country and abroad, offering rich start packages, original medals and t-shirts, and professional timing services. The event is gaining prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: Night run in the scenery of Bydgoszcz Plantations
Route along historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
Unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: The classification is held over 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative t-shirts, and comprehensive start packages. Professional electronic timing and race bibs are provided. The event features live music, enhancing its appeal for runners and spectators. The event includes 6 distances, electronic timing, commemorative medals and t-shirts, as well as rich start packages. Participants can expect professional signage and artistic arrangements during the race.

Scenic Tuchola Forest terrain
Race held in Osieczna

The event takes place on June 13, 2026, continuing the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the opportunity to compete over a short distance. The race is an excellent opportunity for active recreation and community integration. Organizers provide easy contact through a registration form and administrative support.

Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the best and medals for all finishers

The route runs through the city streets, providing participants with the opportunity to compete at a professional level with recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can participate in accompanying races on shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event a unique, nocturnal character. Organizers ensure participant comfort by offering refreshments after the race and decorations for the winners.

Night race starting at 21:55
City route running through Szamotuły streets
additional: On race day, a temporary traffic organization is in place with parking difficulties and designated detours. Race packets are issued from 17:00 to 21:30. After the race, participants are offered refreshments and winners are decorated. There are 26 free start packages available for disabled persons in the family race with a guardian upon email registration. The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find updates and information on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Airplane Run is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at the Mielec airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway under lit lights and a setting sun, creating a distinctive aviation atmosphere. Organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring the Iskra airplane motif, and awards in the form of statuettes and vouchers for tandem flights. After the race, participants can admire aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.
course_highlights: 6.5 km route along the Mielec airport runway
Run under lit lights and sunset
Start, finish, and decorations in the hangars of the White-Red Wings Foundation
additional: Participants will receive running T-shirts with the Iskra airplane, commemorative medals, as well as statuettes and diplomas in open and age categories. Medical and sanitary facilities are provided. At the end, there will be a raffle for a glider flight funded by the Polish Aviation Foundation. The event partner is DepilConcept salon, which offers a voucher for photodepilation treatments for the first woman to finish. Airport area, online registration, medals, T-shirts, prizes, aviation attractions, recovery meals.

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
location: Łódzki Park Arturówek, Łódź, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The eighth nationwide 'Prescription for Health' run will take place on June 13, 2026, in Arturówek, Łódź. It is a healthy running event promoting physical activity, integration of the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The race routes run along a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with distances of 5 km and 10 km, as well as Nordic Walking on a 5 km route. Shorter races for children and youth are scheduled on the same route. A family picnic with free health screenings and consultations will be held near the start and finish areas.
course_highlights: Race and Nordic Walking route on a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest
Two laps of 5 km for the 10 km distance
Family picnic with blood pressure and sugar measurements and consultations
additional: Start and finish at the recreational facilities of Arturówek, race office open from 8:00 AM on race day. The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start together at 10:00 AM, children's and youth races at 12:00 PM, 10 km run at 1:30 PM. The route is not certified. Awards and medals for children and youth immediately after their races. Registration for children requires an account on zapisy.inessport.pl. The event is supported by organizers from the pharmaceutical industry, with a strong emphasis on promoting a healthy lifestyle and health prevention, taking place in June 2026 in Łódź, at Arturówek.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
location: Leśnictwo Szulmierz, gmina Regimin, Mazowieckie, Poland
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race organized in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in forested areas. The route consists of a 5 km loop through forest paths and a paved section, showcasing the beauty of Masovian nature. Participants can choose from three races: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and Nordic Walking over 5 km. There is also a 1.5 km race for children without classification. The start and finish are located on a forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road, and the time is measured with a professional chip system.
course_highlights: 5 km loop route through forest paths and asphalt
Views of Masovian nature and deer breeding
Route secured by volunteers
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 AM on the forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road. Participants receive a commemorative medal and a recovery meal after the race. There is an option to choose a standard T-shirt at the price or a Premium LAS T-shirt with a surcharge of 20 PLN. Time is measured with chips attached to footwear. Prizes are awarded for places in age categories and open, as well as a raffle among participants. The routes include forest paths and asphalt, with various distances and categories, including races, Nordic Walking, and Cross Duathlon. Starting fees depend on the registration period.

Participation in the memorial honoring Marian Szymański

description: Challenge Gdańsk 2026 is a prestigious triathlon held by the Baltic Sea, set against the picturesque scenery of Gdańsk and Brzeźno. Athletes compete in the half-distance event, which includes 1.9 km of swimming in the Gulf of Gdańsk, a fast 90 km cycling route through the Vistula Lagoon, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing at the Gdańsk pier. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and excellent conditions for sporting competition. It is an official qualifying race taking place from June 19 to June 21, 2026.

Running along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park with finish at the pier in Brzeźno

Participants can opt for a full refund cancellation, with part of the fees donated to the Pomeranian Hospice for Children. The event is also known for high attendance and recognition in the triathlon community, including the title Race of the Year 2021.

description: Pogórze Ultra Trail is a mountain race organized by the Pogórze Ultra Trail Association, which combines a passion for running and exploring the natural beauty of the Pogórze Strzyżowskie region. The race routes lead through picturesque areas with diverse natural features, including old deciduous forests, thickets, loess ravines, and unique rock formations. Participants have the opportunity to run through historic shelter tunnels in Strzyżów and Stępin, as well as admire the Brzeżanka mountain range, the Kiczora massif, Herby, and Chełm Hill. description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening street run scheduled for August 29, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km or 10 km distance, running through the center of Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel beach. The route is certified by PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with musical and lighting effects awaits. It is an excellent opportunity to combine athletic competition with the atmosphere of a city event.
course_highlights: The 10 km route passes through the Grunwaldzka district, downtown, and the Old Town area with views of the Town Hall and High Gate
Start and finish at CRS Ukiel beach with musical and lighting effects
The route is certified by PZLA with markers every 1 km and two refreshment zones
additional: Race kits can be collected on August 28, 2026 (16:00 - 20:00) and August 29, 2026 (9:00 - 15:00) at the race office at CRS Ukiel. It is possible for an authorized person to pick up the kit with an ID. No registration on race day. The 5 km race starts at 18:00, and the 10 km race at 19:00. There is a one-hour break between starts for rest and recovery in the athlete zone. A 10% discount is available when registering for both races in one order. The routes close at 18:45 (5 km) and 20:15 (10 km). The event includes evening runs of 5 km and 10 km, with early registration and discounts available until the end of April 2026, as well as children's races. The routes are designed with participant safety and comfort in mind.

The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Center of the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality, which promotes sports and recreation among residents. The event takes place on August 29, 2026, and is an important sporting event in the region.

Distances from 5 km to 36 km, including races for children and adults
Attractions and fitness challenges for participants
additional: trail runs, online registration via electronic sign-ups, participant limit of 550, terrain: Pruszcz Gdański municipality

The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic route along the Vistula River. The event has a sports and recreational character, promoting physical activity and community integration.

Flat course profile conducive to fast times
Organized as part of the Kociewie Running Grand Prix

description: The 16th Baltic Sea Coast Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, which run along the coast, offering stunning views and a unique atmosphere. The event attracts runners of various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring a intimate and friendly environment.
course_highlights: The route runs along the Baltic Sea coast
Scenic views of the sea and seaside towns Jastarnia and Władysławowo
Available distances: marathon (42 km) and half-marathon (21 km)
additional: The participant limit is 250 people. The K60+ and M65+ age categories have reduced entry fees. Registration is open from March 16 to August 26, 2026. The fee on the event day is higher. Start and finish in the seaside towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. The participant limit is 250 people, registration is open from March 16, 2026, with information on dates and fees.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are demanding cross-country races held in the picturesque Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Jura Krakowsko-Częstochowska region. The routes lead through Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding paths, rocky ascents, and open spaces with a view of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers various distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the challenging Trentaraton for experienced runners. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and enjoying the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Jurassic hills and limestone outcrops
Winding paths and rocky ascents
Panorama of the Jurassic Landscape Park
additional: Race office open on August 30, 2026 from 8:00 to 10:00. Registrations available until 24.08.2026 online, and from 24.08.2026 only on the day of the event at the office. Children can participate free of charge. The event also includes Nordic Walking marches over distances of 14 km and 7 km. Distances range from 7 km to 30 km, with races for children, on-site registration from 8:00, Jura terrain, runs and walks, sporting and recreational event.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Plac Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event held on August 30, 2026, in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half marathon distance (21.0975 km) or a 10 km run, which takes place on a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jasne Błonia Square named after John Paul II. The route is certified by PZLA and is marked every kilometer, with electronic timing using chips embedded in the race bibs. Organizers offer wave starts and high-quality technical shirts from the Ventus brand in extended packages.
course_highlights: Single-loop route through Szczecin streets
Distance selection point at 9.6 km of the route
Route certified by PZLA, marked every 1 km
additional: Participants can choose between a basic or extended package with a Ventus technical shirt. Start and finish at Jasne Błonia Square named after John Paul II. Participant limit is 6000 people. Electronic timing with chips in race bibs. Wave start options available. Courier packages shipped via InPost with the option to redirect to a parcel locker. Distances: half marathon and 10 km run; location: Jasne Błonia, Szczecin; date: August 30, 2026, from 09:00 to 13:00.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held at the historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland's first triathlon event in 1984. Participants can enjoy calm and warm waters for swimming, a fast and flat cycling route through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań — a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines athletic competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swimming in the calm and warm Lake Kierskie, site of Poland's first triathlon
Flat and fast cycling route through villages and the western part of Poznań
Run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań
additional: Start in a rolling start format. The start and finish locations are Lake Kierskie and the International Fairgrounds Poznań. The IRONKIDS event will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, starting at 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications about additional spots are available. Participants have the option to change their start date free of charge within the Flex90 offer. The event also includes accompanying activities such as Night Run and IRONKIDS, with a participant limit of 1500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate trail runs organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The series takes place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, respecting nature and local communities. The events are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, aiming to build a community based on passion, competition, and friendship. The events are non-commercial and intimate, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Trail routes through picturesque forests and hilly terrains in eastern Poland
Respect for nature and local communities
Intimate character with a limited number of participants
additional: The runs are intimate with a limited number of participants. The organizer provides electronic timing, medical support, refreshment stations along the course and at the finish line, and commemorative medals. Participants can earn points towards the overall classification and titles of Finisher and Super Finisher for completing multiple races. The organizer encourages environmental respect and litter-free trails. The event focuses on the trail community, promotes outdoor activity, and supports the development of the local running scene. Registration is conducted via an electronic platform, and the event is part of a series covering various locations.

description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój, which will take place on August 30, 2026. The start will be from the Municipal Stadium at 8:30 AM. The half marathon route passes through representative hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit to complete the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, and the race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: The route runs past representative Busko hotels and sanatoriums
Race through the picturesque Spa Park and charming promenades
Unique atmosphere and scenic surroundings of the route
additional: The time limit to finish the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route is verified and popular; this is the fourth time the race is held on this same course. The event is organized by the Busko Sports and Recreation Center and the Athletics Busko-Zdrój Sports Club. GPX files of the route are available for download for Suunto and Garmin devices. Registration is open until May 31, 2026. The start is at 8:30 AM, with a time limit of 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route includes urban and park areas.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Forest Five Reverse is a cross-country race organized in Koszalin, taking place on September 3, 2026. The race route is run in a different direction than usual, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs, with medals for all finishers and trophies for the best in various categories. The race is the finale of the Forest Five season and part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO, encouraging activity throughout the year.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the Nadleśnictwo Karnieszewice forest
Start and finish at the parking lot on Słupska Street in Koszalin
Race in the reversed direction of the route to experience it anew
additional: Start numbers with chips are to be collected at the race office on the day of the event. Participants can compete in categories for runners, Nordic Walking, and mixed pairs. The race is part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO, where the collected kilometers matter more than pace. After the race, a photo gallery prepared by the A7 FILM team will be available. Participants can register online, and the event includes photographic attractions as part of the Tour of Running in the Area - TurBO.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event organized in the port region of Gdańsk, scheduled for September 5, 2026. The event gathers competitors across various age categories and skill levels, offering race walking competitions over distances of 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20, U18 categories), 5 km, and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders - Energa Cup. The organizer, the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over distances of 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km tailored to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships 5 km and Polish U23 Championships 10 km
Accompanying events including the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders
additional: The festival promotes activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. The organizer is the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, and the event is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. The competitions include various distances such as 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, with online registration available. The event encourages sports activity among different age groups and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: Praga Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Warsaw, attracting both amateurs and experienced runners. The half marathon route runs through the picturesque and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event is held at night, which adds a special climate and appeal. Organizers provide professional service, electronic timing, and start packages with an official T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic district of Praga in Warsaw
The race takes place in the evening, giving the event a nocturnal character
Scenic views and a unique atmosphere of the night half marathon
additional: Official race T-shirt for participants. Electronic timing. The event is held at night, starting at 20:00. Start packages with number and chip are available. The route is certified and secured. There is also an option to participate in a 5 km run - Praska 5k Run. The event includes results and details about the route and regulations. The races are accessible to a wide range of participants, and the event is increasingly popular among runners from Warsaw and the surrounding areas.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that takes place across two countries along Europe's longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Polish Świnoujście with German Wolgast, passing through historic resorts and scenic forested areas. Runners can enjoy a variety of surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the exceptional atmosphere of the Usedom island.
course_highlights: The route runs along Europe's longest seaside promenade
Passes through historic resorts Ahlbeck, Heringsdorf, and Bansin
Diverse surfaces: asphalt, cobblestone, and forest trails
additional: Transport to the marathon start is organized by buses from the organizer with a stop near the race office at 7:15 AM. There are options to board at various points on Usedom island. Baggage transport to the stadium in Wolgast is provided. Time limit: participants must pass Kölpinsee (km 21.8) within 2:30 hours and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 hours; otherwise, they will be withdrawn from the course. After exceeding time limits, there is no route security or refreshment points. Start in Świnoujście, finish in Wolgast, bus transfer available. Registration is open until August 30, 2026. The route includes urban, forest, and seaside sections.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross Country Race for the Leśny Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two loops of 3.2 km each, with the start and finish at the same location. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for entire families in a natural setting. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.
course_highlights: Main race course: two loops of 3.2 km
Start and finish at the same point
Eco-forest surroundings of the course in Obliwice
additional: Program for September 6, 2026: from 11:00 am ceremonial opening, children's and youth races over 600 m and 1.609 km, at 1:20 pm the main 6.4 km race starts, at 2:00 pm the race of village heads and VIPs, at 5:00 pm the International Mile in memory of Piotr Gładki, and at 5:30 pm the Ecological Feast. Approximately 300 competitors will participate in the main race. The top finishers qualify for the International Mile. Forest terrain, online registration, accompanying events, sports memorial.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is the oldest continuously organized street race in Poland, covering a distance of 10 kilometers, held in Gdańsk. The race starts at a historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The route is certified and marked every kilometer, and the finish line is at the Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, which adds an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Coast Defenders of 1939.
course_highlights: Certified route marked every 1 km
Opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, closed to pedestrian traffic on regular days
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - a modern football facility
additional: Number pickup at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 6-7, 2026. Water refreshment point approximately at 6 km on the route. Participant limit is 5000 people. Free buses transport competitors to the start on race day. Deposit for belongings with a start number sticker. No showers available. Award ceremony around 11:45 at the finish line. Cash prizes and trophies for winners in the OPEN classification and age categories. Registration from March 2, 2026, to August 20, 2026, with a limit of 4900 participants, and the option to purchase official T-shirts at the Expo. The event includes package pickup, expo, transportation, start, and awards at Westerplatte.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of various skill levels to test their form on an easy, asphalt course. Organizers encourage preparation with the help of training plans tailored to individual levels, offering expert support. The event is friendly and motivating, ideal for those looking to improve their fitness and enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course length of 5 km
Easy, asphalt surface
Picturesque surroundings of Bukownica
additional: Training plans available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level with instructions and expert support. Training preparations are available for participants, and the event promotes activity and a healthy lifestyle within the local community.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting event that connects participants and raises awareness about autism. The race takes place on an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area in Szczecin, and participation is primarily about personal satisfaction and overcoming oneself, regardless of the finishing position. The event also features joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, which further promotes integration.
course_highlights: The route runs along an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area
Inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers
additional: The number of spots is limited to 300 participants. Start packages can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, May 16, from 10:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on the day of the event from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories with different distances from 200 to 600 meters. The Race Office and start are located at the Szyszka restaurant. The race is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, taking place on an asphalt trail in Arkonka, with online registration available until May 10, 2025. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.2 km long, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Center. The race route is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with limited road traffic during the event. The event promotes popularization of running and recreation as well as integration of the local community. In addition to the main race, there are also races for children and youth on various distances suitable for their age. Participants of the main race receive a starter pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.
course_highlights: Route approximately 21.2 km, 100% asphalt

Refreshment points at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and finish

Classifications include OPEN women and men as well as age categories for adults and children. Approximate distances for children: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I-III), 500 m (grades IV-VI), 800 m (grades VII-VIII). Registration for the event was available online. The event also includes races for children and community activities.

Online registration, timing measurement, and live results are available.

The event is designed for teams of two or individual participants, providing an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are located in the Koszyce area, and organizers provide professional support and assistance.

Traversing the Beskid Mountains and Orawa region
Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing elements

The race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes disciplines such as climbing, kayaking, navigation, and field tasks, with routes passing through scenic areas of Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

description: The 8th Warmia Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in the picturesque Olsztyn. The route takes runners through charming Warmia trails, along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake, offering contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity for active recreation, suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can participate in the children's races Ultra Warmiaczek. The atmosphere of the competition fosters integration and shared sporting adventure.

Route along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake
Contact with nature and charming views

The start times for the W50+ and W25+ distances are at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, participants must leave the course and remove their bib numbers. The Ultra Warmiaczek children's races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center, near numerous hotels and apartments. The event includes distances of 53 km, 32 km, 19 km, and children's races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours, and the start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support. Registration closes on April 26, 2025.

The event features music and activities along the course and is a local community celebration encouraging walking, jogging, and running. Welcome to a day of movement, socializing, and joy on Saturday, May 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometers with start and finish in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the course runs close to Svartån
99 percent asphalt; some challenging uphill sections and the last kilometer through Mjölby center towards Gästisparken
additional: Race bibs are collected at Intersport on Friday, May 8 from 12:00 to 18:00 (discount coupon 25% upon pickup). Uncollected race bibs are handed out in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The top flap on the bib is the chip - without it, no time will be registered. Late registration is open from April 30 to May 7 via the website and can also be done at the bib distribution on May 8 or in Stadsparken on May 9 (only Swish). Warm-up is provided by Fitness4You; the event offers refreshments from ICA Supermarket Mjölby and water/sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. The number of participants has been high previously, with 1074 runners reported; registration for 2026 opens and results and record descriptions will be published by organizing media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred that takes place along Lake Hulingen on a nice, flat course. There is a 10 km course and two children's distances, and the organizers welcome both club and recreational runners. Children can also register for the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizer refers to the race information sheet on the race website.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children's races
Friendly family-oriented race environment at Herrstorpet
additional: The children's races start at 10:00 AM and the 10 km race starts at 11:00 AM. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizer refers to a race information sheet for more details. The children's race starts at 10:00 AM according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet's new building day with dressage cycling, guided tours, and concerts in the morning.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 10 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: 21 km 400 kr; 11 km 300 kr; 6 km 200 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr
tiers.description: Till och med 3 Maj: 21 km 400 kr, 11 km 300 kr, 6 km 200 kr, Ungdom 50 kr, Kidz 50 kr.

late_fee.price: 21 km 500 kr; 11 km 400 kr; 6 km 300 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr

description: The Kolmårdstrail is a hilly and experience-focused trail run in the scenic Kolmården with technical trails, rocky outcrops, and many elevation meters. You can choose between courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km, and 6 km (as well as a children’s course of 500 m). The course is described as challenging but close to nature - passing through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offering fine views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services such as a water station and the option to download GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with many elevation meters and rocky outcrops
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Ågelsjön; Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level) with a view
Small trails and single tracks, wooden bridge over marsh areas, rope in the “koklämman”, and a final tough/partially unpaved kilometer
additional: Regular registration until May 3; late registration online until May 6 and thereafter on site (race day) from 09:00 to 11:00, payment in cash or via Swish. GPX data for the courses can be downloaded. Water stations are available after approximately 7.5 km at the Scout Cabin. A children’s run of about 500 m is available for children up to 10 years old. For the Kolmården Night Trail: bring a headlamp, the course is marked with reflectors, no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as an optional add-on. Kolmården races in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 meters of elevation), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km), and Luciatåget (7.5 km). Results are available online, and several distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organized by Östhammars Friidrott and will take place on Saturday, May 9, 2026, starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club's competition page and is aimed at local runners and participants in the nearby area. When registering, necessary contact information is collected for race administration and result publication, and images from the event may be used in the club's channels.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club informs that contact details provided during registration are used for race contact and that name, age, and results may be stored for result lists and race statistics. Images from the event may be used on the club's website, Facebook, and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request removal. Club membership for 2026 is managed via Svenska Lag. The website contains start lists, registration, and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organized by Spånga/Bromstens Bandy Club, scheduled for May 9, 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and levels, including 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga center, as well as a 2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race. The start and finish for all races are at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to participate, and registration is done via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and Spånga center
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m kids' race
Start and finish at Spånga IP for all races
additional: Registration is via RaceID under "Spångaloppet 2026". Contact for questions: spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and finish near Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity run in Älmhult that raises money for the fight against cancer. The race is organized by Aktivitetshuset/IKEA network and welcomes both the general public and IKEA employees and their families. Registration is done via RaceID where participants choose both distance and start time; online registration is open until May 9th at 8:00 PM and late registration can be done on-site from 8:30 AM if space permits. The race weekend is complemented by inspirational lectures and an after-run at Grillen after the finish line.
additional: Registration is via RaceID (select distance and start time). Online registration is open until May 9th at 8:00 PM; late registration is possible on-site from 8:30 AM if space allows. Since the race is a charity event, no fees are refunded upon cancellation. Group registration is supported (add additional participants during payment) and confirmation emails from RaceSupport include the chosen distance and start time. Inspirational lectures are held at Aktivitetshuset before the race (including Aron Anderson on April 10th from 17:00 to 19:00 and a lecture with researchers on April 24th from 17:30 to 19:00). The after-run at Grillen begins at 14:00 after the race. A course map is available as a PDF on the event page, and IKEA Hotel is recommended for overnight stays.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Öland's Parish Relay is a classic long-distance relay race held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on a spring-blooming Öland. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race is available in two variants: a longer course with eleven legs totaling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totaling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs suitable for all levels. Officials and a announcer follow the race to provide the best possible service and atmosphere throughout the event.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 2.7 km to 8.5 km, total 67.5 km
Short course: 6 legs, 2.7 km to 5.4 km, total 23.5 km
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Number bib collection takes place on May 8th from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day May 9th from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall 200 meters north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio hosts a group warm-up before the start. Individual split times, intermediate times, and team finish times are provided. The announcer follows the lead pack from start to finish. The race offers accommodation and food options at Ekerum Resort and Best Western Plus Kalmarsund Hotel. Registration is open until April 30, 2026, with late registration until May 6. Participants can expect a well-organized event with officials, a group warm-up, and awards for the best teams.

name: Humlestafetten
distance_verbose: 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race held in Bruksparken in Bromölla, starting and finishing at the same location. The race consists of six legs and is suitable for all runners, from casual joggers to more experienced athletes. The course is flat and easy to run, with varying surfaces of gravel and asphalt, making the event a day filled with running joy and camaraderie. During the anniversary year, a mini race for children is organized, and a balloon ride is raffled off for participating teams. The start is at 11:00 AM, and bib numbers can be collected from 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: Flat and easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs with timing via data chip
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Bib numbers are collected from 9:00 AM in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available in Sparbankshallen. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and many prizes are raffled among participants. Timing is done with data chips, recording both total time and split times for each runner. The race has a common start and encourages slower runners to keep to the right to allow faster runners to pass. The event includes a mini race for children, medals for all participants, and prizes for the top three in each category. Bib distribution begins at 9:00 AM, with shower and changing facilities available in Sparbankshallen. Registration is open until May 8, 2026.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://humlestafetten.se): 2026-05-09 — "den 9 maj 2026" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Lundaloppet
location: Centrala Idrottsplatsen, Lund, Skåne County, Sweden
price_range: 400-650 kr beroende på distans och datum

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startavgifter 2,5, 5 och 10 km: 400 kr (500 kr från 23 april)

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Lundaloppet is a recreational race held in the city center of Lund, offering several distances for all ages and levels, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, as well as the Little Lundaloppet for children. The race is known for its wonderful atmosphere and beautiful course through parks and urban environments. It is a festival where both beginners and experienced runners gather to enjoy running joy in springtime Lund. The finish line is located inside the Central Sports Field, which has been the race's vibrant heart since 1997.
course_highlights: 10 km running joy through a springtime Lund
Course through parks and city center
Child-friendly race of about 500 meters around the Central Sports Field
additional: Number bib distribution takes place at IFK Hall at the Central Sports Field on May 8 from 13:00 to 19:00 and on May 9 from 09:00. Warm-up for the main race occurs at the start on Svanevägen with raised platforms along the route. Start documents will be sent via email in week 18 and must be shown at the bib pickup. Timing is done with a chip on the bib, and the finish line is filmed. Cross-country and city running, registration via website, race bibs, and T-shirts can be purchased in advance or on-site.
