description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a welcoming yet challenging trail run for both elite runners and amateurs. Choose between longer challenges (45 km or 60 km) where the course takes you through Kolmårdsskogen, up to Kvarseboklints mountain ridge, down to the shore of Bråviken, past Nävsjön's nature, and finally through the technical Bråviksbranten before reaching the finish line. The race combines technical trails, boardwalks over mosses, and spectacular views, with well-equipped water stations along the way. The organizer emphasizes safety and mandatory equipment, as well as a finishing medal and light refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Kvarseboklints majestic mountain ridge with views
Descent to Bråviken's shore and passage at Nävsjön with boardwalks over extensive mosses
Technical and demanding running through Bråviksbranten nature reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack with fluids (at least 0.5 L), pressure bandage/stop bleeding device, and map with emergency number (distributed at bib pickup). Water stations: 45K = 4 stations, 60K = 5 stations (for the 48 km variant, detailed stations with various energy products are provided). Bib pickup from 05:30; bib must be collected at least 30 minutes before start. Course marked with large orange arrows and ribbons. At the finish, light refreshments and a custom-designed medal are included; massage offered at cost. Energy/fluid in collaboration with Umara. Mandatory equipment; start times: 45K at 08:00; cut-off time 13:30 at 44 km; water stations: 45K with 4 stations, 60K with 5 stations; finish: meal included in the entry fee.

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is more of an adventure run than a traditional race: a self-supported journey around Gotland approximately 511 km with start and finish in Visby. Participants follow a clockwise loop that also includes a lap around Fårö, and are supported by four so-called Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides some basic services, but runners are responsible for most food and logistics arrangements. The entire route must be completed on foot within 10 days, with regular position reports throughout the day.
course_highlights: Circular route around Gotland (start and finish in Visby) including a lap around Fårö
Most of the route follows Gotlandsleden: long asphalt stretches, gravel roads, and shorter trail sections
Four Angel Stations along the course offering water, support, and sometimes opportunities for short rest/bed
additional: Self-sufficient format: the organizer provides only the most basic; participants are responsible for food and most accommodation. Mandatory pre-race dinner and mandatory race briefing in Visby the evening before the start. Includes one overnight stay at Visby Fängelse Hostel (one night) and breakfast on race morning, race number, baggage storage during the race, and a souvenir for finishers. Transportation back to Visby is offered for participants who withdraw. Participants must report their position twice daily (10:00 and 22:00) via an online check-in tool and a Google Maps link. Total time limit 10 days (approximately 51 km per day on average). There are sections on mandatory equipment and basic rules on the information page. History: first edition in 2023 had 5 starters and 3 finishers. Distance approximately 511 km (318 miles); four Angel Stations along the way; no pacing; mandatory equipment; pre-race dinner and briefing; one night accommodation in Visby included; baggage storage; race number; transport back to Visby upon withdrawal; finishers receive a souvenir.

name: Kustmaran
price_range: 50 kr - 600 kr (beroende på distans och anmälningsperiod)
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family held on June 27, 2026, in Kristianopel, Blekinge. With distances from 0.9 km up to the marathon 42.2 km, there is something for all levels and ages. The race offers a beautiful and idyllic summer landscape environment with dedicated support and cheerful cheers from Team Blekinge's staff. Participants can also enjoy Kristianopel's charm with swimming, restaurants, cafes, and accommodation options. It is a memorable day focused on running and community for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Distance options from 0.9 km to 42.2 km
Running in an idyllic summer landscape by the east coast
Children's race inside Kristianopel Camping
additional: Number bib collection and late registration can be done on race day from 08:00. Electronic timing with Racetimer. Rules according to the Swedish Athletics Federation's long-distance rules. Only participants who turn at least 17 years old during the year are allowed to participate in the half marathon and marathon. Sommarlunken is a 4 km recreational distance without timing or medals, with prize draws. Terrain, registration via the website, water stations, swimming opportunities, camping, and changing facilities are available.

name: Killebom Loppet Sölvesborg
description:
Sölvesborg's Killebom Race offers several different formats and distances to choose from, suitable for both the slower and faster runners.
Since it is part of an ongoing city festival, there will likely be a lot of activity and spectators cheering on all participants.
Of course, our wonderful volunteers will ensure to encourage and cheer you on out on the course.
The available distances are a children's race (approximately 400 meters), 5 km, or 10 km (loop course for 10 km). All proceeds from the children's race go to the Children's Cancer Foundation, so take the opportunity to do a good deed and run with the whole family.

images.alt_text: Två kvinnor under en välkomstportal vid ett löplopp.
Tre män i löparkläder med nummerbrickor står vid en hamn, redo för Killebom Loppet.
Deltagare i en löpartävling på en landsväg, med tydliga nummerlappar och löparutrustning.
Människor i varselvästar organiserar papper vid ett bord under ett event.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is an urban race of 6.2 km in and around Västervik city center, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The course consists of two approximately 3 km loops with a turn at Fiskaretorget. The race has been held since 2011 and is traditionally run on the Monday of week 28, starting at 20:00. The race is well established in Västervik and attracts runners of various ages.
course_highlights: Urban race 6.2 km (two loops of approximately 3 km each)
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
Loop at Fiskaretorget
additional: The Kids Race (Sparbanksloppet) is a children’s race of 800 meters for kids up to 10 years old, with a common start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30; the start for the kids race is at the level of Stegeholms castle ruins at the sun deck and Myntbryggan, following the cycle path along Gamlebyviken to the finish at Grönsakstorget. After the finish, participants in the kids race receive a medal. Bib pickup at ICA Maxi or the race secretariat; pre-registration closes on July 3rd at 16:00; registration on race day from 13:00 to 19:00.

name: Byrundan (Gamleby)
description: The Byrundan is a running race held in Gamleby with start and finish in Unos park. The race offers various distances suitable for all ages, making it a welcoming event for both children and adults. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere in the heart of Gamleby. Welcome to participate and enjoy a pleasant running day in the center of Gamleby.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Gamleby with start and finish in Unos park
Multiple distances for all ages
Central and easily accessible in Gamleby
additional: Registration on-site is accepted from 15:00 on race day at the start and finish area in Unos park. Payment can be made in cash or via Swish. Late registration must be completed at least 60 minutes before the start of each race. Bib numbers can be collected on race day from 15:00 until at least 1 hour before the start of each race. Members of Gamleby OK run for free with the discount code GOK. Entry fees are non-refundable in case of absence, but a Startklar insurance is recommended in case of illness or injury. Race date: 2026-07-10; terrain is likely urban and park environment; registration details are available at Byrundan.se and vastervik.com

name: Musköloppet
location: Muskö Hembygdsgård, Muskö, Haninge kommun, Stockholms län, Sverige
description: Muskö Race is a traditional jogging event set in a magnificent archipelago environment with start and finish at Muskö Heritage Farm / Muskö IF's clubhouse. The race typically attracts around 300 runners (approximately 400 including children) and has a friendly, hometown atmosphere where many take the opportunity to meet family and neighbors. The competition offers children and youth classes as well as recreational classes (5 km and 10 km) on varied terrain and is scheduled for Saturday, July 11, 2026.
course_highlights: Start/finish at Muskö Heritage Farm near clubhouse, outdoor gym, and hockey rink
Course surface: approximately 50% asphalt, 30-40% gravel, and 10% terrain
5 km and 10 km courses are measured (by federation measurer Mikael Hill, 240523) and the 10 km is run as a single lap this year
additional: Late registration takes place at the start/finish area no later than one hour before the race begins. Food and drinks are available at the start/finish. Directions with driving and public transport guidance, as well as parking instructions, can be found on the "Hitta hit" page. Around 300 runners usually participate (about 400 including children). Start/finish area at Muskö Heritage Farm / Muskö IF's clubhouse; 5- and 10-km courses with varied terrain (about 50% asphalt, 40% gravel, 10% terrain on one course; about 60% asphalt, 30% gravel, 10% terrain on the other); marketing, kiosk goods, coffee, soda, and refreshments from Mickes Grill; late registration at the finish area no later than one hour before the race start.

name: Klåveröd Backyard 2026
description: Klåveröd Backyard 2026 is a Facebook-listed event in Svalöv taking place on Saturday, July 11, 2026, created by Linda Bengtsson. The event is associated with Klåveröd Ski Club and is presented via an official Facebook event page. The location is Klåveröd near Söderåsen, providing opportunities for trail and cross-country running in a natural environment. For details and contact information, refer to the event page on Facebook.
course_highlights: Running in Klåveröd/Svalöv near Söderåsen
Trail and forest terrain (organized by Klåveröd Ski Club)
Close to Söderåsen's nature and national park area
additional: Organizer/creator: Linda Bengtsson; event linked to Klåveröd Ski Club; main information page and invitation available as a Facebook event: https://www.facebook.com/events/1496584765165217/; Klåveröd's Facebook group and page are used for local information. Previous Klåveröd Backyard 2024: winner Jonas Elmer with 14 laps, approximately 90 km total.

name: Julichansen
description: Julichansen is an annual athletics competition held at Ekängens athletics arena in Eskilstuna. The event includes disciplines such as 100m, 200m, 400m, 1500m, long jump, hammer throw, and javelin. The first race starts around 17:00, and the registration fee is 100 SEK per discipline. Late registration is possible subject to availability at double the fee, and invoicing will be sent to the club after the competition.
course_highlights: Competition at Ekängens athletics arena in Eskilstuna
Disciplines: 100m, 200m, 400m, 1500m, long jump, hammer throw, javelin
First start around 17:00
additional: Late registration is possible subject to availability at double the fee. Invoicing will be sent to the club after the event. The start list is available via a link to webathletics.se. The event includes various athletics disciplines and is open to participants of different age categories. The competition is part of the Swedish athletics season and attracts both youth and adults.

name: Hornsjön Runt
location: Pensionat Hornsjön, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Hornsjön Runt is a family-friendly running event that takes place around Öland's only lake, Hornsjön, featuring beautiful and varied environments. The race is organized by Högby IF and offers distances for children and youth, 5.5 km, 11 km, as well as a walking class without timing. Start and finish at Pensionat Hornsjön, and all finishers receive a medal. The event combines a long tradition with scenic courses over gravel, sand dunes, forests, and open meadows.
course_highlights: Around Öland's only lake (Hornsjön)
Varied terrain: gravel with Öland limestone, grass, and sand dunes
Passes cattle pastures as well as deciduous and coniferous forests; three water stations along the course
additional: Registration by July 11, 2026, late registration until July 16, and thereafter the possibility to register at the bib pickup from 12:00 on race day. Walking class (without timing) with start times between 13:00 and 16:00. Three water stations along the course and water at start/finish. Possibility to shower and change at Högby sports field. Awards for the top three in all categories and raffle prizes. Start times: youth classes 15:30; 5.5 km at 17:00; 11 km at 17:05. Walking class (5.5 or 11 km) with start between 13:00 and 16:00. Shower and changing facilities at Högby sports field.

name: Runmaröloppen 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Mini-Lunken 1.5km 60kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och en kula glass.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lunken 5.7km: från 150kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Halvmarathon 21km: från 350kr inkl nummerlapp, medalj och finisherdryck.

description: RUNmaröloppen is a family-friendly race in the heart of Stockholm's archipelago on Runmarö, starting and finishing at the Svängen inn. The event offers short children's races, Lunken (5.7 km), and a half marathon (21 km) across beautiful trails, open fields, and archipelago villages – perfect as a day trip with Waxholmsbåtarna. The races are limited in number of participants and emphasize atmosphere, energy stations, and sustainability; 20% of the proceeds go to the Skärgårdsstiftelsen.
course_highlights: Half marathon (21 km) around the entire Runmarö with views towards Sandhamn
A mix of trail paths, gravel roads, and archipelago villages; two trail sections in the half marathon
Fixed signs and 1 km markers on the half marathon as well as many local energy stations
additional: Start and finish at the Svängen inn (approximately 400 meters from the pier). Mini-Lunken starts at 11:00; Lunken and Half Marathon start at 13:00. The half marathon has 1 km markers, an interactive map, a total elevation gain of 169 meters, and several local water stations (for example, Nore with salt cucumber and Solberga). Participants in Mini-Lunken receive an ice cream; all finishers get a medal and a finisher's drink. The races are limited in number (200 spots for the half marathon and 120 for Lunken in the first round, with an additional 30 spots released closer to the race, often at 18:00 the day before). Registration opens on May 1 at 09:00. 20% of the proceeds are donated to the Skärgårdsstiftelsen. Results are published online and an award ceremony takes place after the races; in the evening, there is dinner/party at Svängen. Start and finish at Svängen; the courses are marked; registration starts May 1 at 09:00; a significant number of spots are limited (Half marathon 200 spots, Lunken 120 in the first round, plus 30 extra spots later); a purposeful charity aspect and local atmosphere.

name: Victorialoppet
price_range: 175-550 kr beroende på kategori och registreringsdatum
description: Victorialoppet is an annual running festival in Borgholm celebrating its 45th year in 2026. The race offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including the main race of 9 km, Victoriajoggen of 4 km, Lilla Victorialoppet of 2 km, and Mini for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run with beautiful seaside views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event is a community celebration with live music along the course and a welcoming atmosphere for both participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Fast and easy-to-run 9 km course with seaside views
Live music at multiple locations along the course
Courses for all ages including para-sport classes
additional: Number bibs are distributed from 10:00 to 18:00 at Borgholm Sports Hall on race day. There are changing rooms and showers for men/boys in the sports hall and for women/girls in Viktoriaskolan's gymnasium. Water is served along the 9 km course, and participants receive drinks and snacks after finishing. Timing is done with disposable chips for most races, optional timing for Victoriajoggen and para-sport classes. Children in Lilla Victorialoppet receive medals, ice cream, and drinks after finishing. The entire event runs from early afternoon to evening with multiple start times and races. Several race distances including 9 km, 4 km, 2 km, and 1.5 km, with participation from different age groups and disability classes. The event takes place in Borgholm's sports area and includes both competitive and recreational races as well as charity fundraisers.

name: Löttorpsvarvet
location: First Camp Löttorp, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Löttorpsvarvet is a family-friendly cross-country race held at First Camp Löttorp on Öland. The main distance is 6.2 km, and the course runs through forest and meadow areas with beautiful views of the Baltic Sea. There are youth categories with 1.4 km and 800 m for younger runners, and medals are awarded to all finishers. The organizer is Högby IF, and the event welcomes both recreational runners and youth.
course_highlights: 6.2 km in lovely terrain around First Camp Löttorp
Running through forest and meadow with views of the Baltic Sea
Youth courses 1.4 km and 800 m
additional: Registration by July 15, 2026. Late registration until July 20; thereafter, registration is possible at the bib pickup on race day (from 15:00). Late registration fee: 300 SEK for Men/Women and 200 SEK for Children/Youth. Payment accepted in cash, card, or Swish. Children/youth categories: P/F7 (800 m), P/F9, P/F11, P/F13 (1.4 km) with specific start times; categories 11 years and younger have no timing or prize ceremony. Medals to all finishers. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. Registration deadline: July 15, 2026; late registration until July 20; thereafter at bib pickup on race day from 15:00. Late registration fee: 300 SEK (M/W), 200 SEK (Children/Youth). Classes P/F11 and younger have no timing or prize ceremony. Cross-country race along First Camp Löttorp with start times for different age groups: P/F7 (800 m), P/F9 (1.4 km), P/F11 (1.4 km), and P/F13 (1.4 km).

name: Kalmar Sommarspel
description: Kalmar Summer Games is an athletics competition organized by IK Hinden Friidrott in Kalmar. The event brings together active athletes of various ages and disciplines, including discus, pentathlon, and running. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and opportunities for personal bests and impressive performances. It is a popular summer competition within the Östsvenska Friidrottsförbundet.
course_highlights: Athletics competition with multiple disciplines such as discus, pentathlon, and running
Participants of different age groups, including youth
Held in Kalmar with good opportunities for personal records
additional: The event includes sprints, multi-event festivals, and para-sports, and is a valued part of Kalmar's summer sports season.

name: ATEA Kalmarmilen
description: ATEA Kalmarmilen is an established half marathon in Kalmar taking place on July 29, 2026, welcoming both recreational runners and elite athletes. The start is at Teatervallen and the finish area is at Larmtorget, with a course passing Kalmar Castle, Stensö, the Old Town, the harbor, Fredrikskans, Lindö, and Ängö before returning to the city center. The race also serves as the DM/VDM status for Eastern Sweden and is organized by Högby IF, while being part of the I Run Kalmar race series. On the same day, the Little Atea Kalmarmilen is held for children in various age groups, making it a family event with multiple running options.
course_highlights: Start at Teatervallen and finish at Larmtorget in Kalmar
The course passes iconic locations such as Kalmar Castle, Old Town, and the harbor
Illuminated running tracks and exercise trails in Kalmar; Little Atea Kalmarmilen for children held simultaneously
additional: Högby IF's athletics page lists several upcoming races (including Kalmar Backyard Ultra, Skälbyloppet, Ölands Tjurrus) with specified dates and start times. The pages mention GPX files and a map of the course, as well as a walking class (Skälbyloppet: 4 km without timing) and separate start times for youth and senior categories. Bib pickup is at Kalmar Theater on July 28 from 15:00 to 17:00 and on July 29 from 15:00 to 19:00. ICA MAXI offers drinks, fruit, and chocolate after the race. The Little Atea Kalmarmilen is held simultaneously for children aged 2-13; the main race has a main distance of 10 km, along with mini classes and distances for younger age groups.

name: Hais-Spelen
price_range: 110 kr per deltagare och gren för klasser 17 år och äldre, 90 kr för övriga

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift 110 kr per deltagare och gren för klasserna 17 år och äldre.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 90 kr per deltagare och gren för övriga klasser.

description: HAIS-Play is a traditional athletics competition in Hässleholm welcoming seniors, juniors, and youth. The event is organized by Hässleholms AIS and takes place over three days, starting on Friday at 15:00 and continuing on Saturday and Sunday from 09:30. The event offers a wide range of disciplines, and medals are awarded to the top three in each event from age 12 and up. The competition is characterized by a long tradition and a welcoming atmosphere for all ages.
course_highlights: Athletics competition for seniors, juniors, and youth
Events take place over three days starting Friday afternoon
Medals awarded to the top three in each discipline from age 12 and up
additional: Registration is done online via easyrecord.se. Late registration is possible subject to availability and at double the fee. Medals are awarded to the top three in each discipline from age 12 and up; younger participants receive participation medals. Throwing and jumping measurements are conducted with advanced technology from Leica Geosystems. A preliminary daily program is available for download. Terrain may be affected by repairs to all-weather surfaces; medals for the top three in each discipline for ages 12 and older; online registration via easyrecord.se

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a Backyard Ultra event in Växjö that will be held as a Silver Ticket event in 2026. Participants run a lap of 6,706 meters starting every full hour; the first start is at 10:00 AM, and the race follows last-man-standing rules according to general Backyard Ultra principles. The course is varied and easy to run, with both asphalt and gravel/trail sections to enable participants to stay as long as possible. The laps and finish line are at the southern shore of Trummen, with services in the lap area for runners and accompanying persons.
course_highlights: Lap of 6,706 meters - 24 laps equal 100 miles (160.93 km)
Approximately 35 meters of elevation gain per lap
About 3 km asphalt per lap, the rest gravel and trail; lap at Trummen’s southern shore near playground, skatepark, and swimming area
additional: The organizer offers an energy table in the lap area with sports drinks (Umara), water, Coca Cola, coffee, candy, chips, and fruit; cooked food is served every six hours, with the first serving after four hours. Completing at least one lap earns a medal from Yoga Wood and a Finisher Beer from Tomorrow Brewing. Participants may set up small tents and chairs in the lap area. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen (line 3), and the recommended parking lot is at Ica Kvantum Teleborg (fee approximately 10 SEK per day). Participants who choose to withdraw must notify the race management to receive a result; they are not allowed to pass the start line and turn back (the course is one-way), but they can cross the line to change clothes, eat, or use the toilet. Energy and drink stations with sports drinks, water, cola, coffee, candy, chips, and fruit are available; food is served every six hours (starting after four hours). A medal is awarded for completing at least one lap, and a Finisher Beer awaits at the finish line. The race is accessible by public transport and parking regulations are in effect.

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS - Trail Through Skåne is a trail race offering running on beautiful paths in Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves with start and finish at The Treehouse (Hovdala, Hässleholm). The race offers four distances (TGS 60, 35, 25, and 10 km), with TGS 60 run as two laps (35+25 km). The new route for 2026 is more technical and has less asphalt (under 3 km) for closer contact with nature. The race suits runners of different levels who want to enjoy forest terrain and well-marked courses.
course_highlights: Running on beautiful trails in Göinge and Hovdala nature reserves
TGS 60 is two laps (35+25 km) - more technical course and less than 3 km asphalt
Water stations at km 13.2 and 24.6; start/finish at The Treehouse (Hovdala)
additional: Start and finish at The Treehouse (Hovdala, Hässleholm). TGS 60: 61.7 km with 1060 m D+ / D- (maximum time 9h15min, cut-off time at lap change 13:30). TGS 35: 35.1 km, 600 m+/-, start at 09:30, finish closes at 17:00. TGS 25: 26.6 km, 460 m+/-, start at 10:45, finish closes at 17:00. TGS 10: 10.2 km, 200 m+/-, start at 13:45. Water stations (VK) offer food, water, cola, and sports drinks (located at km 13.2 and 24.6 depending on the distance). Registration is binding after payment; the organizer recommends that runners purchase a race insurance. Start: The Treehouse at Hovdala; various distances (50, 25/27, 10 km); restrictions include no trekking poles and carrying a mobile phone, water, and energy supplies; maximum and cut-off times according to the website; free parking near start/finish; water stations as needed during hot days; results and food after the race.

name: KK-joggen / Sparbanksjoggen, Katrineholm
description: Sparbanksjoggen in Katrineholm is one of Sweden's leading recreational races and Katrineholm's largest sporting event with approximately 1500 participants and up to 8000 spectators. The race offers categories for both elite and recreational runners, with distances from 1.1 km for children to 10 km for adults. It is a well-organized running festival with prizes, medals, and T-shirts for all participants, and a friendly atmosphere with lots of spectators and officials. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and follows their competition rules for children and youth.
course_highlights: Courses from 1.1 km for children to 10 km for adults
Measured 10 km course according to Swedish Athletics Association rules
Start and finish in Katrineholm city center with audience support
additional: Number bib and T-shirt are collected at the race office in Magasinet next to the Travel Center, Fabriksgatan 1, Katrineholm. The race office is open on August 4th from 12:00 to 18:00 and on August 5th from 11:00 to 21:00. After the finish, medals, chocolate bars, and bananas are handed out to all who complete the race. Prize money is awarded in the 10 km race to the top eight men and women as training grants to their athletics clubs. Sibling discounts and group registration with discounts are available. The race follows the Swedish Athletics Association's rules and is sanctioned. The race takes place on August 11, 2026, with registration at Magasinet near the Travel Center in Katrineholm. The event is a celebration for the entire municipality and attracts thousands of spectators and participants.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is an open marathon race starting and finishing at the square in Löttorp. The course is very flat and easy to run, completely paved, offering views towards Blå Jungfrun. The race consists of an inner loop of 2.1 km and an outer loop of 11.2 km, which are repeated three times to reach 42.195 km. The event is organized by Högby IF and is aimed at recreational runners and veteran classes according to specified categories.
course_highlights: Very flat and easy-to-run marathon course
100% asphalt, measured by federation course measurer Carl-Gustaf Nilsson
Start and finish at the square in Löttorp; 2.1 km inner loop + 11.2 km outer loop repeated 3 times, view towards Blå Jungfrun
additional: Number bibs can be collected from 12:00. Three water stations per lap (approximately 13.3 km) offering sports drink (Umara), Coca-Cola, and water; personal energy supplements must be submitted at least one hour before start. All finishers receive a medal/fossil in Öland limestone; ÖM medals for the top two in each category. Winners in the women's and men's categories will receive a dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp. Accommodation is available in 4-bed cabins at Högby IP. Water stations: three per lap. The course consists of a 2.1 km stretch in Löttorp followed by an 11.2 km stretch Löttorp - Alvedsjö - Kalmarsund - Gudesjö - Löttorp, repeated three times for a total of 42.195 km. Start and finish at the square in Löttorp; accommodation information available via links on the organizer's website.

name: Ångaloppet Trail
description: Ångaloppet is a welcoming swimrun event at Ånga gård with the goal "swimrun for everyone". The 2026 races will be held on August 8 and include several distances and events for different levels, including 22 km, 11 km, Trail, 5 km, and Family. The courses offer varied nature with forest trails, gravel roads, and hilly technical terrain; the swimrun races also include multiple swimming sections in both lake and sea. Organizers emphasize an inviting atmosphere for participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Varied forest, trails, and gravel roads
Hilly and technical terrain suitable for trail running
Location between Lake Ången and the Baltic Sea - a combination of running and swimming (for swimrun distances)
additional: The event in 2026 consists of five races on the same day (August 8): 22 km, 11 km, Trail, 5 km, and Family. For the 22 km race: loop course (11 km per lap), approximately 20 swimming sections (the longest about 190 m, the shortest about 30 m), six water stations along the course, and a cut-off time at the turn of 2.5 hours. Team changes are possible for a fee of 400 SEK - email info@angaloppet.se. The courses are marked and the start group 1 (earliest start) is scheduled for 10:00 AM. Ångaloppet Trail is a new distance in the 2026 program. Team changes possible for a fee of 400 SEK. More information about equipment, safety, accommodation, and parking can be found on the race website.

name: Kräftivalloppet
description: Kräftivalloppet is a running race in Tidaholm that is part of Kraftivalen and takes place near the Old Square. The adult race requires registration via motionsloppet.se, while children’s and senior races are without pre-registration. Warm-up before the races is done in collaboration with Hälsocenter, and the event is open to the whole family. Children’s race from 7 years old is about 600 meters per lap (up to three laps), walker- and senior races are about 600 meters, and children from 2 years old about 400 meters.
course_highlights: Part of Kraftivalen in Tidaholm with start/area around the Old Square
Adult race requires pre-registration via motionsloppet.se; children’s and senior races without pre-registration
Short children’s and senior races with distances around 400 - 600 meters per lap
additional: Warm-up before the races with Hälsocenter

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 470 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 520 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: duoklass: 940 kr per par (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar duolopp 1040 kr)

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a summer race on Vikbolandet in Östergötland where participants can choose to run or cycle. The main route is approximately 45 km long and largely runs on country roads and gravel (about 50/50), with several energy stations and tastings from local farms along the way. There are categories for runners, cyclists, duos, and children, and the event has a clear focus on local producers and a genuine farm environment. Registered participants receive a foldable cup (reusable mug) to bring during the race to avoid disposable cups.
course_highlights: Main route approximately 45 km, about 50/50 gravel and asphalt
Energy stations at several local farms with delicacies and opportunities for farm visits
Opportunities for meetings and tastings at farms with animals (ostriches, alpacas, llamas)
additional: Limited number of participants in the main race (300). Online registration is open until August 4; late registration can be done from 09:00 at the start area until 30 minutes before each start signal (if spots are available). Registered participants receive a foldable cup that must be used during the race. The children's race (approximately 700 m or 1,400 m) does not require prior registration and is free of charge thanks to ICA's sponsorship (children receive a medal and ice cream). Toilets and showers are available at APPTEK's premises (open approximately 09:30 - 18:30). The running category has timing and prizes for the top three in both women’s and men’s categories; cycling and duo categories have specific rules (helmet mandatory, e-bike not allowed, duo pairs can exchange unlimited times but must keep a maximum distance of 100 m). Group warm-up before start. Energy stations with water and sports drinks; registered participants receive a foldable cup; medals for all; not sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; helmet mandatory when cycling; start/finish in a trail environment with lighting; medical staff present; rules regarding image rights. Register at vikbovandan.se/472-2/ or via the registration page on the main website.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Jönköping - a recreational race to raise awareness of the need for blood donation where you can walk, jog, or run. In Jönköping, timed races are offered at 5 km and 10 km, as well as a 5 km walk without timing. For children, there is the Little Blood Race (approximately 700 meters) which has a common start and medal. The race gathers participants in teams and traditionally ends with a picnic.
course_highlights: Selectable distances: 5 km and 10 km (with timing) as well as a 5 km walk (without timing)
Little Blood Race: approximately 700 meters for children up to 12 years, common start and medal; start from Knektaparken
Event area at Knektaparken with a traditional common picnic after the finish line
additional: Team registration consists of 3 - 5 participants; registered blood donors receive a 40 SEK discount if indicated at registration. Changes (e.g., from 10 km to 5 km) cost 50 SEK upon modification and presenting the order ID during pickup; on the day of the race (August 11), only Swish or cash payment are accepted. Payment terms are otherwise 30 days with multiple options (Swish, card via Swedbank Pay, postal giro, invoice). Team registration and individual registrations have different prices; discounts for blood donors and a fee for invoice. Bib numbers are collected at Hovslätts IK's clubhouse or at the start, and the award ceremony takes place at 19:30.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km) 180 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar (max 15st per anmälan) 900 kr (Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km)

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is an open and spectator-friendly city race scheduled for August 14, 2026, with start and finish on Storgatan in Vetlanda. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km on an easy-to-run loop course, and there are several children and youth categories as well as a Funktionsklass (disability class). Number bibs can be collected and late registration is available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day, and the event is combined with activities and light food service at the square. We photograph and film during the race, and images may be used in future marketing.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Storgatan in the center of Vetlanda
Easy-to-run, spectator-friendly loop course (5 km or 10 km)
Children and youth distances from 400 m up to 1.7 km as well as a 1 km Funktionsklass
additional: Number bibs can be collected and late registration is available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. Late registration can be done no later than 30 minutes before the respective start time, with on-site payment possible via Swish (additional fee applies for late registration). Timing is done with a chip in the bib by Racetimer, and results are published live on Racetimer's website as well as on OK Njudung's website. The event includes activities and light food service at the square; the organizer photographs and films during the race. Participants can walk/jog/run at their own pace; late registration on site for a fee; photography/filming during the race that may be used in marketing.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a festive evening race on Södermalm held on August 15, 2026, offering 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km distances, as well as several children’s and disability-friendly races. The race is characterized by late start times, music, spectators, and activities along the course, creating a unique and lively atmosphere. The 21 km class runs two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm, which is described as relatively hilly. The organizer emphasizes community, running joy, and that the event suits both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: 21 km = two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm
Relatively hilly course - inclines and the character of the district
Music, samba rhythms, and spectators along the course create a festival atmosphere
additional: Start/ warm-up location: Ringvägen 26. Finish line: Hornsgatan 57. The registration fee includes a t-shirt from Björn Borg (this year's color/print), precise timing, sports drinks and water along the course, as well as a cold Vitamin Well, fruit, and energy bar at the finish; medals can be purchased during registration and a digital diploma is offered. There is an option to use wellness providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits) and instructions for redemption codes are available; group registration grants a 50 SEK discount per person. Information about start groups, shirts, race kits, and dedicated pages for companies can be found on the organizer’s website. The digital Midnattsloppet runs from September 12 to September 20.

name: 6 sjöar
location: Fjällnora friluftsgård, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Six Lakes is a volunteer-organized running event held on August 15, 2026, starting and finishing at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Area outside Uppsala. You can choose between a marathon (42 km around six lakes), half marathon (21 km around four lakes), 10.3 km, or a shorter 5.5 km course around Ramsen – all routes are well marked and feature varied forest trails and gravel roads. The race is environmentally friendly (few disposable cups, option to get a reusable cup or Hydrapouch) and offers free direct buses from Uppsala Central Station; the organizers work voluntarily. It is a nature-oriented race where swimming along the course may be possible in warm weather, and the start times are scheduled so that different distances can be run simultaneously by families and friends.
course_highlights: Marathon around six lakes; half marathon around four lakes – scenic views by several waters
Easy-to-run courses mostly on small gravel roads and shorter trails, with some technical sections (5 km has tricky trails and bridges)
Opportunity to take a dip along the course in warm weather and water stations on the routes
additional: Start and finish at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Area. Start times: Marathon 10:00, Half Marathon 10:30, 10 km 11:00, 5 km 11:30. Bibs can be collected at Uppsala Central Station Thursday – Friday before the race from 11:00 to 19:00 or on site no later than 30 minutes before the start. Free direct buses from Uppsala Central Station (fossil fuel-free) and information/timetable are published by the organizer. The race avoids disposable cups – bring your own bottle or get a free reusable cup/Hydrapouch; no free T-shirts but the option to purchase one after finishing. The event is organized voluntarily; questions can be directed to info@6sjoar.se, and contact details for registration are provided on the contact page. The race offers detailed maps and GPX files via the 'Choose Race' page; fewer disposable cups and a reminder to bring your own bottle or use Hydrapouch. Registration is online, and bibs are collected at Uppsala Central Station or before the start.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Welcome to the Convinistafetten in Stockholm - a festive and team-building relay race at Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården. The event takes place over two late summer evenings (August 19-20, 2026), and each team consists of five people, with each participant running 5 km. There is also a walk category for those who prefer to walk together. As an extra highlight, title sponsor Convini offers all teams a picnic after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Five legs of 5 km each - each team member runs 5 km
Start and finish area at the exchange zone in Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården
Picnic on the grass after crossing the finish line (Convini provides all teams)
additional: Registration is per team (5 persons). The walk team starts separately, and everyone in the walk team walks 5 km together. The team leader registers the team and receives information as well as all five bib numbers by mail; the runner of the last leg picks up the picnic box at the picnic tent. The picnic is included in the registration (details announced in May), and extra picnic boxes can be booked for 495 SEK each. Tents (Basic or Premium) can be booked as optional add-ons; orders are confirmed and tent placement communicated before the event. The age limit for running 5 km is 13 years. A walk category is available; start times are according to bib number (e.g., first team at 17:30, later at 17:33, 17:36); chip timing on the bib; changing rooms at Frescati Sports Center for 40 SEK; RSIF offers a subsidized member price with a deadline of August 16 at 18:00 for discount code; parking and public transport information is available.

name: BAUHAUS-galan Youth & Masters
location: Stockholms stadion, Stockholm, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: BAUHAUS-galan Youth & Masters is a prestigious athletics competition held at Stockholm Stadium, one of the world's most iconic athletics venues. The event welcomes youth aged 12 to 19 as well as veterans aged 35 and older, including para-athletics. With an atmosphere characterized by a gala feel and camaraderie, the event offers excellent competition conditions on Sweden's fastest running tracks. Participants have the chance to compete in an environment where world elite athletes also meet during the BAUHAUS-galan Diamond League.
course_highlights: Competition at Stockholm Stadium, the world's oldest active Olympic arena
High-tech VMAX running tracks from Conica for a fast and even surface
Competition disciplines for youth, veterans, and para-athletics
additional: The spectator area opens preliminarily at 14:00 with preliminary competitions from 16:30 and main events from 17:00. The event includes a family festival with activities and food service. It is recommended to reach the stadium by public transport, walking, or cycling. Safety measures are well planned with staff and medical teams on site. Includes live results, live streaming, and social events such as After Track.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Night Run in Kalmar is a night race of 5.0 km that offers a atmospheric running experience along the streets of Kalmar with music, lighting, and surprises along the course. Start and finish are at Stortorget, and the race is open to walkers, joggers, and competitive runners. Everyone who completes the race receives the Night Run medal, and those who register by August 16th also receive the race's unique shirt. The organizer is Högby IF (athletics).
course_highlights: Start, lap, and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
5.0 km in city environment along Kalmar's streets with music, lighting, and surprises
Walking class 5 km without timing offered
additional: Number bib and late registration can be collected at the Högby tent on Stortorget Thursday, August 20th from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday, August 21st from 18:00; on-site late registration is accepted until 1 hour before the start. All participants receive a medal, drink, fruit, and a chocolate bar from ICA MAXI. Payment can be made by card, cash, or Swish. Contact information: Högby IF / friidrott@hogbyif.se, Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. Walking class 5 km without timing; number bib and late registration at the Högby tent on Stortorget August 20th from 15:00 to 17:00 and August 21st from 18:00; a unique night race shirt for pre-registrants until August 16th; drinks, fruit, and chocolate for all participants.

name: Karlskronaspelen
description: Karlskronaspelen is a popular athletics competition held in Karlskrona. The event welcomes both members and non-members and offers a fun and action-packed weekend with athletics training, play, and competition. The event is characterized by volunteer engagement where participants and parents are expected to contribute as officials. It is a great opportunity for youth to develop in athletics and participate in a well-organized competition weekend.
course_highlights: Held in Karlskrona, a beautiful coastal city
Includes various competition categories for runners and athletes
The event takes place on August 21, 2026
additional: The competition takes place in a volunteer-driven club environment where all active participants and parents are expected to help as officials. In 2026, a new format will be tested where different groups are responsible for different disciplines. There is also an official schedule for the competition days. Scandic Karlskrona offers discounted accommodation during the competition weekend. The event is open to participants of various ages and levels, and provides an inspiring competitive environment in a scenic setting.

name: Stockholm Trail
location: Hammarbyhöjdens IP, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Do you dream of winding trails, sunlit rocky outcrops, and lovely slopes? Stockholm Trail offers several well-marked trail runs in the beautiful Nacka Nature Reserve with start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field, near Stockholm city. The course is suitable for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners who want to try trail running. Welcome to a challenging, sweaty, and memorable trail event with encouraging staff and good service.
course_highlights: Technical forest trails and beautiful rocky outcrops with fantastic views in Nacka Nature Reserve
Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field, about a 5-minute walk from Hammarbyhöjden subway station
Multiple hydration stations (Umara sports drink) and bib with your name
additional: Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field; bibs can be collected on Friday 21/8 at Best Western Park City Hammarby Sjöstad from 16:00 to 19:00 or at the venue from 09:00 on race day. Wooden medal from Raw Cut Studio for finishers. Bag drop (supervised, free); possibility to shower and change indoors. Name change and course transfer free of charge until August 8 (contact sekretariat@stockholmtrail.se). Age limit 18 years for the 21K; maximum times: 4 hours for 21K and 3 hours for 10K. Hydration stations with water and Umara sports drink: 21K passes 5 stations, 10K 3 stations, 5K 1 station. Premium package with T-shirt and training sessions available; T-shirt can be purchased separately (349 SEK). Results published online immediately after finish; announcer, music, and refreshments at the venue. Distances include 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K Fun Run, and 2.5K Minitrail; start/finish at Hammarbyhöjden's sports field; hydration and energy stations along the course; baggage drop and bib pickup; finish area offers drinks, coffee, refreshments, as well as indoor shower and changing facilities; no T-shirt sales at the venue this year (purchase in Bagheeras shop).

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultramarathon in Lill‑Jansskogen in Stockholm with selectable distances of 50 or 100 miles. The race emphasizes endurance, nature experiences, and community, and is organized by Nisse and Anna Larsson through the association Hjorthagen Ultra SC. The start and finish are located at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with ample parking and proximity to subway and buses. The start times are 09:00 for 100 miles and 14:00 for 50 miles.
course_highlights: Magical forest sections in Lill‑Jansskogen
Steep hills and many elevation meters
Start/finish at Stora Skuggans väg 22 with good access to parking and public transport
additional: Maximum times are 32 hours for 100 miles and 16 hours for 50 miles. Max 100 participants. Start times: 100 miles at 09:00 and 50 miles at 14:00. Surplus proceeds to Suicide Zero.

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked loop course measuring 6,706 meters, and each participant has one hour to complete the loop. Then a new start occurs every full hour, and as long as you manage to complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the competition. The winner is the one who is the most persistent and ultimately gets to run a final solo lap! A fun race and concept with a very family-like atmosphere and camaraderie, where many participants set their distance records!

images.alt_text: Två män springer under en solig dag vid en sjö.
Deltagare serveras mat vid ett bord utomhus, troligen under ett lopp.
Deltagare springer på en grusväg under ett Backyard Ultra lopp i Sölvesborg.
Två löpare på en grusväg under ett lopp, omgivna av grönska och träd.

name: Viking Line Spelen
description: Viking Line Race is organized by Huddinge AIS Athletics and is held at Källbrinks IP in Huddinge. The event is part of the club's broad activities that include youth from 6 years old up to veteran level. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for athletes of various ages and levels, focusing on development and community. Huddinge AIS is an engaged club that also invests in para-athletics and veteran athletics.
course_highlights: The race is held at Källbrinks IP, a well-equipped athletics arena in Huddinge
The event includes multiple age groups from children to veterans
The club has a strong tradition in athletics and also focuses on para-athletics
additional: The event takes place at Källbrinks IP with access to clubhouse and gym facilities. The club also offers training and try-out activities for children and youth with intellectual disabilities. Policies for officials and other participation policies apply. The contact person for the race is Per Öhrland. The event will be held on August 24, 2026, and is part of Huddinge AIS's annual athletics program.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
description: Welcome to the Blood Race in Västerås at Rocklunda IP on August 26, 2026 - a recreational race for everyone where you can walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The Little Blood Race offers two children's races (approximately 1400 m and approximately 500 m) with warm-up and finish under the finish arch. The race is organized to raise awareness of the need for blood donation and traditionally ends with a picnic for teams and participants. Registration can be done individually or in teams (3 - 5 people) and information as well as the race pack are available on the race website.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklunda area (football fields north of the riding hall)
The routes for 5 km and 10 km are marked and have flag marshals placed along the course
Little Blood Race: two children's distances (~1400 m start at 17:15 and ~500 m start at 17:25), finish under the finish arch
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (a team of 3 - 5 participants, the cost always covers 5 participants and a picnic for 5 is included). Teams can be filled up to a maximum of 5 people until Monday 24/8 and the last day to register a team is indicated as 19/8; for larger companies, there is an option for customer side/rabatt code. Children in the Little Blood Race receive a medal and a goody bag from ICA Maxi Hälla; warm-up in front of the stage around 17:00 and children choose their distance on site. Registration is binding, no cancellations are accepted, and registration is possible until 26/8 at 17:30. Course and map materials are available on the race website (link to map). Registration via the website or on-site at Rocklunda IP from 15:00 on August 25 according to the information page; includes a functional T-shirt, bib number, and medal; team registration is allowed for 3 - 5 participants with the last regular registration date on August 20; course layout and start times will be announced by the organizer.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)
description: The NKPG City Norrköping City Run is organized by Tjalve Friidrott Norrköping and takes place with start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata in the heart of Norrköping. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km (10 km is 2 x 5 km) as well as the free children's race Lilla Lundbergsloppet. The course runs through classic Norrköping environments with well-filled spectator areas, several music stations, and a mix of elite runners and recreational runners. The event provides medals and sponsored products at the finish line, as well as options for team registration and timing or untimed participation.
course_highlights: City course through classic Norrköping environments with well-filled spectator areas
More than ten music stations along the route for extra encouragement
10 km = 2 x 5 km; start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata
additional: Start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata near Hötorget. Start times: Lilla Lundbergsloppet from 17:00 (four starts with 15-minute intervals), 10 km start at 18:30, 5 km start at 19:30. Optional timing or untimed participation for 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet (approximately 1,000 m) is free and limited to a maximum of 1,100 children; all children receive a medal and goodie bag. Bib distribution: XXL Ingelsta Tuesday, August 26 from 11:00 to 18:00 and at the partner village near the start and finish area on Wednesday, August 27 from 15:00 (late registration for 5 km and 10 km possible at bib distribution). Start lists and information about your start number will be published from the afternoon of Monday, August 25. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km; Lilla Lundbergsloppet is 1 km free for children; start and finish at Olai Kyrkogata; the course passes Lindens shopping center and includes music stations along the way; Lilla Lundbergsloppet has a maximum of 1,100 children; medals for all participants and a goodie bag; official results page available online.

name: Finnkampsloppet
location: Stockholms Stadion, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Finnkampen Run is a recreational race held in connection with Finnkampen at Stockholm Stadium. The race offers a 5-kilometer course for recreational runners, where participants have the chance to run in the yellow Sweden jersey and finish at the historic arena. There is also a children and youth race of 2 kilometers for age groups 10 - 12 years and 13 - 16 years. After the race, an After Run is organized at the Stadium where participants and spectators can enjoy the competitions and the atmosphere. The race is part of Finnkampshelgen and provides a unique opportunity to experience the athletics atmosphere up close.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stockholm Stadium
5 km recreational race with laps inside the arena
Children and youth race of 2 km for ages 10 - 16
additional: After the recreational race, an After Run is organized at the Stadium simultaneously with the first events of Finnkampen. The elite runners start at the Stadium and run a 2-kilometer course with laps inside the arena, providing the audience several opportunities to see them pass. The finish line is inside Stockholm Stadium. The event includes a 5 km recreational race, youth races, an elite race of 10 km, and is held at Stockholm Stadium during Finnkampshelgen. The event is open to all levels and offers a festive atmosphere for participants and spectators.

name: Östersjöspelen
location: Vägga IP, Karlshamn, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Östersjöspelen is an athletics competition held at Vägga IP in Karlshamn. The event welcomes athletes, coaches, and spectators for two days of competitions in a beautiful environment. All necessary information for participants and visitors is available on the website. The organizer is the Athletics Club IF Udd.
course_highlights: Athletics competition with participants from Sweden and Denmark
Held annually in Karlshamn, often at Vägga IP
Includes various age categories and competition formats
additional: The event includes both indoor and outdoor competitions, with participants from southern Sweden and Denmark, and is an important meeting place for athletes in the region.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
location: Kungliga slottet, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: adidas Stockholm Half Marathon is a half marathon of 21,098 meters that in 2026 will run for the 25th time through Stockholm's city center. The course is unique with both start and finish in the area between the Royal Palace, the Parliament House, and the Opera House, offering easily runnable streets through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm. The first start is at 15:30, and the event includes an Expo and bib number distribution in Kungsträdgården from August 27 to 29, as well as an after run in Kungsträdgården. The race is open from the year you turn 17, and registration is binding.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the area near the Royal Palace/Norrbro (city center)
Easily runnable course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan, and Södermalm
Passes, among others, Hornsbergstrand, Rålambshovsparken, and Söder Mälarstrand; detailed km‑passage available on the course
additional: Bib number distribution and Expo in Kungsträdgården from August 27 to 29; after run in Kungsträdgården at the finish line; registration is binding and the fee is non-refundable without a valid race insurance via Folksam; payment methods: internet banking, Visa, MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna; last day to report results for seeding: August 2, 2026; late registration (subject to availability) from August 24 to 29 until 1 hour before the first start. 21,098 km course; start at 15:30; expo in Kungsträdgården August 27-29; start/finish at the Royal Palace; after run in Kungsträdgården.

name: Trelleborgsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Klass 1-4, löpning 5 och 10 km : 195 kr vid föranmälan , 270 kr vid efteranmälan (efter 25/8)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Klass 5, gång 5 km : 125 kr vid föranmälan 175 kr vid efteranmälan (efter 25/8)

description: Trelleborg Race is a classic city run in Sweden's southernmost city with controlled, approved courses. The event offers 10 km and 5 km for runners as well as 5 km walking/pole walking, starting at Östervång Stadium and finishing in the City Park. The race uses gross time measurement with disposable chip timing and is aimed at competitive runners, corporate teams, and recreational runners. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and there is a team competition for companies, associations, and groups of friends.
course_highlights: Start at Östervång Stadium, finish in the City Park
Controlled, approved city course (gross time measurement)
Distances: 10 km and 5 km (also 5 km walking/pole walking) with separate number series per class
additional: Timing with disposable chip (Neptron), gross time. Bibs are collected no later than 45 minutes before the start at Östervång Stadium or at Söderslätt Hall's foyer on 28/8 from 17:00 to 19:00. Changing in Söderslätt Hall; clothes are transported in a car to the finish (departing once, typically at 10:10). Late registration is possible online until 45 minutes before the start and on-site up to 1 hour before each start. Team competition ("Fastest in town") for companies/organizations/groups of friends is registered via online registration (free of charge). The course is a city run in Trelleborg on gravel paths and sidewalks. Late registration online is possible for an increased fee. Bib collection takes place at Söderslätt Hall; timing is done with a disposable chip (Neptron), and results are published on trelleborgsloppet.se.

name: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon
description: Jönköping Marathon & Half Marathon is a welcoming city race taking place in 2026 on August 29th, offering beautiful views along Lake Vättern, through Jönköping and Huskvarna. The course has been redesigned for fewer elevation changes but maintains a varied profile with natural sections, crowd support, and several power zones; the marathon segment concludes with an impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge. The event attracts international participants and also features shorter races, a MINI children's race, as well as offers for companies and tent packages at the start/finish area.
course_highlights: Impressive finish on the Munksjö Bridge
Beautiful views along Lake Vättern, Jönköping, and Huskvarna with a redesigned course and fewer elevation changes
Marathon: 42,195 m with 12 hydration stations along the course + 1 at Start/Finish, an interactive map, and power zones
additional: Practical information from the website: registration can be done for up to five runners simultaneously; start certificates are not sent out; the marathon course has an interactive map and a downloadable PDF, power zones, and over 12 hydration stations; the organizer offers tent packages for companies at the start/finish and the possibility to use wellness vouchers. Distances: 21K (21,097.5 m) and 42K (42,195 m); includes relay race and MINI Jönköping Marathon for children. Energy and hydration stations along the course, chip timing, group registration for up to 5 runners, and a corporate village with tents at the start/finish.

name: Festivalloppet
description: Festivalloppet is SK Graal's annual running race in Strömsnäsbruk, which follows parts of the Lagan River. The race offers distances of 10 km and 4.8 km, as well as children’s and youth categories, and runs through beautiful surroundings along the river. The event is characterized by a local and friendly atmosphere where clubs, spectators, and volunteers contribute to a great experience. Results, start lists, and information are published on SK Graal's website; the 2025 edition had 173 registered participants and 167 finishers.
course_highlights: Along the Lagan River in Strömsnäsbruk
Distances of 10 km and 4.8 km
Children and youth categories and a friendly local atmosphere
additional: Registration and information via links on SK Graal's website; results, start lists, and photos are published there. The 2025 edition took place on August 30, 2025, in Strömsnäsbruk; 173 runners registered and 167 finished, with weather contributing to a higher late registration count. The site also links to results, start lists, photos, and an information sheet (PM Festivalloppet).

name: Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet (5 eller 10 km): 350 kr  t.o.m 12 augusti.

description: Join us in highlighting the vital blood donation at the Blood Race Växjö on September 2, 2026. The race offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps of a certified 5 km course) as well as the Little Blood Race for the youngest participants. Start and finish are in Linné Park, and the course is described as flat and fast with plenty of crowd support along the way. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally concludes with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linné Park in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, and certified 5 km course (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking route for the 5 km walk and a dedicated loop for the Little Blood Race (~600 m)
additional: Registration can be done individually or in teams (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members within the same team can participate in different distances. The last date to register a team is August 26, 2026. There is an Excel template for mass registrations, and the organizer can assist with customer pages/discount codes for companies registering more than 20 participants. Name changes and class/distance changes cost 50 SEK. Registration is open until the day of the event, and late registration on site in Linné Park is possible (the tent for late registration and bib distribution). The Little Blood Race runs on a separate loop in Linné Park with the same start/finish. Course details: start and finish in Linné Park; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration available; includes T-shirt, bib, medal, and goodie bag; water stations and storage are mentioned.

name: Blodomloppet (Östersund)
description: Blood Donation Run in Västerås is a fitness race that highlights the vital importance of blood donation and welcomes participants to walk, jog, or run 5 km or 10 km. The race also offers the Little Blood Donation Run for children in two different distances. Start and finish are at Rocklundaområdet with clearly marked courses and flag marshals. After the race, participants gather for a communal picnic, strengthening the social community around an important cause.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rocklundaområdet, the football fields north of the riding hall
Marked courses with flag marshals at strategic locations
Little Blood Donation Run for children with two distances of approximately 1400 m and 500 m around Rocklunda IP
additional: The race can be entered individually or in teams of 3-5 people, where the team fee includes a picnic for the entire team. The Little Blood Donation Run has two start times for children aged 1-12, 17:15 for approximately 1400 m and 17:25 for approximately 500 m. Warm-up takes place in front of the stage around 17:00. All participants receive a medal and a goody bag from ICA Maxi Hälla. The courses are marked and flag marshals are positioned. Registration is binding and no cancellations are accepted. The event includes blood donor activities, the possibility to participate with a dog, as well as information about parking and storage. Participants can register individually or in teams, and there is an option to rent tents and flags for the event.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women that will take place in 2026 in Södra Djurgården and through Stockholm city on September 5th. The race suits all levels - from walking to fast running - and is divided into start groups for smooth race flow. It offers a spectator-friendly course with both scenic natural sections and urban environments, as well as optional timing and prize money for the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course through Södra Djurgården and Stockholm city’s beautiful environments
Strong spectator support along the course and an energetic atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to approximately 6 km (start group 12) for those who wish
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out; registration is binding. Late registration is possible (subject to availability) digitally up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: internet banking, Visa/MasterCard, Swish, or invoice via Klarna. Age limit for Tjejmilen Stockholm: from the year you turn 15 (13 years with adult accompaniment). The start is divided into 12 start groups and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen-trail and Stockholm City race); start groups; age 15+; late registration possible; dogs are not allowed; planning information is available on the official website.

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden focusing on technical singletracks and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used by the 24h-ultra; there is also a 51 km race and a children's race. The course is technical and hilly with many small, steep hills and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity, sustainability, and that a large part of the fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop - used for 24h-ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many small hills
additional: Accommodation: options to sleep in the barn (20 - 30 places) or in tents on the area; social activities before and after the race include campfire, BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100 - 120 SEK, 13:00 - 15:00). 24h runners pass the base camp each lap; special moments for 24h ("chainsaw segment") - see race rules. Cut-off for the 24h-ultra is Sunday, 6.09.2026. The event offers separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support to find night companions for dark laps. Swish donation to WAR Child 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively donate via the respective NGO's website. Registration requires proof of donation to War Child or another NGO; the event includes options for multiple distances and a child-friendly trail.

name: LöpRallarn
location: Bottnaryds IP, Bottnaryd, Ljungby Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen series and is organized by Bottnaryds IF. The race offers shorter distances (noted as 7.5 km and 15 km) and attracts both youth and recreational runners - for example, the 2025 event had around 102 participants. The start is held at Bottnaryds IP and the race is conducted as a late summer activity in the area around Bottnaryd. The organizer presents results and contact information via the responsible email for the race.
course_highlights: Small hilly loop near Bottnaryds IP (referenced as an 8 km loop in the Rallarloppet description)
Section following parts of the old disused railway embankment
Passes through natural areas near Dumme Mosse
additional: Previous editions (2025) included both 7.5 km and 15 km distances and many youth on the start list; the organizer publishes results via the same website and email provided. LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen series along with RallarLoppet (skiing) and CykelRallarn. Throughout the natural surroundings, the Rallarloppen framework offers start and finish at Bottnaryds IP; LöpRallarn is offered in several distances (1 km, 2 km, 7.5 km, and 15 km) suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women's fitness run organized by the Marathongruppen in Uppsala on May 7, 2026. The race offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km with start and finish at Studenternas IP. Participants can register as individuals or as part of a team of five people, and timing can be opted out for a simpler experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are offered a picnic and the focus is on community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Team registration (5 people) or individual participation with optional timing
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; digital registration; early registrations encouraged; team consisting of five people; after the finish, a picnic is offered to the team. Distance options are 2.5 km or 5 km (5 km is measured); start and finish at Studenternas IP. Team registrations (teams of 5) are provided with a picnic after the finish; registration can be made until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start, and timing can be opted out.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a historic race for all ages, with a children's race in the morning and an adult race at 12:30 PM. There are two classes to choose from, 6 and 12 kilometers, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it's not completely flat...), starting and finishing on Ålstensgatan, which offers perhaps the most magnificent starting line in the race world. In between, runners will experience running through Bromma's streets, where the feeling is like running through gardens in apple blossom. This experience is enhanced by many neighbors coming out to cheer or even setting up their own small water stations or sprinklers — each refreshing in their own way. Among other things, this has given rise to the race's slogan: Stockholm's most charming running race.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK is organizing for the 53rd time an evening race during Hörby market with three different distances:

Market Race 12.6 km: competition class starts at 18:30, recreational class starts at 18:40

Bil-Månsson Race 6.1 km: all start at 18:50.

CAN-CAN Race 3.4 km: all start at 19:00.

The race starts and ends within Hörby town center, with large parts run in forest environment.
Varied terrain: asphalt, gravel roads, trails. See maps.

Don't miss this opportunity!
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu - right up until the race begins.

Late registration can be done at the Lågehallen entrance (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Directions from Riksväg 13. 55.8552,13.6528

All information regarding preparations, registration, course, and directions can be found at: 
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

Karta över Hörby Marknadslopp med tre olika distanser markerade
Karta över Hörby Marknadslopps banor med distanser 12,6 km, 6,1 km och 3,4 km.
