name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is this year's most generous race, where running joy meets beautiful nature in Djurgården. With a course that winds along gravel and asphalt roads, the race offers a delightful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 registered participants receive a specially designed t-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, there is a relaxing After Run with grilling and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. Additionally, part of the registration fee goes to Sweden for UNHCR, making every step meaningful – both for you and someone in need.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Athletics invites everyone from elite athletes to cheerful recreational runners and children to participate in a winter race on our streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Challenging ice, slush, wonderful winter crispness, or a fast asphalt course awaits those who participate and watch.
The New Year's Race is a pleasant occasion to be a little active before the New Year's feast and to sum up the year. And as some say; "What you do on New Year's Eve, you will do the rest of the year"! So take the opportunity to be active, bring a friend, and run or jog around the course.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners, and families. In 2026, a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories), as well as 10 km and 5 km recreational races, will be offered, and this year's edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. The start is at 13:00 at each starting point, and the finish line is at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish nature and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The race follows Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at the sports ground Bergvallen in Borensberg
Scenic stretch in beautiful Swedish nature along the canal route
additional: Transport: buses are arranged from Borensberg to each start location (half marathon to Ljungsbro, 10 km to Sjöbacka, 5 km to Brunneby) and are booked/paid for during registration (no transport offered after the finish; seat on race day possible subject to availability). The bus fare listed on registration pages is 100 SEK. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; price per runner is 20% lower than individual registration, and team registration can only be done online. Bib numbers are collected at each start location. Registration is valid only after payment is received; if payment is not received within 10 days, the registration is canceled. A detailed information sheet (PM) will be provided later. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; bus to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bank transfer; late registration between 11:30 - 12:30 with increased price; bib-laps are collected at the start location.

name: VAIS-loppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Loppet är gratis för medlemmar i Växjö AIS.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: För dig som inte är medlem är anmälningsavgiften 50 kronor.

description: VAIS Race is a pleasant cross-country race in the Fylleryd nature reserve organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km, where the long course follows large parts of the Trestugespåret trail and becomes hilly towards the end, while the short course follows the illuminated trail. The start for both courses is at VAIS-torpet at 6:30 PM, and the event concludes with coffee. The race is free for members of Växjö AIS; for non-members, the registration fee is 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
Long course (8.4 km) follows large parts of Trestugespåret and is particularly hilly at the end
Short course (4.4 km) follows the illuminated trail and both courses end with a long uphill section towards VAIS-torpet
additional: The race instructions will be published on April 28; map and course profile are available as PDF; registration is indicated to open via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event concludes with coffee at VAIS-torpet. Cross-country race in Fyllerydsskogen with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the participation fee.

name: Altorp Ultra
description:
Join us for an epic day.
Altorp 6.7 km loop - ‘Långa gula‘.
~120m of elevation per loop.
May 10 2025, between 10:00 and 18:00.
As many laps as you can in 8 hours.
Go further than you think.
Challenge yourself, friends and family.
course_highlights: Altorp 6.7 km loop called ‘Långa gula‘
Approximately 120 meters of elevation gain per loop
Event date: May 10, 2025
Run as many laps as possible within 8 hours
Encouragement to go further than you think
Open to individuals, friends, and family

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year's Run is a perfect way to get active during the holiday season. Now in its 42nd year, Vallentuna Athletics invites you to run on New Year's Eve, with the race attracting everyone from elite runners to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can offer challenging terrain or fast asphalt; we never know until race day. Keep an eye on weather forecasts and read our information. Statistically, the terrain has been favorable for running most years, as reflected in the results from previous years.

Above all, the New Year's Run is a pleasant way to come together to close out the old year and something to talk about during the celebrations later in the day.

You're also welcome, see you there!
additional: Remember that the New Year's Run is a winter race and the terrain can vary from year to year. In some years, studded shoes may be recommended.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme - VMX
description:
On September 14, 2025, it's time for what we've all been looking forward to, namely Vånga Mountain Xtreme - VMX 2025! Under new management by FK Göingarna, the race will continue with the same format, high-quality organization, and joy for running!
Three challenging and fun races are offered. Choose between 8 km, 16 km, or 40 km demanding trail running, with 300 m, 600 m, and 1500 m of elevation gain respectively.
After conquering the tough Vångabacken, you will encounter winding trails in pristine wilderness, along small tranquil lakes and deep quarries. A equally beautiful and challenging course with start and finish at the foot of Vångabacken!
Registration is open. Do you accept the challenge!?

name: Öllsjö Löpfest
description:
Warmly welcome to Öllsjö Löpfest on June 28!

The countdown to the start has already begun and now only a few days remain. Registrations with runners of all ages continue to come in, so it looks like it could be another wonderful family celebration. Below, we have gathered all the necessary information you may need. Whether you have signed up for one of our races or just want to come as a visitor.

Please also follow us on Instagram and Facebook where we post information continuously before and during the event.

Location: Öllsjö School
Date: June 28, 2025
Time: The event area is open from 10:00 to 14:00
Routes:
Children's race 450m
Children's race 1700m
Race 5km
Trail mix race 7.5km

Registration is done via RaceID at the following link: https://raceid.com/sv/races/13187/about

Registration fees:
Children's race: 100 SEK

5km & 7.5km:
Until January 31: Early bird price 175 SEK
February 1 - June 22: Regular price 200 SEK
June 23 - June 27: Late registration 225 SEK
On-site registration June 28: 250 SEK

name: SpriT Frontyard Torup (Malmö)
description:
SpriT Frontyard - Sprint Trail Frontyard Torup 2025

Bokskogen premiere
A fast course in a new area that allows you to run your personal best and maybe even see a SpriT Frontyard world record! A small, moderately technical trail at the start and a lovely 250m hill after 600m.
Bokskogen at its best!!!

Do you want to test your ability to combine your speed and running strategy? Then this is definitely the right race for you!
The lap is 1 km (Light Trail) and you run as many times as you can or until the clock stops you!
Course layout 2025:
Explore SpriT Frontyard Torup - 2025 | AllTrails

First lap you have 10 minutes
Second lap 9'40''
Third 9'20'' ...
Will anyone be able to run 21K?
Everyone can participate! – You’ll probably manage at least 5 or 10K

When: Torup (at the parking lot Kejsarvägen)
Date: 03/08 - 9:00 AM

Water / cola and always some other nice "food" at the lap turn
Prizes to ... many/most
Registration fee: 230 SEK - Limited number of spots!!!

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
General
Registration is binding after payment. As organizers, we recommend you to purchase insurance that provides compensation if you miss the race due to injury or illness. For example, Folksams motion race insurance or Startklar.

Participation is at your own risk.

name: Byaloppet
description:
Byaloppet 2025 in Rickarum!
Our newly started race with children's race, 5km and 10km
There will be food and coffee sales on site. A gathering place for the entire community.
Registration takes place on the same day.
See the website for further information later.
additional: Start and finish at the large tent in the middle of the village!

name: Glädjeruset
description: Joy Race is the race where everyone can participate. Choose from different distances. Walk, roll, or run! The Toddler Race for the youngest. Many fun activities on site for the whole family. The proceeds go to Hugo's Foundation.
course_highlights: Choose from different distances
Walk, roll, or run
Toddler Race for the youngest
Many fun activities for the whole family
Proceeds go to Hugo's Foundation

name: Lejonbragden
description: The race takes place on an 8-shaped 10 km course, mostly paved bike and pedestrian path, passing the depot every 5 km. This is Sweden's oldest 100 km race! In addition to 100, 50, and 30 km, there is also a DUO class where two runners share the 100 km at their own pace, in relay format.

name: Tjejstafetten
organizer: Stiftelsen Tjejkraft Tillsammans och Tjejstafetten AB
description:
The Women's Relay is Sweden's first women's relay race at Stockholm Stadium.
But it is much more than that – it is a new way to make a difference.
Each participating team donates 500 SEK directly from the registration fee to nine organizations focused on women, which amounts to 100 SEK per person at each relay exchange. We call it charitable exchange rate.

Welcome to a folk festival filled with joy of movement and community!
additional:
Here's how it works:
You run in teams of 5 women, and it is you and your team who choose which class to participate in, and whether you will run, jog, or walk around the course.

The relay is divided into two classes:
- Recreational class 3 km per person without timing
- Competition class 5 km per person with timing.

Start, exchange, and finish inside Stockholm Stadium with lovely loops in Lill-Jansskogen.

Gather your team of 5 friends, family, or colleagues – register today!

Tjejstafetten logotyp med tre kvinnosymboler och texten Tjejstafetten.

name: Nordiska Mästarnas Backyard Ultra
description:
Location:
Fyskompaniet Training Center at Rattens gränd 1, Bromölla

Venue:
The venue is located adjacent to the entrance of Fyskompaniet. The area is paved; we will know in early October whether we can hold the event indoors in a large warehouse or outside on the asphalt in a large event tent. The start and finish will be outside on the asphalt area, where there is also the possibility to set up smaller tents.

Course:
The course is carefully assembled with the following surfaces to generate as many laps as possible and is currently suitable for 81 laps. Asphalt 2530m, Grass 152m, Path 1301m, Gravel/Field road 2700m, Wooden bridge 23m, with approximately 30 meters of elevation.
Trash bins are located at approximately 1 km, 3 km, and 6 km.
Please check the route on this YouTube video www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBX3idm2zDo; however, the start will differ slightly from the video depending on how we set the start in October. Additionally, the entire course is beautifully colored by the hues of autumn.
The entire course is marked with fabric ribbons with reflectors. The course is also marked with arrows at all junctions or where there may be uncertainty.

Energy Station:
There will always be a well-stocked energy station with water, sports drinks, food, snacks, and other items you might need for long-distance running.

We will also set up:

Dinner: after 17:00 per lap
Evening sandwich after 20:00 per lap
Breakfast: between 05:30-07:30 - from Sunday
Lunch: after 11:00 per lap - from Sunday
And so on... We always offer vegan and gluten-free options.

Changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets:
The changing rooms are located close to the venue. There are spacious changing rooms for women and men with multiple showers and a sauna. Toilets are also available.
Toilets on the venue will be in the form of portable toilets, accessible before and after the start.

Start:
Saturday, October 11th at 10:00

Finish:
When the last runner completes their final lap

Rules:
We follow the official rules which can be found here ultrasignup.com/register.aspx?did=113992

Timing / Results:
Timing is done with a chip attached around the ankle. The time is registered at the lap portal after each completed lap.

Accommodation:
We have a couple of suggestions for those traveling from afar:

Hotell Iföhus
Approximately 1.3 km from the venue
hotellifohus.se/

Bromölla Camping & Hostel
Approximately 0.8 km from the venue
bromollacamping.se/

There is no possibility to camp on the event site.

Spectators:
Feel free to come and cheer on your friends; the easiest way is to follow them from the start area. It is also a pleasant environment near Käsebron or along the northern parts along Lilla Kungsleden.

Race Management:
Jimmy Schön: 076 105 73 77
Anna Schön: 073 355 64 68
Email: tavling@fyskompaniet.se

name: Oskarshamn Backyard 6h
description:
Run a marathon distance in a backyard format!

A backyard race that lasts for 6 hours. One lap of 6.7 km every hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one lap of 8.7 km. Total 42.195 km. If you complete the race, you have run a marathon! The first to cross the finish line on the last lap wins.

The course mostly runs on the exercise trail and is generally accessible, though with moderate elevation changes.

Registration is done via https://raceid.com/sv/races/13769

images.alt_text: Löpare på en skogsstig under Oskarshamn Backyard 6h terränglopp.

name: Tyresö Night Run
description: 10 km, 5 km and kids' race. The kids' race is free. See more information on the website.

images.alt_text: Karta över Tyresö Night Run 10 km och 5 km med höjdprofiler.

name: Stockholm Santa Run
description: This year's best race with a Santa-red theme! Santa Run is approximately 3 km, or alternatively 6 km, long for everyone. You can choose to walk, power walk, jog, or run – the choice is yours! A race where you run, walk, or roll dressed in a Santa costume to raise money for charity. Join us for this year's most festive day with community, atmosphere, and joy for the whole family in the heart of Stockholm! The entire city transforms into a running Christmas celebration with mulled wine, gingerbread cookies, and of course, a medal! Purchase your starting spot including a Santa costume today. All proceeds go to children and young people with disabilities, for an active life according to their own conditions. WELCOME!
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km or 6 km race
Dress in a Santa costume
Fundraising for children with disabilities
Festive atmosphere with mulled wine and gingerbread
Medal for all participants
Family-friendly event in Stockholm

images.alt_text: Affisch för Stockholm Santa Run med texten "Your steps Their hope" och en tomte.

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail was started in 2015 and can be described as a fitness race where nature, community, and experience are in focus, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers a fantastic opportunity for all runners, regardless of level, to participate in three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail), and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place in the beautiful nature around Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has an elevation gain of 500 meters.

name: Uddloppet
description:
Uddloppet is a spring race in Karlshamn, Blekinge, aimed at both recreational and elite runners. It is a perfect start to the running season and a good way to assess fitness after winter training.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Distances:
4 km (09:45)
10 km (11:00)
Half marathon (11:00)
Children's race 400 m (10:30)
Walking class 2.5 km (between 09:00-13:00)
Course: Scenic and gently hilly route along the sea and through the forest east of Karlshamn. Start and finish at Vägga sports ground.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Practical info: Parking at Vägga IP, changing rooms and showers in Väggahallen. Bib numbers can be collected at Intersport in Karlshamn from Wednesday to Saturday, or on race day at the secretariat.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

The race also offers activities for the whole family with mascot, award ceremony, face painting, and on-site catering.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
Warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very beautiful, approximately 15 km long course. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 meters of elevation. Expect great views and a tough run, mostly in hilly terrain, mostly on trails, sometimes unpaved but also on a few gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred meters.

New for 2026
• Be at the start line already in April! This time we are running in early spring, so mark April 18th in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born 2014 or later).
• The Brain Race, a virtual race that runs for 18 days where the entire registration fee goes directly to the Brain Foundation and vital research on epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we will run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to ensure you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What is not new for 2026
• The course, a tough and very beautiful route around Flatensjön.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test that we do not believe anyone can complete. Prove us wrong and you will earn both honor and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All info on the organizer's website

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km lap course with 400 meters of elevation gain. Total distance over five laps is 50 km with 2000 meters of elevation gain. Technical trail on single track and animal trails in dramatic forest! Welcome
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with approximately 400 m climb per loop (50 km / approximately 2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love to run ourselves and forms the foundation of the entire trail weekend. A perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat, and tears reminiscent of spectacular races in our Swedish mountains as well as in the Alps of Europe. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long delightful downhill sections, and stunning views. In between, you enjoy winding trail running through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 offers at least 500 meters of elevation gain and is perfect for those training for mountain marathons and similar races.

NEW FOR 2025!

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
price_range: 42€ für den Marathon, 99€ für die Staffel
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany's first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The runs take place exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea coast, without asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural and running experience directly by the sea. Participants can choose from a marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or a relay marathon. The event combines sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program at the finish area in Ahlbeck.
course_highlights: Running exclusively on sand without asphalt or road traffic
Start in Zinnowitz, finish in Ahlbeck (Marathon)
11 aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, bananas, gels, and cola
additional: The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours (cut-off at 16:00). Exceeding the time limit results in no further course security or catering. The relay consists of 5 segments with at least 3 runners per team, with classifications for female, male, and mixed teams. Start areas are Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, with a common finish area in Ahlbeck. There is a professional entertainment and information program from 10:00 to 18:00 at the finish area. Running on sand, no asphalt course, start and finish areas in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, including catering, medal, certificate, and shuttle transfers.
